After the roots <s>dār</s> and <s>sah</s> when <s>pūḥ</s> (city) or <s>sarva</s> (all) [is the <s>upapada</s>].
After the root <s>kaṣ</s> when <s>sarva</s>, <s>kūla</s>, <s>abhra</s>, or <s>karīṣa</s> (dried dung) [is the <s>upapada</s>].
After the root <s>kṛñ</s> when <s>megha</s> (cloud), <s>ṛti</s> (attack), or <s>bhaya</s> (fear) [is the <s>upapada</s>].
And the affix <s>aṇ</s> [is added] when <s>kṣema</s> (safety), <s>priya</s> (dear), or <s>madra</s> [is the <s>upapada</s>].
After the root <s>bhū</s> when <s>āśita</s> (eaten) [is the <s>upapada</s>], in the senses of instrument (<s>karaṇa</s>) and abstract state (<s>bhāva</s>).
In the sense of a proper name (<s>sañjñā</s>), [the affix <s>aṇ</s> is added] after [the roots] <s>bhṛ</s>, <s>tṝ</s>, <s>vṛ</s>, <s>ji</s>, <s>dhār</s>, <s>sah</s>, <s>tap</s>, and <s>dam</s>.
And after the root <s>gam</s>.
The affix <s>ḍa</s> [is added] when [the <s>upapada</s> is one of the following:] <s>anta</s>, <s>atyanta</s>, <s>adhvan</s>, <s>dūra</s>, <s>pāra</s>, <s>sarva</s>, and <s>ananta</s>.
After the root <s>han</s> in the sense of a benediction (<s>āśis</s>).
After the root [<s>han</s>] with [the preverb] <s>apa</s>, when <s>kleśa</s> (affliction) or <s>tamas</s> (darkness) [is the <s>upapada</s>].
The affix <s>ṇini</s> [is added] when <s>kumāra</s> (boy) or <s>śīrṣa</s> (head) [is the <s>upapada</s>].
The affix <s>ṭak</s> [is added] in the sense of a characteristic mark (<s>lakṣaṇa</s>) when <s>jāyā</s> (wife) or <s>pati</s> (husband) [is the <s>upapada</s>].
And when the agent is non-human.
After [the root denoting] strength, when <s>hasti</s> (elephant) or <s>kapāṭa</s> (door-panel) [is the <s>upapada</s>].
[The compounds] <s>pāṇigha</s> and <s>tāḍagha</s> [are formed] in the sense of a craftsman.

body.text: āḍhya-subhaga-sthūla-palita-nagna-andha-priyeṣu cvy-artheṣv acvau kṛñaḥ karaṇe khyun || PS_3,2.56 ||
body.translated_text: After the root <s>kṛñ</s> when [the <s>upapada</s>] has the sense of the <s>cvi</s> formation — [with words like] <s>āḍhya</s>, <s>subhaga</s>, <s>sthūla</s>, <s>palita</s>, <s>nagna</s>, <s>andha</s>, and <s>priya</s> — the affix <s>khyun</s> [is added] in the sense of instrument (<s>karaṇa</s>), and <s>acvi</s> [is not applied].
After the root <s>bhū</s>, in the sense of the agent, [the affixes] <s>khiṣṇuc</s> and <s>khukañ</s> [are added].
After the root <s>spṛś</s>, [the affix] <s>kvin</s> [is added] when the sense does not involve water.
And in [the words] <s>ṛtvik</s>, <s>dadhṛk</s>, <s>sraj</s>, <s>dik</s>, <s>uṣṇik</s>, <s>añcu</s>, <s>yuj</s>, and <s>kruñca</s> [the affix <s>kvin</s> is used].

After the root <s>dṛś</s>, when [the <s>upapada</s> is one of] the <s>tyad</s>-group of pronouns, [the affix <s>kvin</s> is added] when the sense is not 'looking at,' and [the affix] <s>kañ</s> [is also added].

After [the roots] <s>as</s>, <s>sū</s>, <s>dviṣ</s>, <s>druh</s>, <s>duh</s>, <s>yuj</s>, <s>vid</s>, <s>bhid</s>, <s>chid</s>, <s>ji</s>, <s>nī</s>, and <s>rāj</s>, the affix <s>kvip</s> [is added], even when preceded by an <s>upasarga</s>.
The affix <s>ṇvi</s> [is added] after the root <s>bhaj</s>.
After the root <s>sah</s> in Vedic literature (<s>chandas</s>).
And after the root <s>vah</s>.
The affix <s>ñyuṭ</s> [is added] in [the words] <s>kavya</s>, <s>purīṣa</s>, and <s>purīṣya</s>.
In [the word] <s>havya</s>, [the affix <s>ñyuṭ</s> is added] not at the end of a <s>pāda</s> (verse-quarter).
The affix <s>viṭ</s> [is added] after [the roots] <s>jan</s>, <s>san</s>, <s>khan</s>, <s>kram</s>, and <s>gam</s>.
After the root <s>ad</s> (to eat), [the affix <s>viṭ</s> is added] when the sense is not food.
And in [the word] <s>kravya</s> (raw flesh) [the affix <s>viṭ</s> is added after <s>ad</s>].
After the root <s>duh</s>, [the affix] <s>kab</s> [is added], and also <s>ghaś</s>.
In <s>mantra</s> (Vedic formulas), [the suffixes] <s>ṇvi</s> [are applied after the roots] <s>śveta</s>, <s>vaha</s>, <s>uktha</s>, <s>śas</s>, and <s>puroḍāśa</s>. || PS 3.2.71 ||
[The suffix <s>ṇvi</s> is applied after] <s>yaj</s> (to sacrifice) [when preceded by] <s>ave</s>. || PS 3.2.72 ||
[The suffix <s>ṇvi</s> is applied after] <s>vij</s> (to separate) [when preceded by] <s>upe</s>, in <s>Chandas</s> (Vedic language). || PS 3.2.73 ||
[After a root ending in] <s>ā</s>, [the suffixes] <s>manin</s>, <s>kvanip</s>, and <s>vanip</s> [are also applied]. || PS 3.2.74 ||
[Affixes] are also seen [applied] after other [roots]. || PS 3.2.75 ||
And [the suffix] <s>kvip</s> [is applied]. || PS 3.2.76 ||
[After the root] <s>sthā</s> (to stand), [the suffix] <s>ka</s> [is applied] also. || PS 3.2.77 ||

[When a case-ending beginning with] <s>sup</s> [follows], and when it is not [denoting] birth, [the suffix] <s>ṇini</s> [is applied] in the sense of habitual action (<s>tācchīlya</s>). || PS 3.2.78 ||
[The suffix <s>ṇini</s> is applied] to the agent in the sense of comparison (<s>upamāna</s>). || PS 3.2.79 ||
[The suffix <s>ṇini</s> is applied] in the sense of a vow (<s>vrata</s>). || PS 3.2.80 ||
[The suffix <s>ṇini</s> is applied] variously (<s>bahulam</s>) in the sense of frequency (<s>ābhīkṣṇya</s>). || PS 3.2.81 ||
[The suffix <s>ṇini</s> is applied with] <s>manas</s> (mind). || PS 3.2.82 ||
[The suffix <s>ṇini</s> is applied] in the sense of self-estimation (<s>ātmamāna</s>), and [the suffix] <s>khaś</s> [as well]. || PS 3.2.83 ||
[The suffix <s>ṇini</s> is applied] in the sense of the past (<s>bhūta</s>). || PS 3.2.84 ||
[The suffix <s>ṇini</s> is applied] in the sense of instrument (<s>karaṇa</s>) [after the root] <s>yaj</s> (to sacrifice). || PS 3.2.85 ||
[The suffix <s>ṇini</s> is applied] in the sense of object (<s>karman</s>) [after the root] <s>han</s> (to kill). || PS 3.2.86 ||
[The suffix] <s>kvip</s> [is applied after <s>han</s>] in connection with <s>Brahman</s>, <s>bhrūṇa</s> (embryo), and <s>Vṛtra</s>. || PS 3.2.87 ||
[The suffix <s>kvip</s> is applied] variously (<s>bahulam</s>) in <s>Chandas</s> (Vedic language). || PS 3.2.88 ||

[The suffix <s>kvip</s> is applied after the root] <s>kṛ</s> (to do) in connection with <s>su</s> (good), <s>karman</s> (action), <s>pāpa</s> (sin), <s>mantra</s>, and <s>puṇya</s> (merit). || PS 3.2.89 ||
[The suffix <s>kvip</s> is applied after the root] <s>su</s> (to press out) in connection with <s>soma</s>. || PS 3.2.90 ||
[The suffix <s>kvip</s> is applied after the root] <s>ci</s> (to arrange) in connection with <s>agni</s> (fire). || PS 3.2.91 ||
[The suffix <s>kvip</s> is applied] in the sense of object (<s>karman</s>) when the [compound] is a name for <s>agni</s> (fire). || PS 3.2.92 ||

[The suffix] <s>ini</s> [is applied after the root] <s>kṛ</s> (to do) in the sense of object (<s>karman</s>) [when the derivative is an adjective denoting] transformation (<s>vikriyā</s>). || PS 3.2.93 ||
[The suffix] <s>kvanip</s> [is applied after the root] <s>dṛś</s> (to see). || PS 3.2.94 ||
[The suffix <s>kvanip</s> is applied after the roots] <s>yudh</s> (to fight) and <s>kṛ</s> (to do) in connection with <s>rājan</s> (king). || PS 3.2.95 ||
And [after the root] <s>sah</s> (to endure). || PS 3.2.96 ||
[The suffix] <s>ḍa</s> [is applied after the root] <s>jan</s> (to be born) when a seventh-case (locative) [word is in composition]. || PS 3.2.97 ||
[The suffix <s>ḍa</s> is applied] with a fifth-case (ablative) [word], when it is not [denoting] birth. || PS 3.2.98 ||
And [the suffix <s>ḍa</s> is applied] with a <s>upasarga</s> (preverb) in the sense of a proper name (<s>saṃjñā</s>). || PS 3.2.99 ||
[The suffix] <s>anu</s> [is applied] in the sense of object (<s>karman</s>). || PS 3.2.100 ||
[This suffix] is also seen [applied] in other [senses]. || PS 3.2.101 ||
<s>Niṣṭhā</s> [denotes the past participle suffixes <s>kta</s> and <s>ktavatu</s>]. || PS 3.2.102 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṅvanip</s> [is applied after the roots] <s>su</s> (to press) and <s>yaj</s> (to sacrifice). || PS 3.2.103 ||
[The suffix] <s>atṛn</s> [is applied after the root] <s>jṝ</s> (to grow old). || PS 3.2.104 ||
[The affix] <s>liṭ</s> (perfect tense) [is used] in <s>Chandas</s> (Vedic language). || PS 3.2.105 ||
[The suffix] <s>kānac</s> optionally [replaces the affix] <s>liṭ</s> (perfect). || PS 3.2.106 ||
And [the suffix] <s>kvasu</s> [replaces <s>liṭ</s>]. || PS 3.2.107 ||
In <s>bhāṣā</s> (spoken language), [<s>kvasu</s> is applied] after [the roots] <s>sad</s> (to sit), <s>vas</s> (to dwell), and <s>śru</s> (to hear). || PS 3.2.108 ||
And [the forms] <s>upeyivān</s>, <s>anāśvān</s>, and <s>anūcāna</s> [are also formed]. || PS 3.2.109 ||
[The affix] <s>luṅ</s> (aorist) [is used for recent past]. || PS 3.2.110 ||
[The affix] <s>laṅ</s> (imperfect) [is used] for the non-today past (<s>anadyatana</s>). || PS 3.2.111 ||
[The affix] <s>lṛṭ</s> (periphrastic future) [is used] in the sense of expressing something to one who has knowledge (<s>abhijñāvacana</s>). || PS 3.2.112 ||
[<s>lṛṭ</s> is] not [used] if [the particle] <s>yadi</s> (if) [is present]. || PS 3.2.113 ||
Optionally (<s>vibhāṣā</s>) [<s>lṛṭ</s> is used] when there is expectation (<s>sākāṅkṣa</s>). || PS 3.2.114 ||
[The affix] <s>liṭ</s> (perfect) [is used] for the unwitnessed past (<s>parokṣa</s>). || PS 3.2.115 ||
And [the affix] <s>laṅ</s> (imperfect) [is used] with [the particles] <s>ha</s> and <s>śaśvat</s> (always). || PS 3.2.116 ||
And in a question (<s>praśna</s>) referring to the recent past (<s>āsannakāla</s>). || PS 3.2.117 ||
[The affix] <s>laṭ</s> (present tense) [is used] with [the particle] <s>sma</s>. || PS 3.2.118 ||
And [<s>laṭ</s> is used] for the witnessed (<s>aparokṣa</s>) [past]. || PS 3.2.119 ||
[<s>laṭ</s> is used] with [the particles] <s>nanu</s> (is it not so?) in a question and its reply. || PS 3.2.120 ||
Optionally (<s>vibhāṣā</s>) [<s>laṭ</s> is used] with [the particles] <s>na</s> and <s>nu</s>. || PS 3.2.121 ||
[The affix] <s>luṅ</s> (aorist) [is also used] with [the particle] <s>puri</s> (formerly), and not with <s>sma</s>. || PS 3.2.122 ||
[The affix] <s>laṭ</s> (present tense) [is used] for the present (<s>vartamāna</s>). || PS 3.2.123 ||
[The participle suffixes] <s>śatṛ</s> and <s>śānac</s> [replace] <s>laṭ</s> [when the participle is] not in the nominative case or not in apposition [with the subject]. || PS 3.2.124 ||
And in address (<s>sambodhana</s>). || PS 3.2.125 ||
[<s>Śatṛ</s> and <s>śānac</s> replace <s>laṭ</s>] when the action serves as a characteristic (<s>lakṣaṇa</s>) or a reason (<s>hetu</s>). || PS 3.2.126 ||
Those two [i.e., <s>śatṛ</s> and <s>śānac</s>] [may also be called] <s>sat</s>. || PS 3.2.127 ||
[The suffix] <s>śānan</s> [replaces <s>laṭ</s>] after [the roots] <s>pū</s> (to purify) and <s>yaj</s> (to sacrifice). || PS 3.2.128 ||
And [the suffix] <s>cānaś</s> [is applied] in the senses of habitual nature (<s>tācchīlya</s>), age (<s>vayovacana</s>), and capacity (<s>śakti</s>). || PS 3.2.129 ||
[The suffixes] <s>śatra</s> and <s>kṛcchrin</s> [are applied after the roots] <s>iṅ</s> (to study) and <s>dhṛ</s> (to hold). || PS 3.2.130 ||
[The suffix <s>kṛcchrin</s> is applied after the root] <s>dviṣ</s> (to hate) in the sense of 'enemy' (<s>amitra</s>). || PS 3.2.131 ||
[The suffix is applied after the root] <s>su</s> (to press) in connection with <s>yajña</s> (sacrifice). || PS 3.2.132 ||
[The root] <s>arh</s> (to deserve) [takes the suffix] in the sense of praise (<s>praśaṃsā</s>). || PS 3.2.133 ||

Up to [the root] <s>kvi</s>, [the suffixes are applied] in the senses of habitual nature (<s>tācchīlya</s>), inherent quality (<s>taddharma</s>), and one who performs well (<s>tatsādhukāri</s>). || PS 3.2.134 ||
[The suffix] <s>tṛn</s> [is applied in these senses]. || PS 3.2.135 ||

[The suffix] <s>iṣṇuc</s> [is applied after the roots] <s>alaṅkṛ</s> (to adorn), <s>nirākṛ</s> (to reject), <s>prajana</s> (to beget), <s>utpaca</s> (to boil over), <s>utpata</s> (to fly up), <s>unmada</s> (to become mad), <s>ruc</s> (to shine), <s>apatrapa</s> (to be ashamed), <s>vṛtu</s> (to turn), <s>vṛdhu</s> (to grow), <s>sah</s> (to endure), and <s>car</s> (to move). || PS 3.2.136 ||
[The suffix <s>iṣṇuc</s> is applied after the causative root] <s>ṇi</s> in <s>Chandas</s> (Vedic language). || PS 3.2.137 ||
And [after the root] <s>bhū</s> (to be). || PS 3.2.138 ||
And [after the roots] <s>glā</s> (to be weary), <s>ji</s> (to conquer), and <s>sthā</s> (to stand), [the suffix] <s>kṣnu</s> [is applied]. || PS 3.2.139 ||
[The suffix] <s>knu</s> [is applied after the roots] <s>tras</s> (to tremble), <s>gṛdh</s> (to be greedy), <s>dhṛṣ</s> (to dare), and <s>kṣip</s> (to throw). || PS 3.2.140 ||
[The suffix] <s>ghinuṇ</s> [is applied after] the eight [roots] beginning with <s>śam</s> (to be calm). || PS 3.2.141 ||

And [after the roots] <s>saṃpṛc</s>, <s>anurudh</s>, <s>āṅyam</s>, <s>āṅyas</s>, <s>parisṛ</s>, <s>saṃsṛj</s>, <s>paridevi</s>, <s>saṃjvar</s>, <s>parikṣip</s>, <s>pariraṭ</s>, <s>parivad</s>, <s>paridah</s>, <s>parimuh</s>, <s>duṣ</s>, <s>dviṣ</s>, <s>druh</s>, <s>duh</s>, <s>yuj</s>, <s>ākrīḍ</s>, <s>vivic</s>, <s>tyaj</s>, <s>raj</s>, <s>bhaj</s>, <s>aticar</s>, <s>apacar</s>, <s>āmuṣ</s>, and <s>abhyāhan</s>. || PS 3.2.142 ||
[The suffix <s>ghinuṇ</s> is applied after the roots] <s>kaṣ</s> (to rub), <s>las</s> (to play), <s>katth</s> (to boast), and <s>srambh</s> (to trust) with [the preverb] <s>va</s>. || PS 3.2.143 ||
And [after the root] <s>laṣ</s> (to desire) with [the preverb] <s>ape</s>. || PS 3.2.144 ||

[After the roots] <s>lap</s> (to speak), <s>sṛ</s> (to flow), <s>dru</s> (to run), <s>math</s> (to churn), <s>vad</s> (to speak), and <s>vas</s> (to dwell) with [the preverb] <s>pre</s>. || PS 3.2.145 ||

[The suffix] <s>vuñ</s> [is applied after the roots] <s>nind</s> (to blame), <s>hiṃs</s> (to injure), <s>kliś</s> (to torment), <s>khād</s> (to eat), <s>vināś</s> (to destroy), <s>parikṣip</s>, <s>pariraṭ</s>, <s>parivādi</s>, <s>vyābhāṣ</s>, and <s>asūy</s> (to be jealous). || PS 3.2.146 ||
And [after the roots] <s>devi</s> (to lament) and <s>kraś</s> (to cry out) with a <s>upasarga</s> (preverb). || PS 3.2.147 ||
[The suffix] <s>yuc</s> [is applied after] an intransitive [root] having the meaning of motion or sound. || PS 3.2.148 ||
And [<s>yuc</s> is applied after] a root having an <s>anudātta</s> (unaccented) [vowel], beginning with a consonant. || PS 3.2.149 ||

[<s>Yuc</s> is applied after the roots] <s>ju</s> (to hasten), <s>caṅkramya</s> (to walk about), <s>dandramya</s>, <s>sṛ</s> (to flow), <s>gṛdh</s> (to be greedy), <s>jval</s> (to blaze), <s>śuc</s> (to grieve), <s>laṣ</s> (to desire), <s>pat</s> (to fall), and <s>pad</s> (to go). || PS 3.2.150 ||
And [after the roots] <s>krudh</s> (to be angry), <s>maṇḍ</s> (to adorn), and [those having the meaning of] <s>artha</s> (seeking). || PS 3.2.151 ||
[The suffix <s>yuc</s> is applied after a root] not [ending in the semivowel] <s>ya</s>. || PS 3.2.152 ||
And [after the roots] <s>sūd</s> (to flow), <s>dīp</s> (to shine), and <s>dīkṣ</s> (to be consecrated). || PS 3.2.153 ||

[The suffix] <s>ukañ</s> [is applied after the roots] <s>laṣ</s>, <s>pat</s>, <s>pad</s>, <s>sthā</s>, <s>bhū</s>, <s>vṛṣ</s> (to rain), <s>han</s>, <s>kam</s> (to desire), <s>gam</s> (to go), and <s>śṝ</s> (to crush). || PS 3.2.154 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṣākan</s> [is applied after the roots] <s>jalp</s> (to prattle), <s>bhikṣ</s> (to beg), <s>kuṭṭ</s> (to grind), <s>luṇṭ</s> (to rob), and <s>vṛṅ</s> (to choose). || PS 3.2.155 ||
[The suffix] <s>ini</s> [is applied after the root] <s>praj</s> (to beget). || PS 3.2.156 ||

And [after the roots] <s>ji</s> (to conquer), <s>dṛ</s> (to tear), <s>kṣi</s> (to destroy), <s>viśri</s>, <s>iṇ</s> (to go), <s>vam</s> (to vomit), <s>avyath</s>, <s>abhyam</s>, <s>paribhū</s>, and <s>prasū</s>. || PS 3.2.157 ||

[The suffix] <s>āluc</s> [is applied after the roots] <s>spṛh</s> (to desire), <s>gṛh</s> (to seize), <s>pat</s> (to fall), <s>day</s> (to pity), <s>nidrā</s> (to sleep), <s>dandrā</s>, and <s>śraddhā</s> (to have faith). || PS 3.2.158 ||
[The suffix] <s>ru</s> [is applied after the roots] <s>dā</s> (to give), <s>dheṭ</s> (to suck), <s>si</s> (to bind), <s>śad</s> (to fall), and <s>sad</s> (to sit). || PS 3.2.159 ||
[The suffix] <s>kmarac</s> [is applied after the roots] <s>sṛ</s> (to flow), <s>ghas</s> (to eat), and <s>ad</s> (to eat). || PS 3.2.160 ||
[The suffix] <s>ghurac</s> [is applied after the roots] <s>bhañj</s> (to break), <s>bhās</s> (to shine), and <s>mid</s> (to melt). || PS 3.2.161 ||
[The suffix] <s>kurac</s> [is applied after the roots] <s>vid</s> (to find), <s>bhid</s> (to split), and <s>chid</s> (to cut). || PS 3.2.162 ||
[The suffix] <s>kvarap</s> [is applied after the roots] <s>iṇ</s> (to go), <s>naś</s> (to perish), <s>ji</s> (to conquer), and <s>sṛ</s> (to flow). || PS 3.2.163 ||
And [the form] <s>gatvara</s> [is also formed]. || PS 3.2.164 ||
[The suffix] <s>ūka</s> [is applied after] <s>jāgṛ</s> (to be awake). || PS 3.2.165 ||
[The suffix for the] <s>yaṅ</s> (intensive) [of the roots] <s>yaj</s> (to sacrifice), <s>jap</s> (to mutter), and <s>daś</s> (to bite). || PS 3.2.166 ||

[The suffix] <s>ra</s> [is applied after the roots] <s>nam</s> (to bend), <s>kamp</s> (to tremble), <s>smi</s> (to smile), <s>aj</s> (to drive), <s>as</s> (to throw), <s>kam</s> (to desire), <s>hiṃs</s> (to injure), and <s>dīp</s> (to shine). || PS 3.2.167 ||
[The suffix] <s>u</s> [is applied after the desiderative] <s>san</s>, <s>āśaṃs</s> (to hope), and <s>bhikṣ</s> (to beg). || PS 3.2.168 ||
[After the root] <s>vid</s> (to find), [the form] <s>icchu</s> (desiring) [is derived]. || PS 3.2.169 ||
[The affix] <s>kyāc</s> [is used] in <s>Chandas</s> (Vedic language). || PS 3.2.170 ||

[After the roots] <s>ād</s> (to eat), <s>ṛ</s> (to go), <s>gam</s> (to go), <s>han</s> (to kill), and <s>jan</s> (to be born), [the suffixes] <s>ki</s> and <s>kin</s> [are applied], and <s>liṭ</s> (perfect) [is also used]. || PS 3.2.171 ||
[After the roots] <s>svap</s> (to sleep) and <s>tṛṣ</s> (to thirst), [the suffix] <s>najiṅ</s> [is applied]. || PS 3.2.172 ||
[The suffix] <s>āru</s> [is applied after the roots] <s>śṝ</s> (to crush) and <s>vand</s> (to praise). || PS 3.2.173 ||
[After the root] <s>bhī</s> (to fear), [the suffixes] <s>kru</s> and <s>klukan</s> [are applied]. || PS 3.2.174 ||
[The suffix] <s>varac</s> [is applied after the roots] <s>sthā</s> (to stand), <s>īś</s> (to rule), <s>bhās</s> (to shine), <s>pis</s> (to grind), and <s>kas</s> (to go). || PS 3.2.175 ||
And [the suffix] <s>ya</s> [is applied after the intensive] <s>yaṅ</s>. || PS 3.2.176 ||

[The suffix] <s>kvip</s> [is applied after the roots] <s>bhrāj</s> (to shine), <s>bhās</s> (to shine), <s>dhurv</s> (to injure), <s>dyut</s> (to shine), <s>ūrj</s> (to strengthen), <s>pṝ</s> (to fill), <s>ju</s> (to hasten), <s>gru</s> (to swallow), <s>āvas</s> (to call), and <s>stu</s> (to praise). || PS 3.2.177 ||
[Affixes] are also seen [applied] after other [roots]. || PS 3.2.178 ||
[The suffix <s>kvip</s> is applied after the root] <s>bhū</s> (to be) in the sense of a proper name (<s>saṃjñā</s>) and in other [senses]. || PS 3.2.179 ||
[The suffix] <s>ḍa</s> [is applied after <s>bhū</s>] with [the preverbs] <s>vi</s>, <s>pra</s>, and <s>sam</s>, not in the sense of a proper name. || PS 3.2.180 ||
[After the root] <s>dhā</s> (to place), [the suffix] <s>ṣṭran</s> [is applied] in the sense of instrument (<s>karaṇa</s>). || PS 3.2.181 ||

[The suffix <s>ṣṭran</s> is applied after the roots] <s>dā</s> (to bind), <s>nī</s> (to lead), <s>śas</s> (to cut), <s>yu</s> (to join), <s>yuj</s> (to yoke), <s>stu</s> (to praise), <s>tud</s> (to strike), <s>si</s> (to bind), <s>sic</s> (to sprinkle), <s>mih</s> (to urinate), <s>pat</s> (to fall), <s>daś</s> (to bite), and <s>nah</s> (to bind) in the sense of instrument (<s>karaṇa</s>). || PS 3.2.182 ||
[The suffix <s>ṣṭran</s> is applied after the root] <s>pu</s> (to purify) in connection with <s>hala</s> (plough) and <s>sūkara</s> (boar). || PS 3.2.183 ||

[The suffix] <s>itra</s> [is applied after the roots] <s>arti</s> (to go), <s>lū</s> (to cut), <s>dhū</s> (to shake), <s>sū</s> (to produce), <s>khan</s> (to dig), <s>sah</s> (to endure), and <s>car</s> (to move). || PS 3.2.184 ||
[The suffix <s>itra</s> is applied after the root] <s>pu</s> (to purify) in the sense of a proper name (<s>saṃjñā</s>). || PS 3.2.185 ||
[The suffix <s>itra</s> is applied] to the agent (<s>kartṛ</s>) in connection with a <s>ṛṣi</s> (sage) and a deity (<s>devatā</s>). || PS 3.2.186 ||
[After a root preceded by the affix] <s>ñī</s>, [the suffix] <s>kta</s> [is applied]. || PS 3.2.187 ||
And [<s>kta</s> is applied] after [roots] in the senses of thought (<s>mati</s>), understanding (<s>buddhi</s>), and reverence (<s>pūjā</s>). || PS 3.2.188 ||
[The suffixes beginning with] <s>uṇādi</s> [are applied] variously (<s>bahulam</s>). || PS 3.3.1 ||
[These suffixes] are also seen [applied] in the sense of the past (<s>bhūta</s>). || PS 3.3.2 ||
[Forms such as] <s>gamya</s> and others [are used] in the sense of the future (<s>bhaviṣyat</s>). || PS 3.3.3 ||
[The affix] <s>laṭ</s> (present tense) [is used] with the particles <s>yāvat</s> (as long as) and <s>purā</s> (before). || PS 3.3.4 ||
Optionally (<s>vibhāṣā</s>) [<s>laṭ</s> is used] with <s>kadā</s> (when) and <s>karhi</s> (when). || PS 3.3.5 ||
[<s>Laṭ</s> is used] when an action is in progress, in the sense of desire (<s>lipsā</s>). || PS 3.3.6 ||
And [<s>laṭ</s> is used] when the desired object is being obtained. || PS 3.3.7 ||
And [<s>laṭ</s> is used] in the sense of <s>loṭ</s> (imperative) [and] in characterization. || PS 3.3.8 ||
And [the affix] <s>liṅ</s> (optative) [is used] for what extends beyond the current moment (<s>ūrdhvamauhūrtika</s>). || PS 3.3.9 ||
[The suffixes] <s>tumun</s> and <s>ṇvul</s> [are applied] when the action [of the main verb] is performed for the sake of [another] action. || PS 3.3.10 ||
And [these suffixes are applied] when they express a state (<s>bhāva</s>). || PS 3.3.11 ||
[The suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is applied] in the sense of object (<s>karman</s>) also. || PS 3.3.12 ||
[The affix] <s>lṛṭ</s> (periphrastic future) [is used] in the remaining [cases]. || PS 3.3.13 ||
[The suffix] <s>sat</s> optionally [replaces] <s>lṛṭ</s>. || PS 3.3.14 ||
[The affix] <s>luṭ</s> (first future) [is used] for the non-today [future] (<s>anadyatana</s>). || PS 3.3.15 ||
[The suffix] <s>ghañ</s> [is applied after the roots] <s>pad</s> (to go), <s>ruj</s> (to break), <s>viś</s> (to enter), and <s>spṛś</s> (to touch). || PS 3.3.16 ||
[<s>Ghañ</s> is applied after the root] <s>sṛ</s> (to flow) in the sense of 'firm' (<s>sthira</s>). || PS 3.3.17 ||
[<s>Ghañ</s> is applied] in the sense of action itself (<s>bhāva</s>). || PS 3.3.18 ||
And [<s>ghañ</s> is applied] in the sense of a non-agent <s>kāraka</s> (participant), in the sense of a proper name (<s>saṃjñā</s>). || PS 3.3.19 ||
[<s>Ghañ</s> is applied] after all [roots] in the sense of a name for a measure (<s>parimāṇa</s>). || PS 3.3.20 ||
And [after the root] <s>iṅ</s> (to study). || PS 3.3.21 ||
[<s>Ghañ</s> is applied after the root] <s>ru</s> (to sound) with a <s>upasarga</s> (preverb). || PS 3.3.22 ||
[<s>Ghañ</s> is applied after the roots] <s>yu</s> (to mix), <s>dru</s> (to run), and <s>du</s> (to burn) with [the preverb] <s>sam</s>. || PS 3.3.23 ||
[<s>Ghañ</s> is applied after the roots] <s>śri</s> (to resort to), <s>ṇī</s> (to lead), and <s>bhū</s> (to be) without a <s>upasarga</s> (preverb). || PS 3.3.24 ||
[<s>Ghañ</s> is applied after the roots] <s>kṣu</s> (to sneeze) and <s>śru</s> (to hear) with [the preverb] <s>va</s>. || PS 3.3.25 ||
[<s>Ghañ</s> is applied after the root] <s>ni</s> (to lead) with [the preverbs] <s>ava</s> and <s>ud</s>. || PS 3.3.26 ||
[<s>Ghañ</s> is applied after the roots] <s>dru</s> (to run), <s>stu</s> (to praise), and <s>sru</s> (to flow) with [the preverb] <s>pre</s>. || PS 3.3.27 ||
[<s>Ghañ</s> is applied after the roots] <s>pū</s> (to purify) and <s>lū</s> (to cut) with [the preverbs] <s>nir</s> and <s>abhi</s>. || PS 3.3.28 ||
[<s>Ghañ</s> is applied after the root] <s>gṛ</s> (to swallow) with [the preverbs] <s>un</s> and <s>ni</s>. || PS 3.3.29 ||
[<s>Ghañ</s> is applied after the root] <s>kṝ</s> (to scatter) in connection with grain (<s>dhānya</s>). || PS 3.3.30 ||
[<s>Ghañ</s> is applied after the root] <s>stu</s> (to praise) with [the preverb] <s>sam</s> in connection with <s>yajña</s> (sacrifice). || PS 3.3.31 ||
[<s>Ghañ</s> is applied after the root] <s>stṛ</s> (to spread) with [the preverb] <s>pre</s>, not in connection with sacrifice. || PS 3.3.32 ||
Optionally [<s>ghañ</s> is applied] in the sense of spreading (<s>prathana</s>), not [when the derivative denotes] a sound. || PS 3.3.33 ||
And [<s>ghañ</s> is applied] in the name of a Vedic meter (<s>chandas</s>). || PS 3.3.34 ||
[<s>Ghañ</s> is applied after the root] <s>grah</s> (to seize) with [the preverb] <s>ud</s>. || PS 3.3.35 ||
[<s>Ghañ</s> is applied after the root] <s>muṣ</s> (to steal) with [the preverb] <s>sam</s> in the sense of 'fist' (<s>muṣṭi</s>). || PS 3.3.36 ||

[<s>Ghañ</s> is applied after the roots] <s>nī</s> (to lead) and <s>ṇī</s> with [the preverbs] <s>pari</s> and <s>ni</s> in the senses of gambling (<s>dyūta</s>) and failure (<s>abhreṣa</s>). || PS 3.3.37 ||
[<s>Ghañ</s> is applied after the root] <s>iṇ</s> (to go) with [the preverb] <s>parā</s> in the sense of one who does not follow (<s>anupātyaya</s>). || PS 3.3.38 ||
[<s>Ghañ</s> is applied after the root] <s>śī</s> (to lie down) with [the preverbs] <s>vi</s> and <s>upa</s> in the sense of alternation (<s>paryāya</s>). || PS 3.3.39 ||
[<s>Ghañ</s> is applied after the root] <s>ci</s> (to gather) with [the preverb] <s>hasta</s> and <s>adāna</s> in the sense of non-theft (<s>asteya</s>). || PS 3.3.40 ||

[<s>Ghañ</s> is applied] with [the preverb] <s>ā</s> [after the root] <s>diś</s> (to point), and [the suffix] <s>ka</s> [is also applied], in the senses of dwelling (<s>nivāsa</s>), pyre (<s>citi</s>), body (<s>śarīra</s>), and resting place (<s>upasamādhāna</s>). || PS 3.3.41 ||
And [<s>ghañ</s> is applied] in the sense of assembly (<s>saṅgha</s>), not in the sense of 'higher and lower' (<s>anottarādhārya</s>). || PS 3.3.42 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṇac</s> [is applied] in the sense of reciprocal action (<s>karmavyatihāra</s>), and it is feminine (<s>strī</s>). || PS 3.3.43 ||
[The suffix] <s>inuṇ</s> [is applied] in the sense of action (<s>bhāva</s>) [when there is] pervasion (<s>abhividhi</s>). || PS 3.3.44 ||
[<s>Ghañ</s> is applied after the root] <s>grah</s> (to seize) with [the preverbs] <s>ava</s> and <s>ni</s> in the sense of abuse (<s>ākrośa</s>). || PS 3.3.45 ||
[<s>Ghañ</s> is applied] with [the preverb] <s>pre</s> in the sense of desire (<s>lipsā</s>). || PS 3.3.46 ||
[<s>Ghañ</s> is applied] with [the preverb] <s>para</s> in connection with <s>yajña</s> (sacrifice). || PS 3.3.47 ||
[<s>Ghañ</s> is applied after the root] <s>vṛ</s> (to choose) with [the preverb] <s>na</s> in connection with grain (<s>dhānya</s>). || PS 3.3.48 ||
[<s>Ghañ</s> is applied after the roots] <s>śray</s> (to resort to), <s>yaut</s> (to mix), <s>pū</s> (to purify), and <s>dru</s> (to run) with [the preverb] <s>ud</s>. || PS 3.3.49 ||
Optionally [<s>ghañ</s> is applied after the roots] <s>ru</s> (to sound) and <s>plu</s> (to float) with [the preverb] <s>āṅ</s>. || PS 3.3.50 ||
[<s>Ghañ</s> is applied after the root] <s>grah</s> (to seize) with [the preverb] <s>ava</s> in the sense of obstruction of rain (<s>varṣapratibandha</s>). || PS 3.3.51 ||
[<s>Ghañ</s> is applied] with [the preverb] <s>pre</s> in connection with merchants (<s>vaṇij</s>). || PS 3.3.52 ||
And [<s>ghañ</s> is applied] in the sense of 'rein' (<s>raśmi</s>). || PS 3.3.53 ||
[<s>Ghañ</s> is applied after the root] <s>vṛṇu</s> (to cover) in the sense of covering (<s>ācchādana</s>). || PS 3.3.54 ||
[<s>Ghañ</s> is applied after the root] <s>bhū</s> (to be) with [the preverb] <s>prau</s> in the sense of disrespect (<s>avajñāna</s>). || PS 3.3.55 ||
[The suffix] <s>ac</s> [is applied after the root] <s>ṛ</s> (to go). || PS 3.3.56 ||
[The suffix] <s>ap</s> [is applied after the roots] <s>ṝ</s> and others. || PS 3.3.57 ||
And [<s>ap</s> is applied after the roots] <s>grah</s> (to seize), <s>vṛ</s> (to choose), <s>dṛ</s> (to tear), <s>niś</s> (to examine), and <s>gam</s> (to go). || PS 3.3.58 ||
[<s>Ap</s> is applied after the root] <s>ad</s> (to eat) with a <s>upasarga</s> (preverb). || PS 3.3.59 ||
And [the suffix] <s>ṇa</s> [is applied] with [the preverb] <s>na</s>. || PS 3.3.60 ||
[<s>Ap</s> is applied after the roots] <s>vyadh</s> (to pierce) and <s>jap</s> (to mutter) without a <s>upasarga</s> (preverb). || PS 3.3.61 ||
Optionally [<s>ap</s> is applied after the roots] <s>svan</s> (to sound) and <s>has</s> (to laugh). || PS 3.3.62 ||
[<s>Ap</s> is applied after the root] <s>yam</s> (to restrain) with [the preverbs] <s>sam</s>, <s>upa</s>, <s>ni</s>, and <s>vi</s>. || PS 3.3.63 ||
[<s>Ap</s> is applied after the roots] <s>gad</s> (to speak), <s>nad</s> (to roar), <s>paṭh</s> (to recite), and <s>svan</s> (to sound) with [the preverb] <s>na</s>. || PS 3.3.64 ||
And [<s>ap</s> is applied after the root] <s>kvaṇ</s> (to ring) in connection with <s>vīṇā</s> (lute). || PS 3.3.65 ||
[<s>Ap</s> is applied] invariably (<s>nityam</s>) after [the root] <s>paṇ</s> (to barter) in the sense of measure (<s>parimāṇa</s>). || PS 3.3.66 ||
[<s>Ap</s> is applied after the root] <s>mad</s> (to be intoxicated) without a <s>upasarga</s> (preverb). || PS 3.3.67 ||
[The derivatives] <s>pramada</s> and <s>sammada</s> [are formed] in the sense of joy (<s>harṣa</s>). || PS 3.3.68 ||
[<s>Ap</s> is applied after the root] <s>aj</s> (to drive) with [the preverbs] <s>sam</s> and <s>ud</s> in connection with livestock (<s>paśu</s>). || PS 3.3.69 ||
[The derivative] <s>glaha</s> [is formed] in connection with dice (<s>akṣa</s>). || PS 3.3.70 ||
[<s>Ap</s> is applied after the root] <s>sṛ</s> (to flow) in the sense of offspring (<s>prajana</s>). || PS 3.3.71 ||

[After the root] <s>hū</s> (to call), [the suffix <s>ap</s> is applied] with <s>samprasāraṇa</s> (semivowel replacement), with [the preverbs] <s>ni</s>, <s>abhi</s>, <s>upa</s>, and <s>vi</s>. || PS 3.3.72 ||
[<s>Ap</s> is applied after <s>hū</s>] with [the preverb] <s>āṅ</s> in connection with battle (<s>yuddha</s>). || PS 3.3.73 ||
[The derivatives] <s>nipāna</s> (watering-place) and <s>āhāva</s> (invocation) [are formed]. || PS 3.3.74 ||
[<s>Ap</s> is applied] in the sense of action (<s>bhāva</s>) [after a root] without a <s>upasarga</s> (preverb). || PS 3.3.75 ||
And [after the root] <s>han</s> (to kill), [the derivative] <s>vadha</s> (killing) [is formed]. || PS 3.3.76 ||
[The derivative] <s>ghana</s> (solid mass) [is formed from <s>han</s>] in the sense of a solid form (<s>mūrti</s>). || PS 3.3.77 ||
[The derivative] <s>antarghana</s> [denotes] a space [within a building]. || PS 3.3.78 ||
[The derivatives] <s>praghaṇa</s> and <s>praghāṇa</s> [denote] a part of a house (<s>agāraikadeśa</s>). || PS 3.3.79 ||
[The derivative] <s>udghana</s> [denotes] a mortgage (<s>atyādhāna</s>). || PS 3.3.80 ||
[The derivative] <s>apaghana</s> [denotes] a limb (<s>aṅga</s>). || PS 3.3.81 ||
[<s>Ap</s> is applied after <s>han</s>] in the sense of instrument (<s>karaṇa</s>), in connection with iron (<s>ayas</s>) and wood (<s>vidru</s>). || PS 3.3.82 ||
And [the suffix] <s>ka</s> [is applied] in the sense of a stump (<s>stamba</s>). || PS 3.3.83 ||
[The suffix] <s>gha</s> [is applied] with [the preverb] <s>para</s>. || PS 3.3.84 ||
[The derivative] <s>upaghna</s> [denotes] a support (<s>āśraya</s>). || PS 3.3.85 ||
[The derivatives] <s>saṅgha</s> and <s>udgha</s> [are formed] in the senses of a group (<s>gaṇa</s>) and praise (<s>praśaṃsā</s>). || PS 3.3.86 ||
[The derivative] <s>nigha</s> [denotes] a cause (<s>nimitta</s>). || PS 3.3.87 ||
[The suffix] <s>ktri</s> [is applied after a root that takes the affix] <s>ḍvit</s>. || PS 3.3.88 ||
[The suffix] <s>athuc</s> [is applied after a root that takes the affix] <s>ṭvit</s>. || PS 3.3.89 ||

[The suffix] <s>naṅ</s> [is applied after the roots] <s>yaj</s> (to sacrifice), <s>yāc</s> (to request), <s>yat</s> (to strive), <s>vicch</s> (to desire), <s>pracch</s> (to ask), and <s>rakṣ</s> (to protect). || PS 3.3.90 ||
[The suffix] <s>nan</s> [is applied after the root] <s>svap</s> (to sleep). || PS 3.3.91 ||
[The suffix] <s>ki</s> [is applied after the root] <s>ghu</s> with a <s>upasarga</s> (preverb). || PS 3.3.92 ||
[<s>Ki</s> is applied] in the senses of object (<s>karman</s>) and location (<s>adhikaraṇa</s>) also. || PS 3.3.93 ||
[The suffix] <s>ktin</s> [is applied] in the feminine (<s>strī</s>). || PS 3.3.94 ||

[<s>Ktin</s> is applied after the roots] <s>sthā</s> (to stand), <s>gā</s> (to go), and <s>pā</s> (to drink) in the sense of action (<s>bhāva</s>), [and also after] <s>pac</s> (to cook). || PS 3.3.95 ||

In <s>mantra</s> (Vedic formulas), [the suffix <s>ktin</s> applied after the roots] <s>vṛṣ</s> (to rain), <s>iṣ</s> (to desire), <s>pac</s> (to cook), <s>man</s> (to think), <s>vid</s> (to know), <s>bhū</s> (to be), <s>vī</s> (to go), and <s>rā</s> (to give) [takes] <s>udātta</s> (acute accent). || PS 3.3.96 ||
And <s>ūti</s>, <s>yūti</s>, <s>jūti</s>, <s>sāti</s>, <s>heti</s>, and <s>kīrti</s> (are also irregular formations in the sense of the action). || 3.3.97 ||
The affix <s>kyap</s> comes after the roots <s>vraj</s> (to go) and <s>yaj</s> (to sacrifice) when the action itself is denoted. || 3.3.98 ||

In the sense of a proper name, (the affix <s>kyap</s> comes) after <s>sam-aj</s> (to drive together), <s>ni-sad</s> (to sit down), <s>ni-pat</s> (to fall down), <s>man</s> (to think), <s>vid</s> (to know), <s>ṣuñ</s> (to press out), <s>śīṅ</s> (to lie), <s>bhṛñ</s> (to bear), and <s>iṇ</s> (to go). || 3.3.99 ||
And after <s>kṛñ</s> (to do), the affix <s>śa</s> (also comes in the sense of a proper name). || 3.3.100 ||
(The word) <s>icchā</s> (desire, is formed irregularly). || 3.3.101 ||
(The feminine affix) <s>a</s> comes after a (preceding) affix. || 3.3.102 ||
And after a heavy syllable ending in a consonant. || 3.3.103 ||
The affix <s>aṅ</s> comes after roots marked with <s>ṣ</s> (as an indicatory letter), and after roots in the <s>bhidādi</s> group. || 3.3.104 ||
And (the affix <s>aṅ</s> comes) after <s>cint</s> (to think), <s>pūj</s> (to worship), <s>kath</s> (to tell), <s>kumb</s> (to cover), and <s>carc</s> (to study). || 3.3.105 ||
And after (roots ending in) <s>ā</s>, when a <s>upasarga</s> (preverb) is present. || 3.3.106 ||
The affix <s>yuc</s> comes after a causative (<s>ṇi</s>-derivative), and after <s>ās</s> (to sit) and <s>śranth</s> (to loosen). || 3.3.107 ||
The affix <s>ṇvul</s> is used variously (<s>bahulam</s>) in denoting a disease. || 3.3.108 ||
(The affix <s>ṇvul</s> is also used) in the sense of a proper name. || 3.3.109 ||
And the affix <s>iñ</s> (comes) in the sense of exposition (<s>vibhāṣākhyāna</s>) and inquiry (<s>paripraśna</s>). || 3.3.110 ||
The affix <s>ṇvuc</s> comes in the senses of succession (<s>paryāya</s>), worthiness (<s>arha</s>), debt (<s>ṛṇa</s>), and origin (<s>utpatti</s>). || 3.3.111 ||
In abuse (<s>ākrośa</s>), (the word) <s>ati</s> is used when <s>nañ</s> (the negative particle) is present. || 3.3.112 ||
The <s>kṛtya</s> affixes and <s>lyuṭ</s> are used variously (<s>bahulam</s>). || 3.3.113 ||
The affix <s>kta</s> (comes) in the neuter gender when the action itself (<s>bhāva</s>) is denoted. || 3.3.114 ||
And <s>lyuṭ</s> (also comes in the neuter when <s>bhāva</s> is denoted). || 3.3.115 ||

body.text: karmaṇi ca yena saṃsparśāt kartuḥ śarīra-sukham || PS_3,3.116 ||
body.translated_text: And in the sense of the object (<s>karman</s>), when through contact with which the agent experiences bodily pleasure. || 3.3.116 ||
And in the senses of instrument (<s>karaṇa</s>) and locus (<s>adhikaraṇa</s>). || 3.3.117 ||
In the masculine gender, in the sense of a proper name, the affix <s>gha</s> is used generally (<s>prāyeṇa</s>). || 3.3.118 ||

And (the following are also formed with <s>gha</s>): <s>gocara</s> (pasture), <s>sañcara</s> (passage), <s>vaha</s> (vehicle), <s>vraja</s> (cow-pen), <s>vyaja</s> (deception), <s>āpaṇa</s> (market), and <s>nigama</s> (town). || 3.3.119 ||
The affix <s>ghañ</s> comes after the roots <s>tṝ</s> (to cross) and <s>stṛ</s> (to spread) when preceded by <s>ava</s>. || 3.3.120 ||
And (the affix <s>ghañ</s> comes) after (roots ending in) a consonant. || 3.3.121 ||

And (the following are also formed with <s>ghañ</s>): <s>adhyāya</s> (chapter), <s>nyāya</s> (rule), <s>udyāva</s> (a kind of shelter), <s>saṃhāra</s> (collection), <s>ādhāra</s> (support), and <s>āvāya</s> (weaving). || 3.3.122 ||
(The word) <s>udaṅka</s> (is formed with <s>ghañ</s>) when not referring to water. || 3.3.123 ||
A net (<s>jālam</s>) is called <s>ānāya</s>. || 3.3.124 ||
And the affix <s>gha</s> comes after <s>khan</s> (to dig). || 3.3.125 ||
The affix <s>khal</s> comes after <s>īṣat</s> (slightly), <s>dus</s> (with difficulty), and <s>su</s> (easily), in the senses of difficult and not difficult. || 3.3.126 ||
And (the affix <s>khal</s> comes) in the senses of agent (<s>kartṛ</s>) and object (<s>karman</s>) after <s>bhū</s> (to be) and <s>kṛñ</s> (to do). || 3.3.127 ||
The affix <s>yuc</s> comes after (roots ending in) <s>ā</s>. || 3.3.128 ||
In Vedic usage (<s>chandas</s>), (the affix <s>yuc</s> comes) after roots meaning motion. || 3.3.129 ||
(The affix <s>yuc</s>) is also seen after other (roots in Vedic usage). || 3.3.130 ||
When the present tense is proximate (<s>sāmīpya</s>), optionally the present tense form may be used as if it were the present. || 3.3.131 ||
And in expressing expectation (<s>āśaṃsā</s>), (the present tense may be used) as if it were the past. || 3.3.132 ||
The <s>lṛṭ</s> (simple future tense) is used in expressing quickness. || 3.3.133 ||
The <s>liṅ</s> (optative mood) is used in expressing a wish (<s>āśaṃsā</s>). || 3.3.134 ||
Not like the non-today-past tense (<s>anadyatanavat</s>) in the senses of continuity of action (<s>kriyāprabandha</s>) and proximity (<s>sāmīpya</s>). || 3.3.135 ||
In expressing a limit (<s>maryādā</s>) in the future, (the present tense is used) with reference to the nearer (of two points in time). || 3.3.136 ||
And in a division of time (<s>kālavibhāga</s>), except for days and nights. || 3.3.137 ||
Optionally with reference to the farther (point in time). || 3.3.138 ||
The <s>lṛṅ</s> (conditional mood) is used when the condition for <s>liṅ</s> (optative) exists but the action has lapsed (<s>kriyātipatti</s>). || 3.3.139 ||
And (the <s>lṛṅ</s> is used to express) the past (in conditional sentences). || 3.3.140 ||
(The <s>lṛṅ</s> is used) with <s>vā</s>, <s>ū</s>, <s>uta</s>, and <s>api</s>. || 3.3.141 ||
In reproach (<s>garhā</s>), <s>laṭ</s> (present tense) is used with <s>api</s> and <s>jātu</s>. || 3.3.142 ||
Optionally, <s>liṅ</s> (optative) is also used with <s>katham</s> (how). || 3.3.143 ||
When the sense is 'what has happened?' (<s>kiṃvṛtta</s>), <s>liṅ</s> (optative) and <s>lṛṭ</s> (future) are used. || 3.3.144 ||
In the senses of impossibility (<s>anavaklṛpti</s>) and impatience (<s>amarṣa</s>), (these are used) even when the sense is not <s>kiṃvṛtta</s>. || 3.3.145 ||
The <s>lṛṭ</s> (future) is used in the senses of <s>kim</s>, <s>kila</s>, and <s>asti</s>. || 3.3.146 ||
The <s>liṅ</s> (optative) is used with <s>jātu</s> and <s>yad</s>. || 3.3.147 ||
(The <s>liṅ</s> is also used) with <s>yacca</s> and <s>yatrā</s>. || 3.3.148 ||
And in reproach (<s>garhā</s>). || 3.3.149 ||
And in expressing wonder (<s>citrīkaraṇa</s>). || 3.3.150 ||
In the remaining cases, <s>lṛṭ</s> (future) is used when the affix does not begin with <s>aya</s>. || 3.3.151 ||
The <s>liṅ</s> (optative) is used with <s>uta</s> and <s>api</s> when they are connected in sense. || 3.3.152 ||
In expressing a wish (<s>kāmapravedana</s>), (the <s>liṅ</s> is used) when <s>kaccit</s> is not present. || 3.3.153 ||
In supposition (<s>sambhāvana</s>), (the <s>liṅ</s> is used) with <s>alam</s> and the like, if the action is not actually accomplished. || 3.3.154 ||
Optionally (the <s>liṅ</s> is used) with a verbal root in expressing supposition, when <s>yadi</s> (if) is not present. || 3.3.155 ||
The <s>liṅ</s> (optative) is used to express the relation of cause (<s>hetu</s>) and effect (<s>hetumat</s>). || 3.3.156 ||
The <s>liṅ</s> (optative) and <s>loṭ</s> (imperative) are used in the sense of desire (<s>icchā</s>). || 3.3.157 ||
The affix <s>tumun</s> (infinitive) is used when the agent of both actions is the same (<s>samānakartṛka</s>). || 3.3.158 ||
And <s>liṅ</s> (optative may also be used in that sense). || 3.3.159 ||
After roots meaning desire (<s>icchārtha</s>), optionally (the <s>liṅ</s> or <s>tumun</s> is used) in the present tense. || 3.3.160 ||

The <s>liṅ</s> (optative) is used in the senses of injunction (<s>vidhi</s>), invitation (<s>nimantraṇa</s>), courteous address (<s>āmantraṇa</s>), command (<s>adhīṣṭa</s>), inquiry (<s>saṃpraśna</s>), and request (<s>prārthana</s>). || 3.3.161 ||
And <s>loṭ</s> (imperative) (is also used in those senses). || 3.3.162 ||
In the senses of direction (<s>praiṣa</s>), permission (<s>atisarga</s>), and the appropriate time (<s>prāptakāla</s>), the <s>kṛtya</s> affixes are also used. || 3.3.163 ||
And <s>liṅ</s> (optative is used) when the time exceeds a <s>muhūrta</s> (48 minutes). || 3.3.164 ||
The <s>loṭ</s> (imperative) is used with <s>sma</s>. || 3.3.165 ||
And in a command (<s>adhīṣṭa</s>). || 3.3.166 ||
The affix <s>tumun</s> (infinitive) is used with (words denoting) time (<s>kāla</s>), occasion (<s>samaya</s>), and moment (<s>velā</s>). || 3.3.167 ||
The <s>liṅ</s> (optative) is used with <s>yadi</s> (if). || 3.3.168 ||
In the sense of worthiness (<s>arha</s>), the <s>kṛtya</s> affixes and <s>tṛc</s> are also used. || 3.3.169 ||
The affix <s>ṇini</s> is used in the senses of obligation (<s>āvaśyaka</s>) and indebtedness (<s>ādhamarṇya</s>). || 3.3.170 ||
And the <s>kṛtya</s> affixes (are also used in those senses). || 3.3.171 ||
With <s>śak</s> (to be able), <s>liṅ</s> (optative) is also used. || 3.3.172 ||
In blessing (<s>āśis</s>), <s>liṅ</s> (optative) and <s>loṭ</s> (imperative) are used. || 3.3.173 ||
And (the affixes) <s>ktic</s> and <s>kta</s> (are used) in the sense of a proper name. || 3.3.174 ||
The <s>luṅ</s> (aorist) is used with <s>mā</s> (prohibition particle). || 3.3.175 ||
And <s>laṅ</s> (imperfect) is used after <s>sma</s>. || 3.3.176 ||
Verbal affixes (<s>pratyaya</s>) are connected with a verbal root (<s>dhātu</s>). || 3.4.1 ||

body.text: kriyāsam-abhihāre loṭ loṭo hi-svau vā ca ta-dhvamoḥ || PS_3,4.2 ||
body.translated_text: In frequentative action (<s>kriyāsamabhihāra</s>), <s>loṭ</s> (imperative) is used; and of <s>loṭ</s>, the particles <s>hi</s> and <s>su</s> optionally replace the endings of <s>ta</s> and <s>dhvam</s>. || 3.4.2 ||
Optionally in a combination (<s>sayuccaya</s>). || 3.4.3 ||
The regular application (<s>yathāvidhyanuprayoga</s>) pertains to the preceding (rule). || 3.4.4 ||
(In) aggregation (<s>samuccaya</s>), (this applies) to a general term (<s>sāmānyavacana</s>). || 3.4.5 ||
In Vedic usage (<s>chandas</s>), <s>luṅ</s> (aorist), <s>laṅ</s> (imperfect), and <s>liṭ</s> (perfect) (are used interchangeably). || 3.4.6 ||
The <s>leṭ</s> (Vedic subjunctive) is used in the sense of <s>liṅ</s> (optative). || 3.4.7 ||
And in persuasion (<s>upasaṃvāda</s>) and apprehension (<s>āśaṅkā</s>). || 3.4.8 ||

In the sense of the infinitive (<s>tumun</s>), (the following Vedic affixes are used): <s>se</s>, <s>sen</s>, <s>ase</s>, <s>asen</s>, <s>kṣe</s>, <s>kasen</s>, <s>adhyai</s>, <s>adhyain</s>, <s>kadhyai</s>, <s>kadhyain</s>, <s>śadhyai</s>, <s>śadhyain</s>, <s>tavai</s>, <s>taveṅ</s>, and <s>tavena</s>. || 3.4.9 ||
(The Vedic infinitives) <s>prayai</s>, <s>rohiṣyai</s>, and <s>avyathiṣyai</s> (are also used). || 3.4.10 ||
And <s>dṛśe</s> (to see) and <s>vikhye</s> (to appear) (are also Vedic infinitive forms). || 3.4.11 ||
With <s>śak</s> (to be able), the affixes <s>ṇamul</s> and <s>kamul</s> are used. || 3.4.12 ||
With <s>īśvara</s> (a lord, in the sense of ability), the affixes <s>tosun</s> and <s>kasun</s> are used. || 3.4.13 ||
In the sense of the <s>kṛtya</s> affixes, (the Vedic affixes) <s>tavai</s>, <s>ken</s>, <s>kenya</s>, and <s>tvana</s> (are used). || 3.4.14 ||
And (these are used) with <s>avacakṣe</s> (in the sense of seeing, disapproving). || 3.4.15 ||

In continuous action without interruption (<s>bhāvalakṣaṇa</s>), the affix <s>tosun</s> comes after <s>sthā</s> (to stand), <s>iṇ</s> (to go), <s>kṛñ</s> (to do), <s>vad</s> (to speak), <s>car</s> (to move), <s>hu</s> (to sacrifice), <s>tam</s> (to be exhausted), and <s>jan</s> (to be born). || 3.4.16 ||
The affix <s>kasun</s> comes after <s>sṛp</s> (to creep) and <s>tṛd</s> (to split). || 3.4.17 ||
According to the eastern grammarians (<s>prācām</s>), <s>ktvā</s> is used with <s>alam</s> (enough) and <s>khalu</s> (indeed) in the sense of prohibition. || 3.4.18 ||
According to the northern grammarians (<s>udīcām</s>), (the <s>ktvā</s> affix is used) with <s>mā</s> in reciprocal action (<s>vyatīhāra</s>). || 3.4.19 ||
And in connection with <s>para</s> (after) and <s>avara</s> (before). || 3.4.20 ||
(The affix <s>ktvā</s> is used) when two actions have the same agent (<s>samānakartṛka</s>) and one precedes (<s>pūrvakāla</s>) the other. || 3.4.21 ||
And the affix <s>ṇamul</s> (is used) in the sense of repetition (<s>ābhīkṣṇya</s>). || 3.4.22 ||
Not (used) when there is no syntactic expectation (<s>ānākāṅkṣa</s>) with <s>yad</s>. || 3.4.23 ||
Optionally with <s>agre</s> (before), <s>prathama</s> (first), and <s>pūrva</s> (prior). || 3.4.24 ||
In abuse directed at the object (<s>karman</s>), the affix <s>khamuñ</s> comes after <s>kṛñ</s> (to do). || 3.4.25 ||
The affix <s>ṇamul</s> is used with <s>svādum</s> (sweetly, pleasantly). || 3.4.26 ||
With <s>anyathā</s> (otherwise), <s>evam</s> (thus), <s>katham</s> (how), and <s>ittham</s> (in this way), if the action is not actually accomplished. || 3.4.27 ||
With <s>yathā</s> (as) and <s>tathā</s> (so) in the sense of reproach and reply. || 3.4.28 ||
(The affix <s>ṇamul</s> is used) with the object (<s>karman</s>) after <s>dṛś</s> (to see) and <s>vid</s> (to know) when completeness (<s>sākalya</s>) is meant. || 3.4.29 ||
(The affix <s>ṇamul</s> is used) with <s>yāvat</s> (as long as) after <s>vind</s> (to find) and <s>jīv</s> (to live). || 3.4.30 ||
(The affix <s>ṇamul</s> is used) with <s>carman</s> (skin) and <s>udara</s> (belly) after <s>pūr</s> (to fill). || 3.4.31 ||

body.text: varṣa-pramāṇa ūlopaś ca asya anyatrasyām || PS_3,4.32 ||
body.translated_text: With a measure of years (<s>varṣapramāṇa</s>), with elision of <s>ū</s>, and optionally in other cases. || 3.4.32 ||
(The affix <s>ṇamul</s> is used) with <s>cela</s> (cloth) after <s>knop</s> (to moisten). || 3.4.33 ||
With <s>nimūla</s> (uprooted) and <s>samūla</s> (with the root), (the affix <s>ṇamul</s> is used) after <s>kaṣ</s> (to rub, scrape). || 3.4.34 ||
With <s>śuṣka</s> (dry), <s>cūrṇa</s> (powdered), and <s>rūkṣa</s> (rough), (the affix <s>ṇamul</s> is used) after <s>piṣ</s> (to grind). || 3.4.35 ||

With <s>samūla</s> (with root), <s>akṛta</s> (undone), and <s>jīva</s> (alive), (the affix <s>ṇamul</s> is used) after <s>han</s> (to kill), <s>kṛñ</s> (to do), and <s>grah</s> (to seize). || 3.4.36 ||
With the instrument (<s>karaṇa</s>), (the affix <s>ṇamul</s> is used) after <s>han</s> (to strike). || 3.4.37 ||
With (a word denoting) anointing (<s>snehana</s>), (the affix <s>ṇamul</s> is used) after <s>piṣ</s> (to grind). || 3.4.38 ||
With <s>hasta</s> (hand), (the affix <s>ṇamul</s> is used) after <s>vart</s> (to turn) and <s>grah</s> (to seize). || 3.4.39 ||
With <s>sva</s> (one's own), (the affix <s>ṇamul</s> is used) after <s>puṣ</s> (to nourish). || 3.4.40 ||
With the locus (<s>adhikaraṇa</s>), (the affix <s>ṇamul</s> is used) after <s>vandh</s> (to bind). || 3.4.41 ||
(These formations with <s>ṇamul</s> apply) in the sense of a proper name (<s>sañjñā</s>). || 3.4.42 ||
With the agent (<s>kartṛ</s>) being <s>jīva</s> (a living being) or <s>puruṣa</s> (a person), (the affix <s>ṇamul</s> is used) after <s>naś</s> (to perish) and <s>vah</s> (to carry). || 3.4.43 ||
With <s>ūrdhva</s> (upward), (the affix <s>ṇamul</s> is used) after <s>śuṣ</s> (to dry) and <s>pūr</s> (to fill). || 3.4.44 ||
And in comparison (<s>upamāna</s>) and with the object (<s>karman</s>). || 3.4.45 ||
With the <s>kaṣādi</s> group (of words), regular application follows (<s>yathāvidhyanuprayoga</s>). || 3.4.46 ||
(The word) <s>upadaṃśa</s> (a relish, side dish) takes the third case (instrumental). || 3.4.47 ||
And (the affix <s>ṇamul</s> is used) with verbs meaning injury (<s>hiṃsārtha</s>) that share the same object. || 3.4.48 ||
And with the locative (seventh case), (the affix <s>ṇamul</s> is used) after <s>upapīḍ</s> (to press), <s>rudh</s> (to obstruct), and <s>karṣ</s> (to drag). || 3.4.49 ||
(The affix <s>ṇamul</s> is used) in close proximity (<s>samāsatti</s>). || 3.4.50 ||
And with a measure (<s>pramāṇa</s>). || 3.4.51 ||
With the ablative (<s>apādāna</s>), in the sense of seeking to obtain (<s>parīpsā</s>). || 3.4.52 ||
And with the accusative (second case). || 3.4.53 ||
With one's own body (<s>svāṅga</s>), when it is not fixed (<s>adhruva</s>). || 3.4.54 ||
And when (the body part) is being afflicted (<s>pariklaśyamāna</s>). || 3.4.55 ||
(The affix <s>ṇamul</s> is used) after <s>viś</s> (to enter), <s>pat</s> (to fall), <s>pad</s> (to go), and <s>skand</s> (to leap), in the senses of being pervaded and being frequented. || 3.4.56 ||
(The affix <s>ṇamul</s> is used) after <s>as</s> (to throw) and <s>tṛṣ</s> (to thirst), when another action intervenes, in (expressions of) time. || 3.4.57 ||
(The affix <s>ṇamul</s> is used) with a name (<s>nāman</s>) after <s>ādiś</s> (to point out) and <s>grah</s> (to seize). || 3.4.58 ||
With an indeclinable (<s>avyaya</s>), in the sense of an action not as intended (<s>ayathābhipretākhyāna</s>), the affixes <s>ktvā</s> and <s>ṇamul</s> come after <s>kṛñ</s> (to do). || 3.4.59 ||
(The affix <s>ṇamul</s> is used) with <s>tiryac</s> (transversely) in the sense of deviation (<s>apavarga</s>). || 3.4.60 ||
With one's own body (<s>svāṅga</s>), when the affix <s>tas</s> follows, (the affix <s>ṇamul</s> is used) after <s>kṛ</s> (to do) and <s>bhū</s> (to be). || 3.4.61 ||
When neither <s>nā</s> (name-forming) nor <s>dhā</s> (placing) nor a meaning-bearing affix is present, (the affix <s>ṇamul</s> is used) in the sense of <s>cvi</s> (becoming). || 3.4.62 ||
With <s>tūṣṇīm</s> (silently), (the affix <s>ṇamul</s> is used) after <s>bhū</s> (to be). || 3.4.63 ||
With <s>anvac</s> (following), in the sense of conformity (<s>ānulomya</s>). || 3.4.64 ||

The affix <s>tumun</s> (infinitive) is used in the senses of ability (<s>śak</s>), daring (<s>dhṛṣ</s>), knowing (<s>jñā</s>), languishing (<s>glā</s>), striving (<s>ghaṭ</s>), undertaking (<s>rabh</s>), obtaining (<s>labh</s>), proceeding (<s>kram</s>), enduring (<s>sah</s>), deserving (<s>arh</s>), and being (<s>asti</s>). || 3.4.65 ||
(The affix <s>tumun</s> is used) in expressions of sufficiency (<s>paryāptivacana</s>), in the sense of <s>alam</s> (enough). || 3.4.66 ||
A <s>kṛt</s> (primary derivative affix) denotes the agent (<s>kartṛ</s>). || 3.4.67 ||
<s>Bhavya</s>, <s>geya</s>, <s>pravacanīya</s>, <s>upasthānīya</s>, <s>janya</s>, <s>āplāvya</s>, and <s>āpātyā</s> are optionally (used to denote the agent). || 3.4.68 ||

body.text: laḥ karmaṇi ca bhāve ca akramakebhyaḥ || PS_3,4.69 ||
body.translated_text: The <s>la</s>-affixes (finite verb endings) denote the object (<s>karman</s>) and the action (<s>bhāva</s>), but not after intransitive roots (<s>akarmaka</s>). || 3.4.69 ||
Of those two (object and action), the <s>kṛtya</s>, <s>kta</s>, and <s>khal</s> affixes also express the same meanings. || 3.4.70 ||
The affix <s>kta</s> denotes the object when it is the primary object (<s>ādikarman</s>), and also denotes the agent. || 3.4.71 ||

And (the affix <s>kta</s> denotes the agent) after roots of motion (<s>gatyartha</s>), intransitive roots (<s>akarmaka</s>), <s>śliṣ</s> (to embrace), <s>śīṅ</s> (to lie), <s>sthā</s> (to stand), <s>ās</s> (to sit), <s>vas</s> (to dwell), <s>jan</s> (to be born), <s>ruh</s> (to grow), and <s>jṝ</s> (to age). || 3.4.72 ||
<s>Dāśa</s> (a fisherman) and <s>goghna</s> (a guest, lit. cow-slayer) denote the recipient (<s>sampradāna</s>). || 3.4.73 ||
<s>Bhīma</s> and others denote the source (<s>apādāna</s>). || 3.4.74 ||
In senses other than those two (agent and object), the <s>uṇādi</s> affixes (are used). || 3.4.75 ||
The affix <s>kta</s> also denotes the locus (<s>adhikaraṇa</s>) after roots meaning fixity (<s>dhrauvya</s>), motion (<s>gati</s>), and cessation (<s>pratyavasāna</s>). || 3.4.76 ||
(The following are the substitutes) of <s>la</s> (the abstract verb-affix placeholder). || 3.4.77 ||

<s>Tip</s>, <s>tas</s>, <s>jhi</s>, <s>sip</s>, <s>thas</s>, <s>tha</s>, <s>mib</s>, <s>vas</s>, <s>mas</s>, <s>ta</s>, <s>ātām</s>, <s>jha</s>, <s>thās</s>, <s>āthām</s>, <s>dhvam</s>, <s>iḍ</s>, <s>vahi</s>, and <s>mahiṅ</s> (are the eighteen personal endings). || 3.4.78 ||
Of the <s>ātmanepada</s> endings, <s>ṭa</s>-marked ones are replaced by <s>e</s>. || 3.4.79 ||
<s>Thās</s> is replaced by <s>se</s>. || 3.4.80 ||
In <s>liṭ</s> (perfect tense), <s>ta</s> and <s>jha</s> are replaced by <s>eś</s> and <s>irec</s> respectively. || 3.4.81 ||

Of the <s>parasmaipada</s> (active voice endings), (the <s>liṭ</s> substitutes are) <s>ṇal</s>, <s>atus</s>, <s>us</s>, <s>thal</s>, <s>athus</s>, <s>a</s>, <s>ṇal</s>, <s>va</s>, and <s>ma</s>. || 3.4.82 ||
After <s>vid</s> (to know), optionally (these <s>liṭ</s> endings are used) in the present tense (<s>laṭ</s>). || 3.4.83 ||

body.text: bruvaḥ pañcānām ādita āho bruvaḥ || PS_3,4.84 ||
body.translated_text: Of <s>brū</s> (to speak), for the first five (endings), <s>āha</s> (a form of <s>brū</s>) is substituted. || 3.4.84 ||
The endings of <s>loṭ</s> (imperative) are like those of <s>laṅ</s> (imperfect). || 3.4.85 ||
<s>E</s> is replaced by <s>u</s>. || 3.4.86 ||
<s>Se</s> is replaced by <s>hi</s>, and also by <s>api</s>. || 3.4.87 ||
Optionally in Vedic usage (<s>chandas</s>). || 3.4.88 ||
<s>Me</s> is replaced by <s>ni</s>. || 3.4.89 ||
<s>Ām</s> replaces <s>eta</s>. || 3.4.90 ||
After <s>sa</s> and <s>va</s>, the endings <s>vām</s> and <s>au</s> (are substituted). || 3.4.91 ||
The augment <s>āṭ</s> is prefixed to the first person (<s>uttamasya</s>), and (it receives) <s>pit</s> (marking). || 3.4.92 ||
<s>Eta</s> is replaced by <s>ai</s>. || 3.4.93 ||
In <s>leṭ</s> (Vedic subjunctive), the augments <s>aṭ</s> and <s>āṭ</s> (are added). || 3.4.94 ||
<s>Āta</s> is replaced by <s>ai</s>. || 3.4.95 ||
Optionally, <s>e</s> (replaces <s>āta</s>) elsewhere. || 3.4.96 ||
And <s>it</s> is elided in the <s>parasmaipada</s> (active) endings. || 3.4.97 ||
<s>Sa</s> (replaces the ending) of the first person (<s>uttamasya</s>). || 3.4.98 ||
Always for (endings) marked with <s>ḍ</s> (as an indicatory letter). || 3.4.99 ||
And (elision occurs for endings beginning with) <s>it</s>. || 3.4.100 ||
<s>Tas</s>, <s>thas</s>, <s>tha</s>, and <s>mip</s> are replaced by <s>tām</s>, <s>tam</s>, <s>ta</s>, and <s>am</s> respectively. || 3.4.101 ||
In <s>liṅ</s> (optative), the augment <s>sīyuṭ</s> (is added). || 3.4.102 ||

body.text: yāsuṭ parasmaipadesu udātto ṅic ca || PS_3,4.103 ||
body.translated_text: The augment <s>yāsuṭ</s> (is added) in the <s>parasmaipada</s> (active voice), with <s>udātta</s> accent and the marker <s>ṅit</s>. || 3.4.103 ||
(The augment is) marked with <s>kit</s> in benediction (<s>āśis</s>). || 3.4.104 ||
<s>Jha</s> is replaced by <s>ran</s>. || 3.4.105 ||
<s>Iṭ</s> is replaced by <s>at</s>. || 3.4.106 ||
The augment <s>suṭ</s> (is added) to (endings beginning with) <s>ti</s> and <s>th</s>. || 3.4.107 ||
<s>Jhi</s> is replaced by <s>jus</s>. || 3.4.108 ||
And (this replacement occurs) after <s>sic</s> (the aorist marker), reduplicated stems (<s>abhyasta</s>), and <s>vid</s> (to know). || 3.4.109 ||
(This replacement occurs) after (stems ending in) <s>ā</s>. || 3.4.110 ||
In <s>laṅ</s> (imperfect), according to <s>Śākaṭāyana</s> only. || 3.4.111 ||
And after <s>dviṣ</s> (to hate). || 3.4.112 ||
The <s>tiṅ</s> endings and affixes marked with <s>ś</s> are called <s>sārvadhātuka</s> (applicable to the whole root). || 3.4.113 ||
The remainder is called <s>ārdhadhātuka</s> (applicable to half the root). || 3.4.114 ||
And <s>liṭ</s> (perfect tense, is also <s>ārdhadhātuka</s>). || 3.4.115 ||
The <s>liṅ</s> (optative) in benediction (<s>āśis</s>) (is also <s>ārdhadhātuka</s>). || 3.4.116 ||
In Vedic usage (<s>chandas</s>), (the <s>liṅ</s> and <s>liṭ</s> affixes may be) both ways (either <s>sārvadhātuka</s> or <s>ārdhadhātuka</s>). || 3.4.117 ||
After a feminine marker (<s>ṅī</s>), a feminine marker (<s>āp</s>), or a nominal stem (<s>prātipadika</s>), (case endings are added). || 4.1.1 ||

The case endings are: <s>su</s>, <s>au</s>, <s>jas</s>, <s>am</s>, <s>auṭ</s>, <s>śas</s>, <s>ṭā</s>, <s>bhyām</s>, <s>bhis</s>, <s>ṅe</s>, <s>bhyām</s>, <s>bhyas</s>, <s>ṅasi</s>, <s>bhyām</s>, <s>bhyas</s>, <s>ṅas</s>, <s>os</s>, <s>ām</s>, <s>ṅi</s>, <s>os</s>, and <s>sup</s>. || 4.1.2 ||
In the feminine (gender, the following affixes are added). || 4.1.3 ||
The affix <s>ṭāp</s> comes after (stems) beginning with a vowel and ending in short <s>a</s>. || 4.1.4 ||
The affix <s>ṅīp</s> comes after (stems ending in) <s>ṛ</s> and <s>n</s>. || 4.1.5 ||
And after (stems formed with affixes) marked with <s>u</s> as an indicatory letter. || 4.1.6 ||
After <s>van</s>-ending stems, <s>ra</s> is substituted (for <s>n</s>) as well. || 4.1.7 ||
[The feminine suffix <s>ṅīṣ</s> is added] to [a word ending in] <s>pāda</s> (foot) optionally. || PS_4,1.8 ||
<s>Ṭāp</s> [is added] in [Vedic] <s>ṛc</s> (verse). || PS_4,1.9 ||
Not from <s>ṣaṭ</s> (six), <s>svasṛ</s> (sister), and others [in the <s>svasrādi</s> list]. || PS_4,1.10 ||
[Not from the word] <s>manas</s> (mind). || PS_4,1.11 ||
[Not] from [a word ending in] <s>ana</s> [when it is part] of a <s>bahuvrīhi</s> (possessive compound). || PS_4,1.12 ||
<s>Ḍāp</s> [is added after] both [<s>ubha</s> and the preceding items] optionally. || PS_4,1.13 ||
[<s>Ḍāp</s> is added] when [the word is] not a subordinate member (<s>anupasarjana</s>) [of a compound]. || PS_4,1.14 ||

[<s>Ṅīp</s> is the feminine suffix] after [suffixes] <s>ṭiḍ</s>, <s>ḍha</s>, <s>aṇ</s>, <s>añ</s>, <s>dvayasac</s>, <s>daghnañ</s>, <s>mātrac</s>, <s>tayap</s>, <s>ṭhak</s>, <s>ṭhañ</s>, <s>kañ</s>, <s>kvarap</s>, and <s>khyun</s>. || PS_4,1.15 ||
And [after the suffix] <s>yañ</s>. || PS_4,1.16 ||
[In the usage] of the easterners (<s>prācām</s>), <s>ṣpha</s> [is added as] a <s>taddhita</s> (secondary derivative suffix). || PS_4,1.17 ||
Everywhere [i.e., in all dialects, <s>ṅīp</s> is added] from [words in] the <s>lohitādi</s> (list beginning with <s>lohita</s>) and <s>katanta</s> [list]. || PS_4,1.18 ||
And from <s>Kauravya</s> and <s>Māṇḍūka</s>. || PS_4,1.19 ||
[<s>Ṅīp</s> is added] in the first [period of] age (<s>vayasi prathame</s>). || PS_4,1.20 ||
[<s>Ṅīp</s> is added after] a <s>dvigu</s> (numeral compound). || PS_4,1.21 ||
Not [after] <s>aparimāṇa</s> (immeasurable), <s>bista</s>, <s>ācita</s>, and <s>kambalya</s> when there is <s>luk</s> (elision) of the <s>taddhita</s> [suffix]. || PS_4,1.22 ||
[<s>Ṅīp</s> is added after a compound] ending in <s>kāṇḍa</s> [when it denotes] a field (<s>kṣetra</s>). || PS_4,1.23 ||
[<s>Ṅīp</s> is added] after [a compound with] <s>puruṣa</s> (man) [as prior member when it denotes] a measure (<s>pramāṇa</s>), optionally. || PS_4,1.24 ||
[The feminine suffix] <s>ṅīṣ</s> [is added] after <s>ūdhas</s> (udder) [when it is the final member] of a <s>bahuvrīhi</s> (possessive compound). || PS_4,1.25 ||
<s>Ṅīp</s> [is added after a compound] beginning with a numeral (<s>saṅkhyā</s>) or an indeclinable (<s>avyaya</s>). || PS_4,1.26 ||
And [after compounds ending in] <s>dāman</s>, <s>hāyana</s>, and [words] not ending in <s>a</s> (<s>anāc</s>). || PS_4,1.27 ||
[<s>Ṅīp</s> is added] after [a word whose] penultimate (<s>upadhā</s>) <s>a</s> is elided (<s>lopa</s>), optionally. || PS_4,1.28 ||
Obligatorily (<s>nityam</s>) in proper names (<s>sañjñā</s>) and in Vedic [usage] (<s>chandas</s>). || PS_4,1.29 ||

And after <s>kevala</s> (sole), <s>māmaka</s> (mine), <s>bhāgadheya</s> (destiny), <s>pāpa</s> (sinful), <s>apara</s> (other), <s>samāna</s> (equal), <s>āryakṛta</s> (done by the noble), <s>sumaṅgala</s> (auspicious), and <s>bheṣaja</s> (medicine). || PS_4,1.30 ||
And after <s>rātri</s> (night), [but] not [the suffixes] <s>a</s> or <s>au</s>. || PS_4,1.31 ||
[The augment] <s>nuk</s> [is inserted before <s>ṅīp</s>] after <s>antarvatī</s> (pregnant) and <s>pativatī</s> (having a husband). || PS_4,1.32 ||
Of <s>pati</s> (husband/lord), [the substitute] <s>na</s> [replaces the final] when not in connection with a sacrifice (<s>yajñasaṃyoga</s>). || PS_4,1.33 ||
Optionally when [<s>pati</s> is] preceded [by another word in a compound] (<s>sapūrvasya</s>). || PS_4,1.34 ||
Obligatorily in [the words] <s>sapatnī</s> (co-wife) and others [in the <s>sapatnyādi</s> list]. || PS_4,1.35 ||
And [the substitute] <s>ai</s> [is applied] after <s>pūtakratu</s> (of pure resolve). || PS_4,1.36 ||
[The feminine forms] of <s>Vṛṣākapi</s>, <s>Agni</s>, <s>Kusita</s>, and <s>Kusida</s> have <s>udātta</s> (acute accent) [on the final]. || PS_4,1.37 ||
After <s>manu</s>, [the suffix] <s>au</s> optionally [replaces <s>ṅīp</s>]. || PS_4,1.38 ||
From a color term (<s>varṇa</s>) that is <s>anudātta</s> (unaccented) and has <s>ta</s> as its penultimate (<s>topadhāt</s>), [the suffix] <s>na</s> [is added]. || PS_4,1.39 ||
From other [words], <s>ṅīṣ</s> [is the feminine suffix]. || PS_4,1.40 ||
And from [words ending in affixes marked with] <s>ṣ</s> as <s>it</s> (<s>ṣit</s>), and from [words in] the <s>gaurādi</s> (list beginning with <s>gaura</s>). || PS_4,1.41 ||

[<s>Ṅīṣ</s> is added after] <s>jānapada</s> (country), <s>kuṇḍa</s> (pot), <s>goṇa</s> (sack), <s>sthala</s> (ground), <s>bhāja</s> (sharing), <s>nāga</s> (serpent), <s>kāla</s> (black), <s>nīla</s> (blue), <s>kuśa</s> (grass), <s>kāmuka</s> (desirous), and <s>kabara</s> (variegated) [when they denote respectively] livelihood, vessel, covering, non-artificial [thing], boiling, stoutness, color, non-concealment, iron-product, desire for mating, and hair-style. || PS_4,1.42 ||
From <s>śoṇa</s> (red), [in the usage] of the easterners (<s>prācām</s>). || PS_4,1.43 ||
Optionally from [a word ending in] <s>u</s> [that is] a quality-denoting term (<s>guṇavacana</s>). || PS_4,1.44 ||
And from [words in] the <s>bahvādi</s> (list beginning with <s>bahu</s>). || PS_4,1.45 ||
Obligatorily in Vedic [usage] (<s>chandasi</s>). || PS_4,1.46 ||
And from <s>bhu</s> (earth). || PS_4,1.47 ||
[<s>Ṅīṣ</s> is added] from [a word denoting] association with a man (<s>puṃyoga</s>) when it is a proper name (<s>ākhyā</s>). || PS_4,1.48 ||

[The augment] <s>ānuk</s> [is inserted] after <s>Indra</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Bhava</s>, <s>Śarva</s>, <s>Rudra</s>, <s>Mṛḍa</s>, <s>Hima</s>, <s>Araṇya</s>, <s>Yava</s>, <s>Yavana</s>, <s>Mātula</s>, and <s>Ācārya</s>. || PS_4,1.49 ||
[<s>Ṅīṣ</s> is added] after [a word formed with the suffix] <s>krīta</s> (bought) preceded by [a word denoting] the instrument (<s>karaṇa</s>). || PS_4,1.50 ||
After [a word formed with the suffix] <s>kta</s>, when [the designation is] not a proper name (<s>alpākhyā</s>). || PS_4,1.51 ||
And after a <s>bahuvrīhi</s> (possessive compound) that is accented on the final (<s>antodātta</s>). || PS_4,1.52 ||
Optionally after [a <s>bahuvrīhi</s> compound] whose prior member (<s>pūrvapada</s>) is not a body part (<s>asvāṅga</s>). || PS_4,1.53 ||

And after [a <s>bahuvrīhi</s> with] a body part (<s>svāṅga</s>) [as prior member] that is subordinate (<s>upasarjana</s>) and does not have a conjunct consonant as its penultimate (<s>asaṃyogopadhāt</s>). || PS_4,1.54 ||

And after [<s>bahuvrīhi</s> compounds ending in] <s>nāsikā</s> (nose), <s>udara</s> (belly), <s>oṣṭha</s> (lip), <s>jaṅghā</s> (shin), <s>danta</s> (tooth), <s>karṇa</s> (ear), and <s>śṛṅga</s> (horn). || PS_4,1.55 ||
Not from [words in] the <s>kroḍādi</s> (list beginning with <s>kroḍa</s>) [that are] polysyllabic (<s>bahvac</s>). || PS_4,1.56 ||
And after [a compound with] <s>saha</s> (with), <s>nañ</s> (negative particle), or <s>vidyamāna</s> (existing) as the prior member. || PS_4,1.57 ||
After [compounds ending in] <s>nakha</s> (nail) and <s>mukha</s> (face), in the sense of a proper name (<s>sañjñāyām</s>). || PS_4,1.58 ||
And <s>dīrghajihvī</s> (long-tongued) in Vedic [usage] (<s>chandasi</s>). || PS_4,1.59 ||
<s>Ṅīp</s> [is added] after [a compound with] a direction (<s>dik</s>) as its prior member (<s>pūrvapada</s>). || PS_4,1.60 ||
[<s>Ṅīp</s> is added after the word] <s>vāhas</s> (carrying). || PS_4,1.61 ||
<s>Sakhī</s> (female friend) and <s>aśiṣvī</s> [take <s>ṅīp</s>] in common speech (<s>bhāṣāyām</s>). || PS_4,1.62 ||
From [a word denoting] a species (<s>jāti</s>), [when it is] not restricted to the female [and has] <s>aya</s> as its penultimate (<s>ayopadhāt</s>). || PS_4,1.63 ||

And after [compounds with] <s>pāka</s> (cooking), <s>karṇa</s> (ear), <s>parṇa</s> (leaf), <s>puṣpa</s> (flower), <s>phala</s> (fruit), <s>mūla</s> (root), and <s>vāla</s> (hair) as the final member (<s>uttarapada</s>). || PS_4,1.64 ||
[<s>Ṅīp</s> is added] after [a word ending in] <s>i</s> [that denotes] a human species (<s>manuṣyajāti</s>). || PS_4,1.65 ||
<s>Ūṅ</s> [is the feminine suffix] after [a word ending in] <s>u</s>. || PS_4,1.66 ||
After [a word] ending in <s>bāhu</s> (arm), in the sense of a proper name (<s>sañjñāyām</s>). || PS_4,1.67 ||
And after <s>paṅgu</s> (lame). || PS_4,1.68 ||
After [a compound with] <s>ūru</s> (thigh) as its final member (<s>uttarapada</s>), [when used] in the sense of comparison (<s>aupamya</s>). || PS_4,1.69 ||
And after <s>saṃhita</s> (joined), <s>śapha</s> (hoof), <s>lakṣaṇa</s> (mark), <s>vāma</s> (left/beautiful), and <s>ādeśa</s> (instruction). || PS_4,1.70 ||
After <s>kadru</s> and <s>kamaṇḍalu</s> (water-vessel), in Vedic [usage] (<s>chandasi</s>). || PS_4,1.71 ||
In the sense of a proper name (<s>sañjñāyām</s>) [<s>ūṅ</s> is added]. || PS_4,1.72 ||
<s>Ṅīn</s> [is the feminine suffix] after [words in] the <s>śārṅgaravādi</s> (list beginning with <s>Śārṅgarava</s>) ending in <s>a</s>. || PS_4,1.73 ||
And <s>cāp</s> [is the feminine suffix] after [words formed with the suffix] <s>yañ</s>. || PS_4,1.74 ||
And after [words ending in] <s>āvaṅya</s>. || PS_4,1.75 ||
[The following rules treat words formed with] <s>taddhita</s> (secondary derivative suffixes). || PS_4,1.76 ||
After <s>yūna</s> (young), [the suffix] <s>ti</s> [is added to form the feminine]. || PS_4,1.77 ||

body.text: aṇ-iñor anārṣayor guru-upottamayoḥ ṣyaṅ gotre || PS_4,1.78 ||
body.translated_text: [The suffix] <s>ṣyaṅ</s> [replaces] <s>aṇ</s> and <s>iñ</s>, when they are not Vedic (<s>anārṣa</s>), [and the base has] a heavy syllable as the penultimate (<s>guruupottama</s>), in [denoting] a <s>gotra</s> (lineage). || PS_4,1.78 ||
[<s>Ṣyaṅ</s> is added] after [a word denoting] a sub-branch (<s>avayava</s>) of a <s>gotra</s> (lineage). || PS_4,1.79 ||
And from [words in] the <s>krauḍyādi</s> (list beginning with <s>Krauḍī</s>). || PS_4,1.80 ||
From <s>Daivayajñi</s>, <s>Śaucivṛkṣi</s>, <s>Sātyamugri</s>, and <s>Kāṇṭheviddhi</s>, optionally. || PS_4,1.81 ||
Of [words that are] semantically connected (<s>samartha</s>), [the suffix is added] optionally after the first [word]. || PS_4,1.82 ||
Before [the section ending at the rule] <s>dīvyati</s>, [the default suffix is] <s>aṇ</s>. || PS_4,1.83 ||
And from [words in] the <s>aśvapatyādi</s> (list beginning with <s>Aśvapati</s>). || PS_4,1.84 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṇya</s> [is added] after [compounds with] <s>diti</s>, <s>aditi</s>, <s>āditya</s>, or <s>pati</s> as the final member (<s>uttarapada</s>). || PS_4,1.85 ||
From [words in] the <s>utsādi</s> (list beginning with <s>Utsa</s>), [the suffix] <s>añ</s> [is added]. || PS_4,1.86 ||
From <s>strī</s> (woman) and <s>puṃs</s> (man), [the suffixes] <s>nañ</s> and <s>snañ</s> [are added respectively, denoting offspring] from a dwelling (<s>bhavana</s>). || PS_4,1.87 ||
After a <s>dvigu</s> (numeral compound), <s>luk</s> (elision) [of the patronymic suffix occurs] when not [denoting] offspring (<s>anapatye</s>). || PS_4,1.88 ||
In [denoting] a <s>gotra</s> (lineage), there is no <s>luk</s> (elision) [when the suffix is followed by a vowel] (<s>alug aci</s>). || PS_4,1.89 ||
In [denoting] a <s>yuvan</s> (young descendant), <s>luk</s> (elision) [of the <s>gotra</s> suffix occurs]. || PS_4,1.90 ||
[The suffixes] <s>phak</s> and <s>phiñ</s> [undergo <s>luk</s>] optionally. || PS_4,1.91 ||
[The affix <s>aṇ</s> is added in the sense of] 'his offspring' (<s>tasya apatyam</s>). || PS_4,1.92 ||
A single [affix denotes] <s>gotra</s> (lineage). || PS_4,1.93 ||
From a <s>gotra</s> (lineage name), [an affix is added to denote] a <s>yuvan</s> (young descendant), [but] not in the feminine. || PS_4,1.94 ||
After [a base ending in] <s>a</s>, [the suffix] <s>iñ</s> [is added to denote a <s>yuvan</s>]. || PS_4,1.95 ||
And from [words in] the <s>bāhvādi</s> (list beginning with <s>Bāhu</s>). || PS_4,1.96 ||
After <s>Sudhātu</s>, [the suffix] <s>akaṅ</s> [is added] as well. || PS_4,1.97 ||
In [denoting] a <s>gotra</s> (lineage), from [words in] the <s>kuñjādi</s> (list beginning with <s>Kuñja</s>), [the suffix] <s>cphañ</s> [is added]. || PS_4,1.98 ||
From [words in] the <s>naḍādi</s> (list beginning with <s>Naḍa</s>), [the suffix] <s>phak</s> [is added]. || PS_4,1.99 ||
From [words in] the <s>haritādi</s> (list beginning with <s>Harita</s>), [the suffix] <s>añ</s> [is added]. || PS_4,1.100 ||
And [<s>añ</s> replaces the suffixes] <s>yañ</s> and <s>iñ</s>. || PS_4,1.101 ||
From <s>Śaradvat</s>, <s>Śunaka</s>, and <s>Darbha</s>, in [the lineages of] <s>Bhṛgu</s>, <s>Vatsa</s>, and <s>Āgrāyaṇa</s> [respectively]. || PS_4,1.102 ||
From <s>Droṇa</s>, <s>Parvata</s>, and <s>Jīvanta</s>, optionally. || PS_4,1.103 ||
When there is no immediate succession of sages (<s>anṛṣyānantarya</s>), from [words in] the <s>bidādi</s> (list beginning with <s>Bida</s>), [the suffix] <s>añ</s> [is added]. || PS_4,1.104 ||
From [words in] the <s>gargādi</s> (list beginning with <s>Garga</s>), [the suffix] <s>yañ</s> [is added]. || PS_4,1.105 ||
From <s>Madhu</s> and <s>Babhru</s>, in [the lineages of] <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> and <s>Kauśika</s> [respectively]. || PS_4,1.106 ||
From <s>Kapi</s> and <s>Bodha</s>, in [the lineage of] <s>Āṅgirasa</s>. || PS_4,1.107 ||
And from <s>Vataṇḍa</s>. || PS_4,1.108 ||
<s>Luk</s> (elision) [of the <s>gotra</s> suffix occurs] in the feminine. || PS_4,1.109 ||
From [words in] the <s>aśvādi</s> (list beginning with <s>Aśva</s>), [the suffix] <s>phañ</s> [is added]. || PS_4,1.110 ||
From <s>Bharga</s>, in [the clan of] <s>Traigarta</s>. || PS_4,1.111 ||
From [words in] the <s>śivādi</s> (list beginning with <s>Śiva</s>), [the suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is added]. || PS_4,1.112 ||
[<s>Aṇ</s> is added] from those names [of women] that are without <s>vṛddhi</s> (strengthened vowel), [being] river names (<s>nadī</s>) and human women (<s>mānuṣī</s>). || PS_4,1.113 ||
And from [the names] <s>Ṛṣi</s>, <s>Andhaka</s>, <s>Vṛṣṇi</s>, and <s>Kuru</s>. || PS_4,1.114 ||
From the mother (<s>mātuḥ</s>), [the suffix] <s>ut</s> [is added, when the mother's name] is preceded by a numeral (<s>saṅkhyā</s>), <s>sam</s>, <s>bhadra</s>, or <s>pūrva</s>. || PS_4,1.115 ||
And from <s>kanyā</s> (maiden), [the offspring is called] <s>kanīna</s>. || PS_4,1.116 ||
From <s>Vikarṇa</s>, <s>Śuṅga</s>, and <s>Chaṅgala</s>, in [the lineages of] <s>Vatsa</s>, <s>Bharadvāja</s>, and <s>Atri</s> [respectively]. || PS_4,1.117 ||
From <s>Pīlā</s>, optionally. || PS_4,1.118 ||
And [the suffix] <s>ṭhak</s> [is added] from <s>Maṇḍūka</s>. || PS_4,1.119 ||
From feminine [bases], [the suffix] <s>ḍhak</s> [is added to denote offspring]. || PS_4,1.120 ||
[<s>Ḍhak</s> is added] from [feminine bases] of two syllables (<s>dvyac</s>). || PS_4,1.121 ||
And from [feminine bases ending in] <s>i</s>, [when they are] not [formed with the suffix] <s>iñ</s>. || PS_4,1.122 ||
And from [words in] the <s>śubhrādi</s> (list beginning with <s>Śubhrā</s>). || PS_4,1.123 ||
From <s>Vikarṇā</s> and <s>Kuṣītakā</s>, in [the lineage of] <s>Kāśyapa</s>. || PS_4,1.124 ||
From <s>Bhru</s>, [the augment] <s>vuk</s> [is added] as well. || PS_4,1.125 ||
[The suffix] <s>inaṅ</s> [is added] from <s>Kalyāṇī</s> and others [in the <s>kalyāṇyādi</s> list]. || PS_4,1.126 ||
[<s>Inaṅ</s> is also added] from <s>Kulaṭā</s> (a wanton woman). || PS_4,1.127 ||
From <s>Caṭakā</s> (sparrow), [the suffix] <s>airak</s> [is added]. || PS_4,1.128 ||
From <s>Godhā</s> (iguana), [the suffix] <s>ḍhrak</s> [is added]. || PS_4,1.129 ||
[The suffix] <s>ārak</s> [is used, in the usage] of the northerners (<s>udīcām</s>). || PS_4,1.130 ||
From <s>kṣudrā</s> (small/mean) [women], optionally [<s>ḍhak</s> or the other suffixes are added]. || PS_4,1.131 ||
From <s>pitṛsvasṛ</s> (father's sister), [the suffix] <s>chaṇ</s> [is added]. || PS_4,1.132 ||
[When] <s>ṭhak</s> [is the suffix, there is] elision (<s>lopa</s>) [of the final of the base]. || PS_4,1.133 ||
And from <s>mātṛsvasṛ</s> (mother's sister). || PS_4,1.134 ||
From [names of] quadrupeds (<s>catuṣpād</s>), [the suffix] <s>ḍhañ</s> [is added to denote offspring]. || PS_4,1.135 ||
And from [words in] the <s>gṛṣṭyādi</s> (list beginning with <s>Gṛṣṭi</s>). || PS_4,1.136 ||
From <s>rājan</s> (king) and <s>śvaśura</s> (father-in-law), [the suffix] <s>yat</s> [is added]. || PS_4,1.137 ||
From <s>kṣatra</s> (warrior class), [the suffix] <s>gha</s> [is added]. || PS_4,1.138 ||
From <s>kula</s> (family), [the suffix] <s>kha</s> [is added]. || PS_4,1.139 ||
After [a compound] whose prior member has not occurred before (<s>apūrvapada</s>), optionally [the suffixes] <s>yaṅ</s> and <s>ḍhakañ</s> [are added]. || PS_4,1.140 ||
From <s>mahākula</s> (great family), [the suffixes] <s>añ</s> and <s>khañ</s> [are added]. || PS_4,1.141 ||
From <s>duṣkula</s> (bad family), [the suffix] <s>ḍhak</s> [is added]. || PS_4,1.142 ||
From <s>svasṛ</s> (sister), [the suffix] <s>cha</s> [is added]. || PS_4,1.143 ||
From <s>bhrātṛ</s> (brother), [the suffix] <s>vyac</s> [is added] as well. || PS_4,1.144 ||
[The suffix] <s>vyan</s> [is added when denoting] a co-wife's [son] (<s>sapatna</s>). || PS_4,1.145 ||
From [words in] the <s>revatyādi</s> (list beginning with <s>Revatī</s>), [the suffix] <s>ṭhak</s> [is added]. || PS_4,1.146 ||
From a <s>gotra</s> (lineage) [name] of a woman, [the suffix] <s>ṇa</s> [is added] as well, in a derogatory sense (<s>kutsana</s>). || PS_4,1.147 ||
From [a name with] <s>vṛddhi</s> (strengthened initial vowel), [the suffix] <s>ṭhak</s> [is added] among the <s>Sauvīras</s>, with much variation (<s>bahulam</s>). || PS_4,1.148 ||
From <s>Phe</s>, [the suffix] <s>cha</s> [is added] as well. || PS_4,1.149 ||
From <s>Phāṇḍāhṛti</s> and <s>Mimatā</s>, [the suffixes] <s>ṇa</s> and <s>phiñ</s> [are added respectively]. || PS_4,1.150 ||
From [words in] the <s>kurvādi</s> (list beginning with <s>Kuru</s>), [the suffix] <s>ṇya</s> [is added]. || PS_4,1.151 ||
And from [compounds] ending in <s>senā</s> (army), having a characteristic mark (<s>lakṣaṇa</s>), and from [words ending in] <s>kāri</s> (maker). || PS_4,1.152 ||
[In the usage] of the northerners (<s>udīcām</s>), [the suffix] <s>iñ</s> [is added]. || PS_4,1.153 ||
From [words in] the <s>tikādi</s> (list beginning with <s>Tika</s>), [the suffix] <s>phiñ</s> [is added]. || PS_4,1.154 ||
And from <s>Kauśalya</s> and <s>Kārmārya</s>. || PS_4,1.155 ||
[<s>Iñ</s> replaces] <s>aṇ</s> after a disyllabic [base] (<s>dvyac</s>). || PS_4,1.156 ||
[In the usage] of the northerners (<s>udīcām</s>), [<s>iñ</s> is added] from [a name with] <s>vṛddhi</s> (strengthened vowel) that is not a <s>gotra</s> (lineage name). || PS_4,1.157 ||
From <s>Vākina</s> and others, [the augment] <s>kuk</s> [is added] as well. || PS_4,1.158 ||
After [a compound] ending in <s>putra</s> (son), optionally. || PS_4,1.159 ||
[In the usage] of the easterners (<s>prācām</s>), from [a name] without <s>vṛddhi</s>, [the suffix] <s>phin</s> [is added], with much variation (<s>bahulam</s>). || PS_4,1.160 ||

body.text: manor jātāv añ-ayatau ṣuk ca || PS_4,1.161 ||
body.translated_text: From <s>manu</s>, [when denoting] offspring (<s>jāta</s>), [the suffixes] <s>añ</s> and <s>ayat</s> [are added], and [the augment] <s>ṣuk</s> as well. || PS_4,1.161 ||
The offspring (<s>apatya</s>) [of a person], from the grandson (<s>pautra</s>) onward, is [called] <s>gotra</s> (lineage). || PS_4,1.162 ||
But when the [intermediate] descendant of the lineage (<s>vaṃśya</s>) is living, [the descendant is called] <s>yuvan</s> (young). || PS_4,1.163 ||
And when the elder brother (<s>bhrātari jyāyasi</s>) [is living, the younger is called <s>yuvan</s>]. || PS_4,1.164 ||

body.text: vā anyasmin sapiṇḍe sthaviratare jivati || PS_4,1.165 ||
body.translated_text: Optionally when another <s>sapiṇḍa</s> (kinsman within six degrees) who is elder (<s>sthaviratara</s>) is living. || PS_4,1.165 ||
And [the <s>gotra</s> name is used] for the elder (<s>vṛddha</s>) in [a context of] respect (<s>pūjā</s>). || PS_4,1.166 ||
And [the <s>yuvan</s> name is used] for the young in [a context of] contempt (<s>kutsā</s>). || PS_4,1.167 ||
From a <s>janapada</s> (territorial) name, [when it is] a <s>kṣatriya</s> (warrior), [the suffix] <s>añ</s> [is added]. || PS_4,1.168 ||
And from <s>Sālveya</s> and <s>Gāndhāri</s>. || PS_4,1.169 ||
From <s>Dvi</s>, <s>Añ</s>, <s>Magadha</s>, <s>Kaliṅga</s>, and <s>Asūramasa</s>, [the suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is added]. || PS_4,1.170 ||
From [names with] <s>vṛddhi</s> (strengthened vowel) ending in <s>it</s>, and from <s>Kosala</s>, <s>Ajāda</s>, etc., [the suffix] <s>ñyaṅ</s> [is added]. || PS_4,1.171 ||
From <s>Kuru</s>, <s>Nādi</s>, etc., [the suffix] <s>ṇya</s> [is added]. || PS_4,1.172 ||
From <s>Sālvāvayava</s> (a sub-division of the <s>Sālvas</s>), <s>Pratyagratha</s>, <s>Kalakūṭa</s>, and <s>Aśmaka</s>, [the suffix] <s>iñ</s> [is added]. || PS_4,1.173 ||
They [i.e., the words formed by these suffixes] are [called] <s>tadrāja</s> (denoting the king of that region). || PS_4,1.174 ||
From <s>Kamboja</s>, <s>luk</s> (elision) [of the suffix occurs]. || PS_4,1.175 ||
In the feminine, from <s>Avanti</s>, <s>Kunti</s>, and <s>Kuru</s> as well [<s>luk</s> occurs]. || PS_4,1.176 ||
And from [words ending in] <s>a</s>. || PS_4,1.177 ||
Not from <s>Prācya</s> (eastern), [words in] the <s>bhargādi</s> (list beginning with <s>Bharga</s>), and [words in] the <s>yaudheyādi</s> (list beginning with <s>Yaudheya</s>). || PS_4,1.178 ||
[The affix <s>aṇ</s> is added in the sense of] 'dyed by that' (<s>tena raktam</s>), from a dye (<s>rāga</s>). || PS_4,2.1 ||
From <s>lākṣā</s> (lac), <s>rocanā</s> (yellow orpiment), <s>śakala</s> (bark), and <s>kardama</s> (mud), [the suffix] <s>ṭhak</s> [is added]. || PS_4,2.2 ||
[The affix <s>aṇ</s> is added in the sense of] 'connected with that <s>nakṣatra</s> (asterism)' [to denote] a time (<s>kāla</s>). || PS_4,2.3 ||
<s>Lup</s> (elision of the suffix) [occurs] when there is no specific distinction (<s>aviśeṣa</s>). || PS_4,2.4 ||
In the sense of a proper name (<s>sañjñāyām</s>), from <s>Śravaṇa</s> and <s>Aśvattha</s>. || PS_4,2.5 ||
From a <s>dvandva</s> (copulative compound), [the suffix] <s>cha</s> [is added]. || PS_4,2.6 ||
