[The affix <s>aṇ</s> is added in the sense of] 'the <s>sāman</s> (chant) seen [by that seer]' (<s>dṛṣṭam</s>). || PS_4,2.7 ||
From <s>Kali</s>, [the suffix] <s>ḍhak</s> [is added]. || PS_4,2.8 ||
From <s>Vāmadeva</s>, [the suffixes] <s>ḍyaḍ</s> and <s>ḍyau</s> [are added]. || PS_4,2.9 ||
[The affix <s>aṇ</s> is added in the sense of] 'the chariot (<s>ratha</s>) covered by that' (<s>parivṛta</s>). || PS_4,2.10 ||
From <s>pāṇḍukambala</s> (pale blanket), [the suffix] <s>ini</s> [is added]. || PS_4,2.11 ||
From <s>Dvaipa</s> (island-born) and <s>Vaiyāghra</s> (tiger-skin), [the suffix] <s>añ</s> [is added]. || PS_4,2.12 ||
[The affix is added] when denoting <s>kaumāra</s> (youth/virginity), [a meaning] not previously expressed. || PS_4,2.13 ||
[The affix <s>aṇ</s> is added in the sense of] 'taken out therein' (<s>tatra uddhṛtam</s>), [but] not from [words denoting] vessels (<s>amatra</s>). || PS_4,2.14 ||
From <s>sthaṇḍila</s> (bare ground), [the affix is added to denote] one who lies down [on it] (<s>śayitari</s>), as a [religious] vow (<s>vrata</s>). || PS_4,2.15 ||
[The affix <s>aṇ</s> is added in the sense of] 'prepared from that' (<s>saṃskṛtam</s>), [when the product is] food (<s>bhakṣa</s>). || PS_4,2.16 ||
From <s>śūla</s> (spit) and <s>ukha</s> (pot), [the suffix] <s>yat</s> [is added]. || PS_4,2.17 ||
From <s>dadhi</s> (curd), [the suffix] <s>ṭhak</s> [is added]. || PS_4,2.18 ||
From <s>udaśvit</s> (overflowing with water), optionally. || PS_4,2.19 ||
From <s>kṣīra</s> (milk), [the suffix] <s>ḍhañ</s> [is added]. || PS_4,2.20 ||
[The affix <s>aṇ</s> is added in the sense of] 'that <s>paurṇamāsī</s> (full-moon day) falls in it,' in the sense of a proper name (<s>sañjñāyām</s>). || PS_4,2.21 ||
From <s>Āgrahāyaṇī</s> and <s>Aśvattha</s>, [the suffix] <s>ṭhak</s> [is added]. || PS_4,2.22 ||
Optionally from <s>Phālgunī</s>, <s>Śravaṇā</s>, <s>Kārtikī</s>, and <s>Caitrī</s>. || PS_4,2.23 ||
[The affix <s>aṇ</s> is added in the sense of] 'that is its deity' (<s>sā asya devatā</s>). || PS_4,2.24 ||
[The <s>aṇ</s> affix occurs after] any [word denoting a deity, as per the preceding rule]. || PS_4,2.25 ||
From <s>Śukra</s> (Venus/bright), [the suffix] <s>ghan</s> [is added]. || PS_4,2.26 ||
From <s>Aponaptṛ</s> and <s>Apāṃnaptṛ</s> (grandson of the waters), [the suffix] <s>gha</s> [is added]. || PS_4,2.27 ||
And [the suffix] <s>cha</s> [is added as well]. || PS_4,2.28 ||
From <s>Mahendra</s> (great <s>Indra</s>), [the suffixes] <s>gha</s> and <s>aṇ</s> [are added] as well. || PS_4,2.29 ||
From <s>Soma</s>, [the suffix] <s>ṭyaṇ</s> [is added]. || PS_4,2.30 ||
From <s>Vāyu</s> (wind), <s>Ṛtu</s> (season), <s>Pitṛ</s> (ancestors), and <s>Uṣas</s> (dawn), [the suffix] <s>yat</s> [is added]. || PS_4,2.31 ||

From <s>Dyāvāpṛthivī</s> (Heaven and Earth), <s>Śunāsīra</s>, <s>Marutvat</s> (accompanied by <s>Maruts</s>), <s>Agnīṣoma</s> (<s>Agni</s> and <s>Soma</s>), <s>Vāstoṣpati</s> (lord of the dwelling), and <s>Gṛhamedha</s> (domestic sacrifice), [the suffix] <s>cha</s> [is added] as well. || PS_4,2.32 ||
From <s>Agni</s> (fire), [the suffix] <s>ḍhak</s> [is added]. || PS_4,2.33 ||
From [words denoting] time periods (<s>kāla</s>), [the affix is added] as in the sense of 'existing therein' (<s>bhavavat</s>). || PS_4,2.34 ||
From <s>Mahārāja</s> (great king) and <s>Proṣṭhapadā</s>, [the suffix] <s>ṭhañ</s> [is added]. || PS_4,2.35 ||

[The terms] <s>pitṛvya</s> (paternal uncle), <s>mātula</s> (maternal uncle), <s>mātāmaha</s> (maternal grandfather), and <s>pitāmaha</s> (paternal grandfather) [are nipātana, i.e., irregularly formed words]. || PS_4,2.36 ||
[The affix <s>aṇ</s> is added in the sense of] 'a collection of that' (<s>tasya samūhaḥ</s>). || PS_4,2.37 ||
From [words in] the <s>bhikṣādi</s> (list beginning with <s>bhikṣā</s>), [the suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is added]. || PS_4,2.38 ||

[The suffix] <s>vuñ</s> [is added] after <s>gotra</s> (lineage), <s>ukṣa</s> (bull), <s>uṣṭra</s> (camel), <s>urabhra</s> (ram), <s>rāja</s> (king), <s>rājanya</s> (royal), <s>rājaputra</s> (prince), <s>vatsa</s> (calf), <s>manuṣya</s> (human), and <s>aja</s> (goat). || 4.2.39 ||
[The suffix] <s>yañ</s> and [<s>vuñ</s> are added] after <s>kedāra</s> (field). || 4.2.40 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭhañ</s> [is added] after <s>kavacin</s> (one wearing armor) as well. || 4.2.41 ||
[The suffix] <s>yan</s> [is added] after <s>brāhmaṇa</s> (brahmin), <s>māṇava</s> (young man), and <s>vāḍava</s> (mare-born). || 4.2.42 ||
[The suffix] <s>tal</s> [is added] after <s>grāma</s> (village), <s>jana</s> (people), <s>bandhu</s> (kinsman), and <s>sahāya</s> (companion). || 4.2.43 ||
[The suffix] <s>añ</s> [is added] after [a word] beginning with an <s>anudātta</s> (unaccented syllable). || 4.2.44 ||
And [<s>añ</s> is added] after [words in the group] beginning with <s>Khaṇḍikā</s>. || 4.2.45 ||
[The suffix is added] after <s>caraṇa</s> (school of Vedic study) [in the sense of] <s>dharma</s> (duty, practice). || 4.2.46 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭhak</s> [is added] after <s>acitta</s> (inanimate), <s>hastin</s> (elephant), and <s>dhenu</s> (cow). || 4.2.47 ||
[The suffixes] <s>yañ</s> and <s>cha</s> [are added] optionally after <s>keśa</s> (hair) and <s>aśva</s> (horse). || 4.2.48 ||
[The suffix] <s>ya</s> [is added] after [words in the group] beginning with <s>pāśa</s> (noose). || 4.2.49 ||
[<s>ya</s> is added] after <s>khala</s> (threshing floor), <s>go</s> (cow), and <s>ratha</s> (chariot). || 4.2.50 ||
And [<s>ya</s> is added after words] ending in <s>in</s>, <s>tra</s>, and <s>kaṭyac</s>. || 4.2.51 ||
[The meaning is] <s>viṣaya</s> (domain, realm) in [the sense of] <s>deśa</s> (country, region). || 4.2.52 ||
[The suffix] <s>vuñ</s> [is added] after [words in the group] beginning with <s>rājanya</s> (kshatriya). || 4.2.53 ||
[The suffixes] <s>vidha</s> and <s>bhakta</s> [are added] after [words in the groups] beginning with <s>Bhauriki</s> and beginning with <s>Aiṣukāri</s>. || 4.2.54 ||
[The meaning is] 'that is its beginning' — in the <s>pragātha</s> (paired verse) sections of the <s>Chandas</s> (Vedic meter texts). || 4.2.55 ||
In [the sense of] <s>saṅgrāma</s> (battle), [the suffix is added] after [words denoting] the cause and the fighters. || 4.2.56 ||

body.text: tad asyāṃ praharaṇam iti krīḍāyāṃ ṇaḥ || PS_4,2.57 ||
body.translated_text: [In the sense of] 'that is the weapon used in it,' [the suffix] <s>ṇa</s> [is added] in [the context of] <s>krīḍā</s> (sport, game). || 4.2.57 ||
[The suffix] <s>ña</s> [is added after a word derived with the suffix] <s>ghañ</s> [in the sense of] 'that is the activity associated with it.' || 4.2.58 ||
[The meaning is] 'one studies that' [or] 'one knows that.' || 4.2.59 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭhak</s> [is added] after [words ending in] <s>kratu</s> (sacrifice), [words in the group] beginning with <s>uktha</s>, and [words] ending in <s>sūtra</s>. || 4.2.60 ||
[The suffix] <s>vun</s> [is added] after [words in the group] beginning with <s>krama</s> (sequence). || 4.2.61 ||
[The suffix] <s>ini</s> [is added] after <s>anubrāhmaṇa</s> (supplementary brāhmaṇa text). || 4.2.62 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭhak</s> [is added] after [words in the group] beginning with <s>vasanta</s> (spring). || 4.2.63 ||
[There is] <s>luk</s> (elision of the suffix) [when the sense is] 'taught by [a particular teacher].' || 4.2.64 ||
And [<s>luk</s> elision occurs for a word derived] from <s>sūtra</s> when it has <s>ka</s> as its penultimate sound. || 4.2.65 ||
<s>Chandas</s> (metrical texts) and <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> (prose commentaries) also [take the same suffixes] when they are the subject matter [of study]. || 4.2.66 ||

body.text: tad asminn asti iti deśe tannāmni || PS_4,2.67 ||
body.translated_text: [The meaning is] 'that exists in it' — [applied to] a <s>deśa</s> (region) named after that [thing]. || 4.2.67 ||
[The meaning is] 'produced by that.' || 4.2.68 ||
[The meaning is] 'that is the dwelling place of that.' || 4.2.69 ||
And [the meaning includes] 'being not far from [that place].' || 4.2.70 ||
[The suffix] <s>añ</s> [is added after a word ending in] <s>u</s>. || 4.2.71 ||
And [<s>añ</s> is added after a word ending in] <s>matu</s> (the suffix <s>matup</s>) when it has many vowels (<s>bahvac</s>). || 4.2.72 ||
[<s>añ</s> is added after] polysyllabic [words] in [the sense of] <s>kūpa</s> (wells). || 4.2.73 ||
And [<s>añ</s> is added in the region] north (<s>udak</s>) of the <s>Vipāś</s> (river Beas). || 4.2.74 ||
And [<s>añ</s> is added] after [words in the group] beginning with <s>Saṅkala</s>. || 4.2.75 ||
[The feminine form is used] in [reference to] women among the <s>Sauvīra</s>, <s>Sālva</s>, and [peoples of the] East. || 4.2.76 ||
[The suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is added] after [words in the group] beginning with <s>Suvāstu</s>. || 4.2.77 ||
[The word] <s>Roṇī</s> [is an irregular formation]. || 4.2.78 ||
And [<s>aṇ</s> is added] after [a word] having <s>ka</s> as its penultimate sound. || 4.2.79 ||

[The suffixes] <s>vuñ</s>, <s>chaṇ</s>, <s>ka</s>, <s>ṭhaj</s>, <s>ila</s>, <s>sa</s>, <s>ini</s>, <s>ra</s>, <s>ḍha</s>, <s>ṇya</s>, <s>ya</s>, <s>phak</s>, <s>phiñ</s>, <s>iñ</s>, <s>ñya</s>, <s>kak</s>, and <s>ṭhak</s> [are added respectively] after [words in the groups beginning with] <s>Arīhaṇa</s>, <s>Kṛśāśva</s>, <s>Ṛśya</s>, <s>Kumuda</s>, <s>Kāśa</s>, <s>Tṛṇa</s>, <s>Prekṣā</s>, <s>Aśma</s>, <s>Sakhi</s>, <s>Saṅkāśa</s>, <s>Bala</s>, <s>Pakṣa</s>, <s>Karṇa</s>, <s>Sutaṅgama</s>, <s>Pragadin</s>, <s>Varāha</s>, and <s>Kumuda</s>, etc. || 4.2.80 ||
[There is] <s>lup</s> (elision) [of the suffix when the derivative denotes] the <s>janapada</s> (country) [itself]. || 4.2.81 ||
And [<s>lup</s> elision occurs] after [words in the group] beginning with <s>Varaṇā</s>. || 4.2.82 ||
Optionally after <s>Śarkarā</s>. || 4.2.83 ||
And [the suffixes] <s>ṭhak</s> and <s>cha</s> [are added in certain cases]. || 4.2.84 ||
[The suffix] <s>matup</s> [is added when the name refers to] a <s>nadī</s> (river). || 4.2.85 ||
And [<s>matup</s> is added] after [words in the group] beginning with <s>madhu</s> (honey). || 4.2.86 ||
[The suffix] <s>ḍmatup</s> [is added] after <s>kumuda</s> (lotus), <s>naḍa</s> (reed), and <s>vetasa</s> (cane). || 4.2.87 ||
[The suffix] <s>ḍvalac</s> [is added] after <s>naḍa</s> (reed) and <s>śāḍa</s>. || 4.2.88 ||
[The suffix] <s>valac</s> [is added] after <s>śikhā</s> (crest). || 4.2.89 ||
[The suffix] <s>cha</s> [is added] after [words in the group] beginning with <s>utkara</s> (heap). || 4.2.90 ||
And [the augment] <s>kuk</s> [is added] to [words in the group] beginning with <s>naḍa</s>. || 4.2.91 ||
In the remaining [senses, the general taddhita suffixes apply]. || 4.2.92 ||
[The suffixes] <s>gha</s> and <s>kha</s> [are added] after <s>rāṣṭra</s> (kingdom) and <s>avārapāra</s> (this side and the far side). || 4.2.93 ||
[The suffixes] <s>gha</s> and <s>kha</s> [are added] after <s>rāṣṭra</s> (kingdom) and <s>avārapāra</s> (this side and the far side). || 4.2.94 ||
[The suffix] <s>ḍhakañ</s> [is added] after [words in the group] beginning with <s>Katri</s>. || 4.2.95 ||

[<s>ḍhakañ</s> is added] after <s>kula</s> (family), <s>kukṣi</s> (belly), and <s>grīvā</s> (neck) in [the senses of] dog (<s>śvan</s>), mouth (<s>āsya</s>), and ornament (<s>alaṅkāra</s>). || 4.2.96 ||
[The suffix] <s>ḍhak</s> [is added] after [words in the group] beginning with <s>nadī</s> (river). || 4.2.97 ||
[The suffix] <s>tyak</s> [is added] after <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (south), <s>paścāt</s> (west), and <s>puras</s> (east). || 4.2.98 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṣphak</s> [is added] after <s>Kāpiśī</s>. || 4.2.99 ||
[The suffix] <s>aṇ</s> also [is added] after <s>Raṅku</s> when [referring to] a non-human being. || 4.2.100 ||
[The suffix] <s>yat</s> [is added] after <s>dyu</s> (heaven), <s>prāc</s> (east), <s>apāc</s> (west), <s>udac</s> (north), and <s>pratīc</s> (south). || 4.2.101 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭhak</s> [is added] after <s>kanthā</s> (patched garment / town). || 4.2.102 ||
[The augment] <s>vuk</s> [is added to the suffix after a word denoting] <s>varṇa</s> (color, class). || 4.2.103 ||
[The suffix] <s>tyap</s> [is added] after an <s>avyaya</s> (indeclinable). || 4.2.104 ||
[The suffix <s>tyap</s> is added] optionally after [the words meaning] 'of this year' (<s>aiṣama</s>), 'yesterday' (<s>hyas</s>), and 'tomorrow' (<s>śvas</s>). || 4.2.105 ||
[The suffixes] <s>añ</s> and <s>ña</s> [are added] after [words ending in] <s>tīra</s> (bank), <s>rūpya</s> (silver), and as a final member of a compound (<s>uttarapada</s>). || 4.2.106 ||
[The suffix] <s>ña</s> [is added] after [a compound] having a directional term (<s>dik</s>) as its first member, when it is not a proper name. || 4.2.107 ||
[The suffix] <s>añ</s> [is added] after <s>Madra</s>. || 4.2.108 ||
And after <s>udīcyagrāma</s> (northern village) [when the word is] polysyllabic and has a final acute accent (<s>antodātta</s>). || 4.2.109 ||

[The suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is added] after [compounds with] <s>prastha</s> as the final member, and after [words in the group] beginning with <s>Paladi</s> that have <s>ka</s> as the penultimate sound. || 4.2.110 ||
[The suffix <s>aṇ</s> is added] after [words in the group] beginning with <s>Kaṇva</s> in [the sense of] <s>gotra</s> (lineage). || 4.2.111 ||
And [the suffix] <s>iñ</s> [is added as well]. || 4.2.112 ||
[This does] not [apply to] disyllabic [words] among the <s>Prācya</s> (easterners) and <s>Bharata</s> [people]. || 4.2.113 ||
[The suffix] <s>cha</s> [is added] after a <s>vṛddha</s> (word having vṛddhi in the first syllable). || 4.2.114 ||
[The suffixes] <s>ṭhak</s> and <s>cha</s> [are added] after <s>bhavat</s> (your honor). || 4.2.115 ||
[The suffixes] <s>ṭhañ</s> and <s>ñiṭha</s> [are added] after [words in the group] beginning with <s>Kāśi</s>. || 4.2.116 ||
And [these suffixes are added] after the village names of <s>Vāhīka</s> (the Bāhīka region). || 4.2.117 ||
Optionally among the <s>Uśīnara</s> [people]. || 4.2.118 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭhañ</s> [is added after a word ending in] <s>u</s> in [the sense of] <s>deśa</s> (region). || 4.2.119 ||
[The suffix is added] after a <s>vṛddha</s> [word] according to the usage of the <s>Prācya</s> (easterners). || 4.2.120 ||
[The suffix] <s>vuñ</s> [is added] after [a word having] <s>dhanva</s> (desert) [or a word] with <s>ya</s> as its penultimate. || 4.2.121 ||
And [<s>vuñ</s> is added] after [words] ending in <s>prastha</s>, <s>pura</s> (city), and <s>vaha</s>. || 4.2.122 ||
[The suffix <s>vuñ</s> is added after a word] with <s>ra</s> as its penultimate or [ending in] <s>iti</s>, according to the <s>Prācya</s> (easterners). || 4.2.123 ||
And [this applies when the word denotes] a <s>janapada</s> (country) or a place near its border. || 4.2.124 ||
Even after a non-<s>vṛddha</s> [word] when it is in the domain of the plural [i.e., denotes a people]. || 4.2.125 ||
[<s>vuñ</s> is added] after [compounds with] <s>kaccha</s> (marshy land), <s>agni</s> (fire), <s>vaktra</s> (mouth), or <s>garta</s> (pit) as the final member. || 4.2.126 ||
And [<s>vuñ</s> is added] after [words in the group] beginning with <s>Dhūma</s> (smoke). || 4.2.127 ||
[<s>vuñ</s> is added] after <s>nagara</s> (city) in [the senses of] censure (<s>kutsana</s>) and skill (<s>prāvīṇya</s>). || 4.2.128 ||
[<s>vuñ</s> is added] after <s>araṇya</s> (forest) when [the derivative refers to] a human being. || 4.2.129 ||
Optionally after <s>Kuru</s> and <s>Yugandhara</s>. || 4.2.130 ||
[The suffix] <s>kan</s> [is added] after <s>Madra</s> and <s>Vṛji</s>. || 4.2.131 ||
[The suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is added after a word] having <s>ka</s> as its penultimate sound. || 4.2.132 ||
And [<s>aṇ</s> is added] after [words in the group] beginning with <s>Kaccha</s>. || 4.2.133 ||
[The suffix] <s>vuñ</s> [is added when the derivative denotes] a human being or one who resides there. || 4.2.134 ||
[The suffix <s>vuñ</s> is used] when not [referring to] a foot soldier, after <s>Sālva</s>. || 4.2.135 ||
And [the suffix is added] after <s>go</s> (cow) and <s>yavagu</s> (rice gruel). || 4.2.136 ||
[The suffix] <s>cha</s> [is added] after [a compound with] <s>garta</s> (pit) as the final member. || 4.2.137 ||
And [<s>cha</s> is added] after [words in the group] beginning with <s>Gaha</s>. || 4.2.138 ||
[This applies] among the <s>Prācya</s> (easterners), after [words in the group] beginning with <s>Kaṭa</s>. || 4.2.139 ||
[The suffix] <s>ka</s> also [is added] after <s>rājan</s> (king). || 4.2.140 ||
[<s>ka</s> is added] after a <s>vṛddha</s> [word] ending in <s>aka</s> or <s>ika</s>, or having <s>kha</s> as its penultimate sound. || 4.2.141 ||
[<s>ka</s> is added] after [compounds with] <s>kanthā</s> (town), <s>palada</s>, <s>nagara</s> (city), <s>grāma</s> (village), or <s>hrada</s> (lake) as the final member. || 4.2.142 ||
And after <s>parvata</s> (mountain). || 4.2.143 ||
Optionally when [referring to] a non-human being. || 4.2.144 ||
[The suffix is added] after <s>Kṛkaṇaparṇa</s> [in the lineage of] <s>Bharadvāja</s>. || 4.2.145 ||
[The suffixes] <s>khañ</s> and others [are added] optionally after <s>yuṣmad</s> (you) and <s>asmad</s> (we). || 4.3.1 ||
When that [suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is applied], the forms are <s>yuṣmāka</s> and <s>asmāka</s>. || 4.3.2 ||
[The forms] <s>tāvaka</s> and <s>māmaka</s> [are used] in the singular. || 4.3.3 ||
[The suffix] <s>yat</s> [is added] after <s>ardha</s> (half). || 4.3.4 ||
And after <s>para</s> (other), <s>avara</s> (near), <s>adhama</s> (lowest), <s>uttama</s> (highest), and <s>pūrva</s> (former). || 4.3.5 ||
And [the suffix] <s>ṭhañ</s> [is added] after [a compound] having a directional term (<s>dik</s>) as its first member. || 4.3.6 ||
[The suffixes] <s>añ</s> and <s>ṭhañ</s> [are added] after [a word denoting] a part of a <s>grāma</s> (village) or <s>janapada</s> (country). || 4.3.7 ||
[The word becomes] <s>madhyama</s> [when derived] from <s>madhya</s> (middle). || 4.3.8 ||
[This applies when the sense is] not [referring to] the present time (<s>sāmpratika</s>). || 4.3.9 ||
[The suffix] <s>yañ</s> [is added] after <s>dvīpa</s> (island) [when it is situated] along the ocean (<s>anusamudram</s>). || 4.3.10 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭhañ</s> [is added] after [a word denoting] <s>kāla</s> (time). || 4.3.11 ||
[<s>ṭhañ</s> is added] after <s>śarad</s> (autumn) in [connection with] <s>śrāddha</s> (rites for the deceased). || 4.3.12 ||
Optionally [<s>ṭhañ</s> is added after words denoting] disease (<s>roga</s>) and sunshine (<s>ātapa</s>). || 4.3.13 ||
And [<s>ṭhañ</s> is added] after <s>niśā</s> (night) and <s>pradoṣa</s> (evening). || 4.3.14 ||
[The augment] <s>tuṭ</s> [is added] and [the suffix is applied] after <s>śvas</s> (tomorrow). || 4.3.15 ||
[The suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is added] after <s>sandhivelā</s> (twilight) and the like, <s>ṛtu</s> (season), and <s>nakṣatra</s> (lunar mansion). || 4.3.16 ||
[The suffixes] <s>eṇya</s> [are added] after <s>prāvṛṣ</s> (rainy season). || 4.3.17 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭhak</s> [is added] after <s>varṣā</s> (rains). || 4.3.18 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭhañ</s> [is used] in <s>Chandas</s> (Vedic language). || 4.3.19 ||
And after <s>vasanta</s> (spring) [<s>ṭhañ</s> is added in Chandas]. || 4.3.20 ||
And after <s>hemanta</s> (winter) [<s>ṭhañ</s> is added in Chandas]. || 4.3.21 ||

body.text: sarvatra aṇ ca talopaś ca || PS_4,3.22 ||
body.translated_text: [The suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [may be used] everywhere, and [the final] <s>ta</s> is elided as well. || 4.3.22 ||

[The suffixes] <s>ṭyu</s> and <s>ṭyul</s> [are added] after the indeclinables <s>sāyam</s> (evening), <s>ciram</s> (long time), <s>prāhṇe</s> (forenoon), and <s>prage</s> (early morning), with [the augment] <s>tuṭ</s>. || 4.3.23 ||
Optionally after <s>pūrvāhṇa</s> (forenoon) and <s>aparāhṇa</s> (afternoon). || 4.3.24 ||
[The meaning is] 'born there.' || 4.3.25 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭhap</s> [is added] after <s>prāvṛṣ</s> (rainy season). || 4.3.26 ||
[The suffix] <s>vuñ</s> [is added] after <s>śarad</s> (autumn) when [the derivative is] a proper name (<s>sañjñā</s>). || 4.3.27 ||
[The suffix] <s>vun</s> [is added] after <s>pūrvāhṇa</s> (forenoon), <s>aparāhṇa</s> (afternoon), <s>Ārdrā</s>, <s>Mūla</s>, <s>pradoṣa</s> (evening), and <s>avaskara</s> (refuse). || 4.3.28 ||
After <s>pathi</s> (path), [the stem becomes] <s>pantha</s> as well. || 4.3.29 ||
Optionally after <s>amāvāsyā</s> (new moon day). || 4.3.30 ||
And [the suffix] <s>a</s> [is added]. || 4.3.31 ||
[The suffix] <s>kan</s> [is added] after <s>Sindhu</s> and <s>Apakara</s>. || 4.3.32 ||
And [the suffixes] <s>aṇ</s> and <s>añ</s> [are added]. || 4.3.33 ||

[There is] <s>luk</s> (elision) [of the suffix] after <s>Śraviṣṭhā</s>, <s>Phalgunī</s>, <s>Anurādhā</s>, <s>Svāti</s>, <s>Tiṣya</s>, <s>Punarvasu</s>, <s>Hasta</s>, <s>Viśākhā</s>, <s>Āṣāḍhā</s>, and <s>Bahulā</s>. || 4.3.34 ||
And [<s>luk</s> elision occurs] after <s>sthānānata</s>, <s>gośālā</s> (cow-shed), and <s>kharaśālā</s> (donkey-shed). || 4.3.35 ||
Optionally after <s>vatsaśālā</s> (calf-shed), <s>Abhijit</s>, <s>Aśvayuj</s>, and <s>Śatabhiṣaj</s>. || 4.3.36 ||
After <s>nakṣatra</s> (lunar mansion) names, [the suffixes are applied] variously (<s>bahulam</s>). || 4.3.37 ||
[The meaning includes] 'made' (<s>kṛta</s>), 'obtained' (<s>labdha</s>), 'bought' (<s>krīta</s>), and 'skilled in' (<s>kuśala</s>). || 4.3.38 ||
[The meaning includes] 'predominantly consisting of that' (<s>prāyabhava</s>). || 4.3.39 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭhak</s> [is added] after <s>upajānu</s> (up to the knee), <s>upakarṇa</s> (near the ear), and <s>upanīvi</s> (around the waist). || 4.3.40 ||
[The meaning is] 'assembled together' (<s>sambhūta</s>). || 4.3.41 ||
[The suffix] <s>ḍhañ</s> [is added] after <s>kośa</s> (treasury, sheath). || 4.3.42 ||
[The suffix is added] after [a word denoting] <s>kāla</s> (time) in [the senses of] 'good for,' 'flowering in,' and 'ripening in.' || 4.3.43 ||
And [the suffix is added in the sense of] 'sown' (<s>upta</s>). || 4.3.44 ||
[The suffix] <s>vuñ</s> [is added] after <s>āśvayujī</s> (the month of Āśvina). || 4.3.45 ||
[The suffix is added] optionally after <s>grīṣma</s> (summer) and <s>vasanta</s> (spring). || 4.3.46 ||
[The meaning is] 'to be given' (<s>deya</s>) in [the context of] a debt (<s>ṛṇa</s>). || 4.3.47 ||
[The suffix] <s>vun</s> [is added] after <s>kalāpin</s> (peacock / quiver-bearer), <s>aśvattha</s> (sacred fig tree), and <s>yavabusa</s> (barley chaff). || 4.3.48 ||
[The suffix] <s>vuñ</s> [is added] after <s>grīṣma</s> (summer) and <s>avarasama</s> (recent). || 4.3.49 ||
And [the suffix] <s>ṭhañ</s> [is added] after <s>saṃvatsara</s> (year) and <s>āgrahāyaṇī</s> (the full moon of Agrahāyaṇa). || 4.3.50 ||
[The meaning is] 'the deer (<s>mṛga</s>) calls out.' || 4.3.51 ||
[The meaning is] 'that has been endured by him.' || 4.3.52 ||
[The meaning is] 'existing there' (<s>tatra bhava</s>). || 4.3.53 ||
[The suffix] <s>yat</s> [is added] after [words in the group] beginning with <s>dik</s> (direction). || 4.3.54 ||
And after [a word denoting] a part of the body (<s>śarīra-avayava</s>). || 4.3.55 ||
[The suffix] <s>ḍhañ</s> [is added] after <s>dṛti</s> (leather bag), <s>kukṣi</s> (belly), <s>kalaśī</s> (pot), <s>vasti</s> (bladder), <s>asti</s> (bone), and <s>ahi</s> (snake). || 4.3.56 ||
[The suffix] <s>aṇ</s> also [is added] after <s>grīvā</s> (neck). || 4.3.57 ||
[The suffix] <s>ñya</s> [is added] after <s>gambhīra</s> (deep). || 4.3.58 ||
And after an <s>avyayībhāva</s> (indeclinable compound). || 4.3.59 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭhañ</s> [is added] after [a compound] having <s>antar</s> (inside) as its first member. || 4.3.60 ||
[<s>ṭhañ</s> is added] after <s>grāma</s> (village) when preceded by <s>pari</s> (around) or <s>anu</s> (along). || 4.3.61 ||
[The suffix] <s>cha</s> [is added] after <s>jihvāmūla</s> (root of the tongue) and <s>aṅguli</s> (finger). || 4.3.62 ||
And after [a word] ending in a stop consonant (<s>vargānta</s>). || 4.3.63 ||
[The suffixes] <s>yat</s> and <s>kha</s> [are added] optionally when [the base is] not a [real] word (<s>aśabda</s>). || 4.3.64 ||
[The suffix] <s>kan</s> [is added] after <s>karṇa</s> (ear) and <s>lalāṭa</s> (forehead) in [the sense of] ornament (<s>alaṅkāra</s>). || 4.3.65 ||

body.text: tasya vyākhyāna iti ca vyākhyātavyanāmnaḥ || PS_4,3.66 ||
body.translated_text: [The meaning includes] 'that is the explanation of it,' and [the suffix is added] after the name of [a work] to be explained (<s>vyākhyātavya</s>). || 4.3.66 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭhañ</s> [is added] after a polysyllabic [word] with final acute accent (<s>antodātta</s>). || 4.3.67 ||
And after <s>kratu</s> (sacrifice) and <s>yajña</s> (ritual). || 4.3.68 ||
[This applies] only in [connection with] chapters (<s>adhyāya</s>) [taught by] a <s>ṛṣi</s> (sage). || 4.3.69 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṣṭhan</s> [is added] after <s>paurāḍāśa</s> and <s>puroḍāśa</s> (sacrificial rice cake). || 4.3.70 ||
[The suffixes] <s>yat</s> and <s>aṇ</s> [are added in reference to] <s>Chandas</s> (Vedic texts). || 4.3.71 ||

[The suffix] <s>ṭhak</s> [is added] after [a word that is] disyllabic, [ending in] <s>ṛd</s>, <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, <s>Ṛk</s>, <s>prathama</s> (first), <s>adhvara</s> (sacrifice), <s>puraścaraṇa</s> (preparatory rite), and [words denoting] names and verbs. || 4.3.72 ||
[The suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is added] after [words in the group] beginning with <s>Ṛgayana</s>. || 4.3.73 ||
[The meaning is] 'come from there.' || 4.3.74 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭhak</s> [is added] after [words denoting] stations of transit (<s>āyasthāna</s>). || 4.3.75 ||
[The suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is added] after [words in the group] beginning with <s>Śuṇḍikā</s>. || 4.3.76 ||
[The suffix] <s>vuñ</s> [is added after words denoting] knowledge (<s>vidyā</s>), origin (<s>yoni</s>), and relationship (<s>sambandha</s>). || 4.3.77 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭhañ</s> [is added] after <s>ṛtu</s> (season). || 4.3.78 ||
And [the suffix] <s>yat</s> [is added] after <s>pitṛ</s> (father). || 4.3.79 ||
[The suffix is added] after <s>gotra</s> (lineage) as with <s>aṅka</s> (branding). || 4.3.80 ||
[The suffix] <s>rūpya</s> [is added] optionally after [words denoting] a cause (<s>hetu</s>) and human beings (<s>manuṣya</s>). || 4.3.81 ||
And [the suffix] <s>mayaṭ</s> [is added]. || 4.3.82 ||
[The meaning is] 'it produces' (<s>prabhavati</s>). || 4.3.83 ||
[The suffix] <s>ñya</s> [is added] after <s>vidūra</s> (far). || 4.3.84 ||
[The meaning is] 'that goes [by that route]' — in [the case of] a path (<s>pathin</s>) and a messenger (<s>dūta</s>). || 4.3.85 ||
[The meaning is] 'it exits through the door (<s>dvāra</s>).' || 4.3.86 ||
[The meaning is] 'a treatise (<s>grantha</s>) composed having taken [that] as the subject.' || 4.3.87 ||
[The suffix] <s>cha</s> [is added] after [words in the groups] beginning with <s>Śiśukranda</s>, <s>Yamasabhā</s>, <s>Dvandva</s>, and <s>Indrajanana</s>, etc. || 4.3.88 ||
[The meaning is] 'that is the dwelling place of that person.' || 4.3.89 ||
And [the meaning includes] 'birthplace' (<s>abhijana</s>). || 4.3.90 ||
[The suffix] <s>cha</s> [is added] after [words denoting] those who live by weapons (<s>āyudhajīvin</s>) in [the context of] a mountain (<s>parvata</s>). || 4.3.91 ||
[The suffix] <s>ñya</s> [is added] after [words in the group] beginning with <s>Śaṇḍikā</s>. || 4.3.92 ||
[The suffixes] <s>aṇ</s> and <s>añ</s> [are added] after [words in the groups] beginning with <s>Sindhu</s> and <s>Takṣaśilā</s>. || 4.3.93 ||
[The suffixes] <s>ṭhak</s>, <s>chaṇ</s>, <s>ḍhañ</s>, and <s>yaka</s> [are added respectively] after <s>Tūdī</s>, <s>Śalātura</s>, <s>Varmatī</s>, and <s>Kūcavāra</s>. || 4.3.94 ||
[The meaning is] devotion (<s>bhakti</s>). || 4.3.95 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭhak</s> [is added] after an inanimate [word] (<s>acitta</s>) that does not denote a place (<s>deśa</s>) or time (<s>kāla</s>). || 4.3.96 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭhañ</s> [is added] after <s>mahārāja</s> (great king). || 4.3.97 ||
[The suffix] <s>vun</s> [is added] after <s>Vāsudeva</s> and <s>Arjuna</s>. || 4.3.98 ||
[The suffix] <s>vuñ</s> [is added] variously (<s>bahulam</s>) after <s>gotra</s> (lineage), <s>kṣatriya</s> (warrior-class), and <s>ākhyā</s> (name). || 4.3.99 ||

body.text: janapadināṃ janapadavat sarvaṃ janapadena samānaśabdānāṃ bahuvacane || PS_4,3.100 ||
body.translated_text: [The derivatives of] inhabitants of a <s>janapada</s> (country) [follow the same rules] as those of the <s>janapada</s> itself — all [rules applicable] to those having the same name as the <s>janapada</s> [apply] in the plural. || 4.3.100 ||
[The suffix <s>aṇ</s> is applied in the sense of] 'taught by him.' || PS 4.3.101 ||
[The suffix] <s>chaṇ</s> [is applied] after <s>Tittiri</s>, <s>Varatantu</s>, <s>Khaṇḍika</s>, and <s>Ukhā</s>. || PS 4.3.102 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṇini</s> [is applied] after <s>Kāśyapa</s> and <s>Kauśika</s>, [when they are] sages (<s>ṛṣi</s>). || PS 4.3.103 ||
And [<s>ṇini</s> is applied] after <s>Kalāpin</s>, <s>Vaiśampāyana</s>, and their pupils (<s>antevāsin</s>). || PS 4.3.104 ||
[The suffix is applied] in the <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> and <s>Kalpa</s> texts taught in the <s>Purāṇas</s>. || PS 4.3.105 ||
[The suffix is applied] after <s>Śaunaka</s> and others in Vedic literature (<s>chandas</s>). || PS 4.3.106 ||
[The suffix undergoes] <s>luk</s> (elision) after <s>Kaṭha</s> and <s>Caraka</s>. || PS 4.3.107 ||
[The suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is applied] after <s>Kalāpin</s>. || PS 4.3.108 ||
[The suffix] <s>ḍhinuk</s> [is applied] after <s>Chagalin</s>. || PS 4.3.109 ||
[The suffixes are applied] after <s>Pārāśarya</s> and <s>Śilālin</s> in connection with the <s>Bhikṣu</s> and <s>Naṭasūtra</s> texts. || PS 4.3.110 ||
[The suffix] <s>ini</s> [is applied] after <s>Karmanda</s> and <s>Kṛśāśva</s>. || PS 4.3.111 ||
[The suffix <s>aṇ</s> is applied in the sense of] 'directed (<s>ekadik</s>) by him.' || PS 4.3.112 ||
And [the suffix] <s>tasi</s> [is applied]. || PS 4.3.113 ||
And [the suffix] <s>yac</s> [is applied after] <s>uras</s> (chest). || PS 4.3.114 ||
[The suffix is applied] in the sense of 'discovered by' (<s>upajñāta</s>). || PS 4.3.115 ||
[The suffix is applied] in the sense of 'a composed work' (<s>kṛte granthe</s>). || PS 4.3.116 ||
[The suffix is applied] in a proper name (<s>sañjñā</s>). || PS 4.3.117 ||
[The suffix] <s>vuñ</s> [is applied] after <s>Kulāla</s> and others. || PS 4.3.118 ||
[The suffix] <s>añ</s> [is applied] after <s>Kṣudrā</s>, <s>Bhramara</s>, <s>Vaṭara</s>, and <s>Pādapa</s>. || PS 4.3.119 ||
[The suffix <s>aṇ</s> is applied in the sense of] 'this belongs to that' (<s>tasyedam</s>). || PS 4.3.120 ||
[The suffix] <s>yat</s> [is applied after] <s>ratha</s> (chariot) and others. || PS 4.3.121 ||
[The suffix] <s>dañ</s> [is applied] when <s>patra</s> (leaf) is the prior member. || PS 4.3.122 ||
And [<s>dañ</s> is applied after] <s>patra</s>, <s>adhvaryu</s>, and <s>pariṣad</s>. || PS 4.3.123 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭhak</s> [is applied] after <s>hala</s> (plough) and <s>sīra</s> (ploughshare). || PS 4.3.124 ||
[The suffix] <s>vun</s> [is applied] after a <s>dvandva</s> compound in the senses of enmity (<s>vaira</s>) and sexual union (<s>maithuna</s>). || PS 4.3.125 ||
[The suffix] <s>vuñ</s> [is applied] after <s>gotra</s> (lineage) and <s>caraṇa</s> (Vedic school). || PS 4.3.126 ||
[The suffixes] <s>añ</s>, <s>yañ</s>, and <s>iñ</s> are replaced by <s>aṇ</s> in the senses of a group (<s>saṅgha</s>), a mark (<s>aṅka</s>), and a characteristic (<s>lakṣaṇa</s>). || PS 4.3.127 ||
Optionally [<s>aṇ</s> replaces them] after <s>Śākala</s>. || PS 4.3.128 ||
[The suffix] <s>ñya</s> [is applied] after <s>Chandoga</s>, <s>Aukthika</s>, <s>Yājñika</s>, <s>Bahvṛca</s>, and <s>Naṭa</s>. || PS 4.3.129 ||
Not [when referring to] the pupils of <s>Daṇḍamāṇava</s>. || PS 4.3.130 ||
[The suffix] <s>cha</s> [is applied] after <s>Raivatika</s> and others. || PS 4.3.131 ||
[The suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is applied] after <s>Kaupiñjala</s> and <s>Hāsitapada</s>. || PS 4.3.132 ||
And [the <s>ika</s> portion undergoes] <s>ika</s>-elision in the case of <s>Ātharvaṇika</s>. || PS 4.3.133 ||
[The suffix <s>aṇ</s> is applied in the sense of] 'a modification of that' (<s>tasya vikāra</s>). || PS 4.3.134 ||
And [<s>aṇ</s> is applied] in the sense of a part (<s>avayava</s>) [derived] from animals (<s>prāṇin</s>), herbs (<s>oṣadhi</s>), and trees (<s>vṛkṣa</s>). || PS 4.3.135 ||
[The suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is applied] after <s>Bilva</s> and others. || PS 4.3.136 ||
And [<s>aṇ</s> is applied] after [a base] having <s>ka</s> as its penultimate (<s>upādhā</s>). || PS 4.3.137 ||
[The augment] <s>ṣuk</s> [is added] in the case of <s>trapu</s> (tin) and <s>jatu</s> (lac). || PS 4.3.138 ||
[The suffix] <s>añ</s> [is applied after a base ending in] <s>ū</s>. || PS 4.3.139 ||
And [<s>añ</s> is applied] after [a base] with an <s>anudātta</s> (grave-accented) initial. || PS 4.3.140 ||
Optionally [<s>aṇ</s> is applied] after <s>Palāśa</s> and others. || PS 4.3.141 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭlañ</s> [is applied] after <s>Śamī</s> (the Śamī tree). || PS 4.3.142 ||

body.text: mayaḍ vaā+etayor bhāṣāyām abhakṣya ācchādanayoḥ || PS_4,3.143 ||
body.translated_text: [The suffix] <s>mayaḍ</s> [is applied] optionally instead of these two [<s>aṇ</s> and <s>ṭlañ</s>] in common usage (<s>bhāṣā</s>) in the senses of inedible (<s>abhakṣya</s>) and covering (<s>ācchādana</s>). || PS 4.3.143 ||
[<s>Mayaḍ</s> is applied] invariably after <s>Vṛddha</s>, <s>Śara</s>, and others. || PS 4.3.144 ||
And [<s>mayaḍ</s> is applied] after <s>go</s> (cow) in the sense of dung (<s>purīṣa</s>). || PS 4.3.145 ||
And [<s>mayaḍ</s> is applied] after <s>piṣṭa</s> (flour). || PS 4.3.146 ||
[The suffix] <s>kan</s> [is applied] in a proper name (<s>sañjñā</s>). || PS 4.3.147 ||
[<s>Kan</s> is applied] after <s>vrīhi</s> (rice) in the sense of <s>puroḍāśa</s> (sacrificial cake). || PS 4.3.148 ||
[<s>Kan</s> is applied] after <s>tila</s> (sesame) and <s>yava</s> (barley) when it is not a proper name (<s>asañjñā</s>). || PS 4.3.149 ||
[<s>Kan</s> is applied] after a disyllabic [base] in Vedic literature (<s>chandas</s>). || PS 4.3.150 ||
Not after <s>uttva</s>, <s>vardhra</s>, and <s>bilva</s>. || PS 4.3.151 ||
[The suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is applied] after <s>Tāla</s> and others. || PS 4.3.152 ||
[<s>Aṇ</s> is applied] after [words denoting] gold (<s>jātarūpa</s>) in the sense of measure (<s>parimāṇa</s>). || PS 4.3.153 ||
[The suffix] <s>añ</s> [is applied] after <s>Prāṇi</s>, <s>Rajata</s>, and others. || PS 4.3.154 ||
And [<s>añ</s> is applied] after a [base ending in a suffix marked with] <s>ñit</s>. || PS 4.3.155 ||
[The suffixes are applied] as in the case of purchase (<s>krīta</s>) [when the meaning is] measure (<s>parimāṇa</s>). || PS 4.3.156 ||
[The suffix] <s>vuñ</s> [is applied] after <s>uṣṭra</s> (camel). || PS 4.3.157 ||
Optionally [<s>vuñ</s> is applied] after <s>umā</s> (flax) and <s>ūrṇā</s> (wool). || PS 4.3.158 ||
[The suffix] <s>ḍhañ</s> [is applied] after <s>eṇī</s> (female antelope). || PS 4.3.159 ||
[The suffix] <s>yat</s> [is applied] after <s>go</s> (cow) and <s>payas</s> (milk). || PS 4.3.160 ||
And [<s>yat</s> is applied] after <s>dru</s> (wood). || PS 4.3.161 ||
[The suffix <s>yat</s> is applied after] <s>vayas</s> (bird/age) in the sense of [an animal's] hide (<s>māna</s>). || PS 4.3.162 ||
[The suffix undergoes] <s>luk</s> (elision) in the sense of fruit (<s>phala</s>). || PS 4.3.163 ||
[The suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is applied] after <s>Plakṣa</s> and others. || PS 4.3.164 ||
Optionally [<s>aṇ</s> is applied] after <s>Jambū</s>. || PS 4.3.165 ||
And [the suffix undergoes] <s>lup</s> (elision). || PS 4.3.166 ||
[<s>Lup</s> is applied] after <s>Harītakī</s> and others also. || PS 4.3.167 ||
[The suffixes] <s>yañ</s> and <s>añ</s> [are applied in the case of] <s>Kaṃsīya</s> and <s>Paraśavya</s>, and [the suffix also undergoes] <s>luk</s> (elision). || PS 4.3.168 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭhak</s> [is the default suffix for sūtras] up to [the rule beginning with] <s>vahati</s>. || PS 4.4.1 ||

body.text: tena dīvyati khanati jayati jitam || PS_4,4.2 ||
body.translated_text: [The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied in the senses:] 'he gambles (<s>dīvyati</s>), digs (<s>khanati</s>), or conquers (<s>jayati</s>) with that,' [or] 'conquered (<s>jitam</s>) by that.' || PS 4.4.2 ||
[Or in the sense of] 'prepared (<s>saṃskṛtam</s>) with that.' || PS 4.4.3 ||
[The suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is applied] after <s>Kulattha</s> and [bases] having <s>ka</s> as the penultimate. || PS 4.4.4 ||
[The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied in the sense:] 'he crosses (<s>tarati</s>) with that.' || PS 4.4.5 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭhañ</s> [is applied] after <s>gopuccha</s> (cow-tail). || PS 4.4.6 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭhan</s> [is applied] after <s>nau</s> (boat) and disyllabic [bases]. || PS 4.4.7 ||
[The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied in the sense:] 'he crosses over (<s>parati</s>) with that.' || PS 4.4.8 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṣṭhal</s> [is applied] after <s>ākarṣa</s> (dragging). || PS 4.4.9 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṣṭhan</s> [is applied] after <s>Parpa</s> and others. || PS 4.4.10 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭhañ</s> also [is applied] after <s>śvagaṇa</s> (pack of dogs). || PS 4.4.11 ||
[The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied in the sense:] 'he lives (<s>jīvati</s>) by means of that,' after <s>Vetana</s> and others. || PS 4.4.12 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭhan</s> [is applied] after <s>vasna</s> (price), <s>kraya</s> (purchase), and <s>vikraya</s> (sale). || PS 4.4.13 ||
And [the suffix] <s>cha</s> also [is applied] after <s>āyudha</s> (weapon). || PS 4.4.14 ||
[The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied in the sense:] 'he carries (<s>harati</s>) [that],' after <s>Utsaṅga</s> and others. || PS 4.4.15 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṣṭhan</s> [is applied] after <s>Bhastrā</s> and others. || PS 4.4.16 ||
Optionally [<s>ṣṭhan</s> is applied] after <s>vivadha</s> and <s>vīvadha</s> (carrying-poles). || PS 4.4.17 ||
[The suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is applied] after <s>kuṭilikā</s> (crooked stick). || PS 4.4.18 ||
[The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied] in the sense of 'accomplished through' (<s>nirvṛtta</s>), after <s>akṣa</s> (dice), <s>dyūta</s> (gambling), and others. || PS 4.4.19 ||
[The derivative] <s>trermam</s> [is formed] invariably. || PS 4.4.20 ||
[The suffixes] <s>kak</s> and <s>kanu</s> [are applied] after <s>apamitya</s> (unmeasured) and <s>yācita</s> (requested). || PS 4.4.21 ||
[The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied] in the sense of 'mixed with' (<s>saṃsṛṣṭa</s>). || PS 4.4.22 ||
[The suffix] <s>ini</s> [is applied] after <s>cūrṇa</s> (powder) and others. || PS 4.4.23 ||
[The suffix undergoes] <s>luk</s> (elision) after <s>lavaṇa</s> (salt). || PS 4.4.24 ||
[The suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is applied] after <s>mudga</s> (mung bean). || PS 4.4.25 ||
[The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied in the sense of] 'seasoned (<s>upasikte</s>) with condiments (<s>vyañjana</s>).' || PS 4.4.26 ||
[The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied in the sense of] 'he acts (<s>vartate</s>) with vigor (<s>ojas</s>), strength (<s>sahas</s>), and water (<s>ambhas</s>).' || PS 4.4.27 ||

[The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied in the sense of] 'against (<s>prati</s>), along (<s>anu</s>), or following (<s>pūrvam</s>) the flow (<s>īpa</s>), hair (<s>loma</s>), or bank (<s>kūla</s>).' || PS 4.4.28 ||
And [in the sense of] 'facing' (<s>parimukham</s>). || PS 4.4.29 ||
[The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied in the sense of] 'he gives (<s>prayacchati</s>) what is blameworthy (<s>garhya</s>).' || PS 4.4.30 ||
[The suffixes] <s>ṣṭhan</s> and <s>ṣṭhac</s> [are applied] after <s>kusīda</s> (usury), <s>daśa</s> (ten), and <s>ekādaśa</s> (eleven). || PS 4.4.31 ||
[The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied in the sense of] 'he gleans (<s>ucchati</s>).' || PS 4.4.32 ||
[The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied in the sense of] 'he guards (<s>rakṣati</s>).' || PS 4.4.33 ||
[The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied in the sense of] 'he makes (<s>karoti</s>) a noise like a frog (<s>śabdadardura</s>).' || PS 4.4.34 ||
[The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied in the sense of] 'he kills (<s>hanti</s>) birds (<s>pakṣin</s>), fish (<s>matsya</s>), or animals (<s>mṛga</s>).' || PS 4.4.35 ||
[The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied in the sense of] 'he stands as an obstruction (<s>paripantham tiṣṭhati</s>)' also. || PS 4.4.36 ||

[The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied in the sense of] 'he runs (<s>dhāvati</s>) on the path (<s>mātha</s>), after (<s>uttarapada</s>), along the way (<s>padavī</s>), or following (<s>anupada</s>).' || PS 4.4.37 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭhañ</s> also [is applied] after <s>ākranda</s> (outcry). || PS 4.4.38 ||
[The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied in the sense of] 'he seizes (<s>gṛhṇāti</s>) the foot (<s>pada</s>) or the latter part of a compound (<s>uttarapada</s>).' || PS 4.4.39 ||
And [<s>ṭhak</s> is applied in the sense of one who holds] the neck (<s>pratikaṇṭha</s>), the meaning (<s>artha</s>), or the forehead-mark (<s>lalāma</s>). || PS 4.4.40 ||
[The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied in the sense of] 'he practices <s>dharma</s> (duty).' || PS 4.4.41 ||
[The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied in the sense of] 'he goes (<s>eti</s>) on each path (<s>pratipatham</s>),' and [the suffix] <s>ṭham</s> also [is applied]. || PS 4.4.42 ||
[The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied in the sense of] 'he comes together (<s>samavaiti</s>) from assemblies (<s>samavāya</s>).' || PS 4.4.43 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṇya</s> [is applied] after <s>pariṣad</s> (assembly). || PS 4.4.44 ||
Optionally [<s>ṇya</s> is applied] after <s>senā</s> (army). || PS 4.4.45 ||
[The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied] in a proper name (<s>sañjñā</s>) [in the sense of] 'he sees (<s>paśyati</s>) [the <s>lalāṭa</s> (forehead) or <s>kukkuṭī</s> (hen)].' || PS 4.4.46 ||
[The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied in the sense of] 'conforming to the <s>dharma</s> of that' (<s>tasya dharmyam</s>). || PS 4.4.47 ||
[The suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is applied] after <s>Mahiṣī</s> and others. || PS 4.4.48 ||
[The suffix] <s>añ</s> [is applied] after <s>ṛtu</s> (season). || PS 4.4.49 ||
[The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied in the sense of] 'subletting' (<s>avakraya</s>). || PS 4.4.50 ||
[The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied in the sense of] 'that is his merchandise (<s>paṇya</s>).' || PS 4.4.51 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭhañ</s> [is applied] after <s>lavaṇa</s> (salt). || PS 4.4.52 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṣṭhan</s> [is applied] after <s>Kiśara</s> and others. || PS 4.4.53 ||
[The suffix is applied] after <s>Śalālu</s> optionally. || PS 4.4.54 ||
[The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied in the sense of] 'craft' (<s>śilpa</s>). || PS 4.4.55 ||
[The suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is applied] after <s>Maḍḍuka</s> and <s>Jharjhara</s> optionally. || PS 4.4.56 ||
[The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied in the sense of] 'weapon' (<s>praharaṇa</s>). || PS 4.4.57 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭhañ</s> also [is applied] after <s>paraśvadha</s> (axe). || PS 4.4.58 ||
[The suffix] <s>īkak</s> [is applied] after <s>śakti</s> (spear) and <s>yaṣṭi</s> (staff). || PS 4.4.59 ||
[The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied in the sense of] 'belief (<s>mati</s>) in existence (<s>asti</s>), non-existence (<s>nāsti</s>), or destiny (<s>diṣṭa</s>).' || PS 4.4.60 ||
[The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied in the sense of] 'habitual conduct' (<s>śīla</s>). || PS 4.4.61 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṇa</s> [is applied] after <s>Chatra</s> and others. || PS 4.4.62 ||
[The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied in the sense of] 'engaged in (<s>vṛtta</s>) as an occupation (<s>karma</s>) or study (<s>adhyayana</s>).' || PS 4.4.63 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭhac</s> [is applied] after [a compound] whose prior member (<s>pūrvapada</s>) is polysyllabic (<s>bahvac</s>). || PS 4.4.64 ||
[The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied in the sense of] 'beneficial (<s>hita</s>) food (<s>bhakṣa</s>).' || PS 4.4.65 ||
[The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied in the sense of] 'that which is given (<s>dīyate</s>) to him as an obligation (<s>niyukta</s>).' || PS 4.4.66 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭiṭhan</s> [is applied] after <s>śrāṇā</s> (boiled rice), <s>māṃsa</s> (meat), and <s>odana</s> (cooked rice). || PS 4.4.67 ||
[The suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is applied] after <s>bhakta</s> (food) optionally. || PS 4.4.68 ||
[The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied in the sense of] 'appointed (<s>niyukta</s>) to that.' || PS 4.4.69 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭhan</s> [is applied] after [a compound] ending in <s>agāra</s> (house). || PS 4.4.70 ||
[The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied in the sense of] 'one who studies (<s>adhyāyin</s>) outside the [proper] place (<s>deśa</s>) or time (<s>kāla</s>).' || PS 4.4.71 ||
[The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied in the sense of] 'he deals (<s>vyavaharati</s>) in <s>kaṭhina</s> (robe-ceremony) conclusions, distributions, and arrangements.' || PS 4.4.72 ||
[The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied in the sense of] 'he dwells (<s>vasati</s>) near (<s>nikaṭa</s>).' || PS 4.4.73 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṣṭhal</s> [is applied] after <s>āvasatha</s> (dwelling). || PS 4.4.74 ||
[The suffix] <s>yat</s> [is the default suffix for sūtras] up to [the rule beginning with] <s>hita</s>. || PS 4.4.75 ||
[The suffix <s>yat</s> is applied in the sense of] 'he carries (<s>vahati</s>) that — a chariot-yoke (<s>rathayuga</s>) or harness (<s>prāsaṅga</s>).' || PS 4.4.76 ||
[The suffixes] <s>yaḍ</s> and <s>ḍhak</s> [are applied] after <s>dhur</s> (yoke-pole). || PS 4.4.77 ||
[The suffix] <s>kha</s> [is applied] after <s>sarvadhura</s> (all yoke-positions). || PS 4.4.78 ||
[The suffix undergoes] <s>luk</s> (elision) after <s>ekadhura</s> (single yoke-position) also. || PS 4.4.79 ||
[The suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is applied] after <s>śakaṭa</s> (cart). || PS 4.4.80 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭhak</s> [is applied] after <s>hala</s> (plough) and <s>sīra</s> (ploughshare). || PS 4.4.81 ||
[The suffix <s>yat</s> is applied] in a proper name (<s>sañjñā</s>) [in the sense of] 'born for fighting' (<s>janya</s>). || PS 4.4.82 ||
[The suffix <s>yat</s> is applied in the sense of] 'he shoots (<s>vidhyati</s>) with a bow (<s>dhanus</s>).' || PS 4.4.83 ||
[The suffix <s>yat</s> is applied in the sense of] 'one who has obtained (<s>labdhā</s>) wealth (<s>dhana</s>) or a troop (<s>gaṇa</s>).' || PS 4.4.84 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṇa</s> [is applied] after <s>anna</s> (food). || PS 4.4.85 ||
[The suffix <s>yat</s> is applied in the sense of] 'gone (<s>gata</s>) under control (<s>vaśa</s>).' || PS 4.4.86 ||
[The suffix <s>yat</s> is applied in the sense of] 'a footprint (<s>pada</s>) is visible (<s>dṛśya</s>) in this.' || PS 4.4.87 ||
[The suffix <s>yat</s> is applied in the sense of] 'its root (<s>mūla</s>) is <s>āvarhi</s> (torn out).' || PS 4.4.88 ||
[The suffix <s>yat</s> is applied] in a proper name (<s>sañjñā</s>) after <s>dhenu</s> (cow) with [the feminine suffix] <s>ṣyā</s>. || PS 4.4.89 ||
[The suffix] <s>ñya</s> [is applied in the sense of] 'associated with a <s>gṛhapati</s> (householder).' || PS 4.4.90 ||

[The suffix <s>yat</s> is applied] after <s>nau</s> (boat), <s>vayas</s> (age), <s>dharma</s> (duty), <s>viṣa</s> (poison), <s>mūla</s> (root), <s>sītā</s> (furrow), and <s>tulā</s> (balance) in the senses of 'to be crossed' (<s>tārya</s>), 'equal' (<s>tulya</s>), 'to be reached' (<s>prāpya</s>), 'to be slain' (<s>vadhya</s>), 'to be bent' (<s>ānāmya</s>), 'even' (<s>sama</s>), 'measured' (<s>samita</s>), and 'commensurate' (<s>saṃmita</s>). || PS 4.4.91 ||

[The suffix <s>yat</s> is applied] after <s>dharma</s> (duty), <s>pathi</s> (path), <s>artha</s> (meaning), and <s>nyāya</s> (principle) in the sense of 'not deviated from' (<s>anapeta</s>). || PS 4.4.92 ||
[The suffix <s>yat</s> is applied in the sense of] 'composed (<s>nirmita</s>) in a [Vedic] metre (<s>chandas</s>).' || PS 4.4.93 ||
And [the suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is applied] after <s>uras</s> (chest). || PS 4.4.94 ||
[The suffix <s>yat</s> is applied in the sense of] 'dear (<s>priya</s>) to the heart (<s>hṛdaya</s>).' || PS 4.4.95 ||
[The suffix <s>yat</s> is applied] after [a word denoting] a bond (<s>bandhana</s>) in connection with a ploughman (<s>carṣa</s>). || PS 4.4.96 ||

[The suffix <s>yat</s> is applied] after <s>mata</s> (opinion), <s>jana</s> (people), and <s>hala</s> (plough) in the senses of instrument (<s>karaṇa</s>), speech (<s>jalpa</s>), and ploughing (<s>karṣa</s>). || PS 4.4.97 ||
[The suffix <s>yat</s> is applied in the sense of] 'skilled in that' (<s>tatra sādhu</s>). || PS 4.4.98 ||
[The suffix] <s>khañ</s> [is applied] after <s>Pratijana</s> and others. || PS 4.4.99 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṇa</s> [is applied] after <s>bhakta</s> (food). || PS 4.4.100 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṇya</s> [is applied] after <s>pariṣad</s> (assembly). || PS 4.4.101 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭhak</s> [is applied] after <s>Kathā</s> and others. || PS 4.4.102 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭhañ</s> [is applied] after <s>Guḍa</s> and others. || PS 4.4.103 ||
[The suffix] <s>ḍhañ</s> [is applied] after <s>pathi</s> (path), <s>atithi</s> (guest), <s>vasati</s> (dwelling), and <s>svapati</s> (sleeping). || PS 4.4.104 ||
[The suffix] <s>ya</s> [is applied] after <s>sabhā</s> (assembly). || PS 4.4.105 ||
[The suffix] <s>ḍha</s> [is applied] in Vedic literature (<s>chandas</s>). || PS 4.4.106 ||
[The suffix <s>yat</s> is applied in the sense of] 'one who dwells (<s>vāsin</s>) at the same pilgrimage-site (<s>samānatīrtha</s>).' || PS 4.4.107 ||
[The suffix <s>yat</s> is applied in the sense of] 'one who has lain (<s>śayita</s>) in the same womb (<s>samānodara</s>),' and [the derivative takes] <s>udātta</s> (acute accent). || PS 4.4.108 ||
[The suffix] <s>ya</s> [is applied] after <s>sodara</s> (co-uterine). || PS 4.4.109 ||
[The suffix <s>yat</s> is applied] in the sense of becoming (<s>bhāva</s>) in Vedic literature (<s>chandas</s>). || PS 4.4.110 ||
[The suffix] <s>ḍyaṇ</s> [is applied] after <s>pāthas</s> (water) and <s>nadī</s> (river). || PS 4.4.111 ||
[The suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is applied] after <s>veśanta</s> (lake) and <s>himavat</s> (Himālaya). || PS 4.4.112 ||
[The suffixes] <s>ḍyaḍ</s> and <s>ḍyau</s> [are applied] optionally after <s>srotas</s> (stream). || PS 4.4.113 ||
[The suffix] <s>yan</s> [is applied] after <s>sagarbha</s> (co-uterine), <s>sayūtha</s> (of the same herd), and <s>sanuta</s> (praised together). || PS 4.4.114 ||
[The suffix] <s>ghan</s> [is applied] after <s>tugra</s>. || PS 4.4.115 ||
[The suffix] <s>yat</s> [is applied] after <s>agra</s> (front). || PS 4.4.116 ||
And [the suffixes] <s>gha</s> and <s>cha</s> [are applied]. || PS 4.4.117 ||
[The suffix] <s>gha</s> [is applied] after <s>samudra</s> (ocean) and <s>abhra</s> (cloud). || PS 4.4.118 ||
[The suffix <s>yat</s> is applied in the sense of] 'given (<s>datta</s>) at the <s>barhis</s> (sacrificial grass).' || PS 4.4.119 ||
[The suffix <s>yat</s> is applied in the sense of] 'the share (<s>bhāga</s>) or duty (<s>karman</s>) of a messenger (<s>dūta</s>).' || PS 4.4.120 ||
[The suffix <s>yat</s> is applied in the sense of] 'the female slayer (<s>hananī</s>) of <s>Rakṣas</s> (demons) and <s>Yātu</s> (sorcerers).' || PS 4.4.121 ||
[The suffix <s>yat</s> is applied] after <s>Revatī</s>, <s>Jagatī</s>, and <s>Haviṣya</s> in the sense of 'praiseworthy' (<s>praśasya</s>). || PS 4.4.122 ||
[The suffix <s>yat</s> is applied in the sense of] 'the property (<s>sva</s>) of a demon (<s>asura</s>).' || PS 4.4.123 ||
[The suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is applied] in the sense of <s>māyā</s> (illusion). || PS 4.4.124 ||

body.text: tadvān āsām upadhāno mantra iti iṣṭakāsu luk ca matoḥ || PS_4,4.125 ||
body.translated_text: [The suffix <s>yat</s> is applied in the sense of] 'possessing that,' [and in the context of <s>iṣṭakā</s> (sacrificial bricks)] 'having it as a foundation (<s>upadhāna</s>),' 'being a <s>mantra</s> (formula)' — and [the suffix undergoes] <s>luk</s> (elision), and [the suffix] <s>matu</s> [is also applicable]. || PS 4.4.125 ||
[The suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is applied in the sense of] 'possessing a horse (<s>aśvin</s>)' and 'measure (<s>māna</s>).' || PS 4.4.126 ||
[The suffix] <s>matup</s> [is applied] after <s>mūrdhan</s> (head) in the context of <s>vayasya</s> (contemporaries). || PS 4.4.127 ||
[The suffix] <s>matup</s> [is applied in a meaning] deserving <s>matup</s>, after <s>māsa</s> (month) and <s>tanu</s> (body). || PS 4.4.128 ||
And [the suffix] <s>ña</s> [is applied] after <s>madhu</s> (honey). || PS 4.4.129 ||
[The suffixes] <s>yat</s> and <s>kha</s> [are applied] after <s>ojas</s> (vigor) in connection with <s>ahan</s> (day). || PS 4.4.130 ||
[The suffix] <s>yal</s> [is applied] after <s>bhaga</s> (fortune) preceded by <s>veśa</s>, <s>yaśas</s>, and others. || PS 4.4.131 ||
And [the suffix] <s>kha</s> [is applied]. || PS 4.4.132 ||
[The suffixes] <s>ina</s> and <s>ya</s> [are applied in the sense of] 'made by the ancients (<s>pūrva</s>)' also. || PS 4.4.133 ||
[The suffix <s>yat</s> is applied in the sense of] 'consecrated (<s>saṃskṛta</s>) with water (<s>ap</s>).' || PS 4.4.134 ||
[The suffix] <s>gha</s> [is applied in the sense of] 'commensurate (<s>saṃmita</s>) with a thousand (<s>sahasra</s>).' || PS 4.4.135 ||
And [<s>gha</s> is applied] in the sense of 'opinion' (<s>mati</s>). || PS 4.4.136 ||
[The suffix] <s>ya</s> [is applied in the sense of] 'he deserves (<s>arhati</s>) <s>Soma</s>.' || PS 4.4.137 ||
And [<s>ya</s> is applied in the sense of] 'made of' (<s>maya</s>). || PS 4.4.138 ||
[<s>Ya</s> is applied] after <s>madhu</s> (honey). || PS 4.4.139 ||
And [<s>ya</s> is applied] after <s>vasu</s> (wealth) in the sense of a collective (<s>samūha</s>). || PS 4.4.140 ||
[The suffix] <s>gha</s> [is applied] after <s>nakṣatra</s> (constellation). || PS 4.4.141 ||
[The suffix] <s>tātil</s> [is applied] after <s>sarvadeva</s> (all gods). || PS 4.4.142 ||
[The suffix <s>yat</s> is applied in the sense of] 'doing (<s>kara</s>) [what is] auspicious (<s>śiva</s>), beneficial (<s>śam</s>), and propitious (<s>ariṣṭa</s>).' || PS 4.4.143 ||
And [the suffix <s>yat</s> is applied] in the sense of becoming (<s>bhāva</s>). || PS 4.4.144 ||
[The suffix] <s>cha</s> [is the default suffix for sūtras] up to [the section beginning with] <s>krīta</s> (purchased). || PS 5.1.1 ||
[The suffix] <s>yat</s> [is applied] after <s>u</s>-final stems, <s>go</s> (cow), and others. || PS 5.1.2 ||
And [<s>yat</s> is applied] after <s>kaṃvalā</s> in a proper name (<s>sañjñā</s>). || PS 5.1.3 ||
Optionally [<s>yat</s> is applied] after <s>havis</s> (oblation), <s>apūpa</s> (cake), and others. || PS 5.1.4 ||
[The suffix <s>cha</s> is applied in the sense of] 'beneficial (<s>hita</s>) for that.' || PS 5.1.5 ||
[The suffix] <s>yat</s> [is applied] after [a word denoting] a limb (<s>avayava</s>) of the body (<s>śarīra</s>). || PS 5.1.6 ||
And [<s>yat</s> is applied] after <s>khala</s> (threshing-floor), <s>yava</s> (barley), <s>māṣa</s> (bean), <s>tila</s> (sesame), <s>vṛṣa</s> (bull), and <s>brahman</s> (Brahman). || PS 5.1.7 ||
[The suffix] <s>thyan</s> [is applied] after <s>aja</s> (goat) and <s>avi</s> (sheep). || PS 5.1.8 ||
[The suffix] <s>kha</s> [is applied] after [compounds] ending in <s>ātman</s> (self), <s>viśvajana</s> (all people), and <s>bhoga</s> (enjoyment) as the latter member. || PS 5.1.9 ||
[The suffixes] <s>ṇa</s> and <s>ḍhañ</s> [are applied] after <s>sarva</s> (all) and <s>puruṣa</s> (person). || PS 5.1.10 ||
[The suffix] <s>khañ</s> [is applied] after <s>Māṇava</s> and <s>Caraka</s>. || PS 5.1.11 ||
[The suffix <s>cha</s> is applied in the sense of] 'that which is the purpose (<s>artha</s>) of a modification (<s>vikṛti</s>) with respect to the original (<s>prakṛti</s>).' || PS 5.1.12 ||
[The suffix] <s>ḍhañ</s> [is applied] after <s>chadis</s> (covering), <s>upadhi</s> (fraud), and <s>bali</s> (offering). || PS 5.1.13 ||
The suffix <s>ñya</s> [is applied] in the sense of 'bought for that' after [the words] <s>ṛṣabha</s> (bull) and <s>upānah</s> (sandal). || PS_5,1.14 ||
[The suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is applied in the sense of 'bought for that'] after <s>carman</s> (hide). || PS_5,1.15 ||

body.text: tad asya tad asmin syād iti || PS_5,1.16 ||
body.translated_text: [The suffixes prescribed hereafter are applied in the senses:] 'that is his,' [or] 'that is in this.' || PS_5,1.16 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭhañ</s> [is applied in the above senses] after <s>parikhā</s> (moat). || PS_5,1.17 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭhañ</s> [is the default suffix applied in the senses of PS 5.1.16] up to [the rule containing] <s>vateś</s> [i.e., throughout this section]. || PS_5,1.18 ||

[The suffix] <s>ṭhak</s> [is applied] up to [the rule of] <s>arha</s> (PS 5.1.63), except after [words denoting] <s>gopuccha</s> (cow-tail), <s>saṅkhyā</s> (number), and <s>parimāṇa</s> (measure). || PS_5,1.19 ||
[<s>Ṭhak</s> is applied] after [words in] the <s>niṣka</s>-group and others, [but only] when not in a compound (<s>asamāsa</s>). || PS_5,1.20 ||
And after <s>śata</s> (hundred), [the suffixes] <s>ṭhan</s> and <s>yat</s> [are applied, but] not [after a word denoting] a non-hundred [number]. || PS_5,1.21 ||
[The suffix] <s>kan</s> [is applied] after a <s>saṅkhyā</s> (numeral) ending in <s>atiśat</s> (exceeding a hundred). || PS_5,1.22 ||
[The augment] <s>iṭ</s> [is optionally added] after [a numeral ending in] <s>vat</s> [before the <s>ṭhak</s> suffix]. || PS_5,1.23 ||
[The suffix] <s>ḍvun</s> [is applied] after <s>viṃśati</s> (twenty) and <s>triṃśat</s> (thirty), [but] not in a proper name (<s>asañjñāyām</s>). || PS_5,1.24 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭiṭhaṇ</s> [is applied] after <s>kaṃsa</s> (a weight/measure of metal). || PS_5,1.25 ||
[The suffix] <s>añ</s> [is applied] after <s>śūrpa</s> (winnowing basket), optionally. || PS_5,1.26 ||
[The suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is applied] after <s>śatamāna</s> (a weight of 100 <s>palas</s>), <s>viṃśatika</s> (a weight of 20), and <s>sahasra-vasana</s> (a thousand garments). || PS_5,1.27 ||

[There is] <s>luk</s> (elision) [of the suffix] when preceded by <s>adhyardha</s> (one and a half) or [a numeral] with <s>dvigu</s> (a numeral compound), [but] not in a proper name (<s>asañjñāyām</s>). || PS_5,1.28 ||
Optionally [<s>luk</s> occurs] after <s>kārṣāpaṇa</s> (a particular coin) and <s>sahasra</s> (thousand). || PS_5,1.29 ||
[<s>Luk</s> of the suffix occurs] after <s>niṣka</s> preceded by <s>dvi</s> (two) or <s>tri</s> (three). || PS_5,1.30 ||
And [<s>luk</s> occurs] after <s>bista</s> (a small weight). || PS_5,1.31 ||
[The suffix] <s>kha</s> [is applied] after <s>viṃśatika</s> (a measure of twenty). || PS_5,1.32 ||
[The suffix] <s>īkan</s> [is applied] after <s>khārī</s> (a particular measure). || PS_5,1.33 ||
[The suffix] <s>yat</s> [is applied] after <s>paṇa</s> (a coin), <s>pāda</s> (a quarter), <s>māṣa</s> (a bean-weight), and <s>śata</s> (hundred). || PS_5,1.34 ||
Optionally [<s>yat</s> is applied] after <s>śāṇa</s> (a particular weight). || PS_5,1.35 ||
And [the suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is also applied] after [words] preceded by <s>dvi</s> (two) or <s>tri</s> (three). || PS_5,1.36 ||
[The suffixes prescribed in the preceding rules are applied in the sense:] 'bought for that' (<s>tena krītam</s>). || PS_5,1.37 ||
[The suffixes are applied in the sense:] 'that is the cause of it,' [specifically] a conjunction [of planets] (<s>saṃyoga</s>) or a portent (<s>utpāta</s>) [being the cause]. || PS_5,1.38 ||

[The suffix] <s>yat</s> [is applied] after [words of] two syllables ending in a vowel (<s>godvyac</s>), except after [words denoting] <s>saṅkhyā</s> (number), <s>parimāṇa</s> (measure), or [words beginning with] <s>aśva</s> (horse) and others. || PS_5,1.39 ||
And [the suffix] <s>cha</s> [is applied] after <s>putra</s> (son). || PS_5,1.40 ||
[The suffixes] <s>aṇ</s> and <s>añ</s> [are applied] after <s>sarvabhūmi</s> (all land) and <s>pṛthivī</s> (earth) [respectively]. || PS_5,1.41 ||
[The suffixes are applied in the sense:] 'the lord (<s>īśvara</s>) of that.' || PS_5,1.42 ||
And [in the sense:] 'one who is known (<s>vidita</s>) in that [place].' || PS_5,1.43 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭhañ</s> [is applied] after <s>loka</s> (world) and <s>sarvaloka</s> (the whole world). || PS_5,1.44 ||
[The suffixes are applied in the sense:] 'that is his livelihood (<s>vāpa</s>).' || PS_5,1.45 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṣṭhan</s> [is applied] after <s>pātra</s> (vessel, worthy recipient). || PS_5,1.46 ||
[The suffixes are applied in the sense:] 'that in which <s>vṛddhi</s> (interest), <s>āya</s> (income), <s>lābha</s> (profit), <s>śulka</s> (toll), or <s>upadā</s> (present) is given.' || PS_5,1.47 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭhan</s> [is applied] after <s>pūraṇa</s> (ordinal) [numerals] and <s>ardha</s> (half). || PS_5,1.48 ||
And [the suffix] <s>yat</s> [is applied] after <s>bhāga</s> (share, fraction). || PS_5,1.49 ||

body.text: tad dharati vahavty āvahati bhārād vaṃśādibhyaḥ || PS_5,1.50 ||
body.translated_text: [The suffixes are applied in the sense: that which] bears, carries, or brings [that]; after <s>bhāra</s> (load) and [words in] the <s>vaṃśa</s>-group and others. || PS_5,1.50 ||
[The suffixes] <s>ṭhan</s> and <s>kan</s> [are applied] after <s>vasna</s> (price) and <s>dravya</s> (goods) [respectively]. || PS_5,1.51 ||
[The suffixes are applied in the sense: that which] produces, yields, or cooks [that amount]. || PS_5,1.52 ||
[The suffix] <s>kha</s> [is applied] after <s>āḍhaka</s> (a measure), <s>ācita</s> (heaped), and <s>pātra</s> (vessel), optionally. || PS_5,1.53 ||
And [the suffix] <s>ṣṭhan</s> [is applied after] a <s>dvigu</s> (numeral compound). || PS_5,1.54 ||
And after <s>kulija</s> (a small vessel), [there is] <s>luk</s> (elision) and [the suffix] <s>kha</s> [alternatively]. || PS_5,1.55 ||
[The suffixes are applied in the sense:] 'that is his <s>aṃśa</s> (share), <s>vasna</s> (wages), or <s>bhṛti</s> (hire).' || PS_5,1.56 ||
[The suffixes are applied in the sense:] 'that is the measure (<s>parimāṇa</s>) of this.' || PS_5,1.57 ||

[The suffixes are applied] after <s>saṅkhyā</s> (numerals) in [connection with] proper names (<s>sañjñā</s>), groups (<s>saṅgha</s>), <s>sūtra</s> texts, and chapters (<s>adhyayana</s>). || PS_5,1.58 ||

[The words in this group are:] <s>paṅkti</s> (ten/a group of five), <s>viṃśati</s> (twenty), <s>triṃśat</s> (thirty), <s>catvāriṃśat</s> (forty), <s>pañcāśat</s> (fifty), <s>ṣaṣṭi</s> (sixty), <s>saptati</s> (seventy), <s>aśīti</s> (eighty), <s>navati</s> (ninety), and <s>śata</s> (hundred). || PS_5,1.59 ||
Optionally [the suffixes are applied] after <s>pañcan</s> (five) and <s>daśan</s> (ten) in [connection with] a <s>varga</s> (chapter division). || PS_5,1.60 ||
[The suffix] <s>añ</s> [is applied] after <s>saptan</s> (seven) in <s>chandas</s> (Vedic literature). || PS_5,1.61 ||
[The suffix] <s>ḍaṇ</s> [is applied] after <s>triṃśat</s> (thirty) and <s>catvāriṃśat</s> (forty) in a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> [text] when it is a proper name (<s>sañjñā</s>). || PS_5,1.62 ||
[The suffixes are applied in the sense:] 'that deserves that' (<s>tad arhati</s>). || PS_5,1.63 ||
[The suffix <s>ṭhañ</s> is applied] obligatorily (<s>nityam</s>) after [words in] the <s>cheda</s>-group and others. || PS_5,1.64 ||
And [the suffix] <s>yat</s> [is applied] after <s>śīrṣaccheda</s> (beheading). || PS_5,1.65 ||
[The suffix <s>ṭhañ</s> is applied] after [words in] the <s>daṇḍa</s>-group and others [in the sense of 'deserving that']. || PS_5,1.66 ||
And [the above applies] in <s>chandas</s> (Vedic literature) [as well]. || PS_5,1.67 ||
And [the suffix] <s>gha</s> [is applied] after <s>pātra</s> (worthy recipient). || PS_5,1.68 ||
And [the suffix] <s>cha</s> [is applied] after <s>kaḍaṅkara</s> (a small coin) and <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (sacrificial fee). || PS_5,1.69 ||
[The suffix <s>cha</s> is applied] after <s>sthālī</s> (pot) and <s>bila</s> (hole/offering). || PS_5,1.70 ||
[The suffixes] <s>gha</s> and <s>khañ</s> [are applied] after <s>yajña</s> (sacrifice) and <s>ṛtvij</s> (priest) [respectively, in the sense of 'deserving that']. || PS_5,1.71 ||

[The suffixes are applied in the sense: one who] performs (<s>vartayati</s>) a <s>pārāyaṇa</s> (complete recitation), <s>turāyaṇa</s> (a particular observance), or <s>cāndrāyaṇa</s> (a lunar penance). || PS_5,1.72 ||
[The suffixes are applied in the sense: one who] has reached (<s>āpanna</s>) doubt (<s>saṃśaya</s>). || PS_5,1.73 ||
[The suffixes are applied in the sense: one who] travels a <s>yojana</s> (a distance of about 9 miles). || PS_5,1.74 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṣkan</s> [is applied] after <s>patha</s> (path) [in the above sense]. || PS_5,1.75 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṇa</s> [is applied] obligatorily (<s>nityam</s>) after <s>panthan</s> (road). || PS_5,1.76 ||
And [the suffix is applied in the sense:] 'brought along the <s>Uttarapatha</s> (northern route).' || PS_5,1.77 ||
[The suffixes are applied] after [a word denoting] <s>kāla</s> (time). || PS_5,1.78 ||
[The suffixes are applied in the sense:] 'accomplished during that [time]' (<s>tena nirvṛttam</s>). || PS_5,1.79 ||

body.text: tam adhīṣṭo bhṛto bhūto bhāvī || PS_5,1.80 ||
body.translated_text: [The suffixes are applied in the sense: one who] has been appointed to (<s>adhiṣṭha</s>), hired for (<s>bhṛta</s>), existed during (<s>bhūta</s>), or will exist during (<s>bhāvī</s>) that [time]. || PS_5,1.80 ||
[The suffixes] <s>yat</s> and <s>khañ</s> [are applied] after <s>māsa</s> (month) [when the meaning relates to] age (<s>vayas</s>). || PS_5,1.81 ||
[The suffix] <s>yap</s> [is applied after] a <s>dvigu</s> (numeral compound) [denoting age]. || PS_5,1.82 ||
And [the suffix] <s>ṇyat</s> [is applied] after <s>ṣaṇmāsa</s> (six months). || PS_5,1.83 ||
And [the suffix] <s>ṭhan</s> [is applied] when the meaning is not age (<s>avayasi</s>). || PS_5,1.84 ||
[The suffix] <s>kha</s> [is applied] after <s>samā</s> (year). || PS_5,1.85 ||
Optionally [<s>kha</s> is applied after] a <s>dvigu</s> (numeral compound) [with <s>samā</s>]. || PS_5,1.86 ||
And [<s>kha</s> is applied] after <s>rātri</s> (night), <s>ahan</s> (day), and <s>saṃvatsara</s> (year). || PS_5,1.87 ||
And [there is] <s>luk</s> (elision of the suffix) after <s>varṣa</s> (rainy season/year). || PS_5,1.88 ||
[<s>Luk</s> occurs] obligatorily (<s>nityam</s>) when the word has the suffix <s>-vat</s> [denoting possession, in temporal senses]. || PS_5,1.89 ||
[This illustrates the rule:] <s>ṣaṣṭika</s> (sixty-day rice) ripens (<s>pacyante</s>) in sixty nights (<s>ṣaṣṭirātreṇa</s>). || PS_5,1.90 ||
[The suffix] <s>cha</s> [is applied] after [a word] ending in <s>vatsara</s> (year) in <s>chandas</s> (Vedic literature). || PS_5,1.91 ||
And [the suffix] <s>kha</s> [is applied] after [words] preceded by [the preverbs] <s>sam</s> (together) and <s>pari</s> (around). || PS_5,1.92 ||

[The suffixes are applied in the sense:] 'that by which [something] can be won (<s>parijayya</s>), obtained (<s>labhya</s>), accomplished (<s>kārya</s>), or [done] easily (<s>sukara</s>).' || PS_5,1.93 ||
[The suffixes are applied in the sense:] 'that is his <s>brahmacarya</s> (religious studentship).' || PS_5,1.94 ||
And [in the sense:] 'that is the <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (sacrificial fee) of that [sacrifice],' after [words] denoting a sacrifice (<s>yajñākhya</s>). || PS_5,1.95 ||

body.text: tatra ca dīyate kāryaṃ bhavavat || PS_5,1.96 ||
body.translated_text: And [the suffix is applied in the sense:] 'that is given or done there,' with [the form] like [that derived from] <s>bhava</s> (existing). || PS_5,1.96 ||
[The suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is applied] after [words in] the <s>vyuṣṭa</s>-group and others. || PS_5,1.97 ||
[The suffixes] <s>ṇa</s> and <s>yat</s> [are applied] after <s>yathākathāc</s> (anyhow) and <s>hasta</s> (hand) [respectively, in the sense] 'by means of that.' || PS_5,1.98 ||
[The above applies] when [the meaning is] accomplishing (<s>sampādini</s>). || PS_5,1.99 ||
[The suffix] <s>yat</s> [is applied] after <s>karma</s> (action) and <s>veṣa</s> (attire) [in the sense of accomplishing]. || PS_5,1.100 ||
[The suffixes are applied in the sense:] 'it suits him,' after [words in] the <s>santāpa</s>-group and others. || PS_5,1.101 ||
And [the suffix] <s>yat</s> [is applied] after <s>yoga</s> (connection, means). || PS_5,1.102 ||
[The suffix] <s>ukañ</s> [is applied] after [a word denoting] action (<s>karman</s>) [in the above sense]. || PS_5,1.103 ||
[The suffixes are applied in the sense:] 'the proper time (<s>samaya</s>) for that has arrived (<s>prāptam</s>).' || PS_5,1.104 ||
[The suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is applied] after <s>ṛtu</s> (season) [in the above sense]. || PS_5,1.105 ||
[The suffix] <s>gha</s> [is applied] in <s>chandas</s> (Vedic literature) [after <s>ṛtu</s>]. || PS_5,1.106 ||
[The suffix] <s>yat</s> [is applied] after [a word denoting] <s>kāla</s> (time) [in the sense of 'its proper time has come']. || PS_5,1.107 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭhañ</s> [is applied when the meaning is] eminent (<s>prakṛṣṭa</s>). || PS_5,1.108 ||
[The suffixes are applied in the sense of] purpose (<s>prayojana</s>). || PS_5,1.109 ||

[The suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is applied] after <s>Viśākhā</s> and <s>Aṣāḍhā</s> (names of lunar asterisms) in [connection with] a churning stick (<s>mantha</s>) and a staff (<s>daṇḍa</s>). || PS_5,1.110 ||
[The suffix] <s>cha</s> [is applied] after [words in] the <s>anupravacana</s>-group and others [in the sense of purpose]. || PS_5,1.111 ||
[<s>Cha</s> is applied] after <s>samāpana</s> (completion) along with its prior member in a compound. || PS_5,1.112 ||
[The word] <s>aikāgārika</s> [is used] in [the sense of] a thief (<s>caura</s>). || PS_5,1.113 ||
[The word] <s>ākālika</s> [and similar forms are used] in [the sense of] expressing beginning and end (<s>ādyantavacana</s>). || PS_5,1.114 ||

body.text: tena tulyaṃ kriyā ced vatiḥ || PS_5,1.115 ||
body.translated_text: [The suffix] <s>vati</s> [is applied in the sense:] 'the action is equal to that' (<s>tena tulyaṃ kriyā</s>). || PS_5,1.115 ||
[<s>Vati</s> is also applied in the sense:] 'there, like that' (<s>tatra tasyeva</s>). || PS_5,1.116 ||
[The suffixes are applied in the sense:] 'worthy of that' (<s>tad arham</s>). || PS_5,1.117 ||
[The suffix <s>vati</s> is applied] after a <s>upasarga</s> (preverb) in <s>chandas</s> (Vedic literature) in the sense of a verbal root (<s>dhātvartha</s>). || PS_5,1.118 ||
[The suffixes] <s>tva</s> and <s>tal</s> [are applied in the sense of] the abstract state (<s>bhāva</s>) of that. || PS_5,1.119 ||
And [the suffix] <s>ā</s> [is applied, but only] in place of <s>tva</s> [i.e., as an alternative to <s>tva</s>]. || PS_5,1.120 ||

[<s>Tva</s> and <s>tal</s> are] not [applied] after a <s>tatpuruṣa</s> compound preceded by <s>nañ</s> (negative particle), except after [the words] <s>acatura</s>, <s>saṅgata</s>, <s>lavaṇa</s>, <s>vaṭa</s>, <s>budha</s>, <s>kata</s>, <s>rasa</s>, and <s>lasa</s>. || PS_5,1.121 ||
[The suffix] <s>imanij</s> [is applied] optionally after [words in] the <s>pṛthu</s>-group and others [in the sense of abstract state]. || PS_5,1.122 ||
And [the suffix] <s>ṣyañ</s> [is applied] after [words in] the <s>varṇa</s>-group, <s>dṛḍha</s>-group, and others. || PS_5,1.123 ||
And [<s>ṣyañ</s> is applied] after <s>guṇavacana</s> (quality-denoting words) and [words in] the <s>brāhmaṇa</s>-group and others, [also] in the sense of action (<s>karman</s>). || PS_5,1.124 ||
[The suffix] <s>ya</s> [is applied] after <s>stona</s>, with elision of <s>n</s> (<s>nalopa</s>) as well. || PS_5,1.125 ||
[The suffix] <s>ya</s> [is applied] after <s>sakhi</s> (friend) [in the sense of abstract state]. || PS_5,1.126 ||
[The suffix] <s>ḍhak</s> [is applied] after <s>kapi</s> (monkey) and <s>jñāti</s> (kinsman). || PS_5,1.127 ||
[The suffix] <s>yak</s> [is applied] after [words ending in] <s>pati</s> (lord), and after [words in] the <s>purohita</s>-group and others. || PS_5,1.128 ||

[The suffix] <s>añ</s> [is applied] after [words denoting] <s>prāṇabhṛt</s> (a living being), <s>jāti</s> (class), <s>vayovacana</s> (age-denoting words), and [words in] the <s>udgātṛ</s>-group and others. || PS_5,1.129 ||
[The suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is applied] after [words] ending in <s>hāyana</s> (year) and [words in] the <s>yuva</s>-group and others. || PS_5,1.130 ||
And [<s>aṇ</s> is applied] after [words] ending in a vowel of the <s>ik</s> class (i, u, ṛ, ḷ) that have a light (<s>laghu</s>) syllable preceding [the final vowel]. || PS_5,1.131 ||
[The suffix] <s>vuñ</s> [is applied] after [a word] having <s>ya</s> as its penultimate (<s>upadhā</s>) and a heavy (<s>guru</s>) syllable as the one before the last. || PS_5,1.132 ||
And [<s>vuñ</s> is applied] after <s>dvandva</s> [compounds] and [words in] the <s>manojña</s>-group and others. || PS_5,1.133 ||

[The suffix <s>ṣyañ</s> is applied] after [words denoting] <s>gotra</s> (lineage) and <s>caraṇa</s> (Vedic school) in [the senses of] praise (<s>ślāghā</s>), excessive conduct (<s>atyākāra</s>), and being associated with them. || PS_5,1.134 ||
[The suffix] <s>cha</s> [is applied] after [words in] the <s>hotrā</s>-group. || PS_5,1.135 ||
[The suffix] <s>tva</s> [is applied after] <s>brahman</s> (the priestly office) [in the sense of abstract state]. || PS_5,1.136 ||
[The suffix] <s>khañ</s> [is applied in the sense of] 'a field where grain (<s>dhānya</s>) grows' — [i.e., both] the growing (<s>bhavana</s>) and the field (<s>kṣetra</s>). || PS_5,2.1 ||
[The suffix] <s>ḍhak</s> [is applied] after <s>vrīhi</s> (rice) and <s>śāli</s> (a type of rice). || PS_5,2.2 ||
[The suffix] <s>yat</s> [is applied] after <s>yava</s> (barley), <s>yavaka</s> (wild barley), and <s>ṣaṣṭika</s> (sixty-day rice). || PS_5,2.3 ||
Optionally [the above suffixes are applied] after <s>tila</s> (sesame), <s>māṣa</s> (bean), <s>umā</s> (flax), <s>bhaṅgā</s> (hemp), and <s>aṇu</s> (a fine grain). || PS_5,2.4 ||
[The suffixes] <s>kha</s> and <s>khañ</s> [are applied in the sense of] 'made of all [kinds of] hide' (<s>sarvacarman</s>). || PS_5,2.5 ||
[The suffix] <s>kha</s> [is applied in the sense of] 'facing' (<s>darśana</s>) with [the words] <s>yathāmukha</s> (face to face) and <s>sammukha</s> (opposite). || PS_5,2.6 ||

[The suffix <s>kha</s> is applied in the sense:] 'that pervades (<s>vyāpnoti</s>) his whole (<s>sarva</s>) body — [specifically his] path (<s>pathi</s>), limb (<s>aṅga</s>), action (<s>karma</s>), leaf (<s>patra</s>), or vessel (<s>pātra</s>),' after [words] beginning with <s>sarva</s> (all). || PS_5,2.7 ||
[The suffix <s>kha</s> is applied in the sense:] 'it reaches up to the tip of the foot (<s>āprapada</s>).' || PS_5,2.8 ||

[The suffix <s>kha</s> is applied after] <s>anupada</s> (following closely), <s>sarvānna</s> (all food), <s>aya</s> (income), and <s>anaya</s> (misfortune) in [the senses of] 'bound,' 'eating,' and 'leading.' || PS_5,2.9 ||
[The suffix <s>kha</s> is applied after] <s>parovara</s> (high and low), <s>parampara</s> (successive), and <s>putrapautra</s> (sons and grandsons) in the sense of 'experiencing.' || PS_5,2.10 ||
[The suffix <s>kha</s> is applied after] <s>avārapāra</s> (hither and yonder shore), <s>atyanta</s> (perpetual), and <s>anukāma</s> (according to desire) in the sense of 'going.' || PS_5,2.11 ||
[The suffix <s>kha</s> is applied after] <s>samāṃsa</s> (equal portion) in the sense of 'is born' (<s>vijāyate</s>). || PS_5,2.12 ||
[The words] <s>adyaśvīna</s> (procrastinating, [lit.] 'today-tomorrow') [are used] in the sense of 'held back' (<s>avaṣṭabdha</s>). || PS_5,2.13 ||
[The word] <s>āgavīna</s> [is similarly formed, denoting 'relating to cattle coming']. || PS_5,2.14 ||
[The suffix <s>kha</s> is applied after] <s>anugu</s> (following) and <s>alaṅga</s> in the sense of 'going' (<s>gāmī</s>). || PS_5,2.15 ||
[The suffixes] <s>yat</s> and <s>kha</s> [are applied] after <s>adhvan</s> (road, distance). || PS_5,2.16 ||
And [the suffix] <s>cha</s> [is applied] after <s>abhimitra</s> (facing the enemy). || PS_5,2.17 ||
[The suffix] <s>khañ</s> [is applied] after <s>goṣṭha</s> (cow-pen) in the sense of 'having been [there] formerly' (<s>bhūtapūrva</s>). || PS_5,2.18 ||
[The suffix <s>khañ</s> is applied in the sense of] 'a horse's one-day journey' (<s>aśvasyaikāhagama</s>). || PS_5,2.19 ||
[The words] <s>śālīna</s> (modest) and <s>kaupīna</s> (loincloth) [are used] in the senses of 'bashful' (<s>adhṛṣṭa</s>) and 'improper' (<s>akārya</s>) [respectively]. || PS_5,2.20 ||
[The suffix is applied in the sense:] 'one who lives by (<s>jīvati</s>) a <s>vrāta</s> (troop, guild).' || PS_5,2.21 ||
[The word] <s>sāptapadīna</s> [denotes] friendship (<s>sakhya</s>) [established by taking] seven steps [together]. || PS_5,2.22 ||
[The word] <s>haiyaṅgavīna</s> [denotes fresh butter] as a proper name (<s>sañjñā</s>). || PS_5,2.23 ||
[The suffixes] <s>kuṇap</s> and <s>jāhac</s> [are applied] after [words in] the <s>pīlvadi</s> and <s>karṇa</s>-groups respectively, in the sense of 'the cooking or root of that.' || PS_5,2.24 ||
[The suffix] <s>ti</s> [is applied] after <s>pakṣa</s> (wing, side). || PS_5,2.25 ||
[The suffixes] <s>cuñcup</s> and <s>caṇap</s> [are applied in the sense of] 'known for that' (<s>tena vitta</s>). || PS_5,2.26 ||
[The suffixes] <s>nā</s> and <s>nāñ</s> [are applied] after [the preverbs] <s>vi</s> and <s>nañ</s> (negative prefix), [with the meaning] 'without.' || PS_5,2.27 ||
[The suffixes] <s>śālac</s> and <s>śaṅkaṭac</s> [are applied] after <s>vi</s> (the prefix denoting separation). || PS_5,2.28 ||
And [the suffix] <s>kaṭac</s> [is applied] after [the preverbs] <s>sam</s>, <s>pra</s>, and <s>ud</s>. || PS_5,2.29 ||
And [the suffix] <s>kuṭārac</s> [is applied] after <s>ava</s> (the preverb meaning 'down'). || PS_5,2.30 ||

[The suffixes] <s>ṭīṭañ</s>, <s>nāṭaj</s>, and <s>bhraṭac</s> [are applied] in [connection with] the bent (<s>nata</s>) [state] of the nose (<s>nāsikā</s>), when it is a proper name (<s>sañjñā</s>). || PS_5,2.31 ||
[The suffixes] <s>biḍaj</s> and <s>birīsac</s> [are applied after the prefix] <s>ni</s> (down). || PS_5,2.32 ||

body.text: inac piṭac cika ci ca || PS_5,2.33 ||
body.translated_text: [The suffixes] <s>inac</s>, <s>piṭac</s>, <s>cikac</s>, and <s>cic</s> [are also applied in the above senses]. || PS_5,2.33 ||

[The suffix] <s>tyakan</s> [is applied] after [the preverbs] <s>upa</s> (near) and <s>adhi</s> (upon) in the senses of 'near' (<s>āsanna</s>) and 'mounted' (<s>ārūḍha</s>) [respectively]. || PS_5,2.34 ||
[The suffix] <s>aṭhac</s> [is applied to form a word denoting] an agent (<s>ghaṭa</s>) in [connection with] an action (<s>karman</s>). || PS_5,2.35 ||

body.text: tad asya sañjātaṃ tārakā-ādibhya itac || PS_5,2.36 ||
body.translated_text: [The suffix] <s>itac</s> [is applied] after [words in] the <s>tārakā</s>-group and others in the sense of 'that has appeared in him' (<s>tad asya sañjātam</s>). || PS_5,2.36 ||
[The suffixes] <s>dvayasaj</s>, <s>daghnañ</s>, and <s>mātrac</s> [are applied] in the sense of measure (<s>pramāṇa</s>). || PS_5,2.37 ||
And [the suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is applied] after <s>puruṣa</s> (man) and <s>hastin</s> (elephant) [in the sense of measure]. || PS_5,2.38 ||
[The suffix] <s>vatup</s> [is applied] after <s>yat</s> (which), <s>tad</s> (that), and <s>etad</s> (this) in the sense of measure (<s>parimāṇa</s>). || PS_5,2.39 ||
[The suffixes] <s>va</s> [in the form of <s>vatup</s>] and <s>gha</s> [are applied] after <s>kim</s> (what) and <s>idam</s> (this). || PS_5,2.40 ||
And [the suffix] <s>ḍati</s> [is applied] after <s>kim</s> in [the sense of] number (<s>saṅkhyā</s>) and measure (<s>parimāṇa</s>). || PS_5,2.41 ||
[The suffix] <s>tayap</s> [is applied] after a <s>saṅkhyā</s> (numeral) in the sense of a part (<s>avayava</s>). || PS_5,2.42 ||
[The substitute] <s>ayaj</s> [replaces] <s>tayap</s> optionally after <s>dvi</s> (two) and <s>tri</s> (three). || PS_5,2.43 ||
[The word formed with <s>tayap</s>] after <s>ubha</s> (both) is obligatorily <s>udātta</s> (acute-accented). || PS_5,2.44 ||

body.text: tad asminn adhikam iti daśāntāḍ ḍaḥ || PS_5,2.45 ||
body.translated_text: [The suffix] <s>ḍa</s> [is applied] after [numerals] ending in <s>daśan</s> (ten) in the sense of 'that is excessive in this' (<s>tad asminn adhikam</s>). || PS_5,2.45 ||
And [<s>ḍa</s> is applied] after [numerals] ending in <s>śat</s> and <s>viṃśati</s> (twenty). || PS_5,2.46 ||
[The suffix] <s>mayaṭ</s> [is applied] after a <s>saṅkhyā</s> (numeral) in the sense of measuring the degree of a quality (<s>guṇa</s>). || PS_5,2.47 ||
[The suffix] <s>ḍaṭ</s> [is applied in the sense of] the ordinal (<s>pūraṇa</s>) of that [number]. || PS_5,2.48 ||
