[The suffix] <s>maṭ</s> [is applied] after [numerals] not ending in <s>n</s> and not beginning with a non-numeral (<s>asaṅkhyādi</s>). || PS_5,2.49 ||
And [the suffix] <s>thaṭ</s> [is applied as ordinal] in <s>chandas</s> (Vedic literature). || PS_5,2.50 ||
[The augment] <s>thuk</s> [is inserted] after <s>ṣaṣ</s> (six), <s>kati</s> (how many), <s>katipaya</s> (some), and <s>catur</s> (four) [before ordinal suffixes]. || PS_5,2.51 ||
[The augment] <s>tithuk</s> [is inserted] after <s>bahu</s> (many), <s>pūga</s> (multitude), <s>gaṇa</s> (group), and <s>saṅgha</s> (assembly). || PS_5,2.52 ||
[The augment] <s>ithuk</s> [is inserted] after [a numeral ending in] <s>vat</s>. || PS_5,2.53 ||
After <s>dvi</s> (two), [the ordinal is] <s>tīya</s> [i.e., <s>dvitīya</s>, second]. || PS_5,2.54 ||
After <s>tri</s> (three), [the ordinal is formed] with <s>samprasāraṇa</s> (vowel substitution) as well [i.e., <s>tṛtīya</s>, third]. || PS_5,2.55 ||
[The suffix] <s>tamaḍ</s> [is applied as ordinal] after <s>viṃśati</s> (twenty) and the following [numerals], optionally. || PS_5,2.56 ||
Obligatorily [<s>tamaḍ</s> is applied] after <s>śata</s> (hundred) and higher numerals, <s>māsa</s> (month), <s>ardhamāsa</s> (fortnight), and <s>saṃvatsara</s> (year). || PS_5,2.57 ||
And [<s>tamaḍ</s> is applied] after <s>ṣaṣṭi</s> (sixty) and the following [numerals], when [the compound] does not begin with a numeral. || PS_5,2.58 ||
[The suffix] <s>cha</s> [is applied] in the sense of praise (<s>mati</s>) in [connection with] a <s>sūkta</s> (Vedic hymn) and a <s>sāman</s> (chant). || PS_5,2.59 ||
[There is] <s>luk</s> (elision of the suffix) in [connection with] an <s>adhyāya</s> (chapter) and an <s>anuvāka</s> (subsection). || PS_5,2.60 ||
[The suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is applied] after [words in] the <s>vimukta</s>-group and others. || PS_5,2.61 ||
[The suffix] <s>vun</s> [is applied] after [words in] the <s>goṣad</s>-group and others. || PS_5,2.62 ||
[The suffixes are applied in the sense:] 'skilled (<s>kuśala</s>) in that,' [specifically] after <s>patha</s> (road, method). || PS_5,2.63 ||
[The suffix] <s>kan</s> [is applied] after [words in] the <s>ākarṣa</s>-group and others [in the sense of 'skilled in that']. || PS_5,2.64 ||
[The suffix <s>kan</s> is applied] after <s>dhana</s> (wealth) and <s>hiraṇya</s> (gold) in the sense of desire (<s>kāma</s>). || PS_5,2.65 ||
[The suffix <s>kan</s> is applied] after [words denoting] one's own limbs (<s>svāṅga</s>) in the sense of attachment (<s>prasita</s>). || PS_5,2.66 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭhak</s> [is applied] after <s>udara</s> (belly) in the sense of gluttony (<s>ādyūna</s>). || PS_5,2.67 ||
[The suffix <s>kan</s> is applied in the sense:] 'abounding in crops' (<s>sasyena parijāta</s>). || PS_5,2.68 ||
[The suffix <s>kan</s> is applied in the sense:] 'taking a share' (<s>aṃśaṃ hāri</s>). || PS_5,2.69 ||
[The suffix <s>kan</s> is applied in the sense of] 'recently taken away from the loom' (<s>tantrāt acirāpahṛta</s>). || PS_5,2.70 ||
[The words] <s>brāhmaṇaka</s> and <s>uṣṇīka</s> [are used] as proper names (<s>sañjñā</s>). || PS_5,2.71 ||
[The suffix <s>kan</s> is applied] after <s>śīta</s> (cold) and <s>uṣṇa</s> (hot) in the sense of 'causing' (<s>kārin</s>). || PS_5,2.72 ||
[The suffixes are applied in the sense of] 'excess' (<s>adhika</s>). || PS_5,2.73 ||
[The words] <s>anuka</s>, <s>abhika</s>, and <s>abhīka</s> [denote] one who desires (<s>kamitā</s>). || PS_5,2.74 ||
[The suffix is applied in the sense: one who] seeks (<s>anvicchati</s>) by the side (<s>pārśvena</s>). || PS_5,2.75 ||
[The suffixes] <s>ṭhak</s> and <s>ṭhañ</s> [are applied] after <s>ayaḥśūla</s> (iron spike), <s>daṇḍa</s> (stick), and <s>ajina</s> (deer-skin) [respectively]. || PS_5,2.76 ||

body.text: tāvatithaṃ grahaṇam iti lug vā || PS_5,2.77 ||
body.translated_text: [The word] <s>tāvatitha</s> [denotes] 'that many-th taking' (<s>grahaṇa</s>), with optional <s>luk</s> (elision) [of the suffix]. || PS_5,2.77 ||
[The suffix is applied in the sense:] 'he is the <s>grāmaṇī</s> (village headman) of these.' || PS_5,2.78 ||
[The suffix is applied in the sense:] '<s>śṛṅkhala</s> (chain) is his fetter,' in [connection with] a young camel (<s>karabha</s>). || PS_5,2.79 ||
[The word] <s>utka</s> [denotes one who is] longing (<s>unamanās</s>, with uplifted mind). || PS_5,2.80 ||
[The suffix <s>kan</s> is applied] after [a word denoting] time (<s>kāla</s>) or purpose (<s>prayojana</s>) in [connection with] disease (<s>roga</s>). || PS_5,2.81 ||

body.text: tad asminn annaṃ prāye sañjñāyām || PS_5,2.82 ||
body.translated_text: [The <s>taddhita</s> (secondary derivative suffix) is applied] to denote that which is the predominant food in that [place], in a proper name.
[The suffix] <s>añ</s> [is applied] after <s>kulmāṣa</s> (parched grain).
<s>Śrotriya</s> [denotes one who] has studied the <s>Chandas</s> (Vedic texts).
[The suffixes] <s>ini</s> and <s>ṭhan</s> [are applied in the sense of] 'the <s>śrāddha</s> (funeral rite) has been eaten by him.'
[The suffix] <s>niḥ</s> [is applied] after <s>pūrva</s> etc.
And [<s>niḥ</s> is applied] after [words] preceded by <s>sa</s>.
And [<s>niḥ</s> is applied] after <s>iṣṭa</s> (sacrifice) etc.
In the <s>Chandas</s> (Vedic literature), <s>paripanthin</s> and <s>paripariṇa</s> [are used] in the sense of one who obstructs.
[In the <s>Chandas</s>, the forms <s>anupadin</s> and <s>anveṣṭṛ</s> are used] in the sense of a pursuer.
[The suffix <s>ini</s> is applied] in the sense of a direct witness, in a proper name.
<s>Kṣetriyac</s> [denotes] a disease curable [only] in another's field.

<s>Indriya</s> (faculty of sense), <s>indra-liṅga</s> (sign of <s>Indra</s>), <s>indra-dṛṣṭa</s> (seen by <s>Indra</s>), <s>indra-sṛṣṭa</s> (created by <s>Indra</s>), <s>indra-juṣṭa</s> (favored by <s>Indra</s>), <s>indra-datta</s> (given by <s>Indra</s>) — these are optionally [so formed].

body.text: tad asya asty asminn iti matup || PS_5,2.94 ||
body.translated_text: [The suffix] <s>matup</s> [is applied in the sense of] 'he has that' or 'that exists in him.'
And [<s>matup</s> is applied] after <s>rasa</s> (taste, juice) etc.
[The suffix] <s>lac</s> [is applied] optionally after [a stem ending in] <s>ā</s> that denotes something situated on a living being.
And [<s>lac</s> is applied] after <s>sidhma</s> (a skin disease) etc.
[The suffixes <s>lac</s> are applied] after <s>vatsa</s> and <s>aṃsa</s> in the senses of 'desire' and 'strength.'
And [the suffix] <s>ilac</s> [is applied] after <s>phena</s> (foam).
[The suffixes] <s>śa</s>, <s>na</s>, and <s>ilac</s> [are applied] after the <s>lomādi</s>, <s>pāmādi</s>, and <s>picchādi</s> groups respectively.
[The suffix] <s>ṇa</s> [is applied] after <s>prajñā</s> (wisdom), <s>śraddhā</s> (faith), <s>arcā</s> (worship), and <s>vṛtti</s> (livelihood).
[The suffixes] <s>vini</s> and <s>inī</s> [are applied] after <s>tapas</s> (austerity) and <s>sahasra</s> (thousand).
And [the suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is also applied after <s>tapas</s> and <s>sahasra</s>].
And [<s>aṇ</s> is applied] after <s>sikatā</s> (sand) and <s>śarkarā</s> (gravel).
And [the suffixes] <s>lup</s> and <s>ilac</s> [are applied] in [the sense of] a place.
[The suffix] <s>urac</s> [is applied after] <s>danta</s> (tooth) [in the sense of] 'protruding.'
[The suffix] <s>ra</s> [is applied] after <s>ūṣa</s> (saline ground), <s>suṣi</s> (hole), <s>muṣka</s> (testicle), and <s>madhu</s> (honey).
[The suffix] <s>ma</s> [is applied] after <s>dyu</s> (sky) and <s>dru</s> (wood).
[The suffix] <s>va</s> [is applied] after <s>keśa</s> (hair), optionally.
[The suffix <s>va</s> is applied] after <s>gāṇḍī</s> and <s>ajagā</s>, in a proper name.
[The suffixes] <s>īran</s> and <s>īrac</s> [are applied] after <s>kāṇḍa</s> (stalk) and <s>āṇḍa</s> (egg).
[The suffix] <s>valac</s> [is applied] after <s>rajas</s> (dust), <s>kṛṣi</s> (agriculture), <s>āsuti</s> (distillation), and <s>pariṣad</s> (assembly).
[The suffix <s>valac</s> is applied] after <s>danta</s> (tooth) and <s>śikhā</s> (crest), in a proper name.

<s>Jyotsnā</s> (moonlight), <s>tamisrā</s> (darkness), <s>śṛṅgin</s> (horned), <s>ūrjasvin</s> (vigorous), <s>ūrjasvala</s> (energetic), <s>gomin</s> (possessing cattle), <s>malina</s> (dirty), and <s>malīmasa</s> (filthy) [are irregularly formed words denoting possession].
[The suffixes] <s>ini</s> and <s>ṭhan</s> [are applied] after [stems ending in] <s>a</s>.
And [<s>ini</s> and <s>ṭhan</s> are applied] after <s>vrīhi</s> (rice) etc.
And [the suffix] <s>ilac</s> [is applied] after <s>tunda</s> (belly) etc.
[The suffix] <s>ṭhañ</s> [is applied] invariably after [words] preceded by <s>eka</s> (one), <s>go</s> (cow), or <s>pūrva</s> (first).
And [<s>ṭhañ</s> is applied] after [words] ending in <s>śata</s> (hundred) or <s>sahasra</s> (thousand), except <s>niṣka</s>.
[The suffix] <s>yap</s> [is applied] after <s>rūpa</s> (form) in the senses of 'struck' and 'praised.'
[The suffix] <s>vini</s> [is applied] after <s>as</s> (arrow), <s>māyā</s> (illusion), <s>medhā</s> (intelligence), and <s>sraj</s> (garland).
Variously in the <s>Chandas</s> (Vedic literature) [these suffixes are applied].
[The suffix] <s>yus</s> [is applied] after <s>ūrṇā</s> (wool).
[The suffix] <s>gmini</s> [is applied] after <s>vāc</s> (speech).
[The suffixes] <s>āla</s> and <s>jāṭac</s> [are applied in the sense of] one who talks excessively.
[The suffix <s>ini</s> is applied after] <s>svāmin</s> (lord) in the sense of sovereignty.
[The suffix] <s>ac</s> [is applied] after <s>arśa</s> (hemorrhoids) etc.
[The suffix] <s>ini</s> [is applied] after [words denoting] a <s>dvandva</s> (paired disease), <s>upatāpa</s> (affliction), or something blameworthy, [when] situated on a living being.
And [the augment] <s>kuk</s> [is added when <s>ini</s> follows] after <s>vāta</s> (wind-disease) and <s>atisāra</s> (dysentery).
[The suffix <s>ini</s> is applied] after ordinal numerals (<s>pūraṇa</s>) in the sense of age.
And [<s>ini</s> is applied] after <s>sukha</s> (pleasure) etc.
And [<s>ini</s> is applied] after [words] ending in <s>dharma</s> (duty), <s>śīla</s> (character), or <s>varṇa</s> (class).
[The suffix <s>ini</s> is applied] after <s>hasta</s> (hand) in the sense of 'born from.'
[The suffix <s>ini</s> is applied] after <s>varṇa</s> (class) [to denote] a <s>brahmacārin</s> (religious student).
[The suffix <s>ini</s> is applied] after <s>puṣkara</s> (lotus) etc. in the sense of a place.
[The suffix] <s>matup</s> [is applied] after <s>bala</s> (strength) etc., optionally.
In a proper name, [the suffixes] <s>man</s> and <s>mā</s> [are applied].
[The suffixes] <s>ba</s>, <s>bha</s>, <s>yus</s>, <s>ti</s>, <s>tu</s>, <s>ta</s>, and <s>yas</s> [are applied] after <s>kam</s> and <s>śam</s>.
[The suffix] <s>bha</s> [is applied] after <s>tundi</s>, <s>bali</s>, and <s>vaṭa</s>.
[The suffix] <s>yus</s> [is applied] after <s>aham</s> and <s>śubham</s>.
[The <s>taddhita</s> suffixes treated as] <s>vibhakti</s> (case-endings) [are taught in the rules] up to [the section beginning with] <s>prāg diśaḥ</s>.
[These <s>vibhakti</s>-substituting suffixes are applied] after <s>kim</s> (what), <s>sarvanāman</s> (pronouns), and <s>bahu</s> (many) — excluding <s>dvi</s> (two) etc.
[The suffix] <s>iś</s> [is applied] after <s>idam</s> (this).
[The suffixes] <s>ra</s> and <s>tha</s> [are applied] after <s>eta</s> and <s>ita</s> respectively.
[The suffix] <s>aś</s> [is applied] after <s>etad</s> (this).
[The suffix] <s>sa</s> [replaces the suffix] of <s>sarva</s> (all), optionally, in the sense of direction.
[The suffix] <s>tasil</s> [is applied in place of] the fifth case (ablative).
And [<s>tasil</s> is applied in place] of <s>tase</s> (the dative infinitive).
And [<s>tasil</s> is applied] after <s>pari</s> and <s>abhi</s>.
[The suffix] <s>tral</s> [is applied in place of] the seventh case (locative).
[The suffix] <s>ha</s> [is applied] after <s>idam</s> (this) [in the locative sense].
[The suffix] <s>at</s> [is applied] after <s>kim</s> (what) [in the locative sense].
And optionally <s>ha</s> [is applied after <s>kim</s>] in the <s>Chandas</s> (Vedic literature).
[These suffixes] are also seen after other [pronouns in the <s>Chandas</s>].
[The suffix] <s>dā</s> [is applied] after <s>sarva</s> (all), <s>eka</s> (one), <s>anya</s> (other), <s>kim</s> (what), <s>yat</s> (which), and <s>tad</s> (that), in the sense of time.
[The suffix] <s>rhil</s> [is applied] after <s>idam</s> (this) [in the sense of time].
[The word] <s>adhunā</s> (now) [is an irregular formation in the sense of present time from <s>idam</s>].
And [the suffix] <s>dānīm</s> [is applied after <s>idam</s> in the sense of time].
[The suffix] <s>dā</s> also [is applied] after <s>tad</s> (that) [in the sense of time].
And [the suffixes] <s>dā</s> and <s>rhil</s> [are applied] after both of those (<s>idam</s> and <s>tad</s>) in the <s>Chandas</s> (Vedic literature).
[The suffix] <s>rhil</s> [is applied] in [the sense of] non-present time (<s>anadyatana</s>), optionally.

<s>Sadyas</s> (on the same day), <s>parut</s> (last year), <s>parāri</s> (the year before last), <s>auṣamas</s> (of this year), <s>paredyavi</s> (on the following day), <s>adya</s> (today), <s>pūrvedyus</s> (on the previous day), <s>anyedyus</s> (on another day), <s>anyataredyus</s> (on one of two days), <s>itaredyus</s> (on the other day), <s>aparedyus</s> (on the next day), <s>adharedyus</s> (on the day below), <s>ubhayedyus</s> (on both days), <s>uttaredyus</s> (on the following day) [are irregular formations].
[The suffix] <s>thāl</s> [is applied] in the sense of manner.
[The suffix] <s>thamu</s> [is applied] after <s>idam</s> (this) [in the sense of manner].
And [<s>thamu</s> is applied] after <s>kim</s> (what) [in the sense of manner].
[The suffix] <s>thā</s> [is applied] in the sense of cause also, in the <s>Chandas</s> (Vedic literature).
[The suffix] <s>astāti</s> [is applied] after direction-words in the seventh (locative), fifth (ablative), and first (nominative) cases, in the senses of direction, place, and time.
[The suffix] <s>atasuc</s> [is applied] after <s>dakṣiṇa</s> (south) and <s>uttara</s> (north).
Optionally [<s>atasuc</s> is applied] after <s>para</s> (far) and <s>avara</s> (near).
[There is] <s>luk</s> (deletion) of [the suffix] <s>añc</s>.
<s>Upari</s> and <s>upariṣṭāt</s> (above) [are formed irregularly].
<s>Paścāt</s> (behind, after) [is formed irregularly].
<s>Paśca</s> and <s>paścā</s> [are used] in the <s>Chandas</s> (Vedic literature).
[The suffix] <s>āti</s> [is applied] after <s>uttara</s> (north), <s>adhara</s> (below), and <s>dakṣiṇa</s> (south).
[The suffix] <s>ena</s> [is applied] optionally in the sense of 'not far,' [but] not [in place of] the fifth case (ablative).
[The suffix] <s>āc</s> [is applied] after <s>dakṣiṇa</s> (south).
And [the suffix] <s>āhi</s> [is applied] in the sense of 'far.'
And [<s>āhi</s> is applied] after <s>uttara</s> (north).
For <s>pūrva</s> (east), <s>adhara</s> (below), and <s>avara</s> (near), [the suffix] <s>as</s> [is applied, and they are replaced by] <s>pur</s>, <s>adhas</s>, and <s>avas</s> respectively.
And [the suffix] <s>astāti</s> [is also applied after these].
Optionally [this applies] for <s>avara</s> (near).
[The suffix] <s>dhā</s> [is applied] after a numeral in the sense of distribution.
And [<s>dhā</s> is applied] in [the sense of] shift of location (<s>adhikaraṇa-vicāla</s>).
[The suffix] <s>dha</s> [is applied] after <s>eka</s> (one), and optionally [the suffix] <s>dyamuñ</s> [is also applied].
And [the suffix] <s>dhamuñ</s> [is applied] after <s>dvi</s> (two) and <s>tri</s> (three).
And [<s>dhamuñ</s> is applied] after <s>edhā</s>.
[The suffix] <s>pāśap</s> [is applied in the sense of] what is to be bound (<s>yāpya</s>).
[The suffix] <s>an</s> [is applied] after an ordinal numeral from <s>tīya</s> (third) onward, in the sense of a fractional part.
[This rule applies to ordinals] before <s>ekādaśa</s> (eleventh), [but] not in the <s>Chandas</s> (Vedic literature).
And [the suffix] <s>ña</s> [is also applied] after <s>ṣaṣṭha</s> (sixth) and <s>aṣṭama</s> (eighth).
And [the suffixes] <s>kan</s> and <s>luk</s> (zero suffix) [are applied] in [the sense relating to] a measure or a limb of an animal.
And [the suffix] <s>ākinic</s> [is applied] after <s>eka</s> (one) in the sense of 'without a companion.'
[The suffix] <s>caraṭ</s> [is applied in the sense of] 'formerly' (<s>bhūtapūrva</s>).
And [the suffix] <s>rūpya</s> [is applied in place of] the sixth case (genitive).
In the sense of the superlative degree (<s>atiśāyana</s>), [the suffixes] <s>tamab</s> and <s>iṣṭhan</s> [are applied].
And [they are applied] after verbal endings (<s>tiṅ</s>).
[The suffixes] <s>tarab</s> and <s>īyasun</s> [are applied] when a dual or a distributive word is in the context (<s>upapada</s>).
[<s>Tarab</s> and <s>īyasun</s> whose initial is] a vowel [are applied] only after quality-denoting words (<s>guṇavacana</s>).
[The suffix] <s>tu</s> [is used] in the <s>Chandas</s> (Vedic literature) [in the superlative/comparative sense].
[The substitute] <s>śra</s> [replaces the base] of <s>praśasya</s> (praiseworthy) [before <s>iṣṭhan</s> and <s>īyasun</s>].
And [the substitute] <s>jya</s> [replaces <s>praśasya</s> before <s>tamab</s> and <s>tarab</s>].
And [<s>śra</s> and <s>jya</s> replace the base] of <s>vṛddha</s> (old, great).
For <s>antika</s> (near) and <s>bāḍha</s> (strong), [the substitutes are] <s>neda</s> and <s>sādhu</s> [respectively].
For <s>yuvan</s> (young) and <s>alpa</s> (small), [the suffix] <s>kan</s> [is applied] optionally.
[There is] <s>luk</s> (deletion) of [the suffixes] <s>vin</s> and <s>matu</s> [before the comparative and superlative suffixes].
[The suffix] <s>rūpap</s> [is applied] in the sense of praise.
[The suffixes] <s>kalpab</s>, <s>deśya</s>, and <s>deśīyara</s> [are applied] in the sense of 'slightly' or 'almost' (<s>īṣad-asamāpta</s>).

body.text: vibhāṣā supo bahuc parastāt tu || PS_5,3.68 ||
body.translated_text: Optionally, [the suffix] <s>bahuc</s> [is applied] after a <s>sup</s> (nominal ending), but [it is placed] after [the word].
[The suffix] <s>jātīyar</s> [is applied] in the sense of manner or kind.
[The suffix] <s>ka</s> [is applied in rules] up to [the section beginning with] <s>iva</s>.
[The suffix] <s>akac</s> [is applied] after <s>avyayas</s> (indeclinables) and <s>sarvanāmans</s> (pronouns), before [the suffix] <s>ṭe</s>.
And [the substitute] <s>da</s> [replaces the final] of <s>ka</s> [in <s>kim</s>].
[The suffix <s>ka</s> is applied] in the sense of the unknown.
[The suffix <s>ka</s> is applied] in the sense of contempt.
[The suffix] <s>kan</s> [is applied] in a proper name.
[The suffix <s>kan</s> is applied] in the sense of compassion.
And [<s>kan</s> is applied] in the sense of censure, after [a word] connected with that [which is censured].
[The suffix] <s>ṭhaj</s> [is applied] optionally after a polysyllabic human name.
And [the suffixes] <s>ghan</s> and <s>ilac</s> [are also applied in the diminutive sense].
In the eastern [dialects], [the suffixes] <s>aḍaj</s> and <s>vuc</s> also [are applied] after [a word with the prefix] <s>upā</s> etc.
[The suffix] <s>kan</s> [is applied] after a generic name (<s>jātināman</s>).
And [there is] deletion of the final member (<s>uttarapada-lopa</s>) of [a compound] ending in <s>ajina</s> (animal skin).
[The deletion prescribed for words before suffixes] <s>ṭha</s> and <s>aj</s> etc. [occurs from] the second vowel upward.
For <s>Śevala</s>, <s>Supari</s>, <s>Viśālā</s>, <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Aryaman</s> etc., [the deletion occurs] from the third [vowel].
[The suffix <s>ka</s> is applied] in the sense of 'small.'
[The suffix <s>ka</s> is applied] in the sense of 'short.'
[The suffix] <s>kan</s> [is applied] in a proper name [denoting smallness].
[The suffix] <s>ra</s> [is applied] after <s>kuṭī</s> (hut), <s>śamī</s> (the Śamī tree), and <s>śuṇḍā</s> (trunk) [in the diminutive sense].
[The suffix] <s>ḍupac</s> [is applied in the sense of] 'how much?' (<s>kutvā</s>).
[The suffix] <s>ṣṭarac</s> [is applied] after <s>kāsu</s> and <s>goṇī</s> [in the diminutive sense].
And [<s>ṣṭarac</s> is applied] after <s>vatsa</s> (calf), <s>ukṣan</s> (bull), <s>aśva</s> (horse), and <s>ṛṣabha</s> (bull) in the sense of slenderness.

body.text: kiṃ-yat-tado nirdhāraṇe dvayor ekasya ḍatarac || PS_5,3.92 ||
body.translated_text: [The suffix] <s>ḍatarac</s> [is applied] after <s>kim</s> (what), <s>yat</s> (which), and <s>tad</s> (that) in the sense of singling out one of two.
And optionally [the suffix] <s>ḍatamac</s> [is applied in the sense of] an inquiry about the class of many.
And [the suffix] <s>ekāc</s> [is used] in the eastern [dialects for the same purpose].
[The suffix] <s>kan</s> [is applied] in the sense of deprecation.
[The suffix <s>ka</s> is applied] in the sense of resemblance, like <s>iva</s> (like).
And [<s>ka</s> is applied] in a proper name [denoting resemblance].
[There is] <s>luk</s> (deletion) [of <s>ka</s>] in [the sense of] a human being.
And [<s>ka</s> is applied] in [the sense of] trade goods, for livelihood.
And [<s>ka</s> is applied] after <s>devapatha</s> (path of the gods) etc.
[The suffix] <s>dhañ</s> [is applied] after <s>vastra</s> (cloth).
[The suffix] <s>ḍha</s> [is applied] after <s>śilā</s> (stone).
[The suffix] <s>yat</s> [is applied] after <s>śākhā</s> (branch) etc.
And [<s>yat</s> is applied after] a substance word in the sense of 'suitable.'
[The suffix] <s>cha</s> [is applied] after <s>kuśāgra</s> (tip of kuśa grass).
And [<s>cha</s> is applied] after a compound [word] that has that [substance] as its domain.
[The suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is applied] after <s>śarkarā</s> (gravel) etc.
[The suffix] <s>ṭhak</s> [is applied] after <s>aṅguli</s> (finger) etc.
[The suffix] <s>ṭhaj</s> [is applied] after <s>ekaśālā</s> (single hall), optionally.
[The suffix] <s>īkak</s> [is applied] after <s>karka</s> (white) and <s>lohita</s> (red).
[The suffix] <s>thāl</s> [is applied] after <s>pratna</s> (ancient), <s>pūrva</s> (former), <s>viśva</s> (all), and <s>ima</s> (this), in the <s>Chandas</s> (Vedic literature).
[The suffix] <s>ñya</s> [is applied] after a guild (<s>pūga</s>), [but] not after [a word whose prior member is] <s>grāmaṇī</s> (village headman).
[The suffix <s>ñya</s> is applied after] <s>vrāta</s> (multitude) and <s>sphañ</s>, [but] not in the feminine.
[The suffix] <s>ñyaḍ</s> [is applied] in the senses of weapon, livelihood, and guild, [but] not after a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> or <s>Kṣatriya</s> [word]; and in <s>Vāhīka</s> [usage it applies regardless].
[The suffix] <s>ṭeṇyaṇ</s> [is applied] after <s>vṛka</s> (wolf).
[The suffix] <s>cha</s> [is applied] after <s>dāmanyādi</s> and <s>Trigarta-ṣṭha</s> groups.
[The suffixes] <s>aṇ</s> and <s>añ</s> [are applied] after the <s>Parśvādi</s> and <s>Yaudheyādi</s> groups respectively.
[The suffix] <s>yañ</s> [replaces the suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [after] <s>Abhijit</s>, <s>Vidabhṛt</s>, <s>Śālāvat</s>, <s>Śikhāvat</s>, <s>Śamīvat</s>, <s>Ūrṇāvat</s>, and <s>Śarumat</s>.
<s>Ñya</s> and the following [suffixes] are [termed] <s>tadrāja</s> (denoting the ruler or people of that region).

body.text: pādaśatasya saṅkhyāder vīpsāyāṃ vun lopaś ca || PS_5,4.1 ||
body.translated_text: [The suffix] <s>vun</s> [is applied] after [a compound ending in] <s>pāda-śata</s> (hundred verses), with a numeral as the prior member, in the sense of repetition (<s>vīpsā</s>); and [there is] deletion [of the final member].
And [<s>vun</s> is applied] in the senses of punishment (<s>daṇḍa</s>) and release (<s>vyavasarga</s>).
[The suffix] <s>kan</s> [is applied] after <s>sthūla</s> (thick) etc. in the sense of manner or type.
[The suffix <s>kan</s> is applied] after a <s>kta</s> (past participle) [stem] in the sense of 'not completely' (<s>anatyantagata</s>).
[The suffix <s>kan</s> is] not [applied] in the sense of similarity (<s>sāmi-vacana</s>).
[The suffix <s>kan</s> is applied] after <s>bṛhatī</s> (a Vedic meter) in the sense of covering.

[The suffix] <s>kha</s> [is applied] after [compounds such as] <s>aṣaḍakṣa</s>, <s>āśitaṅgu</s>, <s>alaṅkarma</s>, <s>alampuruṣa</s>, and those with <s>adhi</s> as the final member of the prior element.
Optionally [<s>kha</s> is applied] after [words with] <s>añc</s>, [but] not after a <s>Kṣatriya</s> word.
[The suffix] <s>cha</s> [is applied] after [a compound] ending in a generic term, in the sense of a kinsman (<s>bandhu</s>).
Optionally [<s>cha</s> is applied] after [a word denoting] a different place, if [the person is] with someone from the same place.

[The suffix <s>kha</s> is applied after] <s>kim</s> (what), <s>etad</s> (this), a <s>tiṅ</s> (verbal ending), an <s>avyaya</s> (indeclinable), a <s>gha</s>-ending word, or <s>ām</s>-ending word — not in the sense of material excellence.
And [<s>kha</s> is applied] after <s>amu</s> (that) in the <s>Chandas</s> (Vedic literature).
[The suffix] <s>ṭhak</s> [is applied] after <s>anugādin</s> (echo-word) etc.
[The suffix] <s>añ</s> [is applied] after [words ending in the suffix] <s>ṇac</s>, in the feminine.
[The suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is applied] after [words ending in the suffix] <s>inuṇ</s>.
[The suffix <s>aṇ</s> is applied] after <s>visārin</s> in [the sense relating to] fish.
[The suffix] <s>kṛtvasuc</s> [is applied] after a numeral in the sense of counting repetitions of an action.
[The suffix] <s>suc</s> [is applied] after <s>dvi</s> (two), <s>tri</s> (three), and <s>catur</s> (four) [in the same sense].
And [after] <s>eka</s> (one), [the form is] <s>sakṛt</s> (once).
Optionally [the suffix] <s>dhā</s> [is applied] after <s>bahu</s> (many), [but] not in the sense of a remote time.
[The suffix] <s>mayaṭ</s> [is applied in the sense of] 'made of that' or 'consisting of that.'
And [<s>mayaṭ</s> is applied] in the sense of a collectivity, when [referring to] many.
[The suffix] <s>ñya</s> [is applied] after [compounds ending in] <s>ananta</s> (endless), <s>āvasatha</s> (dwelling), <s>itiha</s> (tradition), and <s>bheṣaja</s> (medicine).
[The suffix] <s>yat</s> [is applied] after [a compound] ending in a deity name, in the sense of 'intended for that.'
And [<s>yat</s> is applied] after <s>pāda</s> (foot) and <s>argha</s> (value, offering).
[The suffix] <s>ñya</s> [is applied] after <s>atithi</s> (guest).
[The suffix] <s>tal</s> [is applied] after <s>deva</s> (god).
[The suffix] <s>ka</s> [is applied] after <s>avi</s> (sheep).
[The suffix] <s>kan</s> [is applied] after <s>yāva</s> (barley) etc.
[The suffix <s>kan</s> is applied] after <s>lohita</s> (red) in [the sense relating to] a jewel.
And [<s>kan</s> is applied after <s>lohita</s>] in the sense of a non-permanent color.
[The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied] in the sense of 'dyed' (<s>rakta</s>). || PS 5.4.32 ||
And [<s>ṭhak</s> is applied] after <s>kāla</s> (time). || PS 5.4.33 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭhak</s> [is applied] after <s>Vinaya</s> and others. || PS 5.4.34 ||
[The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied] after <s>vāc</s> (speech) in the sense of an uttered meaning (<s>vyāhṛtārtha</s>). || PS 5.4.35 ||
[The suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [is applied] after [a word denoting] an action (<s>karman</s>) that is connected with that (<s>tadyukta</s>). || PS 5.4.36 ||
[The suffix <s>aṇ</s> is applied] after [a word denoting] a medicinal plant (<s>oṣadhi</s>) when it has not yet produced [fruit] (<s>ajāta</s>). || PS 5.4.37 ||
And [<s>aṇ</s> is applied] after <s>Prajñā</s> and others. || PS 5.4.38 ||
[The suffix] <s>tikan</s> [is applied] after <s>mṛd</s> (clay). || PS 5.4.39 ||
[The suffix <s>tikan</s> is applied] after <s>sasna</s> (dewlap) in the sense of praise (<s>praśaṃsā</s>). || PS 5.4.40 ||
[The suffixes] <s>til</s> and <s>tātil</s> [are applied] after <s>vṛka</s> (wolf) and <s>jyeṣṭha</s> (eldest) respectively, and also in Vedic literature (<s>chandas</s>). || PS 5.4.41 ||
[The suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied] after [a word denoting] 'much' (<s>bahu</s>) or 'little' (<s>alpa</s>) meaning, from [a word ending in] <s>śas</s> or <s>kāra</s>, optionally. || PS 5.4.42 ||
And [the suffix <s>ṭhak</s> is applied] after a numeral (<s>saṅkhyā</s>) in the singular (<s>ekavacana</s>) in the sense of distribution (<s>vīpsā</s>). || PS 5.4.43 ||
[The suffix] <s>tasi</s> [is applied] after the fifth case (<s>pañcamī</s>) in the sense of comparison (<s>pratiyoga</s>). || PS 5.4.44 ||
And [<s>tasi</s> is applied] after the ablative (<s>apādāna</s>) in connection with [the roots] <s>ahīya</s> (to fall short) and <s>ruh</s> (to grow). || PS 5.4.45 ||

[<s>Tasi</s> is applied] after the third case (<s>tṛtīyā</s>) in the senses of excess (<s>atigraha</s>), endurance (<s>avyathana</s>), and throwing (<s>kṣepa</s>), when not [denoting] the agent (<s>akartṛ</s>). || PS 5.4.46 ||
And [<s>tasi</s> is applied] after [a word denoting] diminution (<s>hīyamāna</s>) or bad association (<s>pāpayoga</s>). || PS 5.4.47 ||
[<s>Tasi</s> is applied] after the sixth case (<s>ṣaṣṭhī</s>) in the sense of dependence (<s>vyāśraya</s>). || PS 5.4.48 ||
And [<s>tasi</s> is applied] after [a word denoting] a disease (<s>roga</s>) in the sense of removal (<s>apanayana</s>). || PS 5.4.49 ||

[The suffix] <s>cvi</s> [is applied] in the sense of becoming what one was not before (<s>abhūtatadbhāva</s>), in conjunction with [the roots] <s>kṛ</s> (to make), <s>bhū</s> (to become), and <s>as</s> (to be), when the agent (<s>kartṛ</s>) is the one who undergoes the transformation (<s>sampadya</s>). || PS 5.4.50 ||

And [there is] elision (<s>lopa</s>) of [the final portions of] <s>arus</s> (wound), <s>manas</s> (mind), <s>cakṣus</s> (eye), <s>cetas</s> (thought), <s>rahas</s> (secret), and <s>rajas</s> (dust). || PS 5.4.51 ||
Optionally [<s>cvi</s> is applied] with [the suffix] <s>sāti</s> in the sense of completeness (<s>kārtsnya</s>). || PS 5.4.52 ||
[<s>Cvi</s> is applied] in the sense of inclusion (<s>abhividhi</s>) and with [the suffix] <s>sampad</s> also. || PS 5.4.53 ||
[<s>Cvi</s> is applied] in the sense of 'speaking as subordinate to that' (<s>tadadhīnavacana</s>). || PS 5.4.54 ||
[<s>Cvi</s> is applied] in the sense of 'to be given' (<s>deya</s>), and [the suffix] <s>trā</s> also [is applied]. || PS 5.4.55 ||

[<s>Cvi</s> is applied] after <s>deva</s> (god), <s>manuṣya</s> (human), <s>puruṣa</s> (person), <s>puru</s> (many), and <s>martya</s> (mortal), with the second and seventh cases, variously (<s>bahulam</s>). || PS 5.4.56 ||

[The suffix] <s>ḍāc</s> [is applied] after an onomatopoeic word (<s>avyaktānukaraṇa</s>) that is disyllabic, not ending in a semivowel (<s>avar</s>), and not half [a syllable] (<s>ārdha</s>), when not in the sense of [mere] sound production (<s>anita</s>). || PS 5.4.57 ||

[<s>Ḍāc</s> is applied] after [the root] <s>kṛñ</s> (to make) with [words denoting] 'second' (<s>dvitīya</s>), 'third' (<s>tṛtīya</s>), <s>śamba</s> (bolt), and <s>bīja</s> (seed) in the sense of ploughing (<s>kṛṣa</s>). || PS 5.4.58 ||
And [<s>ḍāc</s> is applied] after a numeral (<s>saṅkhyā</s>) ending in a quality-word (<s>guṇānta</s>). || PS 5.4.59 ||
And [<s>ḍāc</s> is applied] after <s>samaya</s> (agreement) in the sense of passing time (<s>yāpana</s>). || PS 5.4.60 ||
[<s>Ḍāc</s> is applied] after <s>sapatra</s> (with leaves) and <s>niṣpatra</s> (leafless) in the sense of excessive pain (<s>ativyathana</s>). || PS 5.4.61 ||
[<s>Ḍāc</s> is applied] after <s>niṣkula</s> (without husk) in the sense of husking (<s>niṣkoṣaṇa</s>). || PS 5.4.62 ||
[<s>Ḍāc</s> is applied] after <s>sukha</s> (pleasure) and <s>priya</s> (dear) in the sense of 'going with the natural order' (<s>ānulomya</s>). || PS 5.4.63 ||
[<s>Ḍāc</s> is applied] after <s>duḥkha</s> (pain) in the sense of 'going against the natural order' (<s>prātilomya</s>). || PS 5.4.64 ||
[<s>Ḍāc</s> is applied] after <s>śūla</s> (spit) in the sense of cooking (<s>pāka</s>). || PS 5.4.65 ||
[<s>Ḍāc</s> is applied] after <s>satya</s> (truth) in the sense of 'not an oath' (<s>aśapatha</s>). || PS 5.4.66 ||
[<s>Ḍāc</s> is applied] after <s>madra</s> in the sense of shaving (<s>parivāpaṇa</s>). || PS 5.4.67 ||
[The following suffixes are] compound-final (<s>samāsānta</s>) suffixes. || PS 5.4.68 ||
Not [when the compound expresses] veneration (<s>pūjana</s>). || PS 5.4.69 ||
[The suffix <s>ḍāc</s> is applied] after <s>kim</s> (what) in the sense of contempt (<s>kṣepa</s>). || PS 5.4.70 ||
[The suffix <s>ḍāc</s> is applied] after a <s>tatpuruṣa</s> compound [beginning] with <s>nañ</s> (negative particle). || PS 5.4.71 ||
Optionally [<s>ḍāc</s> is applied] after <s>pathu</s> (path). || PS 5.4.72 ||

[The suffix] <s>ḍaj</s> [is applied] in a <s>bahuvrīhi</s> compound that is numerable (<s>saṅkhyeya</s>), [but] not after [a word denoting] a multitude (<s>bahu</s>) or a group (<s>gaṇa</s>). || PS 5.4.73 ||

[The final elements] of <s>ṛc</s> (verse), <s>pūr</s> (fortress), <s>ap</s> (water), <s>dhūḥ</s> (yoke), and <s>pathin</s> (path) [are replaced] when not in the <s>nakṣatra</s> [compounds]. || PS 5.4.74 ||

[The suffix] <s>ac</s> [is applied] after [compounds with] <s>prati</s>, <s>anu</s>, and <s>ava</s> as prior elements, [when the latter member is] <s>sāman</s> (chant) or <s>loman</s> (hair). || PS 5.4.75 ||
[<s>Ac</s> is applied] after <s>akṣan</s> (eye) in the sense of 'not seeing' (<s>adarśana</s>). || PS 5.4.76 ||

[Compound-final forms are fixed in:] <s>acatura</s>, <s>vicatura</s>, <s>sucatura</s>, <s>strīpuṃsa</s>, <s>dhenvanaḍuha</s>, <s>rkṣāma</s>, <s>vāṅmanasa</s>, <s>akṣibhruva</s>, <s>dāragava</s>, <s>ūrvaṣṭhīva</s>, <s>padaṣṭhīva</s>, <s>naktaṃdiva</s>, <s>rātriṃdiva</s>, <s>ahardiva</s>, <s>sarajasa</s>, <s>niḥśreyasa</s>, <s>puruṣāyuṣa</s>, <s>dvyāyuṣa</s>, <s>tryāyuṣa</s>, <s>rgyajuṣa</s>, <s>jātokṣa</s>, <s>mahokṣa</s>, <s>vṛddhokṣa</s>, <s>upaśuna</s>, and <s>goṣṭhaśva</s>. || PS 5.4.77 ||
[The compound-final <s>ac</s> is applied] after <s>brahman</s> and <s>hastin</s> (elephant) when followed by <s>varcas</s> (splendor). || PS 5.4.78 ||
[<s>Ac</s> is applied] after <s>ava</s>, <s>sam</s>, and <s>andha</s> when followed by <s>tamas</s> (darkness). || PS 5.4.79 ||
[<s>Ac</s> is applied] after <s>śvas</s> (tomorrow) when followed by <s>vasīyas</s> (better) and <s>śreyas</s> (best). || PS 5.4.80 ||
[<s>Ac</s> is applied] after <s>anu</s>, <s>ava</s>, and <s>tapta</s> (heated) when followed by <s>rahas</s> (secret). || PS 5.4.81 ||
[<s>Ac</s> is applied] after <s>prati</s> with <s>uras</s> (chest), when [the compound] has the seventh case as its basis (<s>saptamīstha</s>). || PS 5.4.82 ||
[The compound-final form] <s>anugava</s> [is used] in the sense of length (<s>āyāma</s>). || PS 5.4.83 ||
[The compound-final forms] <s>dvistāvā</s> and <s>tristāvā</s> [are used in connection with] <s>vedi</s> (sacrificial altar). || PS 5.4.84 ||
[<s>Ac</s> is applied] after a preverb (<s>upasarga</s>) when followed by <s>adhvan</s> (road). || PS 5.4.85 ||
[<s>Ac</s> is applied] in a <s>tatpuruṣa</s> compound after <s>aṅguli</s> (finger), when the prior member is a numeral (<s>saṅkhyā</s>) or an indeclinable (<s>avyaya</s>). || PS 5.4.86 ||

And [<s>ac</s> is applied] after <s>rātri</s> (night), when preceded by <s>ahar</s> (day), <s>sarva</s> (all), <s>ekadeśa</s> (part), <s>saṅkhyāta</s> (numbered), or <s>puṇya</s> (auspicious). || PS 5.4.87 ||
[The substitute] <s>ahna</s> replaces <s>ahan</s> (day) after these [same prior members]. || PS 5.4.88 ||
Not [when] a numeral is the first member in a collective compound (<s>samāhāra</s>). || PS 5.4.89 ||
And [not] after <s>uttama</s> (last) and <s>eka</s> (one). || PS 5.4.90 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṭac</s> [is applied] after <s>rājan</s> (king), <s>ahan</s> (day), and <s>sakhi</s> (friend). || PS 5.4.91 ||
[<s>Ṭac</s> is applied] after <s>go</s> (cow) when [the suffix] is not a <s>taddhita</s> or <s>luk</s>-elided. || PS 5.4.92 ||
[<s>Ṭac</s> is applied] after <s>uras</s> (chest) in a name (<s>ākhyā</s>) denoting prominence (<s>agra</s>). || PS 5.4.93 ||
[The suffix] <s>an</s> [is applied] after <s>aśman</s> (stone), <s>ayas</s> (iron), and <s>saras</s> (lake) in [the senses of] class (<s>jāti</s>) and proper name (<s>sañjñā</s>). || PS 5.4.94 ||
And [<s>an</s> is applied] after <s>grāma</s> (village) and <s>kauṭa</s> in connection with <s>takṣan</s> (carpenter). || PS 5.4.95 ||
[The suffix] <s>at</s> [is applied] after <s>śunaḥ</s> (of a dog). || PS 5.4.96 ||
[<s>At</s> is applied] after a word of comparison (<s>upamāna</s>) when [the referent is] not an animate being (<s>aprāṇin</s>). || PS 5.4.97 ||
And [<s>at</s> is applied] after <s>sakthi</s> (thigh) when preceded by <s>uttara</s> (upper), <s>mṛga</s> (deer), or <s>pūrva</s> (prior). || PS 5.4.98 ||
[The suffix <s>ac</s> is applied after] <s>nau</s> (boat) in a <s>dvigu</s> compound. || PS 5.4.99 ||
And [<s>ac</s> is applied] after <s>ardha</s> (half). || PS 5.4.100 ||
[<s>Ac</s> is applied] after <s>khārī</s> (a measure) in the eastern [dialect] (<s>prācām</s>). || PS 5.4.101 ||
[<s>Ac</s> is applied] after <s>añjali</s> (cupped hands) when preceded by <s>dvi</s> (two) and <s>tri</s> (three). || PS 5.4.102 ||
[The suffix <s>ac</s> is applied] after neuter (<s>napuṃsaka</s>) [stems] ending in <s>an</s> or <s>as</s> in Vedic literature (<s>chandas</s>). || PS 5.4.103 ||
[<s>Ac</s> is applied] after <s>brahman</s> in a name denoting a country's people (<s>jānapadākhyā</s>). || PS 5.4.104 ||
Optionally [<s>ac</s> is applied] after <s>ku</s> (bad) and <s>mahat</s> (great). || PS 5.4.105 ||
[<s>Ac</s> is applied] after a <s>dvandva</s> compound ending in <s>cu</s>, <s>da</s>, <s>ṣa</s>, or <s>ha</s> in a collective sense (<s>samāhāra</s>). || PS 5.4.106 ||
[<s>Ac</s> is applied] in an <s>avyayībhāva</s> compound after <s>śarat</s> (autumn) and others. || PS 5.4.107 ||
And [<s>ac</s> is applied] after <s>anas</s> (cart). || PS 5.4.108 ||
[<s>Ac</s> is applied] after a neuter (<s>napuṃsaka</s>) optionally. || PS 5.4.109 ||
[The word] <s>nadī</s> (river) [is used in compounds] after <s>Paurṇamāsī</s> (full-moon day) and <s>Āgrahāyaṇī</s>. || PS 5.4.110 ||
[<s>Ac</s> is applied after words] ending in [the suffix] <s>jña</s>. || PS 5.4.111 ||
And [<s>ac</s> is applied] after <s>giri</s> (mountain). || PS 5.4.112 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṣac</s> [is applied] in a <s>bahuvrīhi</s> compound after <s>sakthi</s> (thigh) and <s>akṣi</s> (eye), [when denoting] one's own limb (<s>svāṅga</s>). || PS 5.4.113 ||
[<s>Ṣac</s> is applied] after <s>aṅguli</s> (finger) in connection with wood (<s>dāru</s>). || PS 5.4.114 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṣa</s> [is applied] after <s>dvi</s> (two) and <s>tri</s> (three) with <s>mūrdhan</s> (head). || PS 5.4.115 ||
[The suffix] <s>ap</s> [is applied in the senses of] ordinal (<s>pūraṇī</s>) and measure (<s>pramāṇa</s>). || PS 5.4.116 ||
And [<s>ap</s> is applied] after <s>antar</s> (inner) and <s>bahis</s> (outer) with <s>loman</s> (hair). || PS 5.4.117 ||

body.text: añ nāsikāyāḥ sañjñāyāṃ nasaṃ ca asthūlāt || PS_5,4.118 ||
body.translated_text: [The suffix] <s>añ</s> [is applied] after <s>nāsikā</s> (nose) in a proper name (<s>sañjñā</s>), and [the substitute] <s>nasa</s> [replaces <s>nāsikā</s>], and not after a thick (<s>sthūla</s>) [nose]. || PS 5.4.118 ||
And [<s>añ</s> is applied] after a preverb (<s>upasarga</s>). || PS 5.4.119 ||
[Fixed compound-final forms are:] <s>suprāta</s>, <s>suśva</s>, <s>sudiva</s>, <s>śārikukṣa</s>, <s>caturaśra</s>, <s>eṇīpada</s>, <s>ajapada</s>, and <s>proṣṭhapada</s>. || PS 5.4.120 ||
After <s>nañ</s> (negative), <s>duḥ</s> (bad), and <s>su</s> (good), [the compound-final forms of] <s>hali</s> and <s>sakthi</s> [are applied] optionally. || PS 5.4.121 ||
[The suffix] <s>asic</s> [is applied] invariably after <s>prajā</s> (offspring) and <s>medhā</s> (intelligence). || PS 5.4.122 ||
[The form] <s>bahuprajā</s> [is used] in Vedic literature (<s>chandas</s>). || PS 5.4.123 ||
[The suffix] <s>anic</s> [is applied] after <s>dharma</s> (duty) when standing alone (<s>kevala</s>). || PS 5.4.124 ||
[The substitute] <s>jambha</s> [is applied] after <s>suharita</s>, <s>tṛṇa</s>, and <s>soma</s>. || PS 5.4.125 ||
[The suffix] <s>mā</s> [is applied] after <s>dakṣiṇa</s> (south/right) when not in connection with greed (<s>lubdhayoga</s>). || PS 5.4.126 ||
[The suffix] <s>ic</s> [is applied] in the sense of reciprocal action (<s>karmavyatihāra</s>). || PS 5.4.127 ||
And [<s>ic</s> is applied] after <s>Dvidaṇḍī</s> and others. || PS 5.4.128 ||
[The substitute] <s>jñu</s> [replaces] <s>jānu</s> (knee) after <s>pra</s> and <s>sam</s>. || PS 5.4.129 ||
Optionally [<s>jñu</s> replaces <s>jānu</s>] after <s>ūrdhva</s> (upward). || PS 5.4.130 ||
[The suffix] <s>anaṅ</s> [is applied] after <s>ūdhas</s> (udder). || PS 5.4.131 ||
And [<s>anaṅ</s> is applied] after <s>dhanus</s> (bow). || PS 5.4.132 ||
Optionally in a proper name (<s>sañjñā</s>). || PS 5.4.133 ||
[The suffix] <s>niṅ</s> [is applied] after <s>jāyā</s> (wife). || PS 5.4.134 ||
[The substitute] <s>id</s> [replaces] <s>gandha</s> (smell) after <s>ut</s> (strong), <s>pūti</s> (foul), <s>su</s> (good), and <s>surabhi</s> (fragrant). || PS 5.4.135 ||
[<s>Id</s> replaces <s>gandha</s>] in a name denoting smallness (<s>alpākhyā</s>). || PS 5.4.136 ||
And [<s>id</s> replaces <s>gandha</s>] after a word of comparison (<s>upamāna</s>). || PS 5.4.137 ||
[There is] elision (<s>lopa</s>) of <s>pāda</s> (foot) [when the compound is] not after <s>hasti</s> (elephant) and others. || PS 5.4.138 ||
And [elision of <s>pāda</s> occurs] in the <s>Kumbhapadī</s> group. || PS 5.4.139 ||
[Elision occurs when] a numeral (<s>saṅkhyā</s>) or <s>su</s> (good) is the prior member. || PS 5.4.140 ||
[The substitute] <s>dat</s> [replaces] <s>danta</s> (tooth) in [compounds denoting] age (<s>vayas</s>). || PS 5.4.141 ||
And [this substitution occurs] in Vedic literature (<s>chandas</s>). || PS 5.4.142 ||
[The substitute <s>dat</s> is applied] in the feminine in a proper name (<s>sañjñā</s>). || PS 5.4.143 ||
Optionally [<s>dat</s> replaces <s>danta</s>] after <s>śyāva</s> (dark) and <s>aroka</s> (without luster). || PS 5.4.144 ||
And [<s>dat</s> replaces <s>danta</s>] after <s>agrānta</s> (tip-ended), <s>śuddha</s> (pure), <s>śubhra</s> (bright), <s>vṛṣa</s> (bull), and <s>varāha</s> (boar). || PS 5.4.145 ||
[There is] elision (<s>lopa</s>) of <s>kakuda</s> (hump) in the sense of a condition (<s>avasthā</s>). || PS 5.4.146 ||
[The form] <s>trikakut</s> [is used] in connection with a mountain (<s>parvata</s>). || PS 5.4.147 ||
[Elision of the final of] <s>kakuda</s> [occurs] after <s>ud</s> (up) and <s>vi</s> (apart). || PS 5.4.148 ||
Optionally [elision occurs] after <s>pūrṇa</s> (full). || PS 5.4.149 ||
[The compounds] <s>suhṛd</s> (friend) and <s>durhṛd</s> (enemy) [are formed] in the senses of <s>mitra</s> (friend) and <s>amitra</s> (enemy). || PS 5.4.150 ||
[The suffix] <s>kap</s> [is applied] after <s>uras</s> (chest) and others. || PS 5.4.151 ||
[The suffix <s>kap</s> applies to derivatives] ending in <s>in</s> when in the feminine (<s>strī</s>). || PS 5.4.152 ||
And [<s>kap</s> is applied] after <s>nadī</s> (river) and <s>ṛta</s> (truth). || PS 5.4.153 ||
Optionally [<s>kap</s> is applied] after the rest (<s>śeṣa</s>). || PS 5.4.154 ||
Not in a proper name (<s>sañjñā</s>). || PS 5.4.155 ||
And [not] after [stems ending in the comparative suffix] <s>īyas</s>. || PS 5.4.156 ||
[<s>Kap</s> is applied] after <s>bhrātṛ</s> (brother) in the sense of greeting (<s>vandita</s>). || PS 5.4.157 ||
[<s>Kap</s> is applied] after <s>ṛta</s> (truth) in Vedic literature (<s>chandas</s>). || PS 5.4.158 ||
[<s>Kap</s> is applied] after <s>nāḍī</s> (tube) and <s>tantrī</s> (string) in connection with one's own body (<s>svāṅga</s>). || PS 5.4.159 ||
And [the form] <s>niṣpravāṇi</s> [is fixed]. || PS 5.4.160 ||
One vowel (<s>ac</s>) of the first [syllable of the root], consisting of a single vowel, [is reduplicated]. || PS 6.1.1 ||
[The reduplication is] of the second [consonant] when [the root] begins with a vowel. || PS 6.1.2 ||
Not [when the initial consonant cluster includes] <s>n</s>, <s>d</s>, <s>r</s>, or when a consonant cluster (<s>saṃyoga</s>) is at the beginning. || PS 6.1.3 ||
The prior [portion of the reduplicated form] is the <s>abhyāsa</s> (reduplicative syllable). || PS 6.1.4 ||
Both [the <s>abhyāsa</s> and the root together] are called <s>abhyasta</s> (reduplicated). || PS 6.1.5 ||
<s>Jakṣiti</s> and the [other] six [roots are considered] reduplicated [without further reduplication]. || PS 6.1.6 ||
The <s>abhyāsa</s> (reduplicative syllable) of the <s>Tujādi</s> roots [takes a] long [vowel]. || PS 6.1.7 ||
In the <s>liṭ</s> (perfect tense), [reduplication is applied to] the root that has not [yet] been reduplicated. || PS 6.1.8 ||
[Reduplication is applied] in [the desiderative] <s>san</s> and [the intensive] <s>yaṅ</s>. || PS 6.1.9 ||
[Reduplication is applied] in [the <s>liṅ</s>-replacement] <s>ślu</s>. || PS 6.1.10 ||
[Reduplication is applied] in <s>caṅ</s> (the causative aorist marker). || PS 6.1.11 ||
[The perfect participial forms] <s>dāśvān</s>, <s>sāhvān</s>, and <s>mīḍvān</s> also [involve reduplication]. || PS 6.1.12 ||

[There is] <s>samprasāraṇa</s> (semivowel replacement by the corresponding vowel) of [the <s>ṣyaṅ</s> suffix] in a <s>tatpuruṣa</s> compound [denoting] <s>putra</s> (son) or <s>pati</s> (husband). || PS 6.1.13 ||
[<s>Samprasāraṇa</s> of <s>ṣyaṅ</s> occurs] after <s>bandhu</s> (kinsman) in a <s>bahuvrīhi</s> compound. || PS 6.1.14 ||
[<s>Samprasāraṇa</s> occurs] in [the roots] <s>vac</s> (to speak), <s>svap</s> (to sleep), <s>yaj</s> (to sacrifice), and others, when followed by a suffix marked with <s>kit</s>. || PS 6.1.15 ||

[<s>Samprasāraṇa</s> occurs] in [the roots] <s>grah</s> (to seize), <s>jyā</s> (to overpower), <s>vay</s> (to weave), <s>vyadh</s> (to pierce), <s>vaṣṭi</s> (to desire), <s>vicati</s> (to sift), <s>vṛścati</s> (to cut), <s>pṛcchati</s> (to ask), and <s>bhṛjjati</s> (to roast), when followed by a suffix marked with <s>ṅit</s> also. || PS 6.1.16 ||
In the <s>liṭ</s> (perfect tense), [<s>samprasāraṇa</s> occurs] in the <s>abhyāsa</s> (reduplicative syllable) of both [groups]. || PS 6.1.17 ||
[<s>Samprasāraṇa</s> occurs] in [the root] <s>svap</s> (to sleep) in <s>caṅ</s> (causative aorist). || PS 6.1.18 ||
[<s>Samprasāraṇa</s> occurs] in [the roots] <s>svap</s> (to sleep), <s>syam</s> (to limit), and <s>vyeñ</s> (to cover) in <s>yaṅ</s> (intensive). || PS 6.1.19 ||
Not [<s>samprasāraṇa</s>] in [the root] <s>vaś</s> (to desire). || PS 6.1.20 ||
[The root] <s>cāy</s> becomes <s>kī</s> [by <s>samprasāraṇa</s>]. || PS 6.1.21 ||
[The root] <s>sphāy</s> becomes <s>sphī</s> in the past participle (<s>niṣṭhā</s>). || PS 6.1.22 ||
[The root] <s>sty</s> [undergoes <s>samprasāraṇa</s>] when preceded by <s>pra</s>. || PS 6.1.23 ||
[The root] <s>śy</s> [undergoes <s>samprasāraṇa</s>] in connection with liquid substance (<s>dravamūrti</s>) and touch (<s>sparśa</s>). || PS 6.1.24 ||
And [<s>samprasāraṇa</s> occurs] after <s>prati</s>. || PS 6.1.25 ||
Optionally [<s>samprasāraṇa</s> occurs] when preceded by <s>abhi</s> and <s>ava</s>. || PS 6.1.26 ||
[The form] <s>śṛta</s> [is used] in the sense of cooking (<s>pāka</s>). || PS 6.1.27 ||
[The root] <s>pyāy</s> becomes <s>pī</s> [by <s>samprasāraṇa</s>]. || PS 6.1.28 ||
And [<s>pī</s> occurs] in the <s>liṭ</s> (perfect) and <s>yaṅ</s> (intensive). || PS 6.1.29 ||
Optionally [<s>samprasāraṇa</s> occurs in the root] <s>śvi</s> (to swell). || PS 6.1.30 ||
And [<s>samprasāraṇa</s> occurs] in the causative (<s>ṇi</s>), in <s>saṃś</s> (to doubt) and <s>caṅ</s> (causative aorist). || PS 6.1.31 ||
[The root] <s>hva</s> (to call) undergoes <s>samprasāraṇa</s>. || PS 6.1.32 ||
And [<s>samprasāraṇa</s> occurs] in a reduplicated form (<s>abhyasta</s>). || PS 6.1.33 ||
[<s>Samprasāraṇa</s> occurs] variously (<s>bahulam</s>) in Vedic literature (<s>chandas</s>). || PS 6.1.34 ||
[The root] <s>cāy</s> becomes <s>kī</s>. || PS 6.1.35 ||

[The Vedic forms] <s>apaspṛdhethām</s>, <s>ānṛcuḥ</s>, <s>ānṛhuḥ</s>, <s>cicyuṣe</s>, <s>tityāja</s>, <s>śrātāḥ</s>, <s>śritam</s>, <s>āśīḥ</s>, and <s>āśīrtāḥ</s> [are listed as examples]. || PS 6.1.36 ||
There is no <s>samprasāraṇa</s> where [there is already] a <s>samprasāraṇa</s> [vowel]. || PS 6.1.37 ||
In the <s>liṭ</s> (perfect tense), [the semivowel] <s>v</s> of <s>vyo</s> [becomes] <s>ya</s>. || PS 6.1.38 ||

body.text: vaś ca asya anyatarasyāṃ kiti || PS_6,1.39 ||
body.translated_text: And [the semivowel] <s>v</s> of [the root] <s>vaś</s> (to desire) [becomes <s>u</s>] optionally when followed by a suffix marked with <s>kit</s>. || PS 6.1.39 ||
[<s>Samprasāraṇa</s> occurs in the root] <s>veñ</s> (to weave). || PS 6.1.40 ||
And [<s>samprasāraṇa</s> occurs] in [the absolutive suffix] <s>lyap</s>. || PS 6.1.41 ||
And [<s>samprasāraṇa</s> occurs in the root] <s>jya</s> (to overpower). || PS 6.1.42 ||
And [<s>samprasāraṇa</s> occurs in the root] <s>vya</s> (to envelop). || PS 6.1.43 ||
Optionally [<s>samprasāraṇa</s> occurs] after <s>pari</s> (around). || PS 6.1.44 ||
[The vowel] <s>ā</s> replaces [the vowel] <s>e</s> [of a root] in the original listing (<s>upadeśa</s>), when [the suffix] is not marked with <s>śit</s>. || PS 6.1.45 ||
Not [<s>samprasāraṇa</s> of] <s>v</s> [of <s>vyo</s>] in the <s>liṭ</s> (perfect). || PS 6.1.46 ||
[<s>Samprasāraṇa</s> occurs in the roots] <s>sphur</s> (to throb) and <s>sphul</s> (to spring) in [the suffix] <s>ghañ</s>. || PS 6.1.47 ||
[The vowels of the roots] <s>krī</s> (to buy), <s>iṅ</s> (to go), and <s>jī</s> (to conquer) [are lengthened] in the causative (<s>ṇau</s>). || PS 6.1.48 ||
[The vowel of the root] <s>sidh</s> (to succeed) [is lengthened] when not in the worldly sense (<s>apāralaukika</s>). || PS 6.1.49 ||
[The vowels of the roots] <s>mīnāti</s> (to diminish), <s>minoti</s> (to throw), and <s>dīṅ</s> (to decay) [are lengthened] in <s>lyap</s> (absolutive) also. || PS 6.1.50 ||
Optionally [the vowel is lengthened] in [the root] <s>līyate</s> (to cling). || PS 6.1.51 ||
[The vowel is lengthened] in [the root] <s>khid</s> (to be distressed) in Vedic literature (<s>chandas</s>). || PS 6.1.52 ||
[The vowel is lengthened] in [the root] <s>gur</s> (to praise) with <s>apa</s> in [the suffix] <s>ṇamul</s>. || PS 6.1.53 ||
[The vowels of the roots] <s>ci</s> (to gather) and <s>sphur</s> (to throb) [are lengthened] in the causative (<s>ṇau</s>). || PS 6.1.54 ||
[The vowel of the root] <s>vīyate</s> (to go) [is lengthened] in the sense of birth (<s>prajana</s>). || PS 6.1.55 ||
[The vowel of the root] <s>bhī</s> (to fear) [is shortened] in the causative expressing the cause of fear (<s>hetubhaya</s>). || PS 6.1.56 ||
[The vowel is shortened] invariably in [the root] <s>smi</s> (to smile). || PS 6.1.57 ||
[The roots] <s>sṛj</s> (to create) and <s>dṛś</s> (to see) [take the augment] <s>am</s> when [the suffix is] <s>jñal</s> and not marked with <s>kit</s>. || PS 6.1.58 ||
And [<s>am</s> is added] after [a root with] <s>anudātta</s> (grave accent) having <s>ṛ</s> as its penultimate, optionally. || PS 6.1.59 ||
[The form] <s>śīrṣan</s> [is used] in Vedic literature (<s>chandas</s>). || PS 6.1.60 ||
And [<s>śīrṣan</s> is used before suffixes beginning with] <s>y</s> in a <s>taddhita</s> [context]. || PS 6.1.61 ||
[The form] <s>śīrṣa</s> [is used] before [a suffix beginning with] a vowel (<s>ac</s>). || PS 6.1.62 ||

[The final consonants of] <s>pad</s> (foot), <s>dan</s> (tooth), <s>nas</s> (nose), <s>mās</s> (month), <s>hṛd</s> (heart), <s>niś</s> (night), <s>asan</s> (blood), <s>yūṣan</s> (broth), <s>doṣan</s> (arm), <s>yakan</s> (liver), <s>śakan</s> (excrement), <s>udan</s> (water), and <s>āsan</s> (mouth) [undergo specific changes] before <s>chaspra</s> and other [suffixes]. || PS 6.1.63 ||
[The sound] <s>ṣa</s> at the beginning of a verbal root becomes <s>sa</s>. || PS 6.1.64 ||
[The sound] <s>ṇa</s> [of a root in the original listing] becomes <s>na</s>. || PS 6.1.65 ||
[There is] elision (<s>lopa</s>) of <s>v</s> and <s>y</s> before a consonant (<s>val</s>). || PS 6.1.66 ||
[There is elision] of <s>v</s> when it is a single-sound affix (<s>apṛkta</s>). || PS 6.1.67 ||

After a consonant (<s>hal</s>), [the semi-vowel] <s>ṅ</s>, or a long [vowel before] <s>ā</s>, [the case-endings] <s>su</s>, <s>ti</s>, <s>si</s>, and a single-sound consonant (<s>apṛkta hal</s>) [are elided]. || PS 6.1.68 ||
[The vowel] <s>e</s> or <s>o</s> [replaces] a short [vowel] in the vocative (<s>sambuddhi</s>). || PS 6.1.69 ||
[The substitution by] <s>śe</s> [occurs] in Vedic literature (<s>chandas</s>) variously (<s>bahulam</s>). || PS 6.1.70 ||
[The augment] <s>tuk</s> [is added] after a short [vowel] when [the suffix] is marked with <s>pit</s>, in a <s>kṛt</s> [suffix]. || PS 6.1.71 ||
[The following rules apply] in continuous recitation (<s>saṃhitā</s>). || PS 6.1.72 ||
And [<s>tuk</s> is added] before [the suffix] <s>cha</s>. || PS 6.1.73 ||
And [<s>tuk</s> is added] after <s>āṅ</s> and <s>māṅ</s>. || PS 6.1.74 ||
[<s>Tuk</s> is added] after a long [vowel]. || PS 6.1.75 ||
Optionally [<s>tuk</s> is added] after a word-final (<s>padānta</s>) [long vowel]. || PS 6.1.76 ||
[The semivowels] <s>y</s>, <s>v</s>, <s>r</s>, <s>l</s> replace <s>i</s>, <s>u</s>, <s>ṛ</s>, <s>ḷ</s> respectively (<s>ik</s>) when followed by a vowel (<s>ac</s>). || PS 6.1.77 ||
[The vowels] <s>e</s> and <s>o</s> [are replaced by] <s>ay</s>, <s>av</s>, <s>āy</s>, and <s>āv</s> respectively. || PS 6.1.78 ||
[A stem] ending in <s>v</s> [retains <s>v</s>] when followed by a suffix beginning with <s>y</s>. || PS 6.1.79 ||
[This replacement occurs] only when [the vowel belongs] to the root and is caused by that [root] itself. || PS 6.1.80 ||
[The forms] <s>kṣayya</s> and <s>jayya</s> [are formed] in the sense of 'possible' (<s>śakyārtha</s>). || PS 6.1.81 ||
[The word] <s>krayya</s> (purchasable) [retains its form] when used for that purpose [i.e., when meaning 'intended for purchase']. || PS_6,1.82 ||
[The substitution applies also to] <s>bhya</s> and <s>pravayya</s> in <s>Chandas</s> (Vedic texts). || PS_6,1.83 ||
A single [substitute replaces] both the preceding and the following [sounds]. || PS_6,1.84 ||
And [the single substitute] is treated as if it were the final [of the preceding] and the initial [of the following]. || PS_6,1.85 ||
[This single substitute is] treated as not having taken effect (<s>asiddha</s>) with respect to <s>ṣatva</s> (retroflexion of <s>s</s>) and <s>tuk</s> (augment <s>t</s>). || PS_6,1.86 ||
[When] <s>a</s>/<s>ā</s> [is followed by a dissimilar simple vowel, the substitute is] <s>guṇa</s> (the vowels <s>a</s>, <s>e</s>, <s>o</s>). || PS_6,1.87 ||
<s>Vṛddhi</s> (the vowels <s>ā</s>, <s>ai</s>, <s>au</s>) [is the substitute when <s>a</s>/<s>ā</s> is followed by] <s>ec</s> (the vowels <s>e</s>, <s>o</s>, <s>ai</s>, <s>au</s>). || PS_6,1.88 ||
[<s>Vṛddhi</s> also occurs] before [the augments] <s>eti</s>, <s>edhati</s>, and <s>ūṭh</s>. || PS_6,1.89 ||
And [<s>vṛddhi</s> occurs] after <s>āṭ</s> (the augment <s>ā</s>). || PS_6,1.90 ||
[<s>Guṇa</s> replaces a vowel] after an <s>upasarga</s> (preverb), when <s>ṛ</s> [follows] in a <s>dhātu</s> (verbal root). || PS_6,1.91 ||
Optionally [<s>guṇa</s> occurs] before a <s>sup</s> (nominal ending), according to <s>Āpiśali</s>. || PS_6,1.92 ||
[The substitute for] <s>ā</s> and <s>o</s> [before] <s>am</s> and <s>śas</s> [is <s>guṇa</s>]. || PS_6,1.93 ||
When <s>eṅ</s> (<s>e</s> or <s>o</s>) [precedes a vowel], <s>pararūpa</s> (replacement by the following form) [takes place]. || PS_6,1.94 ||
And [<s>pararūpa</s> occurs] after <s>om</s> and <s>āṅ</s> (the preverb <s>ā</s>). || PS_6,1.95 ||
[<s>Pararūpa</s> occurs for] <s>u</s> of [a stem ending in] <s>us</s>, when not at the end of a <s>pada</s> (word). || PS_6,1.96 ||
[<s>Pararūpa</s> replaces] <s>a</s> [when followed by] <s>guṇa</s>. || PS_6,1.97 ||
[For] an onomatopoeic expression (<s>avyakta-anukaraṇa</s>), [the substitute of] <s>a</s> [before] <s>iti</s> [is <s>pararūpa</s>]. || PS_6,1.98 ||

body.text: na āmreḍitasya anatyasya tu vā || PS_6,1.99 ||
body.translated_text: Not [so] for a repeated form (<s>āmreḍita</s>); but optionally [it applies] when [the repeated form is] not [of the type] <s>atya</s>. || PS_6,1.99 ||
Always in an <s>āmreḍita</s> (iterative compound) [when followed by] <s>ḍāc</s>. || PS_6,1.100 ||

[When a vowel of the] <s>ak</s> class (<s>a</s>, <s>i</s>, <s>u</s>, <s>ṛ</s>, <s>ḷ</s>) [is followed by] a <s>savarṇa</s> (homogeneous) [vowel], <s>dīrgha</s> (a long vowel) [is the substitute]. || PS_6,1.101 ||
[When two vowels belong to] the first two [grades, i.e., short and long], [the substitute is] the <s>savarṇa</s> (homogeneous sound) of the preceding [vowel, made long]. || PS_6,1.102 ||
After that [long substitute], [the replacement of] <s>śas</s> [is] <s>n</s> in the masculine. || PS_6,1.103 ||
[The substitute is] <s>n</s> after <s>nā</s> [when followed by] <s>ic</s> (a vowel of the <s>ic</s> class). || PS_6,1.104 ||
And after a <s>dīrgha</s> (long vowel) [when followed by] <s>jas</s>. || PS_6,1.105 ||
Optionally in <s>Chandas</s> (Vedic texts). || PS_6,1.106 ||
[When followed by] <s>am</s> (the nominative/accusative plural ending), the preceding [vowel prevails as the substitute]. || PS_6,1.107 ||
And [the preceding vowel prevails] after <s>samprasāraṇa</s> (semivowel-to-vowel replacement). || PS_6,1.108 ||
[After] <s>eṅ</s> (<s>e</s> or <s>o</s>) at the end of a <s>pada</s> (word), [there is no sandhi] before <s>a</s>. || PS_6,1.109 ||
And [this applies] before <s>ṅasi</s> and <s>ṅas</s> (genitive singular and plural endings). || PS_6,1.110 ||
[After] <s>ṛ</s>, <s>ut</s> [is the substitute, i.e., the vowel becomes <s>u</s>]. || PS_6,1.111 ||
[This applies] to [the vowel] following [a form ending in a vowel of] <s>khyati</s> class. || PS_6,1.112 ||
[After] <s>a</s>, [the final] <s>r</s> [of a <s>pada</s> is replaced by zero, when the following sound is] a non-<s>pluta</s> [vowel following] a non-<s>pluta</s> [<s>a</s>]. || PS_6,1.113 ||
And [<s>r</s> is replaced by zero] before a <s>haś</s> consonant (a voiced non-nasal stop). || PS_6,1.114 ||
[A word retains] its original form (<s>prakṛtyā</s>) within a <s>pāda</s> (metrical quarter), [when what follows is] not a separate [word]. || PS_6,1.115 ||
And in [the words] <s>avyāt</s>, <s>avadyāt</s>, <s>avakramuḥ</s>, <s>avrata</s>, <s>ayam</s>, <s>avantu</s>, and <s>avasyuḥ</s>. || PS_6,1.116 ||
In the <s>Yajus</s> (Yajurveda), [the word] <s>uraḥ</s> [retains its original form]. || PS_6,1.117 ||
[The words] <s>āpaḥ</s>, <s>juṣāṇa</s>, <s>vṛṣṇi</s>, <s>varṣiṣṭha</s>, <s>amba</s>, <s>ambāla</s>, and <s>ambikā</s> [retain their original form] when preceding. || PS_6,1.118 ||
And [the word] <s>aṅga</s> and so on [retain their original form] at the beginning. || PS_6,1.119 ||
And [a word retains its original form] when <s>anudātta</s> (unaccented) [and followed by a word beginning with] <s>ku</s> or <s>dha</s>. || PS_6,1.120 ||
And [the words] <s>avapathā</s> and <s>asi</s> [retain their original form]. || PS_6,1.121 ||
Everywhere, optionally, [the original form is retained for the word] <s>go</s> (cow). || PS_6,1.122 ||
<s>Avaṅ</s> [is the substitute], according to <s>Sphoṭāyana</s>. || PS_6,1.123 ||
And always before [the word] <s>Indra</s>. || PS_6,1.124 ||
<s>Pluta</s> (protracted) and <s>pragṛhya</s> (exempt from sandhi) vowels [retain their original form] before a vowel (<s>ac</s>). || PS_6,1.125 ||
[The vowel of] <s>āṅ</s> (the preverb <s>ā</s>) [becomes] <s>anunāsika</s> (nasalized) in <s>Chandas</s> (Vedic texts). || PS_6,1.126 ||

[A vowel of the] <s>ik</s> class (<s>i</s>, <s>u</s>, <s>ṛ</s>, <s>ḷ</s>) [is replaced by its corresponding semivowel] before a dissimilar (<s>asavarṇa</s>) vowel, according to <s>Śākalya</s>; and [optionally it becomes] short. || PS_6,1.127 ||
[The semivowel substitute replaces a vowel of the] <s>ak</s> class [when followed by] <s>ṛ</s>. || PS_6,1.128 ||
[A <s>pluta</s> vowel is treated] as non-<s>pluta</s> when [a substitute] is present. || PS_6,1.129 ||
[The vowel] <s>ī3</s> (protracted <s>ī</s>) [is the substitute], according to <s>Ākravarmaṇa</s>. || PS_6,1.130 ||
[The final vowel of] <s>div</s> [is replaced by] <s>u</s>. || PS_6,1.131 ||

[In the forms of] <s>etat</s> and <s>tad</s>, there is <s>su-lopa</s> (elision of the nominative singular ending <s>su</s>) [when the stem ends in a vowel of the] <s>ak</s> class, not before <s>añ</s>, not in a compound, [and when followed by] a <s>hal</s> (consonant). || PS_6,1.132 ||
[The elision of] <s>sya</s> [occurs] variously (<s>bahulam</s>) in <s>Chandas</s> (Vedic texts). || PS_6,1.133 ||

[The nominative ending] <s>s</s> [is retained] before a vowel (<s>ac</s>), if the <s>lopa</s> (elision) would [otherwise leave the meter incomplete as] a <s>pādapūraṇa</s> (metrical filler). || PS_6,1.134 ||
The augment <s>suṭ</s> [is added] before [a suffix beginning with] <s>k</s>, [placed] before [the <s>k</s>]. || PS_6,1.135 ||
Even when <s>aḍ</s> (the past tense augment), <s>abhyāsa</s> (reduplication), or [another element] intervenes. || PS_6,1.136 ||
[<s>suṭ</s> is added] after [the preverbs] <s>sam</s>, <s>pari</s>, and <s>upa</s> before [the root] <s>kṛ</s> (to do) [when the meaning is] adornment (<s>bhūṣaṇa</s>). || PS_6,1.137 ||
And [<s>suṭ</s> is added after <s>sam</s>] in [the sense of] combination (<s>samavāya</s>). || PS_6,1.138 ||

[<s>suṭ</s> is added] after <s>upa</s> in [the senses of] counter-effort (<s>pratiyatna</s>), modification (<s>vaikṛta</s>), speech (<s>vākya</s>), and supplying [an understood word] (<s>adhyāhāra</s>). || PS_6,1.139 ||
[<s>suṭ</s> is added] before [the root] <s>kṝ</s> (to scatter) in [the sense of] cutting (<s>lavana</s>). || PS_6,1.140 ||
And [<s>suṭ</s> is added] after <s>prati</s> in [the sense of] injury (<s>hiṃsā</s>). || PS_6,1.141 ||
[<s>suṭ</s> is added] after <s>apa</s> before [the root] <s>kṛ</s> in [the sense of] scratching (<s>ālekhana</s>) quadrupeds and birds. || PS_6,1.142 ||
<s>Kustumburūṇi</s> [with <s>suṭ</s> augment denotes] a class (<s>jāti</s>). || PS_6,1.143 ||
[The words] <s>apara</s> and <s>para</s> [take <s>suṭ</s>] in [the sense of] continuity of action (<s>kriyāsātatya</s>). || PS_6,1.144 ||
[The word] <s>goṣpada</s> [takes <s>suṭ</s>] in [the senses of] frequented, unfrequented, and measure. || PS_6,1.145 ||
[The word] <s>āspada</s> [takes <s>suṭ</s>] in [the sense of] a standing place (<s>pratiṣṭhā</s>). || PS_6,1.146 ||
[The word] <s>āścarya</s> [takes <s>suṭ</s>] in [the sense of] something impermanent (<s>anitya</s>). || PS_6,1.147 ||
[The word] <s>avaskara</s> [takes <s>suṭ</s>] in [the sense of] excrement (<s>varcaska</s>). || PS_6,1.148 ||
[The word] <s>apaskara</s> [takes <s>suṭ</s>] in [the sense of] a part of a chariot (<s>rathāṅga</s>). || PS_6,1.149 ||
[The word] <s>viṣkira</s> [takes <s>suṭ</s> and denotes] a fowl (<s>śuku</s>); or [the form is] <s>nirvikira</s>, optionally. || PS_6,1.150 ||
[<s>suṭ</s> is added] after a short vowel [when the second member begins with] <s>candra</s> in a <s>mantra</s> (sacred formula). || PS_6,1.151 ||
And [the word] <s>pratiṣkaśa</s> [is formed with <s>suṭ</s>] from [the root] <s>kaś</s>. || PS_6,1.152 ||
<s>Praskaṇva</s> and <s>Hariścandra</s> [are names of] <s>ṛṣis</s> (sages) [formed with <s>suṭ</s>]. || PS_6,1.153 ||
<s>Maskara</s> and <s>Maskarin</s> [denote] a bamboo-staff bearer and a wandering ascetic, respectively. || PS_6,1.154 ||
<s>Kāstīra</s> and <s>Jastunda</s> [are names of] a city (<s>nagara</s>) [formed with <s>suṭ</s>]. || PS_6,1.155 ||
<s>Kāraskara</s> [is the name of] a tree (<s>vṛkṣa</s>) [formed with <s>suṭ</s>]. || PS_6,1.156 ||
And [words like] <s>Pāraskara</s> and others [take <s>suṭ</s>] when used as proper names (<s>sañjñā</s>). || PS_6,1.157 ||
A <s>pada</s> (word) [is] <s>anudātta</s> (grave-accented) except for one [syllable]. || PS_6,1.158 ||
[A word formed with the suffix] <s>ghaña</s> from [a root having] <s>karṣa</s> or <s>ātva</s> [has its] final [syllable] <s>udātta</s> (acute-accented). || PS_6,1.159 ||
And [the final is <s>udātta</s> for words] beginning with <s>uccha</s> and others. || PS_6,1.160 ||
And [the syllable of] an <s>anudātta</s> [is <s>udātta</s>] where <s>udātta</s> has been elided (<s>udātta-lopa</s>). || PS_6,1.161 ||
[The accent falls on the final syllable] of a <s>dhātu</s> (verbal root). || PS_6,1.162 ||
[The accent falls on the penultimate] of [a root marked with] <s>c</s> as <s>it</s> (<s>cit</s>). || PS_6,1.163 ||
[The accent is <s>udātta</s>] of a <s>taddhita</s> (secondary derivative suffix). || PS_6,1.164 ||
[The accent falls on the first syllable] of [a suffix marked with] <s>k</s> as <s>it</s> (<s>kit</s>). || PS_6,1.165 ||
[The accent is on the first syllable] of <s>jas</s> (nominative plural ending) after [the stems] <s>tisṛ</s> (three, feminine). || PS_6,1.166 ||
[The accent is on the first syllable] of <s>śas</s> (accusative plural ending) after <s>catur</s> (four). || PS_6,1.167 ||
That [<s>udātta</s> accent falls on the ending] <s>su</s> etc. of a monosyllabic [stem when] the <s>vibhakti</s> (case ending) begins with the third [case] and onward. || PS_6,1.168 ||

Optionally [the accent falls on the first syllable of the latter member] after [a prior member that is] <s>anta-udātta</s> (accented on the final), [when it is] a subsequent member (<s>uttarapada</s>), in a non-obligatory compound (<s>anityasamāsa</s>). || PS_6,1.169 ||
[The accent of] <s>añc</s> [falls on the root] in <s>Chandas</s> (Vedic texts), [when the ending is] not a <s>sarvanāmasthāna</s> (strong case ending). || PS_6,1.170 ||

[The accent is <s>udātta</s> on the final of the stem] after <s>ūḍh</s>, <s>idam</s>, a word beginning with a <s>pada</s>, <s>ap</s> (water), <s>pum</s> (male), <s>rai</s> (wealth), and <s>dyu</s> (heaven). || PS_6,1.171 ||
[The accent is <s>udātta</s> on the ending] of <s>aṣṭan</s> (eight) after a <s>dīrgha</s> (long vowel). || PS_6,1.172 ||
[The accent of] <s>śatṛ</s> (present participle suffix) [and] <s>anu</s> [falls on the final when the stem is a] <s>nadī</s> (feminine stem) or begins with a vowel (<s>aj-ādi</s>). || PS_6,1.173 ||
[The suffix] <s>yaṇ</s> [which is] <s>udātta</s> [occurs] after [a stem ending in] a <s>hal</s> (consonant). || PS_6,1.174 ||
Not [so] for <s>uṅ</s> (first person ending) and <s>dhātu</s> (verbal root) [bases]. || PS_6,1.175 ||
[The accent is <s>udātta</s> on the first syllable of] <s>matup</s> (possessive suffix) after a <s>hrasva</s> (short vowel) or <s>nuṭ</s> (nasal augment). || PS_6,1.176 ||
[The accent of] <s>nām</s> (genitive plural ending) [is <s>udātta</s>] optionally. || PS_6,1.177 ||
[The accent of] <s>ṅī</s> (feminine suffix) [varies] diversely (<s>bahulam</s>) in <s>Chandas</s> (Vedic texts). || PS_6,1.178 ||
[The accent falls on] a suffix beginning with <s>hal</s> (consonant) after <s>ṣaṭ</s> (six), <s>tri</s> (three), and <s>catur</s> (four). || PS_6,1.179 ||
[The accent falls on] the penultimate (<s>upottama</s>) [syllable in forms with] <s>jña</s> and <s>l</s> [as <s>it</s> markers]. || PS_6,1.180 ||
Optionally in <s>bhāṣā</s> (spoken language, as opposed to Vedic). || PS_6,1.181 ||
Not after [the stems] <s>go</s> (cow), <s>śvan</s> (dog), <s>sāvarṇa</s>, <s>rāḍ</s>, <s>aṅ</s>, <s>kruṅ</s>, and <s>kṛt</s> (primary derivative suffixes). || PS_6,1.182 ||
[The accent falls on the final] <s>jhal</s> consonant of <s>div</s> (heaven). || PS_6,1.183 ||
And [after] <s>nṛ</s> (man), optionally. || PS_6,1.184 ||
[A suffix marked with] <s>t</s> as <s>it</s> (<s>tit</s>) [causes] <s>svarita</s> (circumflex accent) [on the first vowel of the suffix]. || PS_6,1.185 ||

[A suffix which is] <s>tāsi</s>, or [marked by] <s>anudātta</s> [in the <s>Dhātupāṭha</s>], or [marked with] <s>ṅ</s> as <s>it</s>, or [having] <s>ad</s> in the original listing (<s>upadeśa</s>), or a <s>sārvadhātuka</s> [suffix with] <s>la</s> — [all these are] <s>anudātta</s> (grave), [but not in the case of] <s>ah</s>, <s>n</s>, and <s>viṅ</s>. || PS_6,1.186 ||
The initial [syllable of] <s>sic</s> (the aorist sign) [is <s>udātta</s>], optionally. || PS_6,1.187 ||

[The accent falls on the root in forms with] <s>svap</s> and others, and [the root] <s>hiṃs</s> (to injure), before a vowel (<s>ac</s>) [in a suffix that is] <s>aniṭ</s> (without the augment <s>iṭ</s>). || PS_6,1.188 ||
[The accent falls on] the initial [syllable] of reduplicated (<s>abhyasta</s>) [forms]. || PS_6,1.189 ||
And [the accent is] <s>anudātta</s> (grave) [on the rest]. || PS_6,1.190 ||
[The accent falls on the initial] of the entire [stem] before a <s>sup</s> (nominal ending). || PS_6,1.191 ||

[The roots] <s>bhī</s> (to fear), <s>hrī</s> (to be ashamed), <s>bhṛ</s> (to bear), <s>hu</s> (to sacrifice), <s>mad</s> (to rejoice), <s>jan</s> (to be born), <s>dhan</s> (to sound), <s>daridrā</s> (to be poor), and <s>jāgṛ</s> (to be awake) [have the accent on the syllable] preceding the suffix, [when the suffix is] <s>pit</s> (marked with <s>p</s> as <s>it</s>). || PS_6,1.192 ||
[The same applies] in <s>liṭ</s> (the perfect tense). || PS_6,1.193 ||
[The accent falls on] the initial [syllable] of <s>ṇamul</s> (an indeclinable suffix), optionally. || PS_6,1.194 ||
[The accent falls on] a vowel (<s>ac</s>) [of the stem before the suffix] <s>kartṛyak</s>. || PS_6,1.195 ||
And before <s>thal</s> (the perfect ending), [this accent applies] optionally when [the form has] <s>seṭ</s> (with augment <s>iṭ</s>) or ends in <s>īḍ</s>. || PS_6,1.196 ||
[A suffix beginning with] <s>ñ</s> or having a permanent (<s>nitya</s>) initial [vowel is accented on the] initial, always. || PS_6,1.197 ||
And [the accent is <s>udātta</s> on the initial] of a vocative (<s>āmantrita</s>) [form]. || PS_6,1.198 ||
[The accent falls on the initial of] <s>pathi</s> (path) and <s>matha</s> before a <s>sarvanāmasthāna</s> (strong case ending). || PS_6,1.199 ||
And [the accent falls on] the final [syllable simultaneously] with <s>tavai</s> (an infinitive suffix), both at the same time (<s>yugapat</s>). || PS_6,1.200 ||
[The word] <s>kṣaya</s> [has the accent on the first syllable when meaning] dwelling (<s>nivāsa</s>). || PS_6,1.201 ||
[The word] <s>jaya</s> [has the accent on the first syllable when meaning] instrument (<s>karaṇa</s>). || PS_6,1.202 ||
And [the accent on the first syllable applies to the words] <s>vṛṣa</s> and others. || PS_6,1.203 ||
In a proper name (<s>sañjñā</s>), [the accent is <s>udātta</s> on the first syllable when the word functions as] a comparison (<s>upamāna</s>). || PS_6,1.204 ||
And [the accent falls on the first syllable of] a <s>niṣṭhā</s> (past participle) [form] of two syllables (<s>dvyac</s>), not [when the stem ends in] <s>a</s>. || PS_6,1.205 ||
[The words] <s>śuṣka</s> (dry) and <s>dhṛṣṭa</s> (bold) [have the accent on the first syllable]. || PS_6,1.206 ||
[The word] <s>āśita</s> (one who has eaten) [has the accent on the first syllable when denoting] an agent (<s>kartṛ</s>). || PS_6,1.207 ||
[In the word] <s>rikta</s> (empty), [the accent on the first syllable occurs] optionally. || PS_6,1.208 ||
And [the accent on the first syllable applies to] <s>juṣṭa</s> (enjoyed) and <s>arpita</s> (placed) in <s>Chandas</s> (Vedic texts). || PS_6,1.209 ||
Always in a <s>mantra</s> (sacred formula) [the accent is on the first syllable of <s>niṣṭhā</s> forms]. || PS_6,1.210 ||
[The accent is <s>udātta</s> on the final of] <s>yuṣmad</s> (you) and <s>asmad</s> (we/I) before <s>ṅas</s> (genitive singular ending). || PS_6,1.211 ||
And before <s>ṅa</s> (locative singular ending). || PS_6,1.212 ||
[The accent is <s>udātta</s> on the first syllable of a derivative] from [the root] <s>ya</s>, [when the meaning is] not a boat (<s>anāva</s>). || PS_6,1.213 ||

[The roots] <s>īḍ</s> (to praise), <s>vand</s> (to salute), <s>vṛ</s> (to choose), <s>śaṃs</s> (to recite), and <s>duh</s> (to milk) [have the accent on the first syllable] after <s>ṇyat</s> (a gerundive suffix). || PS_6,1.214 ||
Optionally [the accent falls on the first syllable for] <s>veṇu</s> (bamboo) and <s>indhāna</s> (fuel). || PS_6,1.215 ||

[The accent on the first syllable applies to derivatives of] <s>tyāga</s> (abandonment), <s>rāga</s> (attachment), <s>hāsa</s> (laughter), <s>kuha</s>, <s>śvaṭha</s>, and <s>kratha</s>. || PS_6,1.216 ||
[The accent falls on] the penultimate (<s>upottama</s>) [syllable when followed by] <s>r</s> as <s>it</s> marker. || PS_6,1.217 ||
[The accent on the penultimate occurs] in <s>caṅ</s> (the intensive/frequentative), optionally. || PS_6,1.218 ||
[The accent falls on the syllable] preceding <s>mat</s> (possessive suffix) in a proper name (<s>sañjñā</s>) [denoting] a feminine [form]. || PS_6,1.219 ||
[The accent falls on] the final [syllable of the stem] <s>avati</s>. || PS_6,1.220 ||
[The accent falls on the final syllable of the stem] <s>īvati</s>. || PS_6,1.221 ||
[The accent falls on the final syllable] before <s>ca</s> (the particle 'and'). || PS_6,1.222 ||
[The accent rules apply to a] compound (<s>samāsa</s>) [as a whole]. || PS_6,1.223 ||
In a <s>bahuvrīhi</s> (possessive compound), the prior member (<s>pūrvapada</s>) [retains its accent] in its original form (<s>prakṛtyā</s>). || PS_6,2.1 ||

In a <s>tatpuruṣa</s> (determinative compound), [the prior member retains its accent when the relationship is one of]: having equal meaning (<s>tulyārtha</s>), third case (<s>tṛtīyā</s>), seventh case (<s>saptamī</s>), comparison (<s>upamāna</s>), indeclinable (<s>avyaya</s>), second case (<s>dvitīyā</s>), or gerundive (<s>kṛtya</s>). || PS_6,2.2 ||
[The word] <s>varṇa</s> (color/letter) [retains the accent of the prior member] when [denoting] colors, [if the meaning is] not 'going' (<s>aneta</s>). || PS_6,2.3 ||
[The prior member retains its accent in compounds with] <s>gādha</s> (depth) and <s>lavana</s> (salt) [when used in the sense of] measure (<s>pramāṇa</s>). || PS_6,2.4 ||
[The prior member retains its accent in the word] <s>dāyādya</s> (inheritance) when [meaning] an heir (<s>dāyāda</s>). || PS_6,2.5 ||
[The prior member retains its accent in] <s>pratibandhi</s> (obstacle) [when used in the senses of] long duration (<s>cira</s>) or difficulty (<s>kṛcchra</s>). || PS_6,2.6 ||
[The prior member retains its accent in the word] <s>pada</s> (position) when [meaning] a designation (<s>apadeśa</s>). || PS_6,2.7 ||
[The prior member retains its accent in] <s>nivāta</s> (sheltered place) when [meaning] protection from wind (<s>vātatrāṇa</s>). || PS_6,2.8 ||
[The prior member retains its accent in] <s>śārada</s> when [meaning] not seasonal (<s>anārtava</s>). || PS_6,2.9 ||
[The prior member retains its accent in compounds with] <s>adhvaryu</s> (a type of priest) and <s>kaṣāya</s> (astringent) when [denoting] a species (<s>jāti</s>). || PS_6,2.10 ||
[The prior member retains its accent in compounds with] <s>sadṛśa</s> and <s>pratirūpa</s> (resembling) when [used in the sense of] similarity (<s>sādṛśya</s>). || PS_6,2.11 ||
[The prior member retains its accent] in a <s>dvigu</s> (numeral compound) [when used in the sense of] measure (<s>pramāṇa</s>). || PS_6,2.12 ||
[The prior member retains its accent in compounds with] <s>gantavya</s> (to be gone to) and <s>paṇya</s> (merchandise) when [meaning] a merchant (<s>vāṇij</s>). || PS_6,2.13 ||

[The prior member retains its accent in compounds with] <s>mātra</s> (measure), <s>upajña</s> (discovery), <s>upakrama</s> (undertaking), and <s>chāyā</s> (shadow/reflection) in the neuter (<s>napuṃsaka</s>). || PS_6,2.14 ||
[The prior member retains its accent in compounds with] <s>sukha</s> (pleasure) and <s>priya</s> (dear) when [meaning] beneficial (<s>hita</s>). || PS_6,2.15 ||
And [the prior member retains its accent when the meaning is] affection (<s>prīti</s>). || PS_6,2.16 ||
[The prior member retains its accent in the word] <s>sva</s> (one's own) when [meaning] an owner (<s>svāmin</s>). || PS_6,2.17 ||
[The prior member retains its accent in the word] <s>pati</s> (lord) when [meaning] sovereignty (<s>aiśvarya</s>). || PS_6,2.18 ||
Not [so] in [compounds with] <s>bhū</s> (earth), <s>vāk</s> (speech), <s>cit</s> (thought), and <s>didhiṣu</s> (one who has remarried). || PS_6,2.19 ||
Optionally [the prior member retains its accent in the word] <s>bhūvana</s> (world). || PS_6,2.20 ||

[The prior member retains its accent in compounds with] <s>āśaṅkā</s> (apprehension), <s>ābādha</s> (affliction), and <s>nedīyas</s> (nearness) when [meaning] likelihood (<s>sambhāvana</s>). || PS_6,2.21 ||
[The prior member retains its accent in compounds with] <s>pūrva</s> (former) when [meaning] formerly existing (<s>bhūtapūrva</s>). || PS_6,2.22 ||

[The prior member retains its accent] in [the words] <s>savidha</s> (vicinity), <s>sanīḍa</s> (same nest), <s>samaryāda</s> (same boundary), <s>saveśa</s> (same house), and <s>sadeśa</s> (same place) when [meaning] proximity (<s>sāmīpya</s>). || PS_6,2.23 ||
[The prior member retains its accent in words like] <s>vispaṣṭa</s> (clearly visible) and others when [used as] descriptions of qualities (<s>guṇavacana</s>). || PS_6,2.24 ||

[The prior member retains its accent in compounds with] <s>śra</s> (chief), <s>jya</s> (bowstring), <s>avama</s> (lowest), <s>kan</s>, <s>pāpa</s> (evil), and <s>vat</s> [suffixed words] in a <s>karmadhāraya</s> (appositional compound) [denoting] a state (<s>bhāva</s>). || PS_6,2.25 ||
And [the prior member retains its accent in the word] <s>kumāra</s> (youth/prince). || PS_6,2.26 ||
[The accent falls on] the initial [syllable of the latter member] after <s>prati</s> and <s>ena</s> [as prior members]. || PS_6,2.27 ||
[The accent on the initial of the latter member occurs] in groups (<s>pūga</s>), optionally. || PS_6,2.28 ||

[The accent on the initial of the latter member occurs in] <s>dvigu</s> compounds [with final members] ending in <s>i</s> [or other vowels of the <s>ig</s> class], <s>kāla</s> (time), <s>kapāla</s> (cup), <s>bhagāla</s>, and <s>śarāva</s> (dish). || PS_6,2.29 ||
[The prior member retains its accent when the numeral is] <s>bahu</s> (many), optionally. || PS_6,2.30 ||
And [the accent on the initial of the latter member occurs after] <s>diṣṭi</s> and <s>vitasti</s> (a unit of measure). || PS_6,2.31 ||

[The accent of a compound with a] seventh case (<s>saptamī</s>) [relationship retains the prior member's accent when the latter member is] <s>siddha</s> (accomplished), <s>śuṣka</s> (dry), <s>pakva</s> (cooked), or <s>bandha</s> (bound), [but] not [when the prior member denotes] time (<s>kāla</s>). || PS_6,2.32 ||

[The prior member retains its accent in compounds with the preverbs] <s>pari</s> (around), <s>prati</s> (towards), <s>upa</s> (near), and <s>apa</s> (away) when [the latter member denotes] parts of the day and night to be excluded (<s>varjyamāna-ahorātra-avayava</s>). || PS_6,2.33 ||

[The prior member retains its accent in] a <s>dvandva</s> (copulative compound) with plural [members denoting] <s>rājanya</s> (warrior class) [such as the] <s>Andhaka</s> and <s>Vṛṣṇi</s> [clans]. || PS_6,2.34 ||
[The prior member retains its accent in compounds with] numerals (<s>saṅkhyā</s>). || PS_6,2.35 ||
And [in the compound where] <s>ācārya</s> (teacher) [is] subordinate (<s>upasarjana</s>), [the word] <s>antevāsin</s> (resident pupil) [retains the accent of the prior member]. || PS_6,2.36 ||
And [the words] <s>Kārta</s>, <s>Kaujapa</s>, and others [retain the accent of the prior member]. || PS_6,2.37 ||

[The word] <s>mahā</s> (great) [retains the accent of the prior member in compounds with] <s>vrīhi</s> (rice), <s>aparāhṇa</s> (afternoon), <s>gṛṣṭi</s> (a young cow), <s>iṣvāsa</s> (archer), <s>Jābāla</s>, <s>bhāra</s> (burden), <s>Bhārata</s>, <s>Hailihila</s>, <s>Raurava</s>, and <s>pravṛddha</s> (grown). || PS_6,2.38 ||
And [the word] <s>kṣullaka</s> (small) [retains the accent of the prior member in the compound] <s>Vaiśvadeva</s> (offering to all gods). || PS_6,2.39 ||
