[The word] <s>uṣṭra</s> (camel) [retains the accent of the prior member in compounds meaning] riding (<s>sādi</s>) and driving (<s>vāmya</s>). || PS_6,2.40 ||
[The word] <s>go</s> (cow) [retains the accent of the prior member in compounds with] <s>sāda</s> (rider), <s>sādi</s> (riding), and <s>sārathi</s> (charioteer). || PS_6,2.41 ||

[The words] <s>Kurugārhapatya</s>, <s>Riktaguru</s>, <s>Asūtajaratī</s>, <s>Aślīladṛḍharūpā</s>, <s>Pārevaḍavā</s>, <s>Taitilakadrū</s>, and <s>Paṇyakambala</s> [retain the accent of the prior member]; and so do [compounds denoting] female slaves (<s>dāsī</s>) and loads (<s>bhāra</s>). || PS_6,2.42 ||

[The prior member retains its accent in a <s>tatpuruṣa</s> compound expressing the] fourth case (<s>caturthī</s>) [relationship when the meaning is] intended for that purpose (<s>tadartha</s>). || PS_6,2.43 ||
[The prior member retains its accent when the compound is used] in a purposive sense (<s>artha</s>). || PS_6,2.44 ||
And [the prior member retains its accent] before [a latter member formed with] <s>kta</s> (past participle suffix). || PS_6,2.45 ||
In a <s>karmadhāraya</s> (appositional compound), [the prior member retains its accent when the latter member is] not a <s>niṣṭhā</s> (past participle). || PS_6,2.46 ||
[The prior member retains its accent when it expresses the] second case (<s>dvitīyā</s>) [relationship] in [a sacrifice] that is not an <s>ahīna</s> (multi-day Soma sacrifice). || PS_6,2.47 ||
[The prior member retains its accent in a compound expressing the] third case (<s>tṛtīyā</s>) [relationship with the latter member denoting] an action (<s>karman</s>). || PS_6,2.48 ||
[The prior member retains its accent when it is a] <s>gati</s> (preverb/prefix) [and what follows is] immediately connected (<s>anantara</s>). || PS_6,2.49 ||

And [the prior member retains its accent] when [the latter member] begins with <s>ta</s>, [but] not with <s>ni</s> [as <s>it</s> marker, when the suffix is a] <s>kṛtya</s> (gerundive) or <s>at</s> (present participle suffix). || PS_6,2.50 ||

body.text: tavai ca antaś ca yugapat || PS_6,2.51 ||
body.translated_text: [The accent falls on both] <s>tavai</s> (infinitive suffix) and the final [of the prior member] simultaneously (<s>yugapat</s>). || PS_6,2.51 ||
[A stem] not ending in <s>i</s> [or other <s>ig</s> vowels retains the prior member's accent] before <s>añc</s> (to go towards), [when there is] no <s>va</s> suffix. || PS_6,2.52 ||
And [the prior member retains its accent after the preverbs] <s>ni</s> and <s>adhi</s>. || PS_6,2.53 ||
[The prior member retains its accent after] <s>īṣat</s> (slightly), optionally. || PS_6,2.54 ||
[The prior member retains its accent in] <s>hiraṇyaparimāṇa</s> (gold-measured) when [meaning] wealth (<s>dhana</s>). || PS_6,2.55 ||
[The word] <s>prathama</s> (first) [retains the prior member's accent when meaning] a recent arrival (<s>acira-upasampatti</s>). || PS_6,2.56 ||
[The words] <s>katara</s> (which of two) and <s>katama</s> (which of many) [retain the prior member's accent] in a <s>karmadhāraya</s> (appositional compound). || PS_6,2.57 ||
[The word] <s>ārya</s> (noble) [retains the prior member's accent in compounds with] <s>brāhmaṇa</s> (Brahmin) and <s>kumāra</s> (youth). || PS_6,2.58 ||
And [the word] <s>rājan</s> (king) [retains the prior member's accent likewise]. || PS_6,2.59 ||
[The prior member retains its accent in a <s>tatpuruṣa</s> compound expressing the] sixth case (<s>ṣaṣṭhī</s>) [relationship] after <s>prati</s> and <s>ena</s>. || PS_6,2.60 ||
[The prior member retains its accent] before [a latter member formed with] <s>kta</s> (past participle) when [the compound expresses] a permanent sense (<s>nityārtha</s>). || PS_6,2.61 ||
[The word] <s>grāma</s> (village) [retains the prior member's accent when the compound denotes] an artisan (<s>śilpin</s>). || PS_6,2.62 ||
And [the word] <s>rājan</s> (king) [retains the prior member's accent when used] in praise (<s>praśaṃsā</s>). || PS_6,2.63 ||
[The accent of the compound falls on] the initial [syllable, which is] <s>udātta</s> (acute). || PS_6,2.64 ||

[The prior member retains its accent in a compound expressing the] seventh case (<s>saptamī</s>) [relationship with the latter member] <s>hārin</s> (taking) when [the meaning is] righteous (<s>dharmya</s>) and not stealing (<s>aharaṇa</s>). || PS_6,2.65 ||
And [the prior member retains its accent] when [the meaning is] fitting (<s>yukta</s>). || PS_6,2.66 ||
Optionally [the prior member retains its accent when the compound denotes] an overseer (<s>adhyakṣa</s>). || PS_6,2.67 ||
And [the prior member retains its accent in compounds with] <s>pāpa</s> (wicked) when [denoting] an artisan (<s>śilpin</s>). || PS_6,2.68 ||

[The prior member retains its accent in compounds with] <s>gotra</s> (lineage), <s>antevāsin</s> (pupil), <s>mānava</s> (human), and <s>brāhmaṇa</s> (Brahmin) when [used in] reproach (<s>kṣepa</s>). || PS_6,2.69 ||
[The word] <s>aṅga</s> (limb) [retains the prior member's accent in compounds denoting] an ingredient of <s>maireya</s> (a type of intoxicating drink). || PS_6,2.70 ||
[The first member retains its accent when the compound has] names derived from <s>bhakta</s> (food/share) [applied] to things serving that purpose. || PS_6,2.71 ||

[The first member retains its accent] in [compounds with] <s>go</s> (cow), <s>biḍāla</s> (cat), <s>siṃha</s> (lion), and <s>saindhava</s> (horse from Sindh) when used as a standard of comparison (<s>upamāna</s>). || PS_6,2.72 ||
[The first member retains its accent] before [the suffix] <s>aka</s> in the sense of livelihood (<s>jīvikā</s>). || PS_6,2.73 ||
[The first member retains its accent] according to the eastern [grammarians] (<s>prācām</s>) [when the compound denotes] a game (<s>krīḍā</s>). || PS_6,2.74 ||
[The first member retains its accent] before [the suffix] <s>aṇ</s> [when the compound denotes] one appointed (<s>niyukta</s>). || PS_6,2.75 ||
And [the first member retains its accent when the compound denotes] an artisan (<s>śilpin</s>), except [when derived] from [the root] <s>kṛ</s> (to do). || PS_6,2.76 ||
And [the first member retains its accent] in a proper name (<s>sañjñā</s>). || PS_6,2.77 ||
[The words] <s>go</s> (cow), <s>tanti</s> (weaver), and <s>yava</s> (barley) [retain the accent of the first member when compounded with a word meaning] guardian (<s>pāla</s>). || PS_6,2.78 ||
[The first member retains its accent] before [the suffix] <s>ṇini</s>. || PS_6,2.79 ||

The standard of comparison (<s>upamāna</s>) [retains the accent of the first member] only when [the compound refers to] a word (<s>śabda</s>), a meaning (<s>artha</s>), or a natural form (<s>prakṛti</s>). || PS_6,2.80 ||
And <s>yuktārohi</s> and others [retain the accent of the first member]. || PS_6,2.81 ||

[The words] <s>dīrgha</s> (long), <s>kāśa</s> (a type of grass), <s>tuṣa</s> (husk), <s>bhrāṣṭra</s> (frying pan), and <s>vaṭa</s> (banyan tree) [retain the accent of the first member] before [the suffix] <s>ja</s>. || PS_6,2.82 ||
[The accent falls on the syllable] before the last [syllable], in [a word having] many vowels (<s>bahvac</s>). || PS_6,2.83 ||
[The first member retains its accent when the compound denotes those] not dwelling (<s>anivasantaḥ</s>) in a village (<s>grāma</s>). || PS_6,2.84 ||
And [the first member retains its accent] in [compounds beginning with] <s>ghoṣa</s> and others. || PS_6,2.85 ||
<s>Chātrī</s> and others [retain the accent of the first member when compounded with] <s>śālā</s> (hall). || PS_6,2.86 ||
[The first member retains its accent when compounded with] <s>prastha</s> (plateau), [provided the first member is] not <s>vṛddha</s>, excluding <s>akarki</s> and others. || PS_6,2.87 ||
And [the first member retains its accent when compounded with] <s>mālā</s> and others. || PS_6,2.88 ||

[The first member retains its accent when compounded with a word meaning] city (<s>nagara</s>), except [with] <s>mahat</s> (great) and <s>nava</s> (new), according to the northern [grammarians] (<s>anudīcām</s>). || PS_6,2.89 ||

body.text: arme ca avarṇam dvyac tryac || PS_6,2.90 ||
body.translated_text: And [the first member retains its accent when compounded with] <s>arma</s>, [provided it contains] an <s>a</s>-vowel [and] is disyllabic or trisyllabic. || PS_6,2.90 ||
Not [in the case of] <s>bhūta</s> (ghost), <s>adhika</s> (excess), <s>sañjīva</s> (reviving), <s>madra</s> (a people), <s>aśma</s> (stone), and <s>kajjala</s> (soot). || PS_6,2.91 ||
End [of the section on first-member accent retention]. || PS_6,2.92 ||
[The following rule] will be stated: [the compound has the accent on] the whole [last member to express] a quality (<s>guṇa</s>) or totality (<s>kārtsnya</s>). || PS_6,2.93 ||
[The last member retains its accent] in a proper name (<s>sañjñā</s>) [when the compound denotes] a mountain (<s>giri</s>) or a collection (<s>nikāya</s>). || PS_6,2.94 ||
[The last member retains its accent in compounds with] <s>kumārī</s> (maiden) [when denoting] age (<s>vayas</s>). || PS_6,2.95 ||
[The last member retains its accent in compounds with] <s>udaka</s> (water) when [it means water] alone (<s>kevala</s>). || PS_6,2.96 ||
[The last member retains its accent] in a <s>dvigu</s> [compound when denoting] a sacrifice (<s>kratu</s>). || PS_6,2.97 ||
[The last member retains its accent in compounds with] <s>sabhā</s> (assembly hall) when [the compound is] neuter (<s>napuṃsaka</s>). || PS_6,2.98 ||
[The last member retains its accent in compounds with] <s>pura</s> (city) according to the eastern [grammarians] (<s>prācām</s>). || PS_6,2.99 ||
And [the last member retains its accent in compounds] preceded by <s>ariṣṭa</s> or <s>gauḍa</s>. || PS_6,2.100 ||
Not [in the case of] <s>hāstina</s>, <s>phalaka</s>, and <s>mārdeya</s>. || PS_6,2.101 ||

[The words] <s>kusūla</s> (granary), <s>kūpa</s> (well), <s>kumbha</s> (pot), and <s>śālā</s> (hall) [retain the accent of the last member when compounded with] <s>bila</s> (hole/opening). || PS_6,2.102 ||

Direction words (<s>dikśabda</s>) [retain the accent of the last member when the compound denotes] a village (<s>grāma</s>), a district (<s>janapada</s>), a narrative (<s>ākhyāna</s>), or <s>cānarāṭa</s>. || PS_6,2.103 ||

And [the last member retains its accent in compounds where] <s>ācārya</s> (teacher) is the subordinate member (<s>upasarjana</s>), [when the compound denotes] a resident pupil (<s>antevāsin</s>). || PS_6,2.104 ||
And when the latter member undergoes <s>vṛddhi</s> [augmentation], [the accent falls on] the whole [compound]. || PS_6,2.105 ||
In a <s>bahuvrīhi</s> [compound], <s>viśva</s> (all) [retains the accent of the last member] in a proper name (<s>sañjñā</s>). || PS_6,2.106 ||
[The last member retains its accent in <s>bahuvrīhi</s> compounds with] <s>udara</s> (belly), <s>aśva</s> (horse), and <s>iṣu</s> (arrow). || PS_6,2.107 ||
[The last member retains its accent] in [compounds expressing] contempt (<s>kṣepa</s>). || PS_6,2.108 ||
[The last member retains its accent when] <s>nadī</s> (river) [is compounded with a word meaning] kinsman (<s>bandhu</s>). || PS_6,2.109 ||
[When the first member is] a past participle (<s>niṣṭhā</s>) preceded by a preverb (<s>upasarga</s>), optionally (<s>anyatarasyām</s>) [the last member retains its accent]. || PS_6,2.110 ||
[The accent falls on] the beginning of the latter member (<s>uttarapada</s>). || PS_6,2.111 ||
[The word] <s>karṇa</s> (ear) [retains the accent on the beginning of the latter member when the first member denotes] a color or a mark (<s>varṇalakṣaṇa</s>). || PS_6,2.112 ||
And [the accent falls on the beginning of the latter member] in proper names (<s>sañjñā</s>) and comparisons (<s>aupamya</s>). || PS_6,2.113 ||
And [the accent falls on the beginning of the latter member when the latter member is] <s>kaṇṭha</s> (throat), <s>pṛṣṭha</s> (back), <s>grīvā</s> (neck), or <s>jaṅghā</s> (shin). || PS_6,2.114 ||
And [the accent falls on the beginning of the latter member when the latter member is] <s>śṛṅga</s> (horn), [when the compound denotes] a state or condition (<s>avasthā</s>). || PS_6,2.115 ||

After <s>nañ</s> (the negative particle), [the accent falls on the beginning of the latter member when the latter member is] <s>jara</s> (old age), <s>mara</s> (death), <s>mitra</s> (friend), or <s>mṛta</s> (dead). || PS_6,2.116 ||

After [the preverb] <s>su</s>, [the accent falls on the beginning of the latter member when the latter member is] <s>manas</s> (mind) or [a word ending in] <s>as</s>, except <s>loman</s> (hair) and <s>uṣas</s> (dawn). || PS_6,2.117 ||
And <s>kratu</s> and others [take the accent on the beginning of the latter member after <s>su</s>]. || PS_6,2.118 ||
[A compound that is] disyllabic (<s>dvyac</s>) has the accent on the first [syllable] (<s>ādy-udātta</s>) in Vedic usage (<s>chandas</s>). || PS_6,2.119 ||
And [the compounds] <s>vīra</s> (hero) and <s>vīrya</s> (valor) [take the accent on the beginning of the latter member]. || PS_6,2.120 ||

[The words] <s>kūla</s> (bank), <s>tīra</s> (shore), <s>tūla</s> (cotton), <s>mūla</s> (root), <s>śālā</s> (hall), and <s>akṣa</s> (axle) [take the accent] equally [on the first syllable] in an <s>avyayībhāva</s> [compound]. || PS_6,2.121 ||

[The words] <s>kiṃsa</s>, <s>mantha</s> (churn), <s>śūrpa</s> (winnowing basket), <s>pāyya</s> (milk), and <s>kāṇḍa</s> (section) [take the accent on the first syllable of the latter member] in a <s>dvigu</s> [compound]. || PS_6,2.122 ||
In a <s>tatpuruṣa</s> [compound, the accent falls on the first syllable of the latter member when the compound denotes] a hall (<s>śālā</s>) [and is] neuter (<s>napuṃsaka</s>). || PS_6,2.123 ||
And [the same applies to compounds with] <s>kanthā</s> (patched garment). || PS_6,2.124 ||
[The accent falls on] the first [syllable] of [compounds with] <s>cihaṇa</s> and others. || PS_6,2.125 ||

[The words] <s>cela</s> (cloth), <s>kheṭa</s> (shield), <s>kaṭuka</s> (pungent), and <s>kāṇḍa</s> (section) [take the accent on the first syllable of the latter member when the compound expresses] reproach (<s>garhā</s>). || PS_6,2.126 ||
[The word] <s>cīra</s> (bark garment) [takes the accent on the first syllable of the latter member when used as] a standard of comparison (<s>upamāna</s>). || PS_6,2.127 ||

[The words] <s>palala</s> (ground sesame), <s>sūpa</s> (broth), and <s>śāka</s> (vegetables) [take the accent on the first syllable of the latter member when the compound denotes something] mixed (<s>miśra</s>). || PS_6,2.128 ||

[The words] <s>kūla</s> (bank), <s>sūda</s> (cook), <s>sthala</s> (dry ground), and <s>karṣa</s> (a weight) [take the accent on the first syllable of the latter member] in a proper name (<s>sañjñā</s>). || PS_6,2.129 ||
[The word] <s>rājya</s> (kingdom) [takes the accent on the first syllable of the latter member] not in a <s>karmadhāraya</s> [compound]. || PS_6,2.130 ||
And <s>vargya</s> and others [take the accent on the first syllable of the latter member]. || PS_6,2.131 ||
[The word] <s>putra</s> (son) [takes the accent on the first syllable of the latter member when the first member denotes] males (<s>puṃs</s>). || PS_6,2.132 ||

Not [when the first member is] <s>ācārya</s> (teacher), <s>rājan</s> (king), <s>ṛtvij</s> (priest), a conjunct consonant (<s>saṃyukta</s>), or a kinsman designation (<s>jñāti-ākhya</s>). || PS_6,2.133 ||

<s>Cūrṇa</s> and others [take the accent on the first syllable of the latter member when the compound is] not a sixth-case [<s>tatpuruṣa</s>] denoting a living being (<s>aprāṇiṣaṣṭhī</s>). || PS_6,2.134 ||
And six [words beginning with] <s>kāṇḍa</s> and others [take the accent on the first syllable of the latter member]. || PS_6,2.135 ||
[The words] <s>kuṇḍa</s> (pit) and <s>vana</s> (forest) [take the accent on the first syllable of the latter member]. || PS_6,2.136 ||
[The word] <s>bhagāla</s> [retains] its original form (<s>prakṛtyā</s>) [i.e., its natural accent]. || PS_6,2.137 ||

After [the preverb] <s>śiti</s> (white), [the accent falls on the first syllable of the latter member] always, except in [compounds with] many vowels (<s>bahvac</s>) and in <s>bahuvrīhi</s> [compounds], and not in [the word] <s>bhasat</s>. || PS_6,2.138 ||
After a <s>gati</s> (preverb), <s>kāraka</s> (case-relation word), or <s>upapada</s> (subordinate word), [the accent of] a <s>kṛt</s> [suffix is retained]. || PS_6,2.139 ||
Both [accents apply] simultaneously (<s>yugapat</s>) in [compounds with] <s>vanaspati</s> and others. || PS_6,2.140 ||
And in a <s>dvandva</s> [compound] of deities (<s>devatā</s>). || PS_6,2.141 ||

Not [both accents apply] on the latter member (<s>uttarapada</s>) when it begins with an unaccented syllable (<s>anudāttādi</s>), except [in compounds with] <s>pṛthivī</s> (earth), <s>Rudra</s>, <s>Pūṣan</s>, and <s>manthin</s>. || PS_6,2.142 ||
End [of the section]. || PS_6,2.143 ||
[The accent falls on the first syllable of] the [suffixes] <s>tha</s>, <s>atha</s>, <s>ghañ</s>, <s>kta</s>, <s>aj</s>, <s>ab</s>, <s>itra</s>, and <s>ka</s>. || PS_6,2.144 ||
[The accent falls on the first syllable of] <s>kta</s> after [a word compounded with the preverb] <s>su</s> [when used as] a standard of comparison (<s>upamāna</s>). || PS_6,2.145 ||
[The accent falls on the first syllable of the latter member] in a proper name (<s>sañjñā</s>), excluding <s>anācita</s> and others. || PS_6,2.146 ||
And [the same applies to] <s>pravṛddha</s> and others. || PS_6,2.147 ||

After a <s>kāraka</s> (case-relation word), [the accent falls on the first syllable of the latter member only with] <s>datta</s> (given) and <s>śruta</s> (heard), and only in a benediction (<s>āśis</s>). || PS_6,2.148 ||
And [the accent falls on the first syllable of the latter member] in [the sense of] 'made (<s>kṛta</s>) by one who is of such a nature (<s>itthaṃbhūta</s>).' || PS_6,2.149 ||
[A derivative] from [the suffix] <s>ana</s> that denotes a state (<s>bhāva</s>) or an action (<s>karma</s>) [takes the accent on the first syllable of the latter member]. || PS_6,2.150 ||

[Compounds ending in suffixes] <s>man</s>, <s>ktin</s>, [and words denoting] explanation (<s>vyākhyāna</s>), a bed (<s>śayana</s>), a seat (<s>āsana</s>), a place (<s>sthāna</s>), a priest (<s>yājaka</s>), and those beginning with <s>ādi</s>, and <s>krīta</s> (purchased) [take the accent on the first syllable of the latter member]. || PS_6,2.151 ||

[The compound takes the accent on the first syllable of the latter member when the first member is in] the seventh case (<s>saptamī</s>) [and the latter member is] <s>puṇya</s> (meritorious). || PS_6,2.152 ||

[The words] <s>ūnārtha</s> (deficient in meaning) and <s>kalaha</s> (quarrel) [take the accent on the first syllable of the latter member when the first member is in] the third case (<s>tṛtīyā</s>). || PS_6,2.153 ||
And [the word] <s>miśra</s> (mixed) [takes the accent on the first syllable of the latter member] without a preverb (<s>anupasarga</s>) and not in <s>sandhi</s>. || PS_6,2.154 ||

After <s>nañ</s> (the negative particle), [the accent falls on the first syllable of the latter member when the compound expresses] denial of a quality (<s>guṇapratiṣedha</s>); [and likewise for] <s>taddhita</s> [derivatives expressing] 'fit to be accomplished' (<s>sampādya</s>), 'worthy' (<s>arha</s>), 'beneficial' (<s>hita</s>), and 'sufficient' (<s>alam</s>). || PS_6,2.155 ||

And [the accent falls on the first syllable of the latter member] with [the suffixes] <s>ya</s> and <s>yat</s> when [used] in a meaning other than that [of the base word] (<s>atadarthe</s>). || PS_6,2.156 ||
[The suffixes] <s>ac</s> and <s>ka</s> [take the accent on the first syllable] when [the compound expresses] inability (<s>aśakti</s>). || PS_6,2.157 ||
And [the accent falls on the first syllable of the latter member] in abuse (<s>ākrośa</s>). || PS_6,2.158 ||
[The accent falls on the first syllable of the latter member] in a proper name (<s>sañjñā</s>). || PS_6,2.159 ||
And <s>kṛtya</s>, <s>uka</s>, <s>iṣṇuc</s>, <s>cāru</s>, and others [take the accent on the first syllable of the latter member]. || PS_6,2.160 ||

Optionally (<s>vibhāṣā</s>) [the accent falls on the first syllable of the latter member when the latter member is] <s>tṛṇṇa</s> (cut), <s>anna</s> (food), <s>tīkṣṇa</s> (sharp), or <s>śuci</s> (pure). || PS_6,2.161 ||

In a <s>bahuvrīhi</s> [compound], after <s>idam</s> (this), <s>etat</s> (that), and <s>tad</s> (that), [the accent falls on the first syllable of the latter member when the compound denotes] ordinal (<s>pūraṇa</s>) or first (<s>prathama</s>) [in] counting actions (<s>kriyāgaṇana</s>). || PS_6,2.162 ||
[The word] <s>stana</s> (breast) [takes the accent on the first syllable of the latter member] after a numeral (<s>saṅkhyā</s>). || PS_6,2.163 ||
Optionally (<s>vibhāṣā</s>) [the accent falls on the first syllable of the latter member in the preceding cases]. || PS_6,2.164 ||
[The accent falls on the first syllable of the latter member] in a proper name (<s>sañjñā</s>) [when the latter member is] <s>mitra</s> (friend) or <s>ajina</s> (hide). || PS_6,2.165 ||
[The word] <s>antara</s> (interval) [takes the accent on the first syllable of the latter member when the first member denotes] an intervening one (<s>vyavāyin</s>). || PS_6,2.166 ||
[The word] <s>mukha</s> (face) [takes the accent on the first syllable of the latter member when the first member denotes] one's own body part (<s>svāṅga</s>). || PS_6,2.167 ||

Not [the accent on the first syllable of the latter member] after an indeclinable (<s>avyaya</s>), a direction word (<s>dikśabda</s>), <s>go</s> (cow), <s>mahat</s> (great), <s>sthūla</s> (thick), <s>muṣṭi</s> (fist), <s>pṛthu</s> (broad), or <s>vatsa</s> (calf). || PS_6,2.168 ||

After a past participle (<s>niṣṭhā</s>) [used as] a standard of comparison (<s>upamāna</s>), optionally (<s>anyatarasyām</s>) [the accent falls on the first syllable of the latter member]. || PS_6,2.169 ||

After [words denoting] birth (<s>jāti</s>), time (<s>kāla</s>), happiness (<s>sukha</s>), and others, [the accent falls on the first syllable of the latter member with] <s>kta</s> [suffix], not [in the case of] a covering (<s>ācchādana</s>), [and the words] <s>akṛta</s> (unmade), <s>mita</s> (measured), and <s>pratipanna</s> (obtained) [also take this accent]. || PS_6,2.170 ||
Or [the accent falls on the first syllable of the latter member when the compound denotes something] born (<s>jāta</s>). || PS_6,2.171 ||
[The accent falls on the first syllable of the latter member] after <s>nañ</s> (the negative particle) and <s>su</s> (the prefix meaning 'good'). || PS_6,2.172 ||
[When the suffix] <s>kap</s> [is added, the accent falls on the] first [syllable of the compound]. || PS_6,2.173 ||
[The accent falls on the syllable] before the last [when the compound ends in] a short vowel (<s>hrasvānta</s>). || PS_6,2.174 ||
After <s>bahu</s> (many), [the accent behaves] like [that after] <s>nañ</s> [when the compound denotes] a domain (<s>bhūmi</s>) of the latter member (<s>uttarapada</s>). || PS_6,2.175 ||
Not [when the first member is] <s>guṇa</s> (quality) and others [that are] component parts (<s>avayava</s>). || PS_6,2.176 ||

After a preverb (<s>upasarga</s>), [the accent falls on the first syllable of the latter member when it denotes] one's own body part (<s>svāṅga</s>), [something] fixed (<s>dhruva</s>), [and] not a rib (<s>aparśu</s>). || PS_6,2.177 ||
[The word] <s>vana</s> (forest) [takes the accent on the first syllable of the latter member] in a compound (<s>samāsa</s>). || PS_6,2.178 ||
End [of the section]. || PS_6,2.179 ||
And [the section on accent] concludes. || PS_6,2.180 ||
Not [the accent on the first syllable of the latter member] after [the preverbs] <s>ni</s> and <s>vi</s>. || PS_6,2.181 ||
After [the preverb] <s>pari</s>, [the accent falls on the first syllable of the latter member when the compound denotes] a surrounding (<s>abhitobhāvin</s>) circle (<s>maṇḍala</s>). || PS_6,2.182 ||

After [the preverb] <s>pra</s>, [the accent falls on the first syllable of the latter member when it denotes something] other than one's own body part (<s>asvāṅga</s>), in a proper name (<s>sañjñā</s>). || PS_6,2.183 ||
And <s>nirudaka</s> and others [take the accent on the first syllable of the latter member]. || PS_6,2.184 ||
After [the preverb] <s>abhi</s>, [the accent falls on the first syllable of the latter member when the latter member is] <s>mukha</s> (face). || PS_6,2.185 ||
And after [the preverb] <s>apa</s>. || PS_6,2.186 ||

And [the words] <s>sphij</s> (buttock), <s>pūta</s> (purified), <s>vīṇā</s> (lute), <s>añjas</s> (ointment), <s>adhvan</s> (road), <s>kukṣi</s> (belly), <s>sīra</s> (plough), and <s>nāman</s> (name) [take the accent on the first syllable of the latter member after preverbs]. || PS_6,2.187 ||
After [the preverb] <s>adhi</s>, [the accent falls on the first syllable of the latter member when it denotes something] situated above (<s>uparistha</s>). || PS_6,2.188 ||

After [the preverb] <s>anu</s>, [the accent falls on the first syllable of the latter member when the compound denotes] a non-principal (<s>apradhāna</s>) or younger [person] (<s>kanīyasī</s>). || PS_6,2.189 ||
And [the word] <s>puruṣa</s> (man) [takes the accent on the first syllable of the latter member after <s>anu</s> when denoting one] dispatched (<s>anvādiṣṭa</s>). || PS_6,2.190 ||
After [the preverb] <s>ati</s>, [the accent falls on the first syllable of the latter member] when [the latter member is] not a <s>kṛt</s>-[derived] word (<s>akṛtpada</s>). || PS_6,2.191 ||
After [the preverb] <s>ni</s>, [the accent falls on the first syllable of the latter member] when [the compound does] not [denote] placing down (<s>anidhāna</s>). || PS_6,2.192 ||
After [the preverb] <s>prati</s>, <s>aṃśu</s> (ray) and others [take the accent on the first syllable of the latter member] in a <s>tatpuruṣa</s> [compound]. || PS_6,2.193 ||

After [the preverb] <s>upa</s>, [compounds that are] disyllabic (<s>dvyac</s>) and not [containing] <s>ajina</s> (hide), and not [belonging to the] <s>gaura</s> class and others [take the accent on the first syllable of the latter member]. || PS_6,2.194 ||
After [the preverb] <s>su</s>, [the accent falls on the first syllable of the latter member when the compound denotes] throwing down (<s>avakṣepaṇa</s>). || PS_6,2.195 ||
Optionally (<s>vibhāṣā</s>) [the accent falls on the first syllable of the latter member in the compound] <s>utpuccha</s> (with raised tail). || PS_6,2.196 ||

After <s>dvi</s> (two) and <s>tri</s> (three), [the accent falls on the first syllable of the latter member when the latter member is] <s>pād</s> (foot), <s>dan</s> (tooth), or <s>mūrdhan</s> (head), in a <s>bahuvrīhi</s> [compound]. || PS_6,2.197 ||
And [the word] <s>sakthi</s> (thigh) [takes the accent on the first syllable of the latter member] except after <s>ākrānta</s> (assailed). || PS_6,2.198 ||
After <s>para</s> and others, [the accent on the first syllable of the latter member occurs] variously (<s>bahulam</s>) in Vedic usage (<s>chandas</s>). || PS_6,2.199 ||
Non-elision of the case ending (<s>aluk</s>) [occurs before] the latter member (<s>uttarapada</s>). || PS_6,3.1 ||
[Non-elision occurs] of the fifth case (<s>pañcamī</s>) after <s>stoka</s> and others. || PS_6,3.2 ||
[Non-elision occurs] of the third case (<s>tṛtīyā</s>) [after the words] <s>ojas</s> (strength), <s>sahas</s> (power), <s>ambhas</s> (water), and <s>tamas</s> (darkness). || PS_6,3.3 ||
[Non-elision of the case ending occurs after] <s>manas</s> (mind) in a proper name (<s>sañjñā</s>). || PS_6,3.4 ||
And [non-elision occurs] in [the compound] <s>ājñāyin</s> (one who commands). || PS_6,3.5 ||
And [non-elision occurs after] <s>ātman</s> (self) [when the latter member denotes] an ordinal (<s>pūraṇa</s>). || PS_6,3.6 ||
[Non-elision occurs] of the fourth case (<s>caturthī</s>) according to the grammarians (<s>vaiyākaraṇa</s>) in a designation (<s>ākhyā</s>). || PS_6,3.7 ||
And [non-elision occurs for the case ending] of [the word] <s>para</s> (other). || PS_6,3.8 ||
[Non-elision occurs] of the seventh case (<s>saptamī</s>) after a stem ending in a consonant (<s>hal</s>) or in <s>a</s>, in a proper name (<s>sañjñā</s>). || PS_6,3.9 ||

And [non-elision occurs] in a name of a cause (<s>kāranāman</s>) according to the eastern [grammarians] (<s>prācām</s>), when [the latter member] begins with a consonant (<s>halādi</s>). || PS_6,3.10 ||
[Non-elision occurs after the word] <s>madhya</s> (middle) when [the latter member denotes something] weighty (<s>guru</s>). || PS_6,3.11 ||

[Non-elision occurs] after one's own body part (<s>svāṅga</s>) except <s>mūrdhan</s> (head) and <s>mastaka</s> (skull), when [the compound is] not [used in the sense of] desire (<s>akāma</s>). || PS_6,3.12 ||
And optionally (<s>vibhāṣā</s>) [non-elision occurs in compounds with] <s>bhandha</s> (bondage). || PS_6,3.13 ||
In a <s>tatpuruṣa</s> [compound], before a <s>kṛt</s> [suffix, non-elision occurs] variously (<s>bahulam</s>). || PS_6,3.14 ||
[Non-elision of the case ending of] <s>prāvṛṣ</s> (rainy season), <s>śarat</s> (autumn), <s>kāla</s> (time), and <s>div</s> (day/heaven) [occurs] before [the suffix] <s>ja</s> (born). || PS_6,3.15 ||
Optionally (<s>vibhāṣā</s>) [non-elision occurs in the preceding cases]. || PS_6,3.16 ||
[Non-elision occurs] of a time-name (<s>kālanāman</s>) before [the suffixes] <s>gha</s>, <s>kāla</s>, and <s>tana</s>. || PS_6,3.17 ||
[Non-elision occurs] before [the words] <s>śaya</s> (lying), <s>vāsa</s> (dwelling), and <s>vāsin</s> (resident), [but] not [after a word denoting] time (<s>akāla</s>). || PS_6,3.18 ||
And [non-elision occurs] before [the words derived from roots] <s>nī</s> (to lead), <s>siddha</s> (accomplished), and <s>badhnāti</s> (binds). || PS_6,3.19 ||
And [non-elision occurs] before [the word] <s>stha</s> (standing) in the spoken language (<s>bhāṣā</s>). || PS_6,3.20 ||
[Non-elision occurs] of the sixth case (<s>ṣaṣṭhī</s>) in abuse (<s>ākrośa</s>). || PS_6,3.21 ||
[Non-elision of the sixth case occurs] in [a compound denoting] a son (<s>putra</s>), optionally (<s>anyatarasyām</s>). || PS_6,3.22 ||
[Non-elision occurs] of [the case ending of a stem in] <s>ṛ</s> [when the compound denotes] learning (<s>vidyā</s>), origin (<s>yoni</s>), or kinship (<s>sambandha</s>). || PS_6,3.23 ||
Optionally (<s>vibhāṣā</s>) [non-elision occurs] of [the case endings of] <s>svasṛ</s> (sister) and <s>pati</s> (lord/husband). || PS_6,3.24 ||
[The augment] <s>anaṅ</s> [is added] to [a stem in] <s>ṛ</s> in a <s>dvandva</s> [compound]. || PS_6,3.25 ||
And in a <s>dvandva</s> [compound] of deities (<s>devatā</s>). || PS_6,3.26 ||
[The augment] <s>īd</s> [is added] to <s>Agni</s> [when compounded with] <s>Soma</s> and <s>Varuṇa</s>. || PS_6,3.27 ||
[The augment] <s>id</s> [is added when there is] <s>vṛddhi</s> [in the latter member]. || PS_6,3.28 ||
[The word] <s>deva</s> (god) [is replaced by] <s>dyāvā</s>. || PS_6,3.29 ||
And [the word] <s>divasa</s> (day) [is replaced by <s>dyāvā</s> when compounded with] <s>pṛthivī</s> (earth). || PS_6,3.30 ||
[The word] <s>uṣas</s> (dawn) [is replaced by] <s>uṣāsā</s>. || PS_6,3.31 ||
[The replacement] <s>mātara</s> [occurs for <s>mātṛ</s>] and <s>pitarau</s> [for <s>pitṛ</s>] according to the northern [grammarians] (<s>udīcām</s>). || PS_6,3.32 ||
And [the forms] <s>pitarā</s> and <s>mātarā</s> [are used] in Vedic usage (<s>chandas</s>). || PS_6,3.33 ||

body.text: striyāḥ puṃvad-bhāṣītapuṃskādanūṅ samānādhikaraṇe striyām apūraṇī-priyādiṣu || PS_6,3.34 ||
body.translated_text: A feminine [stem takes] the masculine form (<s>puṃvat</s>) [when it is a] <s>bhāṣitapuṃska</s> (a word used in the masculine in common speech) [and the compound is in] the same grammatical relation (<s>samānādhikaraṇa</s>) with a feminine [word], excluding <s>pūraṇī</s> (ordinal feminine) and <s>priyā</s> class and others, [and the feminine suffix is] not <s>ūṅ</s>. || PS_6,3.34 ||
[The masculine form applies] before <s>tasil</s> and other [suffixes] up to [but not including] <s>kṛtvasuc</s>. || PS_6,3.35 ||
And [the masculine form applies] before <s>kyaṅ</s> and <s>mānin</s>. || PS_6,3.36 ||
Not [the masculine form] of [a stem with] <s>ka</s> as penultimate (<s>kopadhā</s>). || PS_6,3.37 ||
And [the masculine form applies] in proper names (<s>sañjñā</s>) and ordinals (<s>pūraṇī</s>). || PS_6,3.38 ||
And [the masculine form applies for] a <s>taddhita</s> [suffix] whose occasion is <s>vṛddhi</s>, except [when the suffix denotes] a red dye (<s>araktavikāra</s>). || PS_6,3.39 ||

And [the masculine form applies] after [a word denoting] one's own body part (<s>svāṅga</s>) with [the suffix] <s>ita</s>, [when the compound] does not [denote] a measure (<s>amānin</s>). || PS_6,3.40 ||
And [the masculine form applies when the compound denotes] birth (<s>jāti</s>). || PS_6,3.41 ||
[A feminine stem takes] the masculine form (<s>puṃvat</s>) in a <s>karmadhāraya</s> [compound], [and before the suffixes] <s>jātīya</s> and <s>deśīya</s>. || PS_6,3.42 ||

In [compounds with] <s>ghara</s> (house), <s>rūpa</s> (form), <s>kalpa</s> (resembling), <s>cela</s> (cloth), <s>ḍa</s>, <s>brūva</s> (calling oneself), <s>gotra</s> (lineage), <s>mata</s> (considered), and <s>hata</s> (struck), the final vowel of a <s>ṅī</s>-ending [feminine stem] having more than one syllable (<s>anekāc</s>) is shortened (<s>hrasva</s>). || PS_6,3.43 ||
Of a <s>nadī</s> [feminine stem], the remaining [vowel is shortened] optionally (<s>anyatarasyām</s>). || PS_6,3.44 ||
And [shortening occurs] of [a stem marked with] <s>ukit</s>. || PS_6,3.45 ||

[The substitute] <s>ān</s> [replaces the final of] <s>mahat</s> (great) [when the compounds are in] the same grammatical relation (<s>samānādhikaraṇa</s>) [and before the suffixes] <s>jātīya</s>. || PS_6,3.46 ||
[The stems] <s>dvi</s> (two) and <s>aṣṭan</s> (eight) [take special forms] before a numeral (<s>saṅkhyā</s>), but not in a <s>bahuvrīhi</s> [compound] or before <s>aśīti</s> (eighty). || PS_6,3.47 ||
[The word] <s>tri</s> (three) [is replaced by] <s>trayas</s>. || PS_6,3.48 ||
Optionally (<s>vibhāṣā</s>) [this replacement applies] for all [numerals] beginning with forty (<s>catvāriṃśat</s>). || PS_6,3.49 ||
[The word] <s>hṛdaya</s> (heart) [is replaced by] <s>hṛd</s> before <s>lekha</s> (writing), <s>yat</s>, <s>aṇ</s>, and <s>lāsa</s> (sport). || PS_6,3.50 ||
Or [the replacement by <s>hṛd</s> occurs] before <s>śoka</s> (grief), <s>ṣyañ</s>, and <s>roga</s> (disease). || PS_6,3.51 ||
[The word] <s>pāda</s> (foot) [is replaced by] <s>pad</s> before <s>ājya</s> (ghee), <s>āti</s>, <s>ga</s> (going), and <s>upahata</s> (injured). || PS_6,3.52 ||
[The replacement] <s>pad</s> [occurs] before <s>yat</s> when [the compound is used] in a different meaning (<s>atadartha</s>). || PS_6,3.53 ||
And [the replacement by <s>pad</s> occurs] before <s>hima</s> (cold), <s>kāṣi</s>, and <s>hati</s> (striking). || PS_6,3.54 ||
[The word] <s>ṛc</s> (Ṛgvedic verse) [retains its form] before [the suffix] <s>śa</s>. || PS_6,3.55 ||
Or [the full form of <s>ṛc</s> is retained] before <s>ghoṣa</s> (sound) and mixed-sound words (<s>miśraśabda</s>). || PS_6,3.56 ||
[The word] <s>udaka</s> (water) [is replaced by] <s>uda</s> in a proper name (<s>sañjñā</s>). || PS_6,3.57 ||
And [the replacement by <s>uda</s> occurs] before <s>peṣa</s> (grinding), <s>vāsa</s> (dwelling), <s>vāhana</s> (vehicle), and <s>dhi</s> (holder). || PS_6,3.58 ||
Before [a word] beginning with a single consonant (<s>ekahal-ādi</s>), when [the compound needs to be] completed, optionally (<s>anyatarasyām</s>) [the replacement occurs]. || PS_6,3.59 ||

And [the replacement by <s>uda</s> occurs] before <s>mantha</s> (churning), <s>odana</s> (rice gruel), <s>saktu</s> (barley meal), <s>bindu</s> (drop), <s>vajra</s> (thunderbolt), <s>bhāra</s> (load), <s>hāra</s> (necklace), <s>vīvadha</s> (carrying pole), and <s>gāha</s> (plunge). || PS_6,3.60 ||
A vowel (<s>ik</s>) [in a stem] is shortened (<s>hrasva</s>) [when it is] not a final element (<s>aṅga</s>), according to <s>Gālava</s>. || PS_6,3.61 ||
[The numeral] <s>eka</s> (one) [is shortened] before a <s>taddhita</s> [suffix] as well. || PS_6,3.62 ||
[The final vowels of] <s>ṅī</s> and <s>āp</s> [feminine suffixes are deleted] in proper names (<s>sañjñā</s>) and Vedic usage (<s>chandas</s>), variously (<s>bahulam</s>). || PS_6,3.63 ||
And [the deletion occurs] before <s>tva</s> (the abstract suffix). || PS_6,3.64 ||
[The words] <s>iṣṭakā</s> (brick), <s>iṣīkā</s> (reed), and <s>mālā</s> (garland) [undergo shortening] before <s>cita</s> (piled), <s>tūla</s> (cotton), and <s>bhāra</s> (load). || PS_6,3.65 ||
Before [a suffix marked with] <s>khit</s>, [shortening occurs for a stem that is] not an indeclinable (<s>anavyaya</s>). || PS_6,3.66 ||
[The augment] <s>mum</s> [is inserted after a stem that is] not ending in <s>ṛ</s> or a vowel, nor ending in a consonant with <s>dviṣat</s> (hating). || PS_6,3.67 ||
And [the augment <s>mum</s> is treated] like a <s>pratyaya</s> (suffix) for [a stem in] <s>ic</s> that is monosyllabic (<s>ekāc</s>). || PS_6,3.68 ||
And [the words] <s>Vācaṃyama</s> (restrainer of speech) and <s>Purandara</s> (destroyer of cities) [take the augment <s>mum</s>]. || PS_6,3.69 ||
[The augment <s>mum</s> is inserted] before <s>kāra</s> [in the compound] of <s>satya</s> (truth) and <s>agada</s> (medicine). || PS_6,3.70 ||
[The word] <s>śyena</s> (hawk) and <s>tila</s> (sesame) [take the augment <s>mum</s>] before <s>pāta</s> (fall) and [the suffix] <s>ña</s>. || PS_6,3.71 ||
[The word] <s>rātri</s> (night) [takes the augment <s>mum</s>] before a <s>kṛt</s> [suffix], optionally (<s>vibhāṣā</s>). || PS_6,3.72 ||
[There is] elision of the <s>n</s> (<s>nalopa</s>) of <s>nañ</s> (the negative particle). || PS_6,3.73 ||
After that, [the augment] <s>nuḍ</s> [is inserted] before a vowel (<s>ac</s>). || PS_6,3.74 ||

[The initial <s>na</s> of the following words remains] in its original form (<s>prakṛtyā</s>): <s>nabhra</s>, <s>napāt</s>, <s>naveda</s>, <s>Nāsatya</s>, <s>Namuci</s>, <s>nakula</s>, <s>nakha</s>, <s>napuṃsaka</s>, <s>nakṣatra</s>, <s>nakra</s>, and <s>nāka</s>. || PS_6,3.75 ||

[When the first member of a compound ends in] <s>a</s>, the augment <s>āṭ</s> [is added to the second member beginning with] <s>eka</s> (one) [and to the <s>eka</s> of the second member]. || PS_6,3.76 ||
[The word] <s>naga</s> [retains its original form] optionally (<s>anyatarasyām</s>) [when the second member denotes] a non-living thing (<s>aprāṇi</s>). || PS_6,3.77 ||
[The final] <s>sa</s> of <s>sahas</s> [is replaced by] <s>saḥ</s> in a proper name (<s>sañjñāyām</s>). || PS_6,3.78 ||
And [this replacement occurs] when [the second member means] 'exceeding the limit of a book' (<s>granthānta-adhika</s>). || PS_6,3.79 ||
And [this replacement occurs] in the second [member] when it is not a well-known name (<s>anupākhya</s>). || PS_6,3.80 ||
And in an <s>avyayībhāva</s> (indeclinable compound) [this replacement occurs] when [the meaning is] not time (<s>akāla</s>). || PS_6,3.81 ||
Optionally (<s>vā</s>) [this replacement occurs] for a subordinate member (<s>upasarjana</s>). || PS_6,3.82 ||
[The initial <s>a</s> remains] in its original form (<s>prakṛtyā</s>) in a benediction (<s>āśis</s>) [when the second member is] <s>go</s>, <s>vatsa</s>, or <s>hala</s>. || PS_6,3.83 ||

[The initial vowel] of <s>samāna</s> (same) [remains in its original form] in Vedic usage (<s>chandasi</s>) [when the compound means] 'not previously [existing]' (<s>apūrdha</s>), 'beginning with' (<s>prabhṛti</s>), or 'future consequence' (<s>udarka</s>). || PS_6,3.84 ||

[The initial vowel of <s>samāna</s> remains in its original form when compounded with] <s>jyotis</s> (light), <s>janapada</s> (country), <s>rātri</s> (night), <s>nābhi</s> (navel), <s>nāman</s> (name), <s>gotra</s> (lineage), <s>rūpa</s> (form), <s>sthāna</s> (place), <s>varṇa</s> (class), <s>varya</s> (excellent), <s>vacana</s> (speech), and <s>bandhu</s> (kinsman). || PS_6,3.85 ||
[The initial vowel of <s>samāna</s> remains in its original form when the second member means] a Vedic school (<s>caraṇa</s>) [and refers to] a religious student (<s>brahmacārin</s>). || PS_6,3.86 ||
[The initial vowel of <s>samāna</s> remains in its original form] when [the second member is] <s>tīrtha</s> (sacred place) [and the suffix] <s>ya</s> [follows]. || PS_6,3.87 ||
Optionally (<s>vibhāṣā</s>) [the initial vowel of <s>samāna</s> remains in its original form when the second member is] <s>udara</s> (belly). || PS_6,3.88 ||
[The initial vowel of <s>samāna</s> remains in its original form when the second member has the suffixes] <s>dṛg</s>, <s>dṛśa</s>, or <s>vatu</s>. || PS_6,3.89 ||
[The final vowels] of <s>idam</s> (this) and <s>kim</s> (what) [are replaced by] <s>īś</s> and <s>kī</s> [respectively]. || PS_6,3.90 ||
[This replacement extends] up to [but not including] a <s>sarvanāman</s> (pronominal). || PS_6,3.91 ||

body.text: viṣvag-devayoś ca ṭer adry añcatau vapratyaye || PS_6,3.92 ||
body.translated_text: And [in the case of] <s>viṣvak</s> and <s>deva</s>, [the replacement applies to the final] <s>ṭi</s> portion, [but] not before [the suffix] <s>añc</s> when there is a <s>va</s>-pratyaya. || PS_6,3.92 ||
[The final of] <s>sama</s> [is replaced by] <s>sami</s>. || PS_6,3.93 ||
[The final of] <s>tiras</s> [is replaced by] <s>tiry</s> when there is no elision (<s>alopa</s>). || PS_6,3.94 ||
[The final of] <s>sahas</s> [is replaced by] <s>sadhriḥ</s>. || PS_6,3.95 ||
[The replacement is] <s>sadha</s> [when the second member is] <s>māda</s> or <s>stha</s> in Vedic usage (<s>chandasi</s>). || PS_6,3.96 ||
After [the preverbs] <s>dvi</s>, <s>antar</s>, and [other] <s>upasargas</s> (preverbs), [the root] <s>ap</s> [receives the augment] <s>īṭ</s>. || PS_6,3.97 ||
[The substitute] <s>ūt</s> [replaces the final of] <s>an</s> [when the second member means] a place (<s>deśa</s>). || PS_6,3.98 ||

[For the word] <s>anaya</s>, which is not in the sixth (<s>aṣaṣṭhī</s>) or third (<s>atṛtīyā</s>) case and is not [used with] <s>stha</s>, the augment <s>duk</s> [is added when the second member is] <s>āśīr</s> (blessing), <s>āśā</s> (hope), <s>āsthā</s> (confidence), <s>āsthita</s> (resorted to), <s>utsuka</s> (eager), <s>ūti</s> (aid), <s>kāraka</s> (doer), <s>rāga</s> (attachment), or <s>ccha</s>. || PS_6,3.99 ||
Optionally (<s>vibhāṣā</s>) [the augment <s>duk</s> is added when the second member means] <s>artha</s> (purpose). || PS_6,3.100 ||
[The final] of <s>ku</s> [is replaced by] <s>kat</s> in a <s>tatpuruṣa</s> (determinative compound) [when the second member begins with] a vowel (<s>ac</s>). || PS_6,3.101 ||
And [<s>kat</s> replaces the final of <s>ku</s> before] <s>ratha</s> and <s>vada</s>. || PS_6,3.102 ||
And [<s>kat</s> replaces the final of <s>ku</s> before] <s>dṛṇa</s> when [the compound denotes] a species (<s>jāti</s>). || PS_6,3.103 ||
[The final of <s>ku</s> is replaced by] <s>kā</s> [before] <s>pathi</s> (road) and <s>akṣa</s> (axle). || PS_6,3.104 ||
And [<s>kā</s> replaces the final of <s>ku</s>] in the sense of 'slightly' (<s>īṣat</s>). || PS_6,3.105 ||
Optionally (<s>vibhāṣā</s>) [<s>kā</s> replaces the final of <s>ku</s> before] <s>puruṣa</s> (man). || PS_6,3.106 ||
[<s>kā</s> replaces the final of <s>ku</s> before] <s>vañcu</s> and <s>uṣṇa</s>. || PS_6,3.107 ||
[<s>kā</s> replaces the final of <s>ku</s> before] <s>pathi</s> in Vedic usage (<s>chandasi</s>) also. || PS_6,3.108 ||
[Words like] <s>pṛṣodara</s> and others [are used] as listed (<s>yathopadiṣṭam</s>). || PS_6,3.109 ||

body.text: saṅkhyā-vi-sāya-pūrvasya ahnasya ahann anyatarasyāṃ ṅau || PS_6,3.110 ||
body.translated_text: [The final of] <s>ahan</s> (day) [is replaced by] <s>ahann</s> optionally (<s>anyatarasyām</s>) before [the ending] <s>ṅi</s> (locative singular), when preceded by a numeral (<s>saṅkhyā</s>), <s>vi</s>, <s>sāya</s>, or <s>pūrva</s>. || PS_6,3.110 ||
When [the suffixes] <s>ḍhra</s> [are elided], the vowel of the preceding [member] is lengthened, [if it is] <s>aṇ</s> (a short vowel). || PS_6,3.111 ||
[The final] of <s>sahi</s> and <s>vah</s> [is replaced by] <s>oṭ</s> [when what follows begins with] <s>a</s>-vowel (<s>avarṇa</s>). || PS_6,3.112 ||
<s>sāḍhyai</s>, <s>sāḍhvā</s>, <s>sāḍha</s> — [these forms occur] thus in the <s>Nigama</s> (Vedic texts). || PS_6,3.113 ||
[The above rules apply] in connected recitation (<s>saṃhitā</s>). || PS_6,3.114 ||

[The word denoting] an ear (<s>karṇa</s>) [is compounded as a prefix] to [a word denoting] a characteristic mark (<s>lakṣaṇa</s>) [of the following]: <s>aviṣṭa</s>, <s>aṣṭa</s>, <s>pañca</s>, <s>maṇi</s>, <s>bhinna</s>, <s>cchinna</s>, <s>cchidra</s>, <s>sruva</s>, and <s>svastika</s>. || PS_6,3.115 ||

[The final <s>i</s>-vowel of the roots] <s>nah</s>, <s>vṛt</s>, <s>vṛṣ</s>, <s>vyadh</s>, <s>ruc</s>, <s>sah</s>, and <s>tan</s> [remains in its original form] before [the suffix] <s>kva</s> (i.e., <s>kvau</s>). || PS_6,3.116 ||

[The words] <s>vana</s> (forest) and <s>giri</s> (mountain) [retain their original form] in a proper name (<s>sañjñāyām</s>) [when compounded with] <s>koṭara</s>, <s>kiṃśuluka</s>, and others. || PS_6,3.117 ||
[This also applies] before [the suffix] <s>val</s>. || PS_6,3.118 ||
[The final vowel remains in its original form] before [the suffix] <s>matup</s>, for polysyllabic words (<s>bahvac</s>) [except those in the list beginning with] <s>anajira</s>. || PS_6,3.119 ||
And [the same applies to words in the list] beginning with <s>śara</s>. || PS_6,3.120 ||
[The vowel] <s>ik</s> [remains unchanged] before [the suffix] <s>vaha</s>, except for [the word] <s>pīlu</s>. || PS_6,3.121 ||

[The final vowel] of an <s>upasarga</s> (preverb) [remains in its original form] before [the suffix] <s>ghañ</s> irregularly (<s>bahulam</s>) when [the derivative does] not [denote] a human being (<s>amanuṣya</s>). || PS_6,3.122 ||
[The vowel] <s>ik</s> [remains in its original form before a suffix beginning with] <s>kāśa</s>. || PS_6,3.123 ||
[The final of] <s>das</s> [is replaced by] <s>ti</s>. || PS_6,3.124 ||
[The final of] <s>aṣṭan</s> (eight) [is treated thus] in a proper name (<s>sañjñāyām</s>). || PS_6,3.125 ||
And in Vedic usage (<s>chandasi</s>) [as well]. || PS_6,3.126 ||
[The final of] <s>citi</s> [remains in its original form] before [the suffix] <s>kap</s>. || PS_6,3.127 ||
[The final of] <s>viśva</s> (all) [remains in its original form before] <s>vasu</s> and <s>rāṭ</s>. || PS_6,3.128 ||
[The final of <s>viśva</s> remains in its original form before] <s>nara</s> in a proper name (<s>sañjñāyām</s>). || PS_6,3.129 ||
[The final of <s>viśva</s> remains in its original form before] <s>mitra</s> [when it refers to a] <s>carṣu</s> (cultivator/sage). || PS_6,3.130 ||
In a <s>mantra</s> (sacred formula), [the final of] <s>soma</s>, <s>aśva</s>, <s>indriya</s>, and <s>viśvadeva</s> [remains in its original form] before [the suffix] <s>matup</s>. || PS_6,3.131 ||
And [the final of] <s>oṣadhi</s> (plant) [remains in its original form] before a case ending (<s>vibhakti</s>) other than the first (nominative). || PS_6,3.132 ||
In <s>Ṛc</s> (Ṛgveda), [the final <s>i</s> of the stems remains in its original form for] <s>tunu</s>, <s>ghama</s>, <s>kṣu</s>, <s>taṅku</s>, <s>troru</s>, and <s>ṣyāṇa</s>. || PS_6,3.133 ||
[A vowel] <s>ik</s> [remains in its original form] before [the suffix] <s>suñ</s>. || PS_6,3.134 ||
[This applies to] a disyllabic (<s>dvyac</s>) [stem that does not end in] <s>as</s> or a <s>tiṅ</s> (verbal ending). || PS_6,3.135 ||
And [this applies to] an indeclinable (<s>nipāta</s>). || PS_6,3.136 ||
[This lengthening] is also seen (<s>dṛśyate</s>) in other [cases]. || PS_6,3.137 ||
[This applies] before [the particle] <s>ca</s> (i.e., <s>cau</s>). || PS_6,3.138 ||
[This applies to a vowel that is the result of] <s>samprasāraṇa</s> (semivowel-to-vowel replacement). || PS_6,3.139 ||
[The following rules apply to] an <s>aṅga</s> (stem before a suffix). || PS_6,4.1 ||
[The penultimate <s>a</s> of an <s>aṅga</s> ending in] a consonant (<s>hal</s>) [is lengthened]. || PS_6,4.2 ||
[This lengthening occurs] before a <s>nām</s>-ending (i.e., an ending marked with <s>ṅ</s> or <s>ṇ</s>). || PS_6,4.3 ||
Not [in the case of the stems] <s>tisṛ</s> (three, feminine) and <s>catasṛ</s> (four, feminine). || PS_6,4.4 ||
In Vedic usage (<s>chandasi</s>), both ways [i.e., with or without lengthening are seen]. || PS_6,4.5 ||
And [the same lengthening applies to] <s>nṛ</s> (man). || PS_6,4.6 ||
Not [when the penultimate is] an <s>upadhā</s> (penultimate letter) [that is <s>a</s> preceded by <s>na</s>]. || PS_6,4.7 ||
And [this lengthening occurs] before a <s>sarvanāmasthāna</s> (strong case ending), except in the vocative singular (<s>asambuddhi</s>). || PS_6,4.8 ||
Optionally (<s>vā</s>) [the lengthening occurs] for [a stem] preceded by <s>ṣaṭ</s> (six) in <s>Nigama</s> (Vedic texts). || PS_6,4.9 ||
[The lengthening occurs for a stem ending in] <s>sa</s> preceded by <s>anta</s> or <s>mahat</s>, [when it is part of] a consonant cluster (<s>saṃyoga</s>). || PS_6,4.10 ||

[The lengthening occurs for the stems] <s>ap</s> (water), <s>tṛn</s>, <s>tṛc</s>, <s>svasṛ</s> (sister), <s>naptṛ</s> (grandson), <s>neṣṭṛ</s> (a priest), <s>tvaṣṭṛ</s> (<s>Tvaṣṭṛ</s>), <s>kṣattṛ</s> (charioteer), <s>hotṛ</s> (invoker), <s>potṛ</s> (purifier), and <s>praśāstṛ</s> (director). || PS_6,4.11 ||
[The stems] <s>in</s>, <s>han</s>, <s>Pūṣan</s>, and <s>Aryaman</s> [are lengthened] before [the case ending] <s>śau</s> (nominative dual). || PS_6,4.12 ||
And before [the ending] <s>su</s> (nominative singular) [as well]. || PS_6,4.13 ||
And [the lengthening occurs for a stem] that does not end in <s>a</s> and is not derived from a root (<s>adhātu</s>), before [an ending containing] <s>t</s> or <s>v</s>. || PS_6,4.14 ||

[The nasal] of a stem ending in a nasal (<s>anunāsika</s>) [is deleted] before [the suffixes] <s>kvi</s> and [endings beginning with] <s>jhal</s> consonants, [when the suffix is] <s>kṅit</s> (marked with <s>k</s> or <s>ṅ</s>). || PS_6,4.15 ||
[The nasal of] <s>aj</s> (to drive), <s>jhan</s> (= <s>han</s>, to strike), and <s>gam</s> (to go) [is deleted] before [the suffix] <s>san</s> (desiderative). || PS_6,4.16 ||
[The nasal of] <s>tanoti</s> (the root <s>tan</s>, to extend) [is deleted] optionally (<s>vibhāṣā</s>) [before <s>san</s>]. || PS_6,4.17 ||
And [the nasal of] <s>kram</s> (to stride) [is deleted before the suffix] <s>ktvi</s> (the absolutive <s>-tvā</s>). || PS_6,4.18 ||
[The finals] <s>ch</s> and <s>v</s> [of a root are replaced by] <s>ś</s> and <s>ūḍh</s> [respectively] before a nasal (<s>anunāsika</s>) [ending]. || PS_6,4.19 ||
[The <s>upadhā</s> (penultimate) of the roots] <s>jvar</s> (to be feverish), <s>tvar</s> (to hasten), <s>sriv</s>, <s>av</s>, and <s>mav</s> [is also deleted]. || PS_6,4.20 ||
[A consonant of the class] <s>r</s>-<s>al</s> [is subject to] deletion (<s>lopa</s>). || PS_6,4.21 ||
[The following rules are] treated as if not having taken effect (<s>asiddha</s>) with respect to each other, up to [the end of the section beginning with] <s>bhāt</s>. || PS_6,4.22 ||
[After the stem formed with] <s>śnā</s> (<s>śnā</s>-pratyaya, class 9 infix), [there is] deletion of <s>n</s> (<s>nalopa</s>). || PS_6,4.23 ||

[The <s>upadhā</s> (penultimate) of] stems not marked with <s>iṭ</s> (<s>anidiṭ</s>), [which is a] consonant (<s>hal</s>), [is deleted when the suffix is] <s>kṅit</s> (marked with <s>k</s> or <s>ṅ</s>). || PS_6,4.24 ||
[The nasal of the roots] <s>daṃś</s> (to bite), <s>sañj</s> (to attach), and <s>svañj</s> (to embrace) [is deleted] before [the vikaraṇa] <s>śap</s>. || PS_6,4.25 ||
And [the nasal of] <s>rañj</s> (to be colored) [is deleted before <s>śap</s>]. || PS_6,4.26 ||
And [the nasal of <s>rañj</s> is deleted] before <s>ghañ</s> [when the meaning is] abstract state (<s>bhāva</s>) or instrument (<s>karaṇa</s>). || PS_6,4.27 ||
[The nasal of] <s>syad</s> (= <s>syand</s>, to flow) [is deleted when the meaning is] speed (<s>java</s>). || PS_6,4.28 ||
[The forms] <s>avoda</s>, <s>edh</s>, <s>odma</s>, <s>praśratha</s>, <s>himaśratha</s> [are listed as irregularly formed words]. || PS_6,4.29 ||
Not [the nasal of] <s>añc</s> (to bend) [is deleted] when [the meaning is] reverence (<s>pūjā</s>). || PS_6,4.30 ||
[The nasal is deleted] before [the suffix] <s>ktvi</s> [in the case of the roots] <s>skand</s> (to leap) and <s>syand</s> (to flow). || PS_6,4.31 ||
[The nasal of roots ending in] <s>jā</s>-final and <s>naś</s> (to perish) [is deleted] optionally (<s>vibhāṣā</s>). || PS_6,4.32 ||
And [the nasal of] <s>bhañj</s> (to break) [is deleted] before <s>ciṇ</s> (causative aorist marker). || PS_6,4.33 ||
[The root] <s>śās</s> (to instruct) [has its penultimate replaced by] <s>i</s> before [an ending beginning with a] consonant (<s>hal</s>) [in <s>parasmaipada</s>]. || PS_6,4.34 ||
[The root <s>śās</s> becomes] <s>śā</s> before [the ending] <s>hi</s> (imperative second person singular). || PS_6,4.35 ||
[The root] <s>han</s> (to kill) [is replaced by] <s>ja</s> [before <s>hi</s>]. || PS_6,4.36 ||

[Roots with] <s>anudātta</s> (grave accent) in their listing (<s>upadeśa</s>), and [roots like] <s>van</s> (to desire), <s>tan</s> (to extend), and others — [their] nasal is deleted (<s>anunāsikalopa</s>) before [a consonant of the] <s>jhal</s> class, [when the suffix is] <s>kṅit</s>. || PS_6,4.37 ||
Optionally (<s>vā</s>) [this nasal deletion occurs] before <s>lyap</s> (the absolutive suffix <s>-ya</s> after a preverb). || PS_6,4.38 ||
Not before <s>ktic</s>, and [the preceding vowel becomes] long (<s>dīrgha</s>) [instead]. || PS_6,4.39 ||
[The nasal of] <s>gam</s> (to go) [is deleted] before <s>kva</s> (i.e., <s>kvau</s>). || PS_6,4.40 ||
[The nasal] of <s>viḍ</s> and <s>van</s> [is replaced by] <s>āt</s>. || PS_6,4.41 ||
[The nasal of] <s>jan</s> (to be born), <s>san</s> (to obtain), and <s>khan</s> (to dig) [is deleted] before <s>sañ</s> and [endings beginning with] <s>jhal</s>. || PS_6,4.42 ||
[The nasal deletion occurs] optionally (<s>vibhāṣā</s>) before [the suffix] <s>ya</s>. || PS_6,4.43 ||
[The nasal of] <s>tanoti</s> (root <s>tan</s>) [is deleted] before [the suffix] <s>yak</s>. || PS_6,4.44 ||

body.text: sanaḥ ktici lopaś ca asya anyatarasyām || PS_6,4.45 ||
body.translated_text: [The nasal] of <s>san</s> (to obtain) [is deleted] before <s>ktic</s>, and the deletion of this [nasal occurs] optionally (<s>anyatarasyām</s>). || PS_6,4.45 ||
[The following rules apply] before an <s>ārdhadhātuka</s> (non-conjugational) suffix. || PS_6,4.46 ||
[The root] <s>bhrasj</s> (to roast), being <s>ra</s>-penultimate (<s>ra-upadhā</s>), [has its penultimate replaced by] <s>ram</s> optionally (<s>anyatarasyām</s>). || PS_6,4.47 ||
[The final] <s>a</s> [of a stem] is deleted (<s>lopa</s>) [before an <s>ārdhadhātuka</s> suffix]. || PS_6,4.48 ||
[This deletion applies to the <s>a</s>] which is followed by a consonant (<s>hal</s>). || PS_6,4.49 ||
[The deletion of <s>a</s>] of [the suffix] <s>kya</s> [occurs] optionally (<s>vibhāṣā</s>). || PS_6,4.50 ||
[The deletion occurs after the suffix] <s>ṇi</s> (causative) [when the following suffix is] <s>aniṭ</s> (without the augment <s>iṭ</s>). || PS_6,4.51 ||
[The deletion occurs] before <s>niṣṭhā</s> (past participle suffixes <s>kta</s> and <s>ktavatu</s>) [when the suffix is] <s>seṭ</s> (with the augment <s>iṭ</s>). || PS_6,4.52 ||
[The form] <s>janitā</s> [is used for the agent noun of <s>jan</s>] in a <s>mantra</s> (sacred formula). || PS_6,4.53 ||
[The form] <s>śamitā</s> [is used for the agent noun of <s>śam</s>] in [the context of] sacrifice (<s>yajña</s>). || PS_6,4.54 ||

[The final <s>a</s> of the causative is replaced by] <s>ay</s> before [the suffixes] <s>ām</s>, [endings beginning with] <s>anta</s>, <s>āl</s>, <s>āyya</s>, [those with] <s>iṭ</s>, and <s>iṣṇu</s>. || PS_6,4.55 ||
[The <s>ay</s> replacement occurs] before <s>lyap</s> [when the preceding syllable is] light (<s>laghu</s>). || PS_6,4.56 ||
Optionally (<s>vibhāṣā</s>) [the <s>ay</s> replacement occurs for the root] <s>āp</s> (to obtain). || PS_6,4.57 ||
[The vowel of the roots] <s>yu</s> (to join) and <s>plu</s> (to float) [becomes] long (<s>dīrgha</s>) in Vedic usage (<s>chandasi</s>). || PS_6,4.58 ||
[And the vowel of] <s>kṣi</s> (to destroy) [becomes long in Vedic usage]. || PS_6,4.59 ||
Not [the deletion of final <s>a</s> occurs] before <s>niṣṭhā</s> (past participle) [when the meaning is] other [than the agent] (<s>aṇyadartha</s>). || PS_6,4.60 ||
Optionally (<s>vā</s>) [the deletion occurs] in [expressions of] abuse (<s>ākrośa</s>) and wretchedness (<s>dainya</s>). || PS_6,4.61 ||

body.text: sya-sic-sīyuṭ-tāsiṣu bhāva-karmaṇor upadeśe 'j-jhana-graha-dṛśāṃ vā ciṇvad-iṭ ca || PS_6,4.62 ||
body.translated_text: Before [the suffixes] <s>sya</s>, <s>sic</s>, <s>sīyuṭ</s>, and <s>tāsi</s>, in the passive (<s>bhāva-karman</s>), when [the root] in its listing (<s>upadeśa</s>) is <s>aj</s> (to drive), <s>jhan</s> (= <s>han</s>), <s>grah</s> (to seize), or <s>dṛś</s> (to see), optionally (<s>vā</s>) [the <s>a</s> of <s>ṇi</s> is treated] like <s>ciṇ</s> and [the augment] <s>iṭ</s> [is added]. || PS_6,4.62 ||
[The root] <s>dīṅ</s> (to fly) [receives the augment] <s>yuṭ</s> before [a suffix beginning with] a vowel (<s>ac</s>), [when the suffix is] <s>kṅit</s>. || PS_6,4.63 ||
[The final] <s>ā</s> [of a root] is deleted (<s>lopa</s>) [before a suffix with the augment] <s>iṭ</s> as well. || PS_6,4.64 ||
[The above rule applies when the suffix] <s>ī</s> [follows, as in] <s>dyati</s>. || PS_6,4.65 ||

[The stems] <s>ghu</s> (roots so designated), <s>mā</s> (to measure), <s>sthā</s> (to stand), <s>gā</s> (to go), <s>pā</s> (to drink), <s>jahāti</s> (root <s>hā</s>, to abandon), and <s>sā</s> (to bind) [have their final <s>ā</s> replaced by <s>ī</s>] before [an ending beginning with] a consonant (<s>hal</s>). || PS_6,4.66 ||
[The final <s>ā</s> is replaced by] <s>e</s> before <s>liṅ</s> (optative mood). || PS_6,4.67 ||
Optionally (<s>vā</s>) [the <s>ā</s> is replaced] for another [root] whose [stem begins with] a consonant cluster (<s>saṃyoga-ādi</s>). || PS_6,4.68 ||
Not before <s>lyap</s> (absolutive <s>-ya</s>). || PS_6,4.69 ||
[The root] <s>may</s> (= <s>mā</s>, to exchange) [takes the augment] <s>iṭ</s> optionally (<s>anyatarasyām</s>). || PS_6,4.70 ||
Before [the tenses] <s>luṅ</s> (aorist), <s>laṅ</s> (imperfect), and <s>lṛṅ</s> (conditional), [the augment] <s>aṭ</s> [is added, and it is] <s>udātta</s> (acute-accented). || PS_6,4.71 ||
[The augment] <s>āṭ</s> [is added to roots] beginning with a vowel (<s>aj-ādi</s>). || PS_6,4.72 ||
[This augment] is also seen (<s>dṛśyate</s>) in Vedic usage (<s>chandasi</s>). || PS_6,4.73 ||
Not when [the prohibitive particle] <s>mā</s> is joined [with the verb]. || PS_6,4.74 ||
Irregularly (<s>bahulam</s>) in Vedic usage (<s>chandasi</s>), even when <s>mā</s> is not joined [the augment may be absent]. || PS_6,4.75 ||
[The <s>ira</s> of the root <s>ir</s>] <s>ira</s> [is replaced by] <s>re</s>. || PS_6,4.76 ||

Before a vowel (<s>ac</s>), [the <s>y</s> and <s>v</s> of] <s>śnu</s> (class 5 marker), a root (<s>dhātu</s>), and <s>bhrū</s> (eyebrow) [are replaced by] <s>iyaṅ</s> and <s>uvaṅ</s> [respectively]. || PS_6,4.77 ||
[<s>iyaṅ</s> and <s>uvaṅ</s> replace the vowel] of a reduplicated syllable (<s>abhyāsa</s>) [when followed by] a dissimilar vowel (<s>asavarṇa</s>). || PS_6,4.78 ||
[<s>iyaṅ</s> replaces the <s>ī</s>] of [the feminine suffix] <s>strī</s>. || PS_6,4.79 ||
Optionally (<s>vā</s>) [<s>iyaṅ</s> is substituted] before [the suffixes] <s>aṃśa</s> and <s>as</s>. || PS_6,4.80 ||
[The vowel] of [the root] <s>iṇ</s> (to go) [is replaced by] <s>yaṇ</s> (i.e., <s>y</s>). || PS_6,4.81 ||
[The final] <s>i/u</s> (<s>er</s>) of a polysyllabic (<s>anekāc</s>) [stem] not preceded by a consonant cluster (<s>asamyogapūrva</s>) [is replaced by <s>yaṇ</s>]. || PS_6,4.82 ||
[The final] <s>o</s> [of a stem is replaced by <s>av</s>] before a <s>sup</s> (nominal ending). || PS_6,4.83 ||
And [the same applies to the stems] <s>varṣā</s> (rain) and <s>abhra</s> (cloud). || PS_6,4.84 ||
Not [for] <s>bhū</s> (earth) and <s>sudhī</s> (wise one). || PS_6,4.85 ||
In Vedic usage (<s>chandasi</s>), both ways [are seen]. || PS_6,4.86 ||
[The vowels of] <s>hu</s> (to offer) and <s>śnu</s> (class 5 infix) [are replaced by <s>guṇa</s>] before a <s>sārvadhātuka</s> (conjugational) suffix. || PS_6,4.87 ||
[The root] <s>bhū</s> (to become) [receives the augment] <s>vuk</s> before [the tenses] <s>luṅ</s> (aorist) and <s>liṭ</s> (perfect). || PS_6,4.88 ||
[The penultimate vowel (<s>upadhā</s>) of the root] <s>goh</s> (= <s>guh</s>, to hide) [is replaced by] <s>ūṭ</s> (long <s>ū</s>). || PS_6,4.89 ||
[The root] <s>doṣ</s> (= <s>duṣ</s>, to be corrupted) [has its penultimate replaced by <s>o</s>] before <s>ṇi</s> (causative <s>ṇic</s>). || PS_6,4.90 ||
Optionally (<s>vā</s>) [this replacement occurs] when [the meaning is] mental disenchantment (<s>citta-virāga</s>). || PS_6,4.91 ||
[The vowel of stems] marked with <s>m</s> (<s>mit</s>) [is replaced by a] short vowel (<s>hrasva</s>). || PS_6,4.92 ||
[The vowel before] <s>ciṇ</s> (causative aorist) and <s>ṇamul</s> [becomes] long (<s>dīrgha</s>) optionally (<s>anyatarasyām</s>). || PS_6,4.93 ||
[The vowel becomes] short (<s>hrasva</s>) before [the suffix] <s>khac</s>. || PS_6,4.94 ||
[The root] <s>hlād</s> (to refresh) [has its vowel shortened] before <s>niṣṭhā</s> (past participle). || PS_6,4.95 ||
[The vowel of] <s>chād</s> (to cover) [is shortened] before <s>gha</s> (i.e., the suffix <s>ghañ</s>), [when the root is] without two preverbs (<s>advy-upasarga</s>). || PS_6,4.96 ||
And [the vowel is shortened] before [the suffixes] <s>is</s> (<s>iṣ</s>), <s>man</s>, <s>tran</s>, and <s>kvi</s>. || PS_6,4.97 ||

[The penultimate of the roots] <s>gam</s> (to go), <s>han</s> (to kill), <s>jan</s> (to be born), <s>khan</s> (to dig), and <s>ghas</s> (to eat) [is] deleted (<s>lopa</s>) [when the suffix is] <s>kṅit</s>, but not before [the substitute] <s>aṅ</s>. || PS_6,4.98 ||
[The penultimate of] <s>tan</s> (to extend) and <s>pat</s> (= <s>pati</s>, lord) [is deleted] in Vedic usage (<s>chandasi</s>). || PS_6,4.99 ||
[The penultimate of] <s>ghas</s> (to eat) and <s>bhas</s> [is deleted] before [an ending beginning with] a consonant (<s>hal</s>) also. || PS_6,4.100 ||
[Before the endings of] <s>hu</s> (to offer) and those beginning with <s>jhal</s> consonants, [the imperative ending] <s>hi</s> [is replaced by] <s>dhi</s>. || PS_6,4.101 ||

[The same replacement occurs after the roots] <s>śru</s> (to hear), <s>śṛṇu</s> (class 5 form of <s>śru</s>), <s>pṝ</s> (to fill), <s>kṛ</s> (to do), and <s>vṛ</s> (to choose) in Vedic usage (<s>chandasi</s>). || PS_6,4.102 ||
And [after stems] not marked with <s>ṅ</s> (<s>aṅit</s>). || PS_6,4.103 ||
[The suffix] <s>ciṇ</s> [undergoes] <s>luk</s> (complete deletion). || PS_6,4.104 ||
[<s>hi</s> is deleted] after [a stem ending in] <s>a</s> (<s>ato heḥ</s>). || PS_6,4.105 ||
And after [a stem ending in] <s>u</s>, [when that <s>u</s> comes] from a suffix (<s>pratyaya</s>) and is not preceded by a consonant cluster (<s>asamyogapūrva</s>). || PS_6,4.106 ||

body.text: lopaś ca asya anyatarasyāṃ ṃvoḥ || PS_6,4.107 ||
body.translated_text: And the deletion of this [<s>hi</s> occurs] optionally (<s>anyatarasyām</s>) before [the endings] <s>m</s> and <s>v</s>. || PS_6,4.107 ||
[This deletion is] obligatory (<s>nityam</s>) for [the root] <s>kṛ</s> (to do). || PS_6,4.108 ||
And before [the suffix] <s>ya</s> [as well]. || PS_6,4.109 ||
[The final] <s>a</s> [of a stem is replaced by] <s>ut</s> before a <s>sārvadhātuka</s> (conjugational) suffix. || PS_6,4.110 ||
[The final of the class 2 marker] <s>śna</s> and [the final] <s>s</s> [of the root undergo] <s>r</s>-deletion and <s>al</s>-deletion (<s>allopaḥ</s>). || PS_6,4.111 ||
[The <s>ā</s> of] <s>śnā</s> (class 9 marker) and <s>abhyāsa</s> (reduplication) [is replaced by the corresponding short vowel] before [endings that are] <s>āt</s>-initial. || PS_6,4.112 ||
[The <s>ā</s> of these stems is replaced by] <s>ī</s> before [an ending beginning with] a consonant (<s>hal</s>) that is not <s>dha</s> (i.e., <s>adhoḥ</s>). || PS_6,4.113 ||
[The <s>ā</s> is replaced by] <s>id</s> for [the root] <s>daridrā</s> (to be poor). || PS_6,4.114 ||
[The <s>ā</s> is replaced by <s>ī</s>] for [the root] <s>bhī</s> (to fear) optionally (<s>anyatarasyām</s>). || PS_6,4.115 ||
And for [the root of] <s>jahāti</s> (<s>hā</s>, to abandon) [as well]. || PS_6,4.116 ||
And [the replacement is] <s>ā</s> before [the ending] <s>hi</s> (imperative 2nd person singular). || PS_6,4.117 ||
[There is] deletion (<s>lopa</s>) [of the stem-final vowel] before [an ending beginning with] <s>y</s>. || PS_6,4.118 ||

[For stems of the] <s>ghu</s> [class] and <s>as</s> (to be), [the replacement is] <s>e</s> and <s>dhāv</s> [respectively], and [there is also] deletion of the reduplication (<s>abhyāsalopa</s>). || PS_6,4.119 ||

[The final] <s>a</s> [of a root that stands] in the middle of a single consonant (<s>ekahal-madhya</s>), [and whose initial is] not a substitute (<s>anādeśādi</s>), [is deleted] in <s>liṭ</s> (perfect tense). || PS_6,4.120 ||
And before [the ending] <s>thal</s> (perfect 2nd person singular) [when it is] <s>seṭ</s> (takes augment <s>iṭ</s>). || PS_6,4.121 ||
And [the same applies to the roots] <s>tṝ</s> (to cross), <s>phal</s> (to burst), <s>bhaj</s> (to share), and <s>trap</s> (to be ashamed). || PS_6,4.122 ||
[And the same applies to] <s>radh</s> (= <s>rādh</s>) [when the meaning is] injury (<s>hiṃsā</s>). || PS_6,4.123 ||
Optionally (<s>vā</s>) [the same applies to] <s>jṝ</s> (to grow old), <s>bhramu</s> (= <s>bhram</s>, to wander), and <s>tras</s> (to tremble). || PS_6,4.124 ||
And [for] seven [roots in the list beginning with] <s>phaṇ</s>. || PS_6,4.125 ||
Not [for the roots] <s>śas</s> (to cut), <s>dad</s> (to give), those beginning with <s>v</s> (<s>v-ādi</s>), or those taking <s>guṇa</s>. || PS_6,4.126 ||
[The stem] <s>arvan</s> (horse) [drops its final before suffixes] other than <s>tr</s>, <s>asāv</s>, and those marked with <s>ñ</s> (<s>anañ</s>). || PS_6,4.127 ||
[The stem] <s>maghavan</s> (<s>Maghavan</s>, epithet of <s>Indra</s>) [undergoes this change] irregularly (<s>bahulam</s>). || PS_6,4.128 ||
[The following rules apply to a stem in its] <s>bha</s> [form] (i.e., before <s>bha</s>-saṃjñā endings). || PS_6,4.129 ||
[As] will be stated [later]: [the final of] <s>pāda</s> (foot) [is replaced by] <s>pat</s>. || PS_6,4.130 ||
[The stem] <s>vas</s> (= <s>vāsas</s>, cloth) [undergoes] <s>samprasāraṇa</s> (semivowel-to-vowel replacement). || PS_6,4.131 ||
[The stem] <s>vāh</s> (one who carries) [has its final replaced by] <s>ūṭh</s>. || PS_6,4.132 ||
[The stems] <s>śvan</s> (dog), <s>yuvan</s> (youth), and <s>maghon</s> (<s>Maghavan</s>) [undergo <s>samprasāraṇa</s>] when [the following suffix is] not a <s>taddhita</s>. || PS_6,4.133 ||
[The final] <s>al</s> (consonant) is deleted before [the ending] <s>as</s> (<s>ana</s>). || PS_6,4.134 ||
[The stems] preceded by <s>ṣaṭ</s> (six), <s>han</s> (killer), and <s>dhṛtarājan</s> (<s>Dhṛtarāṣṭra</s>'s lineage) [undergo this change] before <s>aṇ</s>. || PS_6,4.135 ||
Optionally (<s>vibhāṣā</s>) before [the endings] <s>ṅi</s> (locative) and <s>śya</s>. || PS_6,4.136 ||
Not [when the final consonant is] preceded by a cluster (<s>saṃyoga</s>) ending in <s>va</s> or <s>ma</s>. || PS_6,4.137 ||
[The deletion occurs] after a vowel (<s>ac</s>). || PS_6,4.138 ||
[The stem] <s>ud</s> [takes the augment] <s>īṭ</s>. || PS_6,4.139 ||
[The final] <s>ā</s> of a root (<s>dhātu</s>) [is deleted before a <s>bha</s> ending]. || PS_6,4.140 ||
In <s>mantras</s>, [the final <s>ā</s> of a root is retained when the preverb is] <s>āṅ</s>-initial [and the voice is] <s>ātmanepada</s>. || PS_6,4.141 ||
[The final of] <s>viṃśati</s> (twenty) [is replaced by] <s>ti</s> before [a suffix] marked with <s>ḍ</s> (<s>ḍit</s>). || PS_6,4.142 ||
[The <s>ṭi</s> portion (final syllable) is deleted] before <s>ṭe</s>. || PS_6,4.143 ||
[The final] <s>n</s> [of a stem is deleted] before a <s>taddhita</s> (secondary suffix). || PS_6,4.144 ||
[The <s>n</s> of] <s>ahan</s> (day) [is deleted] only before [suffixes beginning with] <s>ṭa</s> and <s>kha</s>. || PS_6,4.145 ||
[The penultimate vowel of a stem undergoes] <s>guṇa</s> (vowel strengthening) [before a suffix beginning with] <s>or</s>. || PS_6,4.146 ||
[The <s>ī</s>] is deleted before <s>ḍha</s>, except for [the stem] <s>Kadrū</s>. || PS_6,4.147 ||
And [the deletion occurs when the general rule] 'of which' (<s>yasya</s>) [applies, i.e., when the final vowel is to be replaced by <s>lopa</s>]. || PS_6,4.148 ||
[The stems] <s>Sūrya</s>, <s>Tiṣya</s>, <s>Agastya</s>, and <s>Matsya</s> — [the <s>y</s> which is] the penultimate (<s>upadhā</s>) [is deleted before a <s>taddhita</s>]. || PS_6,4.149 ||
[A final] consonant (<s>hal</s>) [is deleted before] a <s>taddhita</s> suffix. || PS_6,4.150 ||
And [the final is deleted for a stem denoting] offspring (<s>āpatya</s>) before a <s>taddhita</s>, [but] not before [the suffix] <s>āti</s>. || PS_6,4.151 ||
And [this deletion occurs] before [the suffixes] <s>kyac</s> and <s>kya</s> (denominative). || PS_6,4.152 ||
[For words] beginning with <s>bilvaka</s> and others, [the suffix] <s>cha</s> [undergoes] <s>luk</s> (complete deletion). || PS_6,4.153 ||
[The final] <s>tu</s> [of a stem is retained] before [the suffixes] <s>iṣṭha</s> (superlative), <s>ima</s>, and <s>īyas</s> (comparative). || PS_6,4.154 ||
[The <s>ṭi</s> portion (final syllable) is deleted] before <s>ṭe</s>. || PS_6,4.155 ||

body.text: sthūla-dūra-yuva-hrasva-kṣiprakṣudrāṇāṃ yaṇādiparaṃ pūrvasya ca guṇaḥ || PS_6,4.156 ||
body.translated_text: For <s>sthūla</s> (thick), <s>dūra</s> (far), <s>yuva</s> (young), <s>hrasva</s> (short), <s>kṣipra</s> (quick), and <s>kṣudra</s> (small), [the substitute is] that which begins with the <s>yaṇ</s> [sounds and follows], and <s>guṇa</s> (vowel strengthening) [applies] to the preceding [vowel]. || PS_6,4.156 ||

For <s>priya</s> (dear), <s>sthira</s> (firm), <s>sphira</s> (abundant), <s>uru</s> (wide), <s>bahula</s> (thick), <s>guru</s> (heavy), <s>vṛddha</s> (old), <s>tṛpra</s> (satisfied), <s>dīrgha</s> (long), and <s>vṛndāraka</s> (eminent), [the substitutes are respectively] <s>pra</s>, <s>stha</s>, <s>spha</s>, <s>var</s>, <s>baṃhi</s>, <s>gar</s>, <s>varṣi</s>, <s>trab</s>, <s>drāghi</s>, and <s>vṛnda</s>. || PS_6,4.157 ||

body.text: bahor lopo bhū ca bahoḥ || PS_6,4.158 ||
body.translated_text: For <s>bahu</s> (many), there is deletion [of the final vowel], and [the substitute] <s>bhū</s> [replaces] <s>bahu</s>. || PS_6,4.158 ||
And [the augment] <s>yiṬ</s> [is added] to [the suffix] <s>iṣṭha</s> [after these substitutes]. || PS_6,4.159 ||
<s>jya</s> [is the substitute], and <s>āT</s> [is added] for [the suffix] <s>īyas</s>. || PS_6,4.160 ||
<s>ra</s> [replaces] <s>ṛ</s> of a light [syllable base] beginning with a consonant. || PS_6,4.161 ||
Optionally for <s>ṛju</s> (straight) in <s>Chandas</s> (Vedic usage). || PS_6,4.162 ||
[A stem remains] in its original form [when it has] a single vowel [before the <s>tadrāja</s> suffix]. || PS_6,4.163 ||
[The suffix] <s>in</s> [is added in the sense of] <s>aṇ</s> when not [denoting] a descendant. || PS_6,4.164 ||
And [this applies to stems formed from] <s>Gāthin</s>, <s>Vidathin</s>, <s>Keśin</s>, <s>Gaṇin</s>, and <s>Paṇin</s>. || PS_6,4.165 ||
And [a stem] beginning with a consonant cluster [retains its original form]. || PS_6,4.166 ||
[The substitute is] <s>an</s> [for the final portion of the base before <s>tadrāja</s> suffixes]. || PS_6,4.167 ||
And [the suffix] <s>ya</s> [is used] in the senses of absence and action. || PS_6,4.168 ||
<s>Ātman</s> and <s>adhvan</s> [take the substitute <s>an</s>] when a <s>kha</s> (taddhita suffix beginning with <s>kha</s>) [follows]. || PS_6,4.169 ||
[The substitute <s>an</s> does] not [apply to a stem] preceded by <s>ma</s> [when denoting] a descendant, except [from the word] <s>varman</s>. || PS_6,4.170 ||
[The form] <s>brāhma</s> [is used when] not [denoting] a birth-based [relationship]. || PS_6,4.171 ||
[The form] <s>kārma</s> [is used] in the sense of habitual practice. || PS_6,4.172 ||
[The form] <s>aukṣa</s> [is used] when not [denoting] a descendant. || PS_6,4.173 ||

[The following are irregularly formed derivatives:] <s>dāṇḍināyana</s>, <s>hāstināyana</s>, <s>ātharvaṇika</s>, <s>jaihmāśineya</s>, <s>vāsināyani</s>, <s>bhrauṇahatya</s>, <s>dhaivatya</s>, <s>sārava</s>, <s>aikṣvāka</s>, <s>maitreya</s>, and <s>hiraṇmaya</s>. || PS_6,4.174 ||
[The forms] <s>ṛtvya</s>, <s>vāstvya</s>, <s>vāstva</s>, <s>mādhvī</s>, and <s>hiraṇyaya</s> [occur] in <s>Chandas</s> (Vedic usage). || PS_6,4.175 ||
[The substitutes] <s>ana</s> and <s>aka</s> [replace the suffixes] <s>yu</s> and <s>vu</s> [respectively]. || PS_7,1.1 ||

<s>āyan</s>, <s>ey</s>, <s>īn</s>, <s>īy</s>, and <s>iya</s> [replace] the initial portions of suffixes [beginning with] <s>pha</s>, <s>ḍha</s>, <s>kha</s>, <s>cha</s>, and <s>gha</s> [respectively]. || PS_7,1.2 ||
<s>ant</s> [replaces] <s>jhi</s> [the third-person plural ending]. || PS_7,1.3 ||
<s>at</s> [replaces <s>jhi</s>] after a reduplicated [stem]. || PS_7,1.4 ||
In <s>Ātmanepada</s> (middle voice) endings, [<s>at</s> replaces <s>jhi</s>] except after [a stem ending in] <s>a</s>. || PS_7,1.5 ||
[The augment] <s>ruṬ</s> [is added] after <s>śīṄ</s> (the root meaning 'to lie down'). || PS_7,1.6 ||
Optionally after <s>veti</s> (the root meaning 'to weave'). || PS_7,1.7 ||
Variously in <s>Chandas</s> (Vedic usage). || PS_7,1.8 ||
<s>ais</s> [replaces] <s>bhis</s> after [a stem ending in] <s>a</s>. || PS_7,1.9 ||
Variously in <s>Chandas</s> (Vedic usage) [this substitution may or may not apply]. || PS_7,1.10 ||
Not [the substitution by <s>ais</s> for] <s>idam</s> (this) and <s>adas</s> (that), except [for forms ending in] <s>a</s>. || PS_7,1.11 ||
<s>ina</s>, <s>āt</s>, and <s>syā</s> [replace] <s>ṬĀ</s>, <s>Ṅasi</s>, and <s>Ṅas</s> [respectively, after a stem ending in <s>a</s>]. || PS_7,1.12 ||
<s>ya</s> [replaces] <s>Ṅe</s> [the dative singular ending, after a stem ending in <s>a</s>]. || PS_7,1.13 ||
<s>smai</s> [replaces <s>Ṅe</s>] after a <s>sarvanāman</s> (pronoun). || PS_7,1.14 ||
<s>smāt</s> and <s>smin</s> [replace] <s>Ṅasi</s> and <s>Ṅi</s> [respectively, after a <s>sarvanāman</s>]. || PS_7,1.15 ||
Optionally after the nine [pronouns] beginning with <s>pūrva</s> (prior). || PS_7,1.16 ||
<s>śī</s> [replaces] <s>jas</s> [the nominative plural ending, after a feminine stem in <s>ā</s>]. || PS_7,1.17 ||
<s>āp</s> [replaces] <s>auṄ</s> [the vocative singular ending, after a feminine stem]. || PS_7,1.18 ||
And after a <s>napuṃsaka</s> (neuter) [stem, <s>śī</s> replaces <s>jas</s>]. || PS_7,1.19 ||
<s>śi</s> [replaces both] <s>jas</s> and <s>śas</s> [the nominative and accusative plural endings, after a neuter stem]. || PS_7,1.20 ||
<s>auś</s> [replaces <s>jas</s>] after <s>aṣṭan</s> (eight). || PS_7,1.21 ||
<s>luk</s> (total deletion) [of the case ending occurs] after <s>ṣaṭ</s> (six) [and similar numerals]. || PS_7,1.22 ||
[<s>luk</s> deletion applies to] <s>su</s> and <s>am</s> [nominative and accusative singular] after a <s>napuṃsaka</s> (neuter) [stem]. || PS_7,1.23 ||
<s>am</s> [is the ending] after [a stem ending in] <s>a</s> [in the neuter nominative/accusative singular]. || PS_7,1.24 ||
[The augment] <s>aḌ</s> [is added] after the five [words] beginning with <s>Ḍatara</s> (comparative suffix). || PS_7,1.25 ||
Not after <s>itara</s> (other) in <s>Chandas</s> (Vedic usage). || PS_7,1.26 ||
<s>aś</s> [replaces] <s>Ṅas</s> (the genitive ending) after <s>yuṣmad</s> (you) and <s>asmad</s> (I/we). || PS_7,1.27 ||
<s>am</s> [replaces] <s>Ṅe</s> (the dative ending) in the first and [second persons, after <s>yuṣmad</s> and <s>asmad</s>]. || PS_7,1.28 ||
<s>na</s> [replaces] <s>śas</s> [the accusative plural, after <s>yuṣmad</s> and <s>asmad</s>]. || PS_7,1.29 ||
<s>bhyam</s> [replaces] <s>bhyas</s> [after <s>yuṣmad</s> and <s>asmad</s>]. || PS_7,1.30 ||
<s>at</s> [replaces the ending] of the fifth case (ablative) [after <s>yuṣmad</s> and <s>asmad</s>]. || PS_7,1.31 ||
And [this applies only] in the singular. || PS_7,1.32 ||
<s>ākam</s> [replaces <s>Ṅas</s> (genitive)] of [the pronoun base] <s>sāma</s> [i.e., <s>asmad</s> in the singular]. || PS_7,1.33 ||
<s>au</s> [replaces] <s>āt</s> (ablative ending) of [a stem ending in] <s>a</s> after [the suffix] <s>Ṇal</s> (<s>liṬ</s> first-person singular). || PS_7,1.34 ||
<s>tātaṄ</s> [replaces] <s>tu</s> and <s>hi</s> (imperative endings) in a benediction (<s>āśis</s>), optionally. || PS_7,1.35 ||
[The substitute] <s>śatṛ</s> of <s>vid</s> (to know) [takes the form] <s>vasu</s> [i.e., <s>vidvas</s>]. || PS_7,1.36 ||
In a compound, when not preceded by <s>a-nañ</s> (the negative particle <s>na</s>), <s>lyap</s> [replaces] <s>ktvā</s>. || PS_7,1.37 ||
<s>ktvā</s> also [occurs] in <s>Chandas</s> (Vedic usage) [even in compounds]. || PS_7,1.38 ||

Of the <s>sup</s> (nominal) endings, [the substitutes are] <s>su</s>, <s>luk</s> (deletion), the preceding homogeneous vowel, <s>ā</s>, <s>āc</s>, <s>che</s>, <s>yā</s>, <s>ḌĀ</s>, <s>Ḍyā</s>, <s>yāj</s>, and <s>āl</s>. || PS_7,1.39 ||
<s>maś</s> [replaces] <s>am</s> [accusative singular of <s>yuṣmad</s>/<s>asmad</s>]. || PS_7,1.40 ||
Deletion (<s>lopa</s>) of <s>ta</s> [occurs] in <s>Ātmanepada</s> (middle voice) [endings]. || PS_7,1.41 ||
<s>dhvāt</s> [replaces] <s>dhvam</s> [in the <s>Ātmanepada</s>]. || PS_7,1.42 ||
And [this is seen in the Vedic expression] '<s>yajadhvainam</s>' (worship him). || PS_7,1.43 ||
<s>tāt</s> [replaces] <s>ta</s> [the second-person singular imperative ending, in certain usages]. || PS_7,1.44 ||
And <s>tapta</s>, <s>napta</s>, <s>tana</s>, and <s>thana</s> [are substitutes for the imperative endings]. || PS_7,1.45 ||
[A stem ending in] <s>id</s> [is substituted] before <s>masi</s> [first-person plural ending, in Vedic]. || PS_7,1.46 ||
<s>yak</s> [replaces] <s>ktvā</s> [in Vedic usage]. || PS_7,1.47 ||
And [this is seen in the Vedic form] '<s>iṣṭvīnam</s>.' || PS_7,1.48 ||
And [the forms] beginning with <s>snātvī</s> [are also attested in Vedic usage]. || PS_7,1.49 ||
After <s>ā</s> [prefixed to the root], [the augment] <s>asuk</s> [is added] before <s>jas</s> [the nominative plural]. || PS_7,1.50 ||
[The denominative suffix] <s>kyac</s> [is applied] to <s>aśva</s> (horse), <s>kṣīra</s> (milk), <s>vṛṣa</s> (bull), and <s>lavaṇa</s> (salt) in the sense of self-gratification. || PS_7,1.51 ||
[The augment] <s>suṬ</s> [is added] to a <s>sarvanāman</s> (pronoun) before <s>āmi</s> [the locative plural ending which begins with <s>ā</s>]. || PS_7,1.52 ||
<s>traya</s> [replaces] <s>tri</s> (three) [before vowel-initial endings]. || PS_7,1.53 ||
[The augment] <s>nuṬ</s> [is added after stems ending in] a short [vowel], <s>nadī</s> (-ī/-ū feminine stems), and <s>āp</s> (-ā feminine stems) [before <s>āmi</s>]. || PS_7,1.54 ||
And after <s>ṣaṭ</s> (six) and <s>catur</s> (four). || PS_7,1.55 ||
[After] <s>śrī</s> (prosperity) and <s>grāmaṇī</s> (village chief) in <s>Chandas</s> (Vedic usage). || PS_7,1.56 ||
[<s>nuṬ</s> is added after] <s>go</s> (cow) at the end of a <s>pāda</s> (metrical quarter). || PS_7,1.57 ||
[The augment] <s>num</s> [is inserted in] a root ending in <s>id</s> (i.e., having <s>i</s> as its penultimate). || PS_7,1.58 ||
[<s>num</s> is inserted] before <s>śe</s> [the <s>Ātmanepada</s> ending] in [the roots] beginning with <s>muc</s> (to release). || PS_7,1.59 ||
[<s>num</s> is inserted in] <s>masj</s> (to sink) and <s>naś</s> (to perish) before a <s>jhal</s> consonant [suffix]. || PS_7,1.60 ||
