[<s>num</s> is inserted in] <s>radh</s> (to accomplish) and <s>jabh</s> (to gape) before a vowel-initial [suffix]. || PS_7,1.61 ||
Not [<s>num</s>] when <s>iṬ</s> [augment intervenes], nor in <s>liṬ</s> (perfect tense), for <s>radh</s>. || PS_7,1.62 ||
For <s>rabh</s> (to seize), [<s>num</s> is inserted] except before <s>śab</s> [pratyaya] and in <s>liṬ</s> (perfect). || PS_7,1.63 ||
And for <s>labh</s> (to obtain) [<s>num</s> is inserted likewise]. || PS_7,1.64 ||
[<s>num</s> is inserted after the preverb] <s>āṄ</s> before [a suffix beginning with] <s>y</s>. || PS_7,1.65 ||
[And after] <s>upa</s> in the sense of praise. || PS_7,1.66 ||
[<s>num</s> is inserted] after an <s>upasarga</s> (preverb) before [the suffixes] <s>khal</s> and <s>ghañ</s>. || PS_7,1.67 ||
Not after <s>su</s> and <s>dur</s> when [they stand] alone (without a verb). || PS_7,1.68 ||
Optionally before [the suffixes] <s>ciṆ</s> and <s>Ṇamul</s>. || PS_7,1.69 ||

[The augment] <s>num</s> [is inserted in stems] marked with <s>u</s> as <s>it</s> and [stems of] the <s>ac</s> class (short-vowel stems), in the <s>sarvanāmasthāna</s> (strong cases), [but] not [in] a verbal root. || PS_7,1.70 ||
[<s>num</s> is inserted] for <s>yuj</s> (to yoke) when not in a compound. || PS_7,1.71 ||
[<s>num</s> is inserted in] a <s>napuṃsaka</s> (neuter) [stem ending in] a <s>jhal</s> consonant or a vowel [before the <s>sarvanāmasthāna</s> endings]. || PS_7,1.72 ||
[The semivowel substitute] of an <s>ik</s> vowel [is used] before a vowel-initial case ending. || PS_7,1.73 ||

In the third case (instrumental) and subsequent [cases], [a neuter stem] designated as <s>bhāṣitapuṃska</s> (optionally masculine in speech) [is treated] as masculine, according to <s>Gālava</s>. || PS_7,1.74 ||
For <s>asthi</s> (bone), <s>dadhi</s> (curds), <s>sakthi</s> (thigh), and <s>akṣi</s> (eye), [the substitute] <s>anaṄ</s> [is added, and it is] <s>udātta</s> (acute-accented). || PS_7,1.75 ||
[This] is also seen in <s>Chandas</s> (Vedic usage). || PS_7,1.76 ||
And <s>ī</s> [replaces the final vowel] in the dual. || PS_7,1.77 ||
Not [<s>num</s> augment applies] after a reduplicated [stem] before [the suffix] <s>śatṛ</s>. || PS_7,1.78 ||
Optionally [not] for a <s>napuṃsaka</s> (neuter) [stem after a reduplicated base]. || PS_7,1.79 ||
[The augment] <s>num</s> [is inserted] before <s>śī</s> and in [the root] <s>nad</s> (to roar), after a vowel. || PS_7,1.80 ||
[<s>num</s> insertion is] obligatory [before] <s>śap</s> and <s>śyan</s> [the vikaraṇa affixes]. || PS_7,1.81 ||
[The augment <s>num</s> is inserted] before <s>sau</s> (nominative singular) in [the word] <s>anaḍuh</s> (bull, draught-ox). || PS_7,1.82 ||
[The forms] <s>dṛk</s>, <s>svavas</s>, and <s>svatavas</s> [occur] in <s>Chandas</s> (Vedic usage). || PS_7,1.83 ||
<s>aut</s> [replaces the final vowel] of <s>div</s> (heaven) [before <s>su</s>]. || PS_7,1.84 ||
<s>āt</s> [replaces the final portion] of <s>pathi</s> (path), <s>mathi</s> (churning stick), and <s>ṛbhukṣ</s> [in the strong cases]. || PS_7,1.85 ||
<s>at</s> [replaces the final] <s>i</s> in the <s>sarvanāmasthāna</s> (strong case endings). || PS_7,1.86 ||
<s>ntha</s> [replaces] <s>tha</s> [the second-person plural ending in the perfect]. || PS_7,1.87 ||
Deletion of the <s>ṬeR</s> (final two sounds) [occurs for a stem] in the <s>bha</s> (weak) [form]. || PS_7,1.88 ||
[The augment] <s>asuṄ</s> [is added after] <s>puṃs</s> (man) [in the strong cases]. || PS_7,1.89 ||
[The substitute for] <s>go</s> (cow) [is treated as] <s>Ṇit</s> (having <s>ṇ</s> as marker). || PS_7,1.90 ||
<s>Ṇal</s> [replaces the <s>liṬ</s> ending] in the first person (uttama), optionally. || PS_7,1.91 ||
[<s>Ṇal</s> replaces the ending] of <s>sakhi</s> (friend), except in the vocative singular (<s>asambuddhau</s>). || PS_7,1.92 ||
[The substitute] <s>anaṄ</s> [replaces the final portion of <s>sakhi</s>] before <s>sau</s> (nominative singular). || PS_7,1.93 ||
And for [stems ending in] <s>ṛ</s>, <s>Uśanas</s>, <s>Purūravas</s>, <s>Daṃs</s>, and <s>Anehas</s> [the same <s>anaṄ</s> augment applies]. || PS_7,1.94 ||
<s>Kroṣṭu</s> (jackal) [is treated] like a <s>tṛj</s>-stem (agent noun in <s>-tṛ</s>). || PS_7,1.95 ||
And in the feminine [<s>kroṣṭu</s> follows the <s>tṛj</s>-stem pattern]. || PS_7,1.96 ||
Optionally in the third case (instrumental) and subsequent [cases] before a vowel-initial [ending, <s>kroṣṭu</s> may follow the <s>tṛj</s>-pattern]. || PS_7,1.97 ||
For <s>catur</s> (four) and <s>anaḍuh</s> (bull), [the substitute] <s>ām</s> [for the genitive plural is] <s>udātta</s> (acute-accented). || PS_7,1.98 ||
<s>am</s> [replaces the final portion of the stem] in the vocative (<s>sambuddhau</s>) [for <s>ṛ</s>-stems]. || PS_7,1.99 ||
[The vowel] <s>ṝ</s> [is replaced by] <s>i</s> for a root containing [<s>ṝ</s>] [before certain suffixes]. || PS_7,1.100 ||
And [<s>i</s> replaces <s>ṝ</s>] in the penultimate position [of a root]. || PS_7,1.101 ||
<s>u</s> [replaces <s>ṝ</s>] when preceded by a labial consonant. || PS_7,1.102 ||
Variously in <s>Chandas</s> (Vedic usage). || PS_7,1.103 ||
<s>Vṛddhi</s> (strongest vowel grade) [applies] before <s>sic</s> (the aorist marker) in <s>Parasmaipada</s> (active voice) [endings]. || PS_7,2.1 ||
[<s>Vṛddhi</s> applies] to [a root ending in] <s>a</s> and having <s>lṚ</s> as its final. || PS_7,2.2 ||
[<s>Vṛddhi</s> applies to] the vowel of <s>vad</s> (to speak), <s>vraj</s> (to go), and [roots] ending in a consonant [before <s>sic</s>]. || PS_7,2.3 ||
Not [<s>vṛddhi</s> for roots taking the augment] <s>iṬ</s>. || PS_7,2.4 ||

[<s>iṬ</s> augment applies to roots] ending in <s>visarga</s>, <s>m</s>, or <s>y</s>, and [to] <s>kṣan</s>, <s>śvas</s> (to breathe), <s>jāgṛ</s> (to be awake), [roots marked with] <s>ṇi</s>, <s>śvi</s> (to swell), and [roots marked as] <s>edit</s>. || PS_7,2.5 ||
Optionally for <s>ūrṇu</s> (to cover). || PS_7,2.6 ||
[<s>Vṛddhi</s> applies to a root ending] in <s>a</s>, beginning with a consonant, [and having] a light [syllable, before <s>sic</s>]. || PS_7,2.7 ||
[There is] no <s>iṬ</s> [augment for roots] ending in a <s>vaś</s>-class consonant when a <s>kṛt</s> (primary verbal suffix) [follows]. || PS_7,2.8 ||
And before [the suffixes] <s>ti</s>, <s>tu</s>, <s>tra</s>, <s>ta</s>, <s>tha</s>, <s>si</s>, <s>su</s>, <s>sara</s>, <s>ka</s>, and <s>se</s>. || PS_7,2.9 ||
[No <s>iṬ</s> for] a monosyllabic [root] as listed in the <s>Dhātupāṭha</s> (root catalogue), [if it is] <s>anudātta</s> (grave-accented). || PS_7,2.10 ||
[No <s>iṬ</s> for roots] ending in <s>śr</s> or <s>uk</s> when a <s>kit</s> (suffix marked with <s>k</s>) [follows]. || PS_7,2.11 ||
And before <s>san</s> (the desiderative suffix) for <s>grah</s> (to seize) and <s>guh</s> (to hide). || PS_7,2.12 ||

[No <s>iṬ</s> for] <s>kṛ</s> (to do), <s>sṛ</s> (to flow), <s>bhṛ</s> (to bear), <s>vṛ</s> (to choose), <s>stu</s> (to praise), <s>dru</s> (to run), <s>sru</s> (to flow), and <s>śru</s> (to hear) in <s>liṬ</s> (the perfect tense). || PS_7,2.13 ||
[No <s>iṬ</s> for roots] <s>śvi</s> (to swell) and [those marked as] <s>idit</s> in the <s>niṣṭhā</s> (past participle suffixes <s>kta</s> and <s>ktavatu</s>). || PS_7,2.14 ||
[This is] optional for [a root] having [<s>ṛ</s> or] <s>ya</s> [as penultimate]. || PS_7,2.15 ||
And [optionally] from the beginning [of the <s>Dhātupāṭha</s>, i.e., for roots listed from the start]. || PS_7,2.16 ||
Optionally in the sense of <s>bhāva</s> (abstract action) and <s>ādikarman</s> (object, when the agent is not expressed). || PS_7,2.17 ||

[The irregular past participle forms are:] <s>kṣubdha</s>, <s>svānta</s>, <s>dhvānta</s>, <s>lagna</s>, <s>mliṣṭa</s>, <s>viribdha</s>, <s>phāṇṭa</s>, and <s>bāḍha</s> in the senses of churning, sounding, darkness, attached, impure/unclear, expanding, splitting, and intensity [respectively]. || PS_7,2.18 ||
[The form] <s>dhṛṣī</s> [is used for the root <s>dhṛṣ</s>] and <s>śasī</s> [for the root <s>śas</s>] in the sense of incitement/boldness. || PS_7,2.19 ||
<s>dṛḍha</s> [is the past participle of <s>dṛh</s>] in the senses of thickness and strength. || PS_7,2.20 ||
[The form] <s>parivṛḍha</s> [is used] in the sense of a lord/chief. || PS_7,2.21 ||
<s>kaṣa</s> [is the form used] in the senses of difficulty and denseness. || PS_7,2.22 ||
[The root] <s>ghuṣ</s> [takes <s>iṬ</s>] when not in the sense of inarticulate sound. || PS_7,2.23 ||
[<s>iṬ</s> applies] for [the root] <s>ard</s> (to go/move) after [the preverbs] <s>sam</s>, <s>ni</s>, and <s>vi</s>. || PS_7,2.24 ||
And for [the root] <s>abh</s> when [meaning] proximity (not remoteness). || PS_7,2.25 ||
[<s>iṬ</s> applies] for [the root] <s>ṇī</s> (to lead) in the sense of study; [this is an] established [usage]. || PS_7,2.26 ||
Optionally, [the forms] <s>dānta</s>, <s>śānta</s>, <s>pūrṇa</s>, <s>dasta</s>, <s>spaṣṭa</s>, <s>cchanna</s>, and <s>jñapta</s> [are used as past participles]. || PS_7,2.27 ||

[And optionally the irregular forms apply] for [the roots] <s>ruṣ</s> (to be angry), <s>am</s> (to be sick), <s>tvar</s> (to hasten), <s>saṅghuṣ</s> (to sound forth), and <s>āsvan</s>. || PS_7,2.28 ||
[The past participle] of <s>hṛṣ</s> (to be thrilled) [is used] in the sense of having body hair erect (<s>lomasu</s>). || PS_7,2.29 ||
And [the form] <s>apacita</s> [is used in certain senses]. || PS_7,2.30 ||
<s>hru</s> [is the form] of <s>hvar</s> (to be crooked) in <s>Chandas</s> (Vedic usage). || PS_7,2.31 ||
And [the form] <s>aparihvṛta</s> [is used in Vedic]. || PS_7,2.32 ||
<s>hvarita</s> [is used in connection with] <s>Soma</s>. || PS_7,2.33 ||

And [the following irregular forms are listed:] <s>grasita</s>, <s>skabhita</s>, <s>stabhita</s>, <s>uttabhita</s>, <s>catta</s>, <s>vikasta</s>; <s>viśastṛ</s>, <s>śaṃstṛ</s>, <s>śāstṛ</s>, <s>tarutṛ</s>, <s>tarūtṛ</s>, <s>varutṛ</s>, <s>varūtṛ</s>, <s>varūtrī</s>; and <s>ujjvaliti</s>, <s>kṣariti</s>, <s>kṣamiti</s>, <s>vamiti</s>, <s>amiti</s>. || PS_7,2.34 ||
[The augment] <s>iṬ</s> [is added] to an <s>ārdhadhātuka</s> (non-conjugational) suffix beginning with a <s>val</s> consonant. || PS_7,2.35 ||
[No <s>iṬ</s>] for <s>snu</s> and <s>kram</s> (to stride) when not occasioned by an <s>Ātmanepada</s> (middle voice) [ending]. || PS_7,2.36 ||
For <s>grah</s> (to seize), [the vowel is made] long, except in <s>liṬ</s> (the perfect). || PS_7,2.37 ||
Optionally for <s>vṝ</s> (to choose/cover). || PS_7,2.38 ||
Not in <s>liṄ</s> (the optative/benedictive mood). || PS_7,2.39 ||
And before <s>sic</s> (the aorist marker) in <s>Parasmaipada</s> (active voice) [endings, the vowel of <s>vṝ</s> is not lengthened]. || PS_7,2.40 ||
<s>iṬ</s> [is inserted] before <s>san</s> (the desiderative suffix), optionally. || PS_7,2.41 ||
[<s>iṬ</s> is inserted] before <s>liṄ</s> (optative) and <s>sic</s> (aorist) in <s>Ātmanepada</s> (middle voice) [endings]. || PS_7,2.42 ||
And [<s>iṬ</s> is inserted] after [a root containing] <s>ṛ</s> when [the root] begins with a consonant cluster. || PS_7,2.43 ||
Optionally for <s>svar</s> (to sound), <s>sūti</s>, <s>sūyati</s>, <s>dhūñ</s> (to shake), and [roots marked as] <s>ūdit</s>. || PS_7,2.44 ||
And after [the roots] beginning with <s>radh</s> (to accomplish). || PS_7,2.45 ||
<s>nir</s> [is the preverb with] <s>kuṣ</s> [i.e., <s>nirkuṣa</s> form applies]. || PS_7,2.46 ||
[The root] <s>iṇ</s> (to go) [takes <s>iṬ</s>] in the <s>niṣṭhā</s> (past participle). || PS_7,2.47 ||

[<s>iṬ</s> applies in <s>niṣṭhā</s> for] <s>ti</s> (to go across), <s>iṣ</s> (to desire), <s>sah</s> (to endure), <s>lubh</s> (to desire), <s>ruṣ</s> (to be angry), and <s>riṣ</s> (to be injured). || PS_7,2.48 ||

[<s>iṬ</s> applies] before <s>san</s> (desiderative) for [roots] ending in <s>i</s>, <s>rdh</s>, <s>bhrasj</s> (to fry), <s>dambhu</s>, <s>śri</s> (to resort to), <s>svṛ</s> (to sound), <s>yu</s> (to mix), <s>ūrṇu</s> (to cover), <s>bhara</s>, <s>jñapi</s>, and <s>san</s>. || PS_7,2.49 ||
For <s>kliś</s> (to suffer) before <s>ktvā</s> and in the <s>niṣṭhā</s> (past participle) [<s>iṬ</s> applies]. || PS_7,2.50 ||
And for <s>pūṄ</s> (to purify). || PS_7,2.51 ||
<s>iṬ</s> [applies] for <s>vas</s> (to dwell) and <s>kṣudh</s> (to be hungry) [in the <s>niṣṭhā</s>]. || PS_7,2.52 ||
For <s>añc</s> (to bend/honor) in the sense of worship. || PS_7,2.53 ||
For <s>lubh</s> (to desire) in the sense of bewilderment. || PS_7,2.54 ||
For <s>jṝ</s> (to grow old) and <s>vraśc</s> (to cut) before <s>ktvi</s> [<s>iṬ</s> applies]. || PS_7,2.55 ||
Optionally for [a root marked as] <s>udit</s> (having <s>u</s> as its <s>it</s> marker). || PS_7,2.56 ||
Before <s>se</s> (the <s>Ātmanepada</s> suffix), except after <s>sic</s>, for [the roots] <s>kṛta</s>, <s>cṛta</s>, <s>cchṛda</s>, <s>tṛda</s>, and <s>nṛta</s>. || PS_7,2.57 ||
<s>iṬ</s> [is added] for [the root] <s>gam</s> (to go) in <s>Parasmaipada</s> (active voice) [endings]. || PS_7,2.58 ||
Not for the four [roots] beginning with <s>vṛd</s> (to grow). || PS_7,2.59 ||
And before <s>tāsi</s> [the conditional/future suffix] for <s>kḷp</s> (to be fit). || PS_7,2.60 ||

body.text: acas tāsvat thaly aniṭo nityam || PS_7,2.61 ||
body.translated_text: Of [a root ending in] a vowel, before <s>tāsi</s> and [a suffix of the] <s>thal</s> type, [<s>iṬ</s> is] obligatory for a non-<s>seṬ</s> (non-<s>iṬ</s>-taking) [root]. || PS_7,2.61 ||
[This applies to a root] not [ending in] <s>a</s> or <s>va</s> as listed in the <s>Dhātupāṭha</s>. || PS_7,2.62 ||
[This applies] to [roots containing] <s>ṛ</s>, according to <s>Bhāradvāja</s>. || PS_7,2.63 ||
[The Vedic forms] '<s>vabhūtha</s>', '<s>ātatantha</s>', '<s>jagṛbhma</s>', and '<s>vavartha</s>' [are found] in the <s>Nigama</s> (Vedic texts). || PS_7,2.64 ||
Optionally for <s>sṛj</s> (to create) and <s>dṛś</s> (to see) [<s>iṬ</s> applies in the perfect]. || PS_7,2.65 ||
<s>iṬ</s> [is added] for <s>at</s> (to go), <s>art</s> (to praise), and <s>vyay</s> (to expend) [in the perfect]. || PS_7,2.66 ||
[The suffix] <s>vas</s> [in <s>liṬ</s> takes <s>iṬ</s>] after monosyllabic [roots], [those ending in] <s>āt</s>, and <s>ghas</s> (to eat). || PS_7,2.67 ||
Optionally for <s>gam</s> (to go), <s>han</s> (to kill), <s>vid</s> (to know), and <s>viś</s> (to enter). || PS_7,2.68 ||
[The Vedic forms are] <s>saniṃ</s>, <s>sasani</s>, and <s>vāṃsam</s>. || PS_7,2.69 ||
[<s>iṬ</s> applies] for [a root containing] <s>ṛ</s> and [the root] <s>dhan</s> before <s>sya</s> (the future suffix). || PS_7,2.70 ||
[No <s>iṬ</s> applies] for <s>jñā</s> (to know) before <s>sic</s> (the aorist marker). || PS_7,2.71 ||
For <s>stu</s> (to praise), <s>su</s> (to press), and <s>dhūñ</s> (to shake) in <s>Parasmaipada</s> (active voice) [endings, no <s>iṬ</s>]. || PS_7,2.72 ||
And for <s>yam</s> (to restrain), <s>ram</s> (to delight), <s>nam</s> (to bow), and those [roots ending in] <s>ā</s>, [the augment] <s>sak</s> [is added before <s>sya</s>]. || PS_7,2.73 ||

[<s>iṬ</s> applies] before <s>san</s> (desiderative) for <s>smi</s> (to smile), <s>pūṄ</s> (to purify), [roots containing] <s>ṛ</s>, <s>añj</s> (to anoint), <s>v</s>, and <s>aś</s> (to eat). || PS_7,2.74 ||
And for [the root] <s>kir</s> (to scatter) after the five [preverbs]. || PS_7,2.75 ||
[<s>iṬ</s> applies] for [roots of] the <s>rud</s> class (second conjugation group) before a <s>sārvadhātuka</s> (conjugational) [suffix]. || PS_7,2.76 ||
For <s>īś</s> (to rule) before <s>se</s> [the <s>Ātmanepada</s> ending]. || PS_7,2.77 ||
And for <s>īḍ</s> (to praise) and <s>jan</s> (to be born) before <s>dhve</s> [the second-person plural <s>Ātmanepada</s> ending]. || PS_7,2.78 ||
Of <s>liṄ</s> (the optative), [there is] deletion of <s>s</s> [of the <s>sīyuṬ</s> marker] for a non-final [<s>s</s>]. || PS_7,2.79 ||
<s>yeya</s> [replaces the optative markers] after [a stem ending in] <s>a</s>. || PS_7,2.80 ||
[<s>yeya</s> replaces the markers] after [a stem ending in] <s>ā</s> when [the suffix is] <s>Ṅit</s> (marked with <s>ṅ</s>). || PS_7,2.81 ||
[The augment] <s>muk</s> [is added] before <s>āne</s> [the <s>Ātmanepada</s> present participle suffix, in the optative]. || PS_7,2.82 ||
[This applies after a stem ending in] <s>ī</s> [or] <s>dā</s> [type roots before <s>āne</s>]. || PS_7,2.83 ||
For <s>aṣṭan</s> (eight), [the substitute] <s>ā</s> [replaces the final] in a case ending. || PS_7,2.84 ||
[The stem] of <s>rāy</s> (wealth) [loses its final] before a <s>hal</s> (consonant-initial) [ending]. || PS_7,2.85 ||
For <s>yuṣmad</s> (you) and <s>asmad</s> (I/we), when there is no [other] substitute [prescribed, the final portion is replaced]. || PS_7,2.86 ||
And in the second case (accusative) [<s>yuṣmad</s>/<s>asmad</s> take the prescribed form]. || PS_7,2.87 ||
And in the dual of the first case (nominative), in ordinary language (<s>bhāṣā</s>). || PS_7,2.88 ||
<s>y</s> [replaces the final of <s>yuṣmad</s>/<s>asmad</s>] before a vowel-initial [ending]. || PS_7,2.89 ||
In the remaining [cases, there is] deletion (<s>lopa</s>) [of the final]. || PS_7,2.90 ||
[Deletion occurs] up to and including <s>m</s> [i.e., the portion ending in <s>m</s> is deleted]. || PS_7,2.91 ||
It will be stated: <s>yuvā</s> and <s>vau</s> [are the substitutes] in the dual [for <s>yuṣmad</s> and <s>asmad</s>]. || PS_7,2.92 ||
<s>yūya</s> and <s>vaya</s> [are the substitutes for <s>yuṣmad</s> and <s>asmad</s> respectively] before <s>jas</s> (the nominative plural ending). || PS_7,2.93 ||
<s>tvā</s> and <s>ahau</s> [are the substitutes for <s>yuṣmad</s> and <s>asmad</s> respectively] before <s>sau</s> (the nominative singular ending). || PS_7,2.94 ||
<s>tubhya</s> and <s>mahya</s> [are the substitutes for <s>yuṣmad</s> and <s>asmad</s> respectively] before <s>Ṅayi</s> (the dative singular ending). || PS_7,2.95 ||
The substitutes <s>tava</s> and <s>mama</s> [replace the pronominal bases <s>yuṣmad</s> and <s>asmad</s> respectively] before <s>ṅasi</s> (the dative singular ending). || PS_7,2.96 ||
[The substitutes] <s>tva</s> and <s>ma</s> [replace <s>yuṣmad</s> and <s>asmad</s> respectively] in the singular. || PS_7,2.97 ||
And [the substitutes <s>tva</s> and <s>ma</s> occur] when a suffix or a latter member of a compound [follows]. || PS_7,2.98 ||
For <s>tri</s> and <s>catur</s>, [the substitutes] <s>tisṛ</s> and <s>catasṛ</s> [are used] in the feminine. || PS_7,2.99 ||
<s>ra</s> [replaces the final of a stem ending in] <s>ṛ</s> before a vowel [<s>ac</s>]. || PS_7,2.100 ||
For <s>jarā</s>, [the substitute] <s>jaras</s> [is used] optionally. || PS_7,2.101 ||
[The final vowel of] <s>tyad</s> and the other [pronominal stems is replaced by] <s>a</s>. || PS_7,2.102 ||
For <s>kim</s>, [the substitute is] <s>ka</s>. || PS_7,2.103 ||
<s>ku</s> [replaces <s>kim</s>] before <s>ti</s> and <s>hi</s> [particles]. || PS_7,2.104 ||
<s>kva</s> [replaces <s>kim</s>] before <s>ati</s>. || PS_7,2.105 ||
<s>sa</s> [replaces the first vowel] of <s>tad</s> before <s>su</s> [nominative singular] and in the remaining [cases], except in the neuter. || PS_7,2.106 ||
For <s>adas</s>, <s>au</s> [replaces the initial vowel], and there is also elision of <s>su</s>. || PS_7,2.107 ||
For <s>idam</s>, [the substitute] <s>ma</s> [replaces the final]. || PS_7,2.108 ||
And [the substitute] <s>da</s> [replaces the initial of <s>idam</s>]. || PS_7,2.109 ||
[The substitute] <s>ya</s> [replaces the initial of <s>idam</s>] before <s>su</s> [nominative singular]. || PS_7,2.110 ||
For <s>id</s> [of <s>idam</s>], [the substitute is] <s>ay</s> in the masculine. || PS_7,2.111 ||
[The substitute] <s>ana</s> [replaces the vowel of <s>idam</s>] and [also] before <s>āp</s> [feminine marker], when the vowel is <s>a</s>. || PS_7,2.112 ||
There is elision [of the final of <s>idam</s>] before a consonant [<s>hal</s>]. || PS_7,2.113 ||
For [the root] <s>mṛj</s>, <s>vṛddhi</s> [is the substitute of the vowel]. || PS_7,2.114 ||
[<s>Vṛddhi</s> replaces] a vowel [<s>ac</s>] when a suffix marked with <s>ñ</s> or <s>ṇ</s> [follows]. || PS_7,2.115 ||
[<s>Vṛddhi</s> replaces] <s>a</s> which is the penultimate [<s>upadhā</s>]. || PS_7,2.116 ||
In <s>taddhita</s> suffixes, [<s>vṛddhi</s> replaces] the initial vowel [<s>ādi</s>] among the vowels [<s>ac</s>]. || PS_7,2.117 ||
And [<s>vṛddhi</s> occurs] when a suffix marked with <s>k</s> [follows]. || PS_7,2.118 ||

For [the words] <s>Devikā</s>, <s>Śiṃśapā</s>, <s>Dityavāḍ</s>, <s>Dīrghasatra</s>, and <s>Śreyas</s>, [the <s>vṛddhi</s> substitute is] <s>ā</s> [i.e., only the initial <s>a</s> undergoes <s>vṛddhi</s>]. || PS_7,3.1 ||
For <s>Kekaya</s>, <s>Mitrayu</s>, and <s>Pralaya</s>, [the substitute] <s>iya</s> [replaces] the <s>ya</s>-initial [vowel]. || PS_7,3.2 ||

body.text: na y-vābhyāṃ padāntābhyāṃ pūrvau tu tābhyām aic || PS_7,3.3 ||
body.translated_text: [<s>Vṛddhi</s> does] not [replace the vowels] before word-final <s>y</s> and <s>v</s>; but [the vowels] preceding those [<s>y</s> and <s>v</s> are replaced by] <s>ai</s> and [<s>au</s> respectively]. || PS_7,3.3 ||
And [this applies] to [words beginning with] <s>dvāra</s> and others. || PS_7,3.4 ||
And [this applies] to <s>nyagrodha</s> when it stands alone [i.e., not in a compound]. || PS_7,3.5 ||
Not [when the <s>taddhita</s> suffix denotes] reciprocal action [<s>karmavyatihāra</s>]. || PS_7,3.6 ||
And [this applies] to [words beginning with] <s>svāgata</s> and others. || PS_7,3.7 ||
For [words beginning with] <s>śvan</s> and others, [<s>vṛddhi</s> occurs] before [the suffix] <s>iñ</s>. || PS_7,3.8 ||
[<s>Vṛddhi</s>] of a word-final [vowel occurs] optionally. || PS_7,3.9 ||
[<s>Vṛddhi</s> occurs in] the latter member of a compound [<s>uttarapada</s>]. || PS_7,3.10 ||
It will be stated: [this rule applies when the base is] a limb [<s>avayava</s>] and [when it ends in] <s>ṛ</s>. || PS_7,3.11 ||
[<s>Vṛddhi</s> occurs for the initial vowel] of [the name of] a <s>janapada</s> (country) [formed with the prefixes] <s>su</s>, <s>sarva</s>, or <s>ardha</s>. || PS_7,3.12 ||
[<s>Vṛddhi</s> occurs for the initial vowel] of a direction-denoting [word when referring to the people] of <s>Madra</s>. || PS_7,3.13 ||
[<s>Vṛddhi</s> occurs for the initial vowel] of [names of] villages and cities [in the region] of the easterners [<s>Prācya</s>]. || PS_7,3.14 ||
[<s>Vṛddhi</s> occurs for the initial vowel] of a numeral [<s>saṅkhyā</s>] and of [a word denoting a] year-number [<s>saṃvatsara-saṅkhya</s>]. || PS_7,3.15 ||
[<s>Vṛddhi</s> occurs for the initial vowel] of <s>varṣa</s> (year) when [it does] not [refer to] the future. || PS_7,3.16 ||

[<s>Vṛddhi</s> occurs for the initial vowel] of [a word] ending in a measure [<s>parimāṇa</s>], except when [it is used as] a proper name [<s>sañjñā</s>] or [before the suffix] <s>śāṇa</s>. || PS_7,3.17 ||
[<s>Vṛddhi</s> occurs] before [the suffix] <s>je</s> [in deriving] <s>Proṣṭhapadā</s> [and similar words]. || PS_7,3.18 ||
[<s>Vṛddhi</s> occurs] of the first member [<s>pūrvapada</s>] when [the compound ends in] <s>hṛd</s>, <s>bhaga</s>, or <s>sindhu</s>. || PS_7,3.19 ||
And [<s>vṛddhi</s> occurs in words beginning with] <s>anuśatika</s> and others. || PS_7,3.20 ||
And [<s>vṛddhi</s> occurs] in a <s>dvandva</s> compound of deities [<s>devatā</s>]. || PS_7,3.21 ||
Not [<s>vṛddhi</s>] of <s>Indra</s> when it is the latter [member of the compound]. || PS_7,3.22 ||
And [not <s>vṛddhi</s>] of <s>Varuṇa</s> [when it follows] a long [vowel]. || PS_7,3.23 ||
[<s>Vṛddhi</s> occurs for the initial vowel] of [words] ending in a city-name, among the easterners [<s>Prācya</s>]. || PS_7,3.24 ||
For [words] ending in <s>jaṅgala</s>, <s>dhenu</s>, or <s>valaja</s>, what follows [i.e., <s>vṛddhi</s>] is optional. || PS_7,3.25 ||

body.text: ardhāt parimāṇasya pūrvasya tu vā || PS_7,3.26 ||
body.translated_text: [<s>Vṛddhi</s> occurs] after <s>ardha</s> [when it precedes] a measure-word, but optionally for the preceding [member]. || PS_7,3.26 ||
Not [<s>vṛddhi</s>] of [the element] after <s>a</s> [i.e., after a short <s>a</s>]. || PS_7,3.27 ||
For <s>Pravāhaṇa</s>, [<s>vṛddhi</s> occurs] before [the suffix] <s>ḍha</s>. || PS_7,3.28 ||
And [<s>vṛddhi</s> occurs] of [a word bearing] that suffix [i.e., the <s>taddhita</s> suffix already present]. || PS_7,3.29 ||
[<s>Vṛddhi</s> does not occur] for [words] <s>śuci</s>, <s>īśvara</s>, <s>kṣetrajña</s>, <s>kuśala</s>, and <s>nipuṇa</s> [when preceded by] <s>nañ</s> (the negative particle). || PS_7,3.30 ||
For <s>yathātatha</s> and <s>yathāpura</s>, [<s>vṛddhi</s> occurs] in alternation [<s>paryāyeṇa</s>]. || PS_7,3.31 ||
For [the root] <s>han</s>, [the substitute] <s>ta</s> [replaces the final], except before <s>ciṇ</s> and <s>ṇal</s>. || PS_7,3.32 ||
After [a root ending in] <s>ā</s>, the augment <s>yuk</s> [is inserted] before <s>ciṇ</s> and <s>kṛt</s> [suffixes]. || PS_7,3.33 ||
Not [the augment <s>yuk</s>] for [a root] with <s>udātta</s> accent in its original teaching [<s>upadeśa</s>], ending in <s>m</s>, except for <s>cam</s> [with prefix <s>ā</s>]. || PS_7,3.34 ||
And [the augment <s>yuk</s> is inserted] for [the roots] <s>jan</s> and <s>vadh</s>. || PS_7,3.35 ||

For [the roots] <s>ṛ</s>, <s>hvī</s>, <s>vlī</s>, <s>rī</s>, <s>knūyī</s>, <s>kṣmāyī</s>, and those ending in <s>ā</s>, the augment <s>puk</s> [is inserted] before <s>ṇau</s> (the causative suffix). || PS_7,3.36 ||
For [the roots] <s>śā</s>, <s>chā</s>, <s>sā</s>, <s>hvā</s>, <s>vyā</s>, <s>ve</s>, and <s>pā</s>, [the augment] <s>yuk</s> [is inserted before <s>ṇau</s>]. || PS_7,3.37 ||
For [the root] <s>ve</s>, [the augment] <s>juk</s> [is inserted] in the sense of winnowing [<s>vidhūnana</s>]. || PS_7,3.38 ||
For [the roots] <s>lī</s> and <s>lo</s>, [the augments] <s>nuk</s> and <s>luk</s> [are inserted] optionally in the sense of clinging and falling [<s>sneha-vipātana</s>]. || PS_7,3.39 ||
For [the root] <s>bhī</s>, [the augment] <s>ṣuk</s> [is inserted] when [the causative denotes] fear caused by another [<s>hetubhaya</s>]. || PS_7,3.40 ||
For [the root] <s>sphāy</s>, [the substitute is] <s>va</s>. || PS_7,3.41 ||
For [the root] <s>śad</s>, [the substitute] <s>ta</s> [replaces the root] in the sense of not going [<s>agati</s>]. || PS_7,3.42 ||
For [the root] <s>ruh</s>, [the substitute] <s>pa</s> [replaces the root, used] optionally [in the causative]. || PS_7,3.43 ||

body.text: pratyayasthāt kāt pūrvasya ata id āpy asupaḥ || PS_7,3.44 ||
body.translated_text: Before [a suffix-initial] <s>ka</s> that is part of a suffix, [the substitute] <s>i</s> [replaces] the preceding <s>a</s>, including before <s>āp</s>, but not before a <s>sup</s> ending. || PS_7,3.44 ||
Not [the substitution of <s>i</s>] for [the suffixes] <s>yā</s> and <s>sa</s>. || PS_7,3.45 ||
According to the northern grammarians [<s>Udīcya</s>], [this substitution occurs] in place of <s>a</s> before [a suffix] preceded by <s>yak</s>. || PS_7,3.46 ||
[The words] <s>bhastrā</s>, <s>eṣā</s>, <s>ajā</s>, <s>jñā</s>, <s>dvā</s>, and <s>svā</s> [undergo this substitution] also when preceded by <s>nañ</s> (the negative particle). || PS_7,3.47 ||
And [the substitution of <s>i</s> occurs] after [a stem] not designated as masculine [in its <s>upadeśa</s>] [<s>abhāṣita-puṃska</s>]. || PS_7,3.48 ||
[The substitution of] <s>ā</s> [occurs] according to the <s>Ācārya</s>s [i.e., some teachers]. || PS_7,3.49 ||
[The substitute] <s>ika</s> [replaces] <s>ṭha</s> [i.e., the <s>taddhita</s> suffix <s>ṭha</s> is replaced by <s>ika</s>]. || PS_7,3.50 ||
After [a stem] ending in <s>is</s>, <s>us</s>, <s>uk</s>, or <s>tā</s>, [the substitute] <s>ka</s> [replaces <s>ṭha</s>]. || PS_7,3.51 ||
<s>Ku</s> [i.e., a guttural] [replaces] the <s>ca</s> and <s>ja</s> [of the root] before [the suffixes] <s>ghiṇ</s> and <s>ṇya</s>. || PS_7,3.52 ||
And [this replacement occurs] for [roots beginning with] <s>nyaṅkv</s> and others. || PS_7,3.53 ||
The <s>ha</s> of [the root] <s>han</s> [is replaced by a guttural] before [the suffixes] <s>ñ</s>-marked, <s>ṇin</s>, and <s>ṇeṣ</s>. || PS_7,3.54 ||
And [a guttural replaces a palatal] after the reduplicative syllable [<s>abhyāsa</s>]. || PS_7,3.55 ||
[A guttural replaces] <s>ha</s> [after the <s>abhyāsa</s>], except before <s>caṅ</s> (the causative marker). || PS_7,3.56 ||
[A guttural replaces the palatal] of [the root] <s>ji</s> before <s>san</s> (the desiderative suffix) and <s>liṭ</s> (the perfect). || PS_7,3.57 ||
Optionally [a guttural replaces the palatal] of [the root] <s>ci</s>. || PS_7,3.58 ||
Not [the guttural replacement] for [a root] beginning with <s>kv</s> [i.e., a guttural]. || PS_7,3.59 ||
And [the guttural replacement occurs] for [the roots] <s>aj</s> and <s>vraj</s>. || PS_7,3.60 ||
[The words] <s>bhuja</s> and <s>nyubja</s> [are formed from <s>bhuj</s>] in the senses of protecting [with the hand, <s>pāṇi</s>] and afflicting [<s>upatāpa</s>] respectively. || PS_7,3.61 ||
[The words] <s>prayāja</s> and <s>anuyāja</s> [are formed with the guttural replacement] in the sense of a part of a sacrifice [<s>yajñāṅga</s>]. || PS_7,3.62 ||
[The guttural replacement occurs] for [the root] <s>vañc</s> in the sense of going [<s>gati</s>]. || PS_7,3.63 ||
[The substitute] <s>oka</s> [replaces the root] <s>uc</s> (to be pleased) before [the suffix] <s>ka</s>. || PS_7,3.64 ||
[The suffix] <s>ṇya</s> [is used] in the sense of obligation [<s>āvaśyaka</s>]. || PS_7,3.65 ||
And [<s>ṇya</s> is used after] the roots <s>yaj</s>, <s>yāc</s>, <s>ruc</s>, <s>pravac</s>, and <s>ṛc</s>. || PS_7,3.66 ||
[<s>Ṇya</s> is used after the root] <s>vac</s> when [the derivative] does not [denote] a word or a name [<s>aśabda-asañjñā</s>]. || PS_7,3.67 ||
[The forms] <s>prayojya</s> and <s>niyojya</s> [are formed with <s>ṇya</s>] in the sense of capability [<s>śakyārtha</s>]. || PS_7,3.68 ||
[The form] <s>bhojya</s> [is used with <s>ṇya</s>] in the sense of food [<s>bhakṣya</s>]. || PS_7,3.69 ||
[The substitute] <s>gho</s> [replaces the final of <s>ghas</s>], and there is elision [of the root-final] before <s>leṭ</s> (the Vedic subjunctive), optionally. || PS_7,3.70 ||
[A guttural replaces the palatal of a root ending in] <s>o</s> before <s>śyan</s> (the class 4 <s>vikaraṇa</s>). || PS_7,3.71 ||
[A guttural replaces] <s>kṣa</s> [of a root] before a vowel [<s>ac</s>]. || PS_7,3.72 ||

body.text: lug vā duha-diha-liha-guhām ātmanepade dantye || PS_7,3.73 ||
body.translated_text: <s>Luk</s> (elision) [of <s>śyan</s> occurs] optionally for [the roots] <s>duh</s>, <s>dih</s>, <s>lih</s>, and <s>guh</s> in the <s>ātmanepada</s> (middle voice) before a dental [ending]. || PS_7,3.73 ||
For the eight [roots beginning with] <s>śam</s>, lengthening [of the root vowel occurs] before <s>śyan</s>. || PS_7,3.74 ||
For [the roots] <s>ṣṭhīv</s>, <s>klam</s>, and <s>ācam</s>, [lengthening occurs] before [a suffix marked with] <s>ś</s> [i.e., a <s>sārvadhātuka</s> suffix with <s>śit</s>]. || PS_7,3.75 ||
For [the root] <s>kram</s>, [lengthening occurs] in the <s>parasmaipada</s> (active voice). || PS_7,3.76 ||
For [the roots] <s>iṣ</s>, <s>gam</s>, and <s>yam</s>, [the augment] <s>cha</s> [is inserted, i.e., the substitute <s>cch</s> replaces the root-final]. || PS_7,3.77 ||

For [the roots] <s>pā</s>, <s>ghrā</s>, <s>dhmā</s>, <s>sthā</s>, <s>mnā</s>, <s>dāṇ</s>, <s>dṛś</s>, <s>ṛ</s>, <s>sṛ</s>, <s>śad</s>, and <s>sad</s>, [the substitutes are] <s>piba</s>, <s>jighra</s>, <s>dhama</s>, <s>tiṣṭha</s>, <s>mana</s>, <s>yaccha</s>, <s>paśya</s>, <s>ṛccha</s>, <s>dhāv</s>, <s>śīya</s>, and <s>sīda</s> [respectively]. || PS_7,3.78 ||
For [the roots] <s>jñā</s> and <s>jan</s>, [the substitute is] <s>jā</s>. || PS_7,3.79 ||
For [roots beginning with] <s>pū</s> and others, [the vowel becomes] short [<s>hrasva</s>]. || PS_7,3.80 ||
For [the root] <s>mīnā</s>, [the short vowel occurs] in the Vedic texts [<s>nigama</s>]. || PS_7,3.81 ||
For [the root] <s>mid</s>, <s>guṇa</s> [replaces the root vowel]. || PS_7,3.82 ||
And [<s>guṇa</s> occurs] before <s>jus</s> [the third person plural <s>ātmanepada</s> ending]. || PS_7,3.83 ||
[<s>Guṇa</s> replaces the <s>ik</s> vowel of a root] before <s>sārvadhātuka</s> (general verbal) and <s>ārdhadhātuka</s> (secondary verbal) [suffixes]. || PS_7,3.84 ||
For [the root] <s>jāgṛ</s>, [<s>guṇa</s> does not occur] before [suffixes that are] not <s>vi</s>, <s>ciṇ</s>, <s>ṇal</s>, or <s>ṅit</s>-marked. || PS_7,3.85 ||
And [<s>guṇa</s> occurs for a root] ending in [the augment] <s>puk</s> or having a light penultimate [<s>laghu-upadhā</s>]. || PS_7,3.86 ||

body.text: na abhyastasya aci piti sārvadhātuke || PS_7,3.87 ||
body.translated_text: [<s>Guṇa</s> does] not [occur] for a reduplicated [<s>abhyasta</s>] stem before a vowel [<s>ac</s>] in a <s>pit</s>-marked <s>sārvadhātuka</s> [suffix]. || PS_7,3.87 ||
For [the roots] <s>bhū</s> and <s>su</s>, [<s>guṇa</s> occurs] before a <s>tiṅ</s> (personal verb ending). || PS_7,3.88 ||
For [a root whose vowel is] <s>u</s>, <s>vṛddhi</s> [replaces the vowel] when [there is] <s>luk</s> (elision of the <s>vikaraṇa</s>) before a consonant [<s>hal</s>]. || PS_7,3.89 ||
For [the root] <s>ūrṇu</s>, [<s>vṛddhi</s> occurs] optionally. || PS_7,3.90 ||
<s>Guṇa</s> [replaces the vowel of a root when the suffix is] single-sound [<s>apṛkta</s>, i.e., consisting of a single phoneme]. || PS_7,3.91 ||
For [the root] <s>tṛṇah</s>, [the augment] <s>im</s> [is inserted before the single-sound suffix]. || PS_7,3.92 ||
For [the root] <s>brū</s>, [the augment] <s>īṭ</s> [is inserted before the single-sound suffix]. || PS_7,3.93 ||
[<s>Guṇa</s> occurs] optionally before [the suffix] <s>yaṅ</s> (the intensive/frequentative). || PS_7,3.94 ||
For [the roots] <s>tu</s>, <s>ru</s>, <s>stu</s>, <s>śam</s>, and <s>am</s>, [<s>guṇa</s> occurs] before a <s>sārvadhātuka</s> [suffix]. || PS_7,3.95 ||
For [the roots] <s>as</s> and <s>sic</s>, [<s>guṇa</s> occurs] when [the suffix is] single-sound [<s>apṛkta</s>]. || PS_7,3.96 ||
[This occurs] variously in Vedic [<s>chandas</s>]. || PS_7,3.97 ||
And [<s>guṇa</s> occurs] for [the root] <s>rud</s> before the five [<s>parasmaipada</s> endings beginning with <s>thas</s> etc.]. || PS_7,3.98 ||
[The augment] <s>aṭ</s> [is used, according to] <s>Gārgya</s> and <s>Gālava</s>. || PS_7,3.99 ||
[The root] <s>ad</s> [takes <s>guṇa</s> before single-sound suffixes], for all [grammarians]. || PS_7,3.100 ||
For [a stem ending in] <s>a</s>, lengthening [occurs] before [a suffix beginning with] <s>yañ</s> [i.e., a semivowel or nasal]. || PS_7,3.101 ||
And [lengthening occurs] before a <s>sup</s> (nominal case ending). || PS_7,3.102 ||
In the plural, [lengthening occurs] before [an ending beginning with] <s>jhal</s> or [containing] <s>y</s>. || PS_7,3.103 ||
And [lengthening occurs] before <s>os</s> [the genitive/locative dual ending]. || PS_7,3.104 ||
And [lengthening occurs] before <s>āṅ</s> [the instrumental singular feminine ending] of [a stem ending in] <s>āp</s>. || PS_7,3.105 ||
And [lengthening occurs] in the vocative [<s>sambuddhi</s>]. || PS_7,3.106 ||
[The final vowel of] <s>ambā</s>-denoting [words] and [words ending in] <s>nadī</s> [class stems becomes] short [<s>hrasva</s>] [in the vocative]. || PS_7,3.107 ||
<s>Guṇa</s> [replaces] the short [vowel, i.e., the <s>ik</s> vowel of a stem before <s>sup</s> endings]. || PS_7,3.108 ||
And [<s>guṇa</s> occurs] before <s>jas</s> [the nominative plural ending]. || PS_7,3.109 ||
For [a stem ending in] <s>ṛ</s>, [<s>guṇa</s> occurs] before <s>ṅi</s> (locative singular) and the <s>sarvanāmasthāna</s> (strong case) endings. || PS_7,3.110 ||
For [stems called] <s>ghi</s>, [<s>guṇa</s> occurs] before a <s>ṅit</s>-marked [suffix]. || PS_7,3.111 ||
[The substitute] <s>āṇ</s> [replaces the case ending] of a <s>nadī</s>-class [stem]. || PS_7,3.112 ||
[The substitute] <s>yāṭ</s> [replaces the case ending] of [a stem ending in] <s>āp</s>. || PS_7,3.113 ||
For a <s>sarvanāman</s> (pronoun), [the substitute is] <s>syāṭ</s>, and [the final vowel becomes] short. || PS_7,3.114 ||
Optionally [<s>syāṭ</s> occurs] after the second (accusative) and third (instrumental) [case endings]. || PS_7,3.115 ||
[The substitute] <s>ām</s> [replaces] <s>ṅer</s> (the genitive singular ending) after <s>nadī</s>, <s>ām</s> [stems], and <s>nī</s>-ending [stems]. || PS_7,3.116 ||
[<s>Ām</s> replaces <s>ṅer</s>] after [stems ending in] <s>i</s> and <s>u</s>. || PS_7,3.117 ||
[The substitute is] <s>aut</s> [for the genitive singular ending after certain stems]. || PS_7,3.118 ||
And [the substitute] <s>ac</s> [replaces the case ending] of [stems called] <s>ghi</s>. || PS_7,3.119 ||
[The substitute] <s>nā</s> [replaces] <s>āṅ</s> (the instrumental singular ending), except in the feminine. || PS_7,3.120 ||
Before <s>ṇau</s> (the causative suffix) and <s>caṅ</s>, [the vowel of] the penultimate [<s>upadhā</s>] becomes short [<s>hrasva</s>]. || PS_7,4.1 ||
Not [shortening occurs] for [roots that undergo] <s>aglopa</s> (non-elision of <s>a</s>), [the root] <s>śās</s>, and [roots marked as] <s>ṛdit</s>. || PS_7,4.2 ||
For [the roots] <s>bhrāj</s>, <s>bhās</s>, <s>bhāṣ</s>, <s>dīp</s>, <s>jīv</s>, <s>mīl</s>, and <s>pīḍ</s>, [shortening occurs] optionally. || PS_7,4.3 ||
There is elision [of the root <s>pā</s>, replaced by] <s>piba</s>, and [the substitute] <s>ī</s> [replaces the vowel] of the reduplicative syllable [<s>abhyāsa</s>]. || PS_7,4.4 ||
For [the substitute] <s>tiṣṭha</s> [replacing <s>sthā</s>], [the reduplicative syllable gets the augment] <s>it</s>. || PS_7,4.5 ||
For [the substitute] <s>jighra</s> [replacing <s>ghrā</s>], [this occurs] optionally. || PS_7,4.6 ||
<s>Ur</s> [replaces] <s>ṛ</s> [in the reduplicative syllable]. || PS_7,4.7 ||
Always [<s>ur</s> replaces <s>ṛ</s>] in Vedic [<s>chandas</s>]. || PS_7,4.8 ||
For [the root] <s>day</s>, [the substitute] <s>di</s> [replaces the root] in <s>liṭ</s> (the perfect tense) [when referring to cutting]. || PS_7,4.9 ||
And <s>guṇa</s> [replaces the vowel] of <s>ṛ</s> [in the reduplicative syllable] when [the root begins with] a consonant cluster [<s>saṃyoga</s>]. || PS_7,4.10 ||
[<s>Guṇa</s> occurs] for [the root] <s>ṛcch</s>, [the root] <s>ṛ</s>, and [stems ending in] <s>ṛ</s>. || PS_7,4.11 ||
For [the roots] <s>śṝ</s>, <s>dṝ</s>, and <s>prā</s>, [the vowel of the <s>abhyāsa</s> becomes] short, optionally. || PS_7,4.12 ||
Before <s>ka</s> [suffix], [this occurs for roots] other than those marked with <s>ṇ</s>. || PS_7,4.13 ||
Not [<s>guṇa</s> of the <s>abhyāsa</s>] before [a suffix containing] <s>ka</s> followed by <s>p</s>. || PS_7,4.14 ||
After [a stem ending in] <s>a</s> [marked with <s>ap</s>], [this occurs] optionally. || PS_7,4.15 ||
For [the roots] <s>ṛ</s> and <s>dṛś</s>, <s>guṇa</s> [replaces the vowel] before <s>aṅi</s> [i.e., before a suffix beginning with a vowel other than <s>a</s>]. || PS_7,4.16 ||
For [the root] <s>as</s> [in the <s>ātmanepada</s> form <s>asyate</s>], [the augment] <s>thuk</s> [is inserted]. || PS_7,4.17 ||
For [the root] <s>śvi</s> [to swell], [the substitute is] <s>a</s>. || PS_7,4.18 ||
For [the root] <s>pat</s>, [the augment] <s>pum</s> [is inserted in the causative]. || PS_7,4.19 ||
For [the root] <s>vac</s>, [the augment] <s>um</s> [is inserted in the causative]. || PS_7,4.20 ||
For [the root] <s>śīṅ</s> (to lie down), <s>guṇa</s> [replaces the vowel] before a <s>sārvadhātuka</s> [suffix]. || PS_7,4.21 ||

[The substitute] <s>ay</s> [replaces the <s>ī</s> of <s>śīṅ</s>] before [a suffix beginning with] <s>y</s>, when [the suffix is] <s>kṅit</s>-marked [i.e., marked with <s>k</s> or <s>ṅ</s>]. || PS_7,4.22 ||
After a prefix [<s>upasarga</s>], [the vowel of] <s>ūh</s> [becomes] short. || PS_7,4.23 ||
For [the root] <s>e</s> (to come), [shortening occurs] in <s>liṅ</s> [the optative]. || PS_7,4.24 ||
Lengthening [of the <s>ik</s> vowel of a root occurs] before [a suffix that is] not a <s>kṛt</s> and not a <s>sārvadhātuka</s>. || PS_7,4.25 ||
And [lengthening occurs] before the <s>cvi</s> [suffix, i.e., in a denominative formation]. || PS_7,4.26 ||
<s>Rīṅ</s> [replaces] <s>ṛ</s> [of a root before certain suffixes]. || PS_7,4.27 ||
<s>Riṅ</s> [replaces <s>ṛ</s> of a root] before <s>śaya</s> (the passive <s>vikaraṇa</s>), <s>liṅ</s> (the optative), and <s>kṣu</s>-group [suffixes]. || PS_7,4.28 ||
<s>Guṇa</s> [replaces] <s>ṛ</s> after [the roots ending in] <s>ṛ</s> and after a consonant cluster [<s>saṃyoga</s>], before [the suffixes] <s>y</s> [and similar]. || PS_7,4.29 ||
And [<s>guṇa</s> replaces <s>ṛ</s>] before <s>yaṅ</s> (the intensive suffix). || PS_7,4.30 ||
[The substitute] <s>ī</s> [replaces the final vowel] of [the roots] <s>ghrā</s> and <s>dhmo</s> [before certain suffixes]. || PS_7,4.31 ||
For [the pronoun] <s>asya</s> [i.e., the stem <s>a</s>], [the substitute occurs] before <s>cvi</s>. || PS_7,4.32 ||
And [the same occurs] before <s>kyac</s> [the denominative suffix]. || PS_7,4.33 ||

[The desiderative forms] <s>aśanāya</s> (desire to eat), <s>udanya</s> (desire for water), and <s>dhānāya</s> [are used in the senses of] hunger [<s>bubhukṣā</s>], thirst [<s>pipāsā</s>], and greed [<s>gardha</s>] respectively. || PS_7,4.34 ||
Not [this replacement occurs] in Vedic [<s>chandas</s>] for [the word] <s>aputrasya</s> (of one without a son). || PS_7,4.35 ||
[The special denominative forms] <s>durasyati</s>, <s>draviṇasyati</s>, <s>vṛṣaṇyati</s>, and <s>riṣaṇyati</s> [are listed as irregular formations]. || PS_7,4.36 ||
For [the words] <s>aśva</s> (horse) and <s>agha</s> (evil), [the final vowel is replaced by] <s>ā</s> [before <s>kyac</s>]. || PS_7,4.37 ||
For [the words] <s>deva</s> and <s>sumna</s>, [the substitution occurs] in the <s>Yajurveda</s>, [specifically] the <s>Kāṭhaka</s> [recension]. || PS_7,4.38 ||
For [the words] <s>kavi</s>, <s>adhvara</s>, and <s>pṛtanā</s>, there is elision [of the final vowel] in the <s>Ṛgveda</s> [<s>ṛc</s>]. || PS_7,4.39 ||
For [the roots] <s>dyut</s>, <s>syat</s>, <s>mā</s>, and <s>sthā</s>, [the augment] <s>it</s> [replaces the root's portion] before a <s>kit</s>-marked [suffix]. || PS_7,4.40 ||
For [the roots] <s>śā</s> and <s>cho</s>, [this occurs] optionally. || PS_7,4.41 ||
For [the root] <s>dadhā</s> [i.e., <s>dhā</s> in its reduplicated form], [the substitute is] <s>hi</s> [before <s>kit</s>-marked suffixes]. || PS_7,4.42 ||
And for [the root] <s>jahā</s> [i.e., <s>hā</s> in its reduplicated form, the substitute <s>hi</s> occurs] before <s>ktvā</s> [the absolutive suffix <s>ktvi</s>]. || PS_7,4.43 ||
Optionally in Vedic [<s>chandas</s>]. || PS_7,4.44 ||
And [the following Vedic forms are established:] <s>sudhita</s>, <s>vasudhita</s>, <s>nemadhita</s>, <s>dhiṣva</s>, and <s>dhiṣīya</s>. || PS_7,4.45 ||
[The substitute] <s>dad</s> [replaces] <s>do</s> [i.e., the root <s>dā</s>] before <s>gho</s>-group [suffixes]. || PS_7,4.46 ||
After a prefix [<s>upasarga</s>], [the root <s>dā</s> is replaced by] <s>ac</s> before <s>ta</s> [the past participle suffix]. || PS_7,4.47 ||
[The root <s>dā</s> is replaced by] <s>ap</s> before <s>bhi</s> [instrumental/dative/ablative plural ending]. || PS_7,4.48 ||
<s>Sa</s> [replaces] <s>sy</s> [of the future suffix] in an <s>ārdhadhātuka</s> [context]. || PS_7,4.49 ||
For [the roots] <s>tās</s> and <s>as</s>, there is elision [of the root-final <s>s</s> before <s>sy</s>]. || PS_7,4.50 ||
And [elision occurs before] <s>ri</s> [i.e., the <s>lṛṭ</s> marker]. || PS_7,4.51 ||
<s>Ha</s> [replaces the root <s>as</s>] before <s>eti</s> [i.e., before the ending beginning with <s>e</s>]. || PS_7,4.52 ||
[The substitutes] <s>yi</s> and <s>ivarṇa</s> (an <s>i</s>-vowel) [replace the root vowel] of [the roots] <s>dīdhī</s> and <s>vevī</s>. || PS_7,4.53 ||

Before <s>san</s> (the desiderative suffix), for [the roots] <s>mī</s>, <s>mā</s>, <s>ghu</s>-group, <s>rabh</s>, <s>labh</s>, <s>śak</s>, <s>pat</s>, and <s>pad</s>, [the substitute] <s>is</s> [replaces] the vowel [<s>ac</s>]. || PS_7,4.54 ||
For [the roots] <s>āp</s>, <s>jñap</s>, and <s>ṛdh</s>, [the augment] <s>īṭ</s> [is inserted before <s>san</s>]. || PS_7,4.55 ||
For [the root] <s>dambh</s>, [the augment] <s>ic</s> [is inserted], and [<s>is</s> also replaces the vowel]. || PS_7,4.56 ||
For [the root] <s>muc</s> when intransitive [<s>akarmaka</s>], <s>guṇa</s> [occurs] optionally [before <s>san</s>]. || PS_7,4.57 ||
In this [context, i.e., in reduplication], there is elision of the reduplicative syllable [<s>abhyāsa</s>]. || PS_7,4.58 ||
[The vowel of the <s>abhyāsa</s> becomes] short [<s>hrasva</s>]. || PS_7,4.59 ||
[Only] the initial consonant [<s>halādi</s>] remains [in the <s>abhyāsa</s>]. || PS_7,4.60 ||
[Among initial consonants, only] the <s>śar</s>-group sounds precede the stops [<s>khay</s>, i.e., a sibilant may be retained before a stop in the <s>abhyāsa</s>]. || PS_7,4.61 ||
[A consonant of the] <s>cu</s>-class [replaces one of the] <s>ku</s>-class and <s>h</s> [in the <s>abhyāsa</s>]. || PS_7,4.62 ||
Not [the <s>cu</s>-replacement] for [the root] <s>kav</s> before <s>yaṅ</s> (the intensive suffix). || PS_7,4.63 ||
For [the root] <s>kṛṣ</s>, [this occurs] in Vedic [<s>chandas</s>]. || PS_7,4.64 ||

[The following irregular Vedic reduplicated forms are recognized:] <s>dādharti</s>, <s>dardharti</s>, <s>dardharṣi</s>, <s>bobhūtu</s>, <s>tetikte</s>, <s>alarṣi</s>, <s>āpanīphaṇat</s>, <s>saṃsaniṣyadat</s>, <s>karikrat</s>, <s>kanikradat</s>, <s>bharibhrat</s>, <s>davidhvataḥ</s>, <s>davidyutat</s>, <s>taritrataḥ</s>, <s>sarīsṛpatam</s>, <s>varīvṛjan</s>, <s>marmṛjya</s>, and <s>āganīganti</s>. || PS_7,4.65 ||
[The vowel] <s>u</s> [replaces <s>ṛ</s> in the <s>abhyāsa</s>] before <s>rat</s> [i.e., when <s>r</s> follows]. || PS_7,4.66 ||
<s>Samprasāraṇa</s> (semivowel-to-vowel replacement) [occurs in the <s>abhyāsa</s>] of [the roots] <s>dyut</s> and <s>svāp</s>. || PS_7,4.67 ||
For [the root] <s>vyath</s>, [<s>samprasāraṇa</s> occurs] in <s>liṭ</s> (the perfect tense). || PS_7,4.68 ||
Lengthening [of the vowel occurs in the <s>abhyāsa</s>] of [the root] <s>iṇ</s> (to go) before a <s>kit</s>-marked [suffix]. || PS_7,4.69 ||
[The substitute] <s>a</s> [replaces] the initial [vowel of the <s>abhyāsa</s>]. || PS_7,4.70 ||
After that [<s>a</s>], [the augment] <s>nuṭ</s> [is inserted when the root has] two consonants [<s>dvihal</s>]. || PS_7,4.71 ||
And [<s>nuṭ</s> is inserted] for [the root] <s>aśno</s> [i.e., <s>aś</s>, to eat]. || PS_7,4.72 ||
For [the root] <s>bhū</s>, [the substitute of the <s>abhyāsa</s> is] <s>a</s>. || PS_7,4.73 ||
[The form] <s>sasūva</s> [is found] in the Vedic texts [<s>nigama</s>]. || PS_7,4.74 ||
For the three [roots taking] <s>ṇij</s> (the causative suffix), <s>guṇa</s> [replaces the vowel] in <s>ślu</s> [i.e., when there is <s>ślu</s>-elision of the <s>vikaraṇa</s>]. || PS_7,4.75 ||
For [the root] <s>bhṛñ</s>, [the augment] <s>am</s> [is inserted, making the form <s>amit</s>]. || PS_7,4.76 ||
And for [the roots] <s>ṛ</s> and <s>pipart</s> [i.e., the reduplicated form of <s>pṛ</s>, <s>guṇa</s> occurs in <s>ślu</s>]. || PS_7,4.77 ||
[This occurs] variously in Vedic [<s>chandas</s>]. || PS_7,4.78 ||
[The above rules apply] for [roots] with the <s>san</s> [desiderative suffix] also [i.e., <s>sanyataḥ</s> means 'starting from <s>san</s>']. || PS_7,4.79 ||
[The <s>u</s>] of <s>o</s> [is replaced by] <s>pu</s>, <s>yaṇ</s>, <s>jya</s>, and <s>apara</s> [in the respective reduplicated forms]. || PS_7,4.80 ||
Optionally [<s>guṇa</s> occurs] in [the roots] <s>stru</s> (to flow), <s>śṛ</s> (to hear), <s>dru</s> (to run), <s>pru</s> (to go), <s>plu</s> (to float), and <s>cyu</s> (to move). || PS 7.4.81 ||
<s>Guṇa</s> (vowel-strengthening) [occurs] in <s>yaṅ</s> (intensive) and <s>yaṅluk</s> (elided intensive). || PS 7.4.82 ||
[The vowel becomes] long when [the suffix] is not marked with <s>kit</s>. || PS 7.4.83 ||

[The augment] <s>nīk</s> [is inserted] in [the roots] <s>vañcu</s> (to go crookedly), <s>sraṃsu</s> (to fall), <s>dhvaṃsu</s> (to scatter), <s>bhraṃsu</s> (to fall), <s>kasa</s> (to go), <s>pata</s> (to fall), <s>pada</s> (to go), and <s>skanda</s> (to leap). || PS 7.4.84 ||
[The augment] <s>nuk</s> [is inserted] after <s>a</s> [of a root] ending in a nasal (<s>anunāsikānta</s>). || PS 7.4.85 ||

And [<s>nuk</s> is inserted] in [the roots] <s>jap</s> (to mutter), <s>jabh</s> (to yawn), <s>dah</s> (to burn), <s>daś</s> (to bite), <s>bhañj</s> (to break), and <s>paś</s> (to see). || PS 7.4.86 ||
And [<s>nuk</s> is inserted] in [the roots] <s>car</s> (to move) and <s>phal</s> (to burst). || PS 7.4.87 ||
[The vowel] <s>u</s> [replaces the] <s>a</s> of the subsequent [<s>abhyāsa</s>]. || PS 7.4.88 ||
And [the vowel becomes] <s>ti</s>. || PS 7.4.89 ||
[The augment] <s>rīk</s> [is inserted after a root] having <s>ṛ</s> as its penultimate (<s>ṛdupadhā</s>) also. || PS 7.4.90 ||
And [the augments] <s>ruk</s> and <s>rik</s> [are inserted] when <s>luk</s> (elision of <s>yaṅ</s>) has occurred. || PS 7.4.91 ||
And [this occurs] after <s>ṛ</s> [of the root]. || PS 7.4.92 ||
In <s>san</s> (desiderative) and <s>val</s> [suffixes], when the [root is] light (<s>laghu</s>) and <s>caṅ</s> follows, [there is] <s>anag</s> [augment] when elision [has occurred]. || PS 7.4.93 ||
[The vowel of the <s>abhyāsa</s> becomes] long when the [root is] light (<s>laghu</s>). || PS 7.4.94 ||

[The vowel] <s>a</s> [replaces the vowel in the <s>abhyāsa</s> of the roots] <s>smṛ</s> (to remember), <s>dṝ</s> (to tear), <s>tvar</s> (to hasten), <s>prath</s> (to spread), <s>mrad</s> (to soften), <s>stṝ</s> (to spread), and <s>spaś</s> (to see). || PS 7.4.95 ||
Optionally [<s>a</s> replaces the vowel] in [the roots] <s>veṣṭ</s> (to wrap) and <s>ceṣṭ</s> (to act). || PS 7.4.96 ||
And [the vowel] <s>ī</s> [replaces the vowel in the <s>abhyāsa</s> of the same roots as] a group. || PS 7.4.97 ||
Every [word can have] a doubling (<s>dve</s>). || PS 8.1.1 ||
The subsequent [portion of the doubled expression] is called <s>āmreḍita</s> (iteration). || PS 8.1.2 ||
And [the <s>āmreḍita</s> portion is] <s>anudātta</s> (grave-accented). || PS 8.1.3 ||
[Doubling occurs] in the senses of invariability (<s>nitya</s>) and distribution (<s>vīpsā</s>). || PS 8.1.4 ||
[Doubling occurs] after <s>pari</s> in the sense of exclusion (<s>varjana</s>). || PS 8.1.5 ||
[Doubling occurs] after <s>pra</s>, <s>sam</s>, <s>upa</s>, and <s>ud</s> in the sense of metrical padding (<s>pādapūraṇa</s>). || PS 8.1.6 ||
[Doubling occurs] after <s>upari</s> (above), <s>adhi</s> (over), and <s>adhas</s> (below) in the sense of proximity (<s>sāmīpya</s>). || PS 8.1.7 ||

[Doubling occurs] for a vocative (<s>āmantrita</s>) at the beginning of a sentence in the senses of reproach (<s>asūyā</s>), approval (<s>sammati</s>), anger (<s>kopa</s>), contempt (<s>kutsana</s>), and threat (<s>bhartsana</s>). || PS 8.1.8 ||
The first [occurrence is treated] like a <s>bahuvrīhi</s> compound. || PS 8.1.9 ||
And [doubling occurs] in the sense of insistence (<s>ābādha</s>). || PS 8.1.10 ||
[The first occurrence is treated] like a <s>karmadhāraya</s> compound in the subsequent [instances]. || PS 8.1.11 ||
[Doubling occurs] for a quality-denoting word (<s>guṇavacana</s>) in the sense of manner (<s>prakāra</s>). || PS 8.1.12 ||
[Doubling occurs] after <s>priya</s> (dear) and <s>sukha</s> (pleasant) optionally, when no difficulty (<s>akṛcchra</s>) [is implied]. || PS 8.1.13 ||
[The expression] <s>yathāyatham</s> [is formed] in the sense of 'each according to its own' (<s>yathāsva</s>). || PS 8.1.14 ||

[A word is treated] as a <s>dvandva</s> compound [when denoting] secret counsel (<s>rahasya</s>), boundary-statement (<s>maryādāvacana</s>), transgression (<s>vyutkramaṇa</s>), sacrificial vessel usage (<s>yajñapātraprayoga</s>), and manifestation (<s>abhivyakti</s>). || PS 8.1.15 ||
[The following rules concern operations on] a <s>pada</s> (word-form). || PS 8.1.16 ||
[The following rules apply] after a <s>pada</s> (word-form). || PS 8.1.17 ||
Everything [that is] not at the beginning of a <s>pāda</s> (verse-quarter) [is] <s>anudātta</s> (grave-accented). || PS 8.1.18 ||
And [<s>anudātta</s> applies to] a vocative (<s>āmantrita</s>). || PS 8.1.19 ||
[The replacements] <s>vām</s> and <s>nau</s> [are applied] for <s>yuṣmad</s> (you) and <s>asmad</s> (I/we) in the sixth, fourth, and second cases. || PS 8.1.20 ||
[The replacements] <s>vas</s> and <s>nas</s> [are applied] in the plural (<s>bahuvacana</s>). || PS 8.1.21 ||
[The replacements] <s>te</s> and <s>me</s> [are applied] in the singular (<s>ekavacana</s>). || PS 8.1.22 ||
[The replacements] <s>tvā</s> and <s>mā</s> [are applied] in the second case (<s>dvitīyā</s>). || PS 8.1.23 ||
Not [when] conjoined with <s>ca</s> (and), <s>vā</s> (or), <s>ha</s>, <s>aha</s>, or <s>eva</s>. || PS 8.1.24 ||
And [not when conjoined] with verbs meaning 'to see' (<s>paśyārtha</s>) when not in the sense of looking at (<s>anālocana</s>). || PS 8.1.25 ||
Optionally [the replacement occurs] for the nominative (<s>prathamā</s>) when preceded by <s>sa</s> (that). || PS 8.1.26 ||
[The verbal endings] <s>tiṅ</s> [are replaced] by <s>gotra</s>-names and others in the senses of contempt (<s>kutsana</s>) and repetition (<s>ābhīkṣṇya</s>). || PS 8.1.27 ||
[The verbal ending] <s>tiṅ</s> [comes] after a non-<s>tiṅ</s> [word]. || PS 8.1.28 ||
Not [the verbal ending of] <s>luṭ</s> (periphrastic future). || PS 8.1.29 ||

[<s>Anudātta</s> occurs] with the particles (<s>nipāta</s>): <s>yat</s>, <s>yadi</s>, <s>hanta</s>, <s>kuvin</s>, <s>net</s>, <s>cet</s>, <s>caṇ</s>, <s>kaccit</s>, and <s>yatra</s> combined [with <s>tiṅ</s>]. || PS 8.1.30 ||
[<s>Anudātta</s> occurs with] <s>naha</s> in the sense of beginning (<s>pratyārambha</s>). || PS 8.1.31 ||
[<s>Anudātta</s> occurs with] <s>satyam</s> in a question (<s>praśna</s>). || PS 8.1.32 ||
[<s>Anudātta</s> occurs with the particle] <s>aṅga</s> when not going against the natural order (<s>aprātilomya</s>). || PS 8.1.33 ||
And [<s>anudātta</s> occurs with the particle] <s>hi</s>. || PS 8.1.34 ||
In Vedic literature (<s>chandas</s>), even more than one [<s>tiṅ</s>-form] is [made <s>anudātta</s>] when there is syntactic expectancy (<s>sākāṅkṣa</s>). || PS 8.1.35 ||
[<s>Anudātta</s> occurs] after <s>yāvat</s> (as long as) and <s>yathā</s> (as). || PS 8.1.36 ||
[<s>Anudātta</s> does] not [occur] immediately after [a word denoting] veneration (<s>pūjā</s>). || PS 8.1.37 ||
And [<s>anudātta</s> occurs when a <s>tiṅ</s>-form is] separated from a preverb (<s>upasarga</s>). || PS 8.1.38 ||
[<s>Anudātta</s> occurs] with <s>tu</s>, <s>paśya-paśyata</s>, and <s>ahai</s> in the sense of veneration (<s>pūjā</s>). || PS 8.1.39 ||
And [<s>anudātta</s> occurs] with <s>aho</s>. || PS 8.1.40 ||
In the remaining [cases, <s>anudātta</s> occurs] optionally. || PS 8.1.41 ||
And [<s>anudātta</s> occurs] with <s>purā</s> (before) in the sense of anxiety (<s>parīpsā</s>). || PS 8.1.42 ||
[<s>Anudātta</s> occurs] with <s>nanu</s> (is it not) in the sense of permission (<s>anujñā</s>) and solicitation (<s>eṣaṇā</s>). || PS 8.1.43 ||

[<s>Anudātta</s> occurs] with <s>kim</s> in a question about action (<s>kriyāpraśna</s>), [when the verb is] without a preverb (<s>anupasarga</s>) and not prohibited (<s>apratiṣiddha</s>). || PS 8.1.44 ||
Optionally [<s>anudātta</s> occurs] when [a particle is] elided (<s>lopa</s>). || PS 8.1.45 ||
[<s>Anudātta</s> occurs] with <s>ehi</s> (come) and <s>manye</s> (I think) in jest (<s>prahāsa</s>), and [the verb takes] <s>lṛṭ</s> (simple future). || PS 8.1.46 ||
[<s>Anudātta</s> occurs with] <s>jātu</s> (ever) [when denoting] 'never before' (<s>apūrvam</s>). || PS 8.1.47 ||
And [<s>anudātta</s> occurs with] <s>kiṃvṛttam</s> (what happened) when followed by <s>cit</s>. || PS 8.1.48 ||
[<s>Anudātta</s> occurs with] <s>āho</s> (or indeed) and <s>utāho</s> (or rather) immediately [before the verb]. || PS 8.1.49 ||
In the remaining [cases, <s>anudātta</s> occurs] optionally. || PS 8.1.50 ||

body.text: gatyartha-loṭā lṛṇ na cet kārakaṃ sarvānyat || PS_8,1.51 ||
body.translated_text: [<s>Anudātta</s> occurs when a] <s>loṭ</s> (imperative) [is used] with a verb of motion (<s>gatyartha</s>), and <s>lṛṇ</s> [replaces it], unless the <s>kāraka</s> (case-relation) is entirely different (<s>sarvānyat</s>). || PS 8.1.51 ||
And [<s>anudātta</s> occurs with] <s>loṭ</s> (imperative). || PS 8.1.52 ||
[This <s>anudātta</s> rule is] optional (<s>vibhāṣita</s>) when [the verb] has a preverb (<s>sopasarga</s>) and is not in the second person (<s>anuttama</s>). || PS 8.1.53 ||
And [<s>anudātta</s> occurs with] <s>hanta</s> (come on). || PS 8.1.54 ||

[The particle] <s>āma</s> (yes) [makes the following word <s>anudātta</s> when] the vocative (<s>āmantrita</s>) intervenes by one [word], and not when [addressed to someone] nearby (<s>anantika</s>). || PS 8.1.55 ||
[<s>Anudātta</s> occurs] after <s>yat</s> (which), <s>hi</s> (for), and <s>tu</s> (but) in Vedic literature (<s>chandas</s>). || PS 8.1.56 ||

[<s>Anudātta</s> does not occur] in [connection with] <s>cana</s>, <s>cit</s>, <s>iva</s>, <s>gotra</s>-names and others, <s>taddhita</s> [derivatives], and <s>āmreḍita</s> (iterations), [but only when the particle] is not <s>gati</s>. || PS 8.1.57 ||
And [<s>anudātta</s> does not occur] in the <s>cādi</s> group [of particles]. || PS 8.1.58 ||
[The] nominative (<s>prathamā</s>) [is used when conjoined] with <s>ca</s> (and) or <s>vā</s> (or). || PS 8.1.59 ||
[The particle] <s>he</s> [is used] in the sense of destruction (<s>kṣiyā</s>). || PS 8.1.60 ||
And [the particle] <s>aha</s> [is used] in allocation (<s>viniyoga</s>). || PS 8.1.61 ||
And [the particles] <s>ca</s>, <s>aha</s>, [with] elision, and <s>eva</s> [are used] in the sense of restriction (<s>avadhāraṇa</s>). || PS 8.1.62 ||
Optionally [<s>anudātta</s> occurs] when <s>ca</s> and others are elided. || PS 8.1.63 ||
And [<s>anudātta</s> occurs] with <s>vai</s> and <s>vāva</s> in Vedic literature (<s>chandas</s>). || PS 8.1.64 ||
[<s>Anudātta</s> occurs] after one [word] from among two capable [words] (<s>samarthābhyām</s>). || PS 8.1.65 ||
[<s>Anudātta</s> occurs] invariably [for a <s>tiṅ</s>-form] that follows a relative clause (<s>yadvṛtta</s>). || PS 8.1.66 ||
[A word] venerated (<s>pūjita</s>) through veneration (<s>pūjana</s>) [is] <s>anudātta</s>, after <s>Kāṣṭha</s> and others. || PS 8.1.67 ||
Even a <s>tiṅ</s> (verbal ending) accompanied by a preverb (<s>sagati</s>) [is made <s>anudātta</s>]. || PS 8.1.68 ||
And [<s>anudātta</s> occurs] in the sense of contempt (<s>kutsana</s>), with a <s>sup</s> (nominal ending), [when it is] not a <s>gotra</s>-name and the like. || PS 8.1.69 ||
A preverb (<s>gati</s>) [is <s>anudātta</s>] in connection with [another] preverb (<s>gati</s>). || PS 8.1.70 ||
And [<s>anudātta</s> occurs] when a <s>tiṅ</s> [form] bearing <s>udātta</s> (acute accent) [follows]. || PS 8.1.71 ||
A vocative (<s>āmantrita</s>) that precedes [is treated] as if non-existent (<s>avidyamānavat</s>). || PS 8.1.72 ||
A general term (<s>sāmānyavacana</s>) [is] not [treated as non-existent] when it is in the same syntactic relation (<s>samānādhikaraṇa</s>) as the vocative (<s>āmantrita</s>). || PS 8.1.73 ||
[The treatment as non-existent is] optional (<s>vibhāṣita</s>) for a specifying word (<s>viśeṣavacana</s>) in the plural (<s>bahuvacana</s>). || PS 8.1.74 ||
[Rules taught] earlier are [treated as] not yet having taken effect (<s>asiddha</s>) with respect to [rules taught] later. || PS 8.2.1 ||

[The elision of] <s>n</s> (<s>nalopa</s>) [is treated as <s>asiddha</s>] in operations concerning <s>sup</s> (nominal endings), accent (<s>svara</s>), technical names (<s>sañjñā</s>), <s>tuk</s> (augment), and rules applying in <s>kṛt</s> [suffixes]. || PS 8.2.2 ||
Not [<s>asiddha</s> for the sound] <s>mu</s> or <s>ne</s>. || PS 8.2.3 ||

[When a sound follows an] <s>udātta</s> (acute) or <s>svarita</s> (circumflex), [the] <s>yaṇ</s> [semivowel replacement] of an <s>anudātta</s> (grave) [vowel takes] <s>svarita</s> (circumflex accent). || PS 8.2.4 ||
A single substitute (<s>ekādeśa</s>) [is] <s>udātta</s> (acute) when [replacing a segment that includes] an <s>udātta</s> [vowel]. || PS 8.2.5 ||
Optionally [the single substitute is] <s>svarita</s> (circumflex) [when replacing] an <s>anudātta</s> (grave) [vowel] at the beginning of a <s>pada</s> (word). || PS 8.2.6 ||
[The] <s>n</s>-elision (<s>nalopa</s>) [occurs for the <s>n</s>] at the end of a nominal stem (<s>prātipadikānta</s>). || PS 8.2.7 ||
Not in [the case of the endings] <s>ṅi</s> (locative singular) and <s>sambuddhi</s> (vocative singular). || PS 8.2.8 ||
And [the consonant] <s>v</s> [replaces] <s>m</s> of the penultimate (<s>upadhā</s>) of <s>mat</s> [suffixes], [but] not after <s>Ayava</s> and others. || PS 8.2.9 ||
[<s>V</s> replaces <s>m</s>] of [a stem ending in a] <s>jhay</s> (stop) consonant. || PS 8.2.10 ||
[This replacement occurs] in a proper name (<s>sañjñā</s>). || PS 8.2.11 ||
[Fixed forms with <s>v</s> for <s>m</s>:] <s>āsandīvat</s>, <s>aṣṭhīvat</s>, <s>cakrīvat</s>, <s>kakṣīvat</s>, <s>rumaṇvat</s>, and <s>carmaṇvatī</s>. || PS 8.2.12 ||
[The form] <s>udanvān</s> [is used] in the sense of 'ocean' (<s>udadhi</s>) also. || PS 8.2.13 ||
[The form] <s>rājanvān</s> [is used] in the sense of 'good kingship' (<s>saurājya</s>). || PS 8.2.14 ||
[The form with] <s>ira</s> [is used] in Vedic literature (<s>chandas</s>). || PS 8.2.15 ||
[The augment] <s>nuṭ</s> [is added] after <s>an</s>. || PS 8.2.16 ||
[The augment] <s>nāṭ</s> [is added after] <s>gha</s> [of the root <s>han</s>]. || PS 8.2.17 ||
[The sound] <s>r</s> of [the root] <s>kḷp</s> (to be fit) [is replaced by] <s>l</s>. || PS 8.2.18 ||
[The <s>r</s> of] a preverb (<s>upasarga</s>) [is replaced by <s>l</s>] when not before <s>a</s> [of the root]. || PS 8.2.19 ||
[The <s>r</s> is replaced by <s>l</s> in the root] <s>gṛ</s> (to swallow) in <s>yaṅ</s> (intensive). || PS 8.2.20 ||
Optionally [<s>r</s> is replaced by <s>l</s>] before a vowel (<s>ac</s>). || PS 8.2.21 ||
And [<s>r</s> is replaced by <s>l</s> in the root] <s>pari</s> in connection with <s>gha</s> (killing) and <s>aṅka</s> (marking). || PS 8.2.22 ||
[There is] elision (<s>lopa</s>) of the final [consonant] of a consonant cluster (<s>saṃyogānta</s>). || PS 8.2.23 ||
[The sound] <s>s</s> [is elided] after <s>r</s>. || PS 8.2.24 ||
And [<s>s</s> is elided] after <s>dhi</s> (imperative ending). || PS 8.2.25 ||
[A stop consonant from the] <s>jhal</s> [class is elided] before [another] <s>jhal</s> [consonant]. || PS 8.2.26 ||
[This elision occurs] after a short [vowel of] the stem (<s>aṅga</s>). || PS 8.2.27 ||
[The augment] <s>iṭ</s> [is inserted] before [the ending] <s>īṭ</s>. || PS 8.2.28 ||
[The sounds] <s>s</s> and <s>k</s> [are elided] at the beginning of a consonant cluster (<s>saṃyogādi</s>) and at the end [of a word]. || PS 8.2.29 ||
[The palatal] <s>c</s> [is replaced by the corresponding] velar <s>ku</s> [consonant]. || PS 8.2.30 ||
[The consonant] <s>h</s> [is replaced by] <s>ḍha</s>. || PS 8.2.31 ||
[The consonant] <s>gh</s> [replaces <s>h</s> of a root] belonging to the <s>Dādi</s> group. || PS 8.2.32 ||
Optionally [<s>gh</s> replaces <s>h</s>] in [the roots] <s>druh</s> (to hate), <s>muh</s> (to be deluded), <s>ṣṇuh</s> (to vomit), and <s>ṣṇih</s> (to be affectionate). || PS 8.2.33 ||
[The consonant] <s>dh</s> [replaces] <s>h</s> of [the root] <s>nah</s> (to bind). || PS 8.2.34 ||
[The consonant] <s>th</s> [replaces <s>h</s>] in [the root] <s>āh</s> (to say). || PS 8.2.35 ||

[The consonant] <s>ṣ</s> [replaces the final consonant] of [the roots] <s>vraśc</s> (to cut), <s>bhrasj</s> (to fry), <s>sṛj</s> (to create), <s>mṛj</s> (to wipe), <s>yaj</s> (to sacrifice), <s>rāj</s> (to shine), <s>bhrāj</s> (to gleam), and [roots ending in] <s>ch</s> and <s>ś</s>. || PS 8.2.36 ||

body.text: ekāco baśo bhaṣ jhaṣantasya s-dhvoḥ || PS_8,2.37 ||
body.translated_text: [The consonant class] <s>bhaṣ</s> [replaces the final consonant of a] monosyllabic [root from the] <s>baś</s> [class], ending in <s>jhaṣ</s>, before <s>s</s> and <s>dhv</s>. || PS 8.2.37 ||
[This also applies to the root] <s>dadh</s> (from <s>dhā</s>) before <s>t</s> and <s>th</s> also. || PS 8.2.38 ||
[The consonants of the] <s>jhal</s> [class are replaced by the corresponding] <s>jaś</s> [voiced unaspirates] at the end [of a word]. || PS 8.2.39 ||
[The consonant] <s>dh</s> [replaces the final] <s>jhaṣ</s> [consonant] before <s>t</s> and <s>th</s>, and [<s>t</s> and <s>th</s>] become <s>dha</s>. || PS 8.2.40 ||
[The consonant] <s>k</s> [replaces] <s>ṣ</s> and <s>ḍh</s> before <s>s</s>. || PS 8.2.41 ||

body.text: ra-dābhyāṃ niṣthāto naḥ pūrvasya ca daḥ || PS_8,2.42 ||
body.translated_text: [The consonant] <s>n</s> [replaces the final consonant] of a past participle (<s>niṣṭhā</s>) after <s>r</s> and <s>d</s>, and the <s>d</s> of the prior [element also becomes <s>n</s>]. || PS 8.2.42 ||

[<s>N</s> replaces the final consonant of the <s>niṣṭhā</s>] after a root (<s>dhātu</s>) beginning with a consonant cluster (<s>saṃyogādi</s>), starting with <s>a</s>, and containing <s>yaṇ</s> [semivowels]. || PS 8.2.43 ||
[<s>N</s> replaces the <s>niṣṭhā</s> final] after the <s>Lvādi</s> roots. || PS 8.2.44 ||
And [<s>n</s> replaces the <s>niṣṭhā</s> final] after [a root marked with] <s>odit</s>. || PS 8.2.45 ||
[<s>N</s> replaces the <s>niṣṭhā</s> final of the root] <s>kṣi</s> (to destroy) after a long [vowel]. || PS 8.2.46 ||
[<s>N</s> replaces the <s>niṣṭhā</s> final of the root] <s>śyā</s> (to coagulate) when not in the sense of a non-contact [substance] (<s>asparśa</s>). || PS 8.2.47 ||
[<s>N</s> replaces the <s>niṣṭhā</s> final of the root] <s>añc</s> (to bend) when not in the sense of <s>apādāna</s> (ablative). || PS 8.2.48 ||
[<s>N</s> replaces the <s>niṣṭhā</s> final of the root] <s>div</s> (to play) when not in the sense of gambling (<s>vijigīṣā</s>). || PS 8.2.49 ||
[The form] <s>nirvāṇa</s> [is used when the root <s>vā</s> means] 'not blowing' (<s>avāta</s>). || PS 8.2.50 ||
[The form with] <s>k</s> [is used for the root] <s>śuṣ</s> (to dry). || PS 8.2.51 ||
[The form with] <s>v</s> [is used for the root] <s>pac</s> (to cook). || PS 8.2.52 ||
[The form with] <s>m</s> [is used for the root] <s>kṣā</s> (to burn). || PS 8.2.53 ||
[The form with a different final] is [used for the root] <s>prasty</s> (to spread) optionally. || PS 8.2.54 ||
Without a preverb (<s>anupasarga</s>), [the forms] <s>phulla</s> (blossomed), <s>kṣība</s> (intoxicated), <s>kṛśa</s> (lean), and <s>ullāgha</s> (healed) [are used]. || PS 8.2.55 ||

[Special past participial forms are used] after [the roots] <s>nud</s> (to push), <s>vid</s> (to know), <s>und</s> (to wet), <s>trā</s> (to protect), <s>ghrā</s> (to smell), and <s>hrī</s> (to be ashamed) optionally. || PS 8.2.56 ||
Not [for the roots] <s>dhyā</s> (to meditate), <s>khyā</s> (to tell), <s>pṝ</s> (to fill), <s>mūrcch</s> (to faint), and <s>mad</s> (to be intoxicated). || PS 8.2.57 ||
[The form] <s>vitta</s> [is used for the root <s>vid</s>] in the senses of enjoyment (<s>bhoga</s>) and belief (<s>pratyaya</s>). || PS 8.2.58 ||
[The form] <s>bhinna</s> [is used for the root <s>bhid</s>] in the sense of 'fragment' (<s>śakala</s>). || PS 8.2.59 ||
[The form] <s>ṛṇa</s> [is used for the root <s>ṛ</s>] in the sense of being a debtor (<s>ādhamarṇya</s>). || PS 8.2.60 ||
[The forms] <s>nasatta</s>, <s>niṣatta</s>, <s>anutta</s>, <s>pratūrta</s>, <s>sūrta</s>, and <s>gūrta</s> [are used] in Vedic literature (<s>chandas</s>). || PS 8.2.61 ||
[The final consonant] of a <s>kvin</s>-suffix derivative [is replaced by the corresponding] <s>ku</s> (velar) consonant. || PS 8.2.62 ||
Optionally [<s>ku</s> replacement occurs for the root] <s>naś</s> (to perish). || PS 8.2.63 ||
[The final] <s>m</s> of a root (<s>dhātu</s>) [is replaced by] <s>n</s>. || PS 8.2.64 ||
And [<s>n</s> replaces] <s>m</s> and <s>v</s>. || PS 8.2.65 ||
[The final] <s>s</s> and [the <s>s</s> of] <s>sajuṣ</s> [are replaced by] <s>ru</s>. || PS 8.2.66 ||
[The forms] <s>avayāḥ</s>, <s>śvetavāḥ</s>, and <s>puroḍāḥ</s> also [take <s>ru</s>]. || PS 8.2.67 ||
[The word] <s>ahan</s> (day) [also takes <s>ru</s>]. || PS 8.2.68 ||
[The sound] <s>r</s> [replaces <s>ru</s>] when not before a <s>sup</s> (nominal ending). || PS 8.2.69 ||
[The forms] <s>amnaḥ</s>, <s>ūdhaḥ</s>, and <s>avaḥ</s> [occur] in both ways in Vedic literature (<s>chandas</s>). || PS 8.2.70 ||
And [<s>ru</s> replaces <s>s</s>] of <s>bhuvas</s> in the <s>Mahāvyāhṛti</s> (great utterance). || PS 8.2.71 ||
[The final consonant] of <s>vasu</s> (wealth), <s>sraṃsu</s> (fallen), <s>dhvaṃsu</s> (scattered), and <s>anaḍuh</s> (bull) [is replaced by] <s>d</s>. || PS 8.2.72 ||
[The replacement by <s>d</s> occurs] before <s>tip</s> (third person singular ending), when the [root] does not end in <s>as</s>. || PS 8.2.73 ||
[The final <s>s</s> of a root] optionally becomes <s>r</s> before <s>si</s> (second person singular ending). || PS 8.2.74 ||
And [the <s>d</s> replacement occurs] before <s>s</s>. || PS 8.2.75 ||
[The penultimate] <s>i</s> or <s>u</s> (<s>ik</s>) of a stem (<s>upadhā</s>) [is lengthened] before <s>r</s> or <s>v</s>. || PS 8.2.76 ||
And [the penultimate <s>ik</s> is lengthened] before a consonant (<s>hal</s>). || PS 8.2.77 ||
And [lengthening occurs] in the penultimate (<s>upadhā</s>) [position]. || PS 8.2.78 ||
Not [lengthening occurs] in [the roots] <s>bha</s>, <s>kur</s>, and <s>chur</s> groups. || PS 8.2.79 ||

body.text: adaso 'ser dād u do maḥ || PS_8,2.80 ||
body.translated_text: The <s>s</s> of [the pronoun] <s>adas</s> (that) [is replaced by] <s>d</s> after <s>dā</s>, and [the final] <s>u</s> [replaces <s>a</s>], and [<s>d</s> is replaced by] <s>m</s>. || PS 8.2.80 ||
[The vowel] <s>ī</s> [replaces the vowel] <s>e</s> of <s>eta</s> (this) in the plural (<s>bahuvacana</s>). || PS 8.2.81 ||
[The final vowel] of a sentence (<s>vākya</s>) [marked with] <s>ṭe</s> [becomes] <s>pluta</s> (prolated, three-mora vowel) and <s>udātta</s> (acute-accented). || PS 8.2.82 ||
[<s>Pluta</s> occurs] in returning a greeting (<s>pratyabhivāda</s>), [provided the greeter is] not a <s>Śūdra</s>. || PS 8.2.83 ||
And [<s>pluta</s> occurs] when calling from a distance (<s>dūrāt</s>) or summoning (<s>dhūta</s>). || PS 8.2.84 ||
[<s>Pluta</s> occurs] in [the exclamations] <s>hai</s> and <s>he</s> used with <s>hai</s> and <s>haya</s>. || PS 8.2.85 ||

body.text: guror anṛto 'nantyasya apy ekaikasya prācām || PS_8,2.86 ||
body.translated_text: [<s>Pluta</s> occurs for] each [syllable] of a heavy [word], even when not final, in the [usage of] the easterners (<s>prācām</s>), for [the vowel of] an untruth (<s>anṛta</s>). || PS 8.2.86 ||
[The syllable] <s>om</s> [is prolated] in assent (<s>abhyādāna</s>). || PS 8.2.87 ||
[<s>Pluta</s> occurs with] <s>ye</s> in sacrificial ritual (<s>yajñakarman</s>). || PS 8.2.88 ||
[The syllable] <s>praṇava</s> (<s>om</s>) [replaces the vowel marked with] <s>ṭe</s>. || PS 8.2.89 ||
[<s>Pluta</s> occurs] at the end of a <s>yājyā</s> (sacrificial formula). || PS 8.2.90 ||
[<s>Pluta</s> occurs] at the beginning of <s>brūhi</s> (speak!), <s>preṣya</s> (servant), <s>śrauṣaṭ</s>, <s>vauṣaṭ</s>, and <s>āvaha</s> (bring). || PS 8.2.91 ||
[<s>Pluta</s> occurs in] the <s>Agnīt</s> (fire-kindler's) command (<s>preṣaṇa</s>), and of the subsequent [word] also. || PS 8.2.92 ||
Optionally [<s>pluta</s> occurs] in a response to a question (<s>pṛṣṭaprativacana</s>) with <s>he</s>. || PS 8.2.93 ||
And [<s>pluta</s> occurs] in a censuring question (<s>nigṛhyānuyoga</s>). || PS 8.2.94 ||
[The <s>āmreḍita</s>] iteration [takes <s>pluta</s>] in threat (<s>bhartsana</s>). || PS 8.2.95 ||
A <s>tiṅ</s> (verbal ending) attached to a stem (<s>aṅgayukta</s>) [takes <s>pluta</s>] when there is syntactic expectancy (<s>ākāṅkṣa</s>). || PS 8.2.96 ||
[<s>Pluta</s> occurs] for [words] being deliberated upon (<s>vicāryamāna</s>). || PS 8.2.97 ||
But [<s>pluta</s> occurs on] the prior [word] in common speech (<s>bhāṣā</s>). || PS 8.2.98 ||
And [<s>pluta</s> occurs] in an echo (<s>pratiśravaṇa</s>). || PS 8.2.99 ||
[The <s>pluta</s> syllable is] <s>anudātta</s> (grave) in the final [syllable of] a question (<s>praśnānta</s>) and in [an expression of] deep respect (<s>abhipūjita</s>). || PS 8.2.100 ||
And [<s>anudātta pluta</s> occurs] when <s>cit</s> is used in the sense of comparison (<s>upamārtha</s>). || PS 8.2.101 ||
And [<s>anudātta pluta</s> occurs in the phrase] <s>upari svid āsīt</s> (was it above?). || PS 8.2.102 ||

[The <s>pluta</s> syllable is] <s>svarita</s> (circumflex) in the <s>āmreḍita</s> (iteration) [used in the senses of] reproach (<s>asūyā</s>), approval (<s>sammati</s>), anger (<s>kopa</s>), and contempt (<s>kutsana</s>). || PS 8.2.103 ||

A <s>tiṅ</s> (verbal ending) [takes <s>pluta</s>] when there is syntactic expectancy (<s>ākāṅkṣa</s>) in [expressions of] destruction (<s>kṣiyā</s>), benediction (<s>āśīḥ</s>), and command (<s>praiṣa</s>). || PS 8.2.104 ||
Even [for a word that is] not final, [<s>pluta</s> occurs] in questions (<s>praśna</s>) and narrations (<s>ākhyāna</s>). || PS 8.2.105 ||
In <s>pluta</s> (prolation), [the diphthongs] <s>ai</s> and <s>au</s> [are replaced by] <s>idut</s> [forms]. || PS 8.2.106 ||

body.text: eco 'pragṛhyasya adūrādhdūte pūrvasya ardhasya ad uttarasya+idutau || PS_8,2.107 ||
body.translated_text: [The diphthong] <s>e</s> or <s>o</s> of a non-<s>pragṛhya</s> [vowel] — when calling from not far or from far — the first half [takes] <s>a</s> and the second [takes] <s>idut</s> [forms]. || PS 8.2.107 ||
[The sounds] <s>y</s> and <s>v</s> replace those [diphthongs] before a vowel (<s>ac</s>) in <s>saṃhitā</s> (continuous recitation). || PS 8.2.108 ||
[The final <s>s</s> of] <s>matu</s> and <s>vas</s> [is replaced by] <s>ru</s> in the vocative (<s>sambuddhi</s>) in Vedic literature (<s>chandas</s>). || PS 8.3.1 ||
Here, [the preceding consonant takes] a nasal (<s>anunāsika</s>), but optionally for the prior [element]. || PS 8.3.2 ||
[<s>Visarga</s> replaces <s>s</s>] after <s>a</s> before <s>ṭ</s> invariably. || PS 8.3.3 ||
After a nasal (<s>anunāsika</s>), the subsequent [sound becomes] <s>anusvāra</s>. || PS 8.3.4 ||
[The next sūtra] will state — [<s>m</s> becomes <s>anusvāra</s>] before <s>s</s> in conjunction (<s>sama</s>). || PS 8.3.5 ||
[The <s>n</s> of] <s>pumas</s> (man) [is replaced by <s>anusvāra</s>] before <s>kha</s>, <s>y</s>, <s>am</s>, or a following [consonant]. || PS 8.3.6 ||
[<s>Anusvāra</s> replaces] the <s>n</s> of <s>nas</s> (nose) before <s>ch</s>, <s>v</s>, <s>y</s>, and <s>praśān</s> [class consonants]. || PS 8.3.7 ||
[The <s>n</s> takes <s>anusvāra</s>] in both ways in [the context of] <s>ṛkṣ</s> (Ṛg-Veda verses). || PS 8.3.8 ||
[<s>Visarga</s> replaces <s>s</s>] after a long [vowel] before <s>aṭ</s> [class consonants] within the same <s>pāda</s> (verse-quarter). || PS 8.3.9 ||
[The form] <s>nṝn</s> [is used for <s>nṛ</s>] before <s>p</s>. || PS 8.3.10 ||
[The form] <s>svatavān</s> [is used for <s>svatavas</s>] before <s>pāyu</s> (protector). || PS 8.3.11 ||
[The form] <s>kān</s> [is used] in <s>āmreḍita</s> (iteration). || PS 8.3.12 ||
[There is] elision (<s>lopa</s>) of <s>ḍha</s> before [another] <s>ḍha</s>. || PS 8.3.13 ||
[The sound] <s>r</s> [is elided] before [another] <s>r</s>. || PS 8.3.14 ||
[The sounds <s>s</s> are replaced by] <s>visarjanīya</s> (visarga) before <s>khar</s> (voiceless consonants) and at the end of an utterance (<s>avasāna</s>). || PS 8.3.15 ||
[<s>Visarjanīya</s> replaces the] <s>r</s> [in <s>ru</s>] before a <s>sup</s> (nominal ending). || PS 8.3.16 ||

[The consonant] <s>y</s> [replaces the final of] <s>bho</s>, <s>bhago</s>, <s>agho</s>, and [words ending in] <s>a</s> not preceded [by these], before [a vowel beginning with] <s>aś</s> (i.e., any vowel). || PS_8,3.17 ||
According to <s>Śākaṭāyana</s>, [the replacement] of <s>v</s> and <s>y</s> is with a lighter articulation (<s>laghuprayatnatara</s>). || PS_8,3.18 ||
According to <s>Śākalya</s>, [there is] elision (<s>lopa</s>) [of the final vowel]. || PS_8,3.19 ||
According to <s>Gārgya</s>, [this applies to a final] <s>o</s>. || PS_8,3.20 ||
And [this applies] before [the particle] <s>u</s> within a word (<s>pada</s>). || PS_8,3.21 ||
Before a <s>hal</s> (consonant), [the above rules apply] for all [grammarians]. || PS_8,3.22 ||
[A final] <s>m</s> [is replaced by] <s>anusvāra</s>. || PS_8,3.23 ||
And [the <s>n</s>] of a non-word-final (<s>apadānta</s>) <s>n</s> [is replaced by <s>anusvāra</s>] before a <s>jhal</s> (non-nasal stop or fricative). || PS_8,3.24 ||
[The final] <s>m</s> [is retained] in [the word] <s>rāji</s> [meaning] 'equal' before [the suffix] <s>kva</s>. || PS_8,3.25 ||
Optionally before <s>h</s> when <s>m</s> follows. || PS_8,3.26 ||
Before a <s>n</s>, [<s>anusvāra</s> is replaced by] <s>n</s>. || PS_8,3.27 ||
[After] <s>ṅ</s> and <s>ṇ</s>, [the augments] <s>kuk</s> and <s>ṭuk</s> [are inserted respectively] before a <s>śar</s> (sibilant or <s>h</s>). || PS_8,3.28 ||
[After a] <s>ḍa</s>, before <s>s</s>, [the augment] <s>ḍhuṭ</s> [is inserted]. || PS_8,3.29 ||
And [after] <s>n</s> [the same augment is inserted]. || PS_8,3.30 ||
Before <s>ś</s>, [the augment] <s>tuk</s> [is inserted]. || PS_8,3.31 ||

body.text: ṅamo hrasvād aci ṅamuṇ nityam || PS_8,3.32 ||
body.translated_text: After a short [vowel followed by] <s>ṅam</s> (a nasal), before a vowel (<s>ac</s>), [the augment] <s>ṅamun</s> is invariably [inserted]. || PS_8,3.32 ||
[After] <s>m</s> followed by <s>a</s>, before <s>u</s>, [the replacement is] <s>v</s> optionally. || PS_8,3.33 ||
[In place] of <s>visarjanīya</s>, [there is] <s>s</s>. || PS_8,3.34 ||
Before a <s>śar</s> (sibilant) followed by a <s>par</s> (voiceless stop), [the replacement is] <s>visarjanīya</s>. || PS_8,3.35 ||
Optionally before a <s>śar</s> (sibilant). || PS_8,3.36 ||
Before <s>ku</s> (velar) and <s>pu</s> (labial), [there is respectively] <s>jihvāmūlīya</s> and <s>upadhmānīya</s>. || PS_8,3.37 ||
[The <s>visarjanīya</s> is replaced by] <s>s</s> when not at the beginning of a <s>pada</s> (word). || PS_8,3.38 ||
After <s>iṇ</s> (<s>i</s> or <s>u</s>), [the replacement is] <s>ṣ</s>. || PS_8,3.39 ||
[This applies to <s>s</s>] after <s>namas</s> and <s>puras</s> when they are <s>gati</s> (preverbs). || PS_8,3.40 ||
And [after a word] having <s>i</s> or <s>u</s> as penultimate (<s>upadhā</s>), [provided it is] not a suffix (<s>pratyaya</s>). || PS_8,3.41 ||
[After] <s>tiras</s>, optionally. || PS_8,3.42 ||
[After] <s>dvis</s>, <s>tris</s>, <s>catur</s>, [when used] in the sense of 'times' (<s>kṛtvas</s>). || PS_8,3.43 ||
[After words ending in] <s>is</s> or <s>us</s>, [provided there is] semantic connection (<s>sāmarthya</s>). || PS_8,3.44 ||
Invariably in a compound (<s>samāsa</s>), [provided the <s>s</s>] does not belong to a subsequent member (<s>uttarapada</s>). || PS_8,3.45 ||

After [a word ending in] <s>a</s>, [the <s>s</s> changes to <s>ṣ</s> in the words] <s>kṛ</s>, <s>kami</s>, <s>kaṃsa</s>, <s>kumbha</s>, <s>pātra</s>, <s>kuśā</s>, and <s>karṇī</s>, [provided the preceding word is] not an indeclinable (<s>avyaya</s>). || PS_8,3.46 ||
[After] <s>adhaḥ</s> and <s>śiras</s>, within a <s>pada</s> (word). || PS_8,3.47 ||
And in [the words beginning with] <s>kaska</s> (the <s>kaskādi</s> list). || PS_8,3.48 ||
In Vedic usage (<s>chandas</s>), optionally, [provided the word is] not a reduplicated form (<s>āmreḍita</s>). || PS_8,3.49 ||
[The change to <s>ṣ</s> occurs in] <s>kaḥkara</s>, <s>karati</s>, <s>kṛdhi</s>, and <s>kṛta</s>, [but] not [after] <s>anadi</s>. || PS_8,3.50 ||
[<s>S</s> changes to <s>ṣ</s> after] a fifth-case (ablative) ending, [when the meaning is] 'up to' (<s>parā</s>) or 'for the purpose of' (<s>avadhi</s>). || PS_8,3.51 ||
And in [the word] <s>pāta</s>, frequently (<s>bahulam</s>). || PS_8,3.52 ||

[<s>S</s> changes to <s>ṣ</s> after] a sixth-case (genitive) ending before [the words] <s>pati</s>, <s>putra</s>, <s>pṛṣṭha</s>, <s>pāra</s>, <s>pada</s>, <s>payas</s>, and <s>poṣa</s>. || PS_8,3.53 ||
Optionally [after the word] <s>iḍā</s>. || PS_8,3.54 ||
[The <s>s</s>] not at the end of a <s>pada</s> [is replaced by] a retroflex (<s>mūrdhanya</s>, i.e., <s>ṣ</s>). || PS_8,3.55 ||
