[In the word] <s>sāḍha</s> derived from <s>sah</s>, [the replacement of <s>s</s> is] <s>ṣ</s>. || PS_8,3.56 ||
[This <s>ṣatva</s> occurs also] after <s>iṇ</s> (<s>i</s>, <s>u</s>) and <s>k</s>. || PS_8,3.57 ||
Even with [an intervening] <s>n</s>, <s>visarjanīya</s>, or <s>śar</s> (sibilant). || PS_8,3.58 ||
[This applies when the <s>s</s> belongs to] a substitute (<s>ādeśa</s>) or a suffix (<s>pratyaya</s>). || PS_8,3.59 ||
And [this applies to the <s>s</s>] of <s>śās</s>, <s>vas</s>, and <s>ghas</s>. || PS_8,3.60 ||
[The <s>ṣatva</s> occurs] only in [the suffixes] <s>stut</s> and <s>ṇy</s> after reduplication (<s>abhyāsa</s>) when preceded by <s>ṣaṇ</s> (six). || PS_8,3.61 ||
[The replacement is] <s>ṣ</s> for [the <s>s</s> of] <s>svid</s>, <s>svad</s>, and <s>sah</s>. || PS_8,3.62 ||
Before <s>sit</s> (the <s>s</s> of an <s>ārdhadhātuka</s> suffix), [the change to <s>ṣ</s> extends to the augment] <s>aṭ</s>, even with an intervening element. || PS_8,3.63 ||
In [the suffixes beginning with] <s>su</s> etc., [the <s>ṣatva</s> of] the reduplicative syllable (<s>abhyāsa</s>) [occurs] also by [proximity to] the reduplicative syllable. || PS_8,3.64 ||

After a <s>upasarga</s> (preverb), [the <s>s</s> changes to <s>ṣ</s> in the roots] <s>su</s> (to press), <s>su</s> (to impel), <s>sya</s>, <s>stu</s> (to praise), <s>stobh</s> (to exclaim), <s>sthā</s> (to stand), <s>senaya</s>, <s>sedh</s> (to obstruct), <s>sic</s> (to sprinkle), <s>sañj</s> (to attach), and <s>svañj</s> (to embrace). || PS_8,3.65 ||
[The root] <s>sad</s> [undergoes <s>ṣatva</s> after a preverb] except after <s>prati</s>. || PS_8,3.66 ||
[Also the root] <s>stambh</s> (to support). || PS_8,3.67 ||
And [the root] <s>añc</s> after <s>ava</s> in the sense of 'hanging down' and 'being far'. || PS_8,3.68 ||
And [the root] <s>svan</s> (to sound) after <s>vi</s> in the sense of eating (<s>bhojana</s>). || PS_8,3.69 ||

After <s>pari</s>, <s>ni</s>, and <s>vi</s>, [the <s>s</s> changes to <s>ṣ</s> in the roots] <s>sev</s> (to serve), <s>sit</s> (to bind), <s>say</s> (to go), <s>siv</s> (to sew), <s>sah</s> (to endure), <s>suṭ</s>, <s>stu</s> (to praise), and <s>svañj</s> (to embrace). || PS_8,3.70 ||
Optionally for [the roots beginning with] <s>siv</s> etc., even with [the augment] <s>aṭ</s> intervening. || PS_8,3.71 ||

After <s>vi</s>, [the <s>s</s> of] <s>skand</s> (to leap) [changes to <s>ṣ</s>], not in the <s>superlative</s> (<s>iṣṭhā</s>). || PS_8,3.73 ||
And after <s>pari</s>. || PS_8,3.74 ||

[The <s>s</s> of] <s>sphur</s> (to throb) and <s>sphul</s> (to spring) [changes to <s>ṣ</s>] after <s>nir</s>, <s>ni</s>, and <s>vi</s>. || PS_8,3.76 ||
After <s>vi</s>, [the <s>s</s> of] <s>skabhnā</s> (to prop) [changes to <s>ṣ</s>] invariably. || PS_8,3.77 ||

In a compound, [after] <s>aṅguli</s> (finger), [the <s>s</s> of] <s>saṅga</s> (attachment) [changes to <s>ṣ</s>]. || PS_8,3.80 ||
[After] <s>bhīru</s> (timid), [the <s>s</s> of] <s>sthāna</s> (place) [changes to <s>ṣ</s>]. || PS_8,3.81 ||
After <s>Agni</s>, [the <s>s</s> of] <s>stut</s>, <s>stoma</s>, and <s>soma</s> [changes to <s>ṣ</s>]. || PS_8,3.82 ||
After <s>jyotis</s> (light) and <s>āyus</s> (life), [the <s>s</s> of] <s>stoma</s> [changes to <s>ṣ</s>]. || PS_8,3.83 ||
After <s>mātṛ</s> (mother) and <s>pitṛ</s> (father), [the <s>s</s> of] <s>svasā</s> (sister) [changes to <s>ṣ</s>]. || PS_8,3.84 ||

[The word is] <s>sūtra</s> [and the form is] <s>pratiṣṇāta</s> (well-bathed). || PS_8,3.90 ||

After <s>gavi</s> (cow) and <s>yudhi</s> (battle), [the <s>s</s> of] <s>sthira</s> (firm) [changes to <s>ṣ</s>]. || PS_8,3.95 ||

And in [the words beginning with] <s>suṣāma</s> (the <s>suṣāmādi</s> list). || PS_8,3.98 ||
After a short [vowel], before [a suffix beginning with] <s>t</s> etc., in a <s>taddhita</s> (secondary derivative suffix). || PS_8,3.99 ||
[After] <s>nisas</s>, [<s>ṣatva</s> occurs in the root] <s>tap</s> (to heat) in the sense of penance, but not in the sense of service (<s>anāsevana</s>). || PS_8,3.100 ||
[The change to <s>ṣ</s> occurs] after <s>yuṣmad</s> (you) and <s>tad</s> (that), and in [the word] <s>takṣu</s>, within a <s>pada</s> (word). || PS_8,3.101 ||
In [the form] <s>yujuṣ</s>, according to some [grammarians]. || PS_8,3.102 ||
[<s>Ṣatva</s> occurs] in <s>stuta</s> and <s>stoma</s> in Vedic usage (<s>chandas</s>). || PS_8,3.103 ||
[<s>Ṣatva</s> occurs in the <s>s</s> coming] from the prior member of a compound (<s>pūrvapada</s>). || PS_8,3.104 ||
[Also in the <s>s</s> of the root] <s>su</s> (to press Soma). || PS_8,3.105 ||
[Also in the <s>s</s> of the <s>ana</s> suffix after] <s>san</s> (to gain). || PS_8,3.106 ||
And [in the <s>s</s>] of <s>sah</s> (to endure) before <s>pṛtanā</s> (army) and <s>ṛta</s> (truth). || PS_8,3.107 ||

Not [in the case of words] beginning with <s>rapara</s>, <s>sṛp</s> (to creep), <s>sṛj</s> (to release), <s>spṛś</s> (to touch), <s>spṛh</s> (to desire), <s>savana</s> (pressing), etc. || PS_8,3.108 ||
[The <s>s</s> changes to <s>ṣ</s> after] <s>sāt</s> at the beginning or end of a <s>pada</s>. || PS_8,3.109 ||

After <s>ni</s>, <s>vi</s>, and <s>abhi</s>, optionally even with [the augment] <s>aṭ</s> intervening, in Vedic usage (<s>chandas</s>). || PS_8,3.117 ||
After <s>r</s> and <s>ṣ</s>, [the consonant] <s>n</s> [is replaced by] <s>ṇ</s> within the same word (<s>samānapada</s>). || PS_8,4.1 ||

[<s>Ṇatva</s> occurs when the <s>r</s> or <s>ṣ</s> is] in the prior member of a compound (<s>pūrvapada</s>), in a proper name (<s>sañjñā</s>), but not [after] <s>a</s> (i.e., the negative prefix). || PS_8,4.3 ||
[<s>Ṇatva</s> occurs in the <s>n</s> of] <s>vana</s> (forest) after <s>puraga</s>, <s>miśraka</s>, <s>sidraka</s> (<s>śidraka</s>), <s>śārikā</s>, <s>koṭara</s>, and <s>agra</s>. || PS_8,4.4 ||

After a <s>upasarga</s> (preverb), frequently (<s>bahulam</s>). || PS_8,4.28 ||

Optionally after [the causative suffix] <s>ṇi</s>. || PS_8,4.30 ||

[This <s>ṇatva</s> applies when the triggering sound is] at the end of a <s>pada</s> (word). || PS_8,4.37 ||
Even with a <s>pada</s> (word boundary) intervening. || PS_8,4.38 ||
And in [the words beginning with] <s>kṣubhna</s> (the <s>kṣubhnādi</s> list). || PS_8,4.39 ||
[The consonants] <s>s</s> and <s>t</s>-series [are replaced by] <s>ś</s> and <s>c</s>-series respectively when followed by a <s>ścu</s> (palatal). || PS_8,4.40 ||

[The <s>d</s>] of <s>ud</s> (prefix) [is replaced by] the preceding [consonant's class, i.e., <s>s</s> or <s>th</s>,] before <s>sthā</s> (to stand) and <s>stambh</s> (to support). || PS_8,4.61 ||

[The particle] <s>a</s> [followed by] <s>a</s> <s>iti</s> [i.e., the repetition of <s>a</s> denotes the end of the treatise]. || PS_8,4.68 ||
